We measured what changes when security requirements, selected from a governed security-by-design knowledge base (SbD-ToE) and delivered through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, are given to the generator at the point of execution. On DualGauge, which scores with a language-model judge, we ran 59 Python tasks: the share of tasks passing all security tests rose from 44.1% to 78.0% and the share of security tests passed from 77.4% to 93.0%. On BaxBench, which runs functional tests and real exploits in containers, we ran 28 backend scenarios: among functionally correct solutions, the share with no successful exploit rose from 65% to 86%, comparable to the authors' Oracle Security Reminder (85%), which they call an unrealistic upper bound; the requirement delivery reached it without knowing the tests. The study has limits. The pre-specified joint secure-and-functional metric did not improve significantly on either benchmark. The code written with the governed requirements is stricter, and it failed functional tests that fix values the task never states; we attribute those failures case by case in a post-hoc analysis. Each experiment used one model and one generation per task. The requirements come from the author's open-source manual; we do not assess its completeness. Governed security requirements delivered at the point of execution appear to improve the security of generated code. Current benchmarks cannot tell whether that code meets the security requirements that apply to it, only whether it shows the weaknesses their evaluators were built to detect. We propose measuring conformance with the applicable requirements.

AI.tldr: 在执行点通过MCP服务器向代码生成智能体提供来自SbD-ToE知识库的治理型安全需求，能显著提升生成代码的安全性（DualGauge全安全测试通过率44.1%→78.0%；BaxBench无漏洞比例65%→86%），但联合安全与功能指标未显著提升，且现有基准无法判断代码是否满足适用的安全需求。
AI.motivation: Security by design要求编写代码前就定义安全需求，但现有安全代码基准通常不给需求、还用未见过的安全测试评分，与设计初衷相反。作者想测量在执行时点提供治理型安全需求会带来什么变化。
AI.method: 从治理型安全设计知识库SbD-ToE中选取安全需求，通过MCP服务器在执行点提供给生成器；在DualGauge（LLM评审）上跑59个Python任务，在BaxBench（容器内功能测试+真实漏洞利用）上跑28个后端场景进行对比。
AI.result: DualGauge上全部安全测试通过率44.1%→78.0%，安全测试通过比例77.4%→93.0%；BaxBench功能正确方案中无成功漏洞利用比例65%→86%，接近作者称为不现实上界的Oracle Security Reminder（85%），且无需知道测试内容。局限：预先设定的联合安全+功能指标在两个基准上均未显著提升；代码更严格，因固定任务未说明的取值而失败于功能测试（已逐案归因）；每实验仅用一模型、每任务一次生成；需求来自作者开源手册，未评估其完备性。
AI.conclusion: 在执行点提供治理型安全需求似乎能提升生成代码安全性；但当前基准只能检测其评估器针对的弱点，无法判断代码是否满足适用的安全需求，作者建议改为度量与适用需求的一致性。

title: MESSENGER: Memory-Enhanced Sequential Scene Flow Estimation via Autoregressive Next-Frame Forecasting
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code will be released at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger
summary: Scene flow can capture low-level 3D motion displacements in dynamic scenarios. Early pairwise estimators relying on instantaneous two-frame motion lack long-term temporal correlation and also struggle with poor extrapolation ability in future prediction. Although some recent methods attempt to explore multi-frame scene flow estimation in a sequence-to-sequence manner, they typically suffer from heavy computational overhead with increasing input frames and long-horizon prediction degradation due to ineffective motion propagation. To address these problems, we propose a novel memory-enhanced sequential scene flow pipeline, called MESSENGER. To sufficiently mine long-term temporal dependencies naturally within consecutive sequences, a memory buffer is designed by explicitly storing multiple history flow estimates and latent states. For each input frame, the temporally stored flows and states are correlated and retrieved to predict the current initialized flow in a next-frame forecasting manner. Furthermore, we develop an uncertainty-aware reweighting module to filter unreliable retrievals and mitigate accumulated errors. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of our MESSENGER, reducing EPE3D by 71.6% on nuScenes and 67.7% on Argoverse 2 in long-horizon future extrapolation. This superiority can be attributed to our designed autoregressive forecasting paradigm, which naturally forces the network to progressively learn the next-frame distribution based on history observations. Code will be released at https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger.

AI.tldr: 提出MESSENGER，一种记忆增强的序列化场景流估计框架，通过显式存储历史流与隐状态的记忆缓冲，以自回归预测方式估计当前帧流，并利用不确定性重加权过滤不可靠检索，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上大幅降低长时外推误差。
AI.motivation: 早期基于瞬时两帧运动的成对估计器缺乏长期时序关联，未来预测外推能力差；近期多帧序列到序列方法则随输入帧数增加计算开销大，且因运动传播无效导致长时预测性能退化。
AI.method: 设计记忆缓冲显式存储多个历史流估计与隐状态；对每帧输入，相关并检索时序存储的流和状态，以"下一帧预测"方式初始化当前流；引入不确定性感知重加权模块过滤不可靠检索、缓解累积误差。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上达到SOTA，长时未来外推中EPE3D分别降低71.6%和67.7%。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升源于所设计的自回归预测范式，迫使网络基于历史观测逐步学习下一帧分布。代码将开源。

title: Overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) Task
summary: In this paper, we provide an overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) task. Building on the success of the NTCIR-18 core task AEOLLM, we proposed AEOLLM-2 for NTCIR-19 to further investigate automatic evaluation methods for Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly in long-form text generation scenarios. In AEOLLM-2, we introduced a new subtask, Deep Research Evaluation, which focuses on the automatic evaluation of long-form deep research reports generated by LLMs. Participants developed evaluation methods to automatically assess the quality of these reports, and the performance of each method was measured by comparing its scores against human-annotated ground-truth labels. This year, we received 91 runs from 10 teams in total. This paper describes the background of the task, the dataset construction, the evaluation measures, the participants' methods, and the final evaluation results.

AI.tldr: 本文概述NTCIR-19 AEOLLM-2任务，聚焦长文本生成场景下LLM自动评估，新增长篇深度研究报告评估子任务，共收到10队91个提交。
AI.motivation: 延续NTCIR-18 AEOLLM任务的成功，进一步探索LLM自动评估方法，尤其针对长文本生成场景。
AI.method: 引入新子任务Deep Research Evaluation，评估LLM生成的长篇深度研究报告质量；参与者开发自动评估方法，通过与人工标注的真值对比衡量性能。
AI.result: 共收到来自10支团队的91个提交运行结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文介绍了任务背景、数据集构建、评估指标、参与者方法及最终评估结果。

title: Optimally Pacing Budget Spending and Learning
summary:
We establish near-optimal regret bounds for budget-constrained online learning against arbitrary classes of budget-pacing experts in the adversarial setting. In particular, given any class of $F$ experts and a candidate budget pacing schedule, we provide a full-information algorithm which obtains regret $O(D \sqrt{\log F}+ \sqrt{T\log F})$ against all experts whose cumulative spending stays within distance $D$ of this schedule, matching lower bounds established by Braverman et al. (2025).
  We additionally show that our technique extends to various problems in online resource allocation, where the learner gets to see the rewards and costs of the current options available to them, and establish $O(D\sqrt{\log F})$ regret bounds when fractional allocation is allowed. This is the first algorithm we are aware of which can achieve $o(\sqrt{T})$ guarantees for such tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对对抗性预算约束在线学习，给出匹配下界的近最优 regret 界，并推广到在线资源分配问题。
AI.motivation: 预算约束在线学习在对抗环境下难以获得最优保证，已有下界与算法之间存在差距；同时在线资源分配通常只能得到 Ω(√T) 级别保证，缺乏亚 √T 的算法。
AI.method: 给定 F 个专家与候选预算支出节奏（pacing schedule），设计全信息算法，其 regret 相对所有累计支出与节奏距离不超过 D 的专家为 O(D√log F + √(T log F))；并将该技术扩展到在线资源分配，在允许分数分配时取得 O(D√log F)。
AI.result: regret 达到 O(D√log F + √(T log F))，匹配 Braverman 等（2025）的下界；在在线资源分配的分数分配情形取得 O(D√log F)，首次实现 o(√T) 保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为预算约束在线学习提供近最优算法，并首次在相关资源分配任务中突破 √T 障碍，拓展了该领域的理论边界。

title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActiveMedAgent，将临床顺序诊断的成本感知逻辑引入多模态医学AI，通过离线训练轻量MLP控制器决策何时获取额外证据、何时下诊断。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断本质是顺序性的：医生只有在预期额外证据能解决诊断不确定性时，才从廉价检查升级到昂贵检查。现有医学AI通常一次性使用全部模态，忽略了这种成本感知的顺序逻辑。
AI.method: 基于冻结的、通过API访问的视觉语言模型，跟踪候选诊断的概率分布，并按"每步诊断效用减成本"对每次证据获取打分；再用这些打分轨迹离线训练一个轻量MLP控制器，学习何时请求额外证据、何时做出诊断。
AI.result: 在三个常用基准上，基于轨迹的策略学习一致优于无引导获取和全模态基线。发现"信息过载效应"：在175个案例中，智能体用更少通道即做出正确诊断，而全模态基线失败。
AI.conclusion: 学习"忽略什么"与学习"获取什么"同样重要；成本感知的顺序获取策略能提升多模态医学AI的诊断效率与准确性。

title: Lossy Compressive Text Autoencoders
summary: Our work explores learning a compressed latent representation of text, at the intersection of data compression and representation learning. We propose an autoencoder architecture that performs residual downscaling and upscaling of hidden representations along the time axis, with a residual low-dimension discrete bottleneck. We analyze our approach for different quantization methods, training objectives, and datasets. For different levels of compression, we evaluate the similarity between the original and reconstructed text both at the surface-level (BLEU) and at the semantic-level (LLM-based judge). Additionally, we evaluate our models on downstream question-answering and semantic text similarity benchmarks. Our approach results in compressed representations which are on par with lossless text compression algorithms at 2.24 bits per byte on web text data, while having good reconstruction and downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自编码器架构，沿时间轴对隐表示进行残差下采样/上采样并配低维离散瓶颈，实现文本压缩潜在表示学习。
AI.motivation: 在数据压缩与表示学习的交叉点，探索文本的压缩潜在表示。
AI.method: 自编码器架构，沿时间轴对隐藏表示做残差下采样与上采样，并使用残差低维离散瓶颈；分析了不同量化方法、训练目标和数据集。
AI.result: 在web文本上达到2.24 bits/byte，与无损压缩算法相当；重建质量（BLEU表面级与LLM语义级）和下游问答、语义文本相似度任务表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 该压缩潜在表示在压缩率、重建质量与下游任务性能之间取得良好平衡。

title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
comment: 14 pages, 5 tables. Code, configuration and per-run outputs: https://github.com/rav11l/cace-bench (v0.6.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23207546)
summary: Self-improving LLM agents can adapt a credit pipeline to a changed rule, but an agent that rewrites itself destroys the artefact a supervisor reviews: a named change, a recorded test, an approval. We argue that self-evolution is reviewable only if it is confined to the runtime harness (instruction text, tool-call logic and primitive composition) while model weights stay fixed, so that every adaptation is a diff with a cause and a test attached. We give a dual-loop engine built on that bound, with one admission gate that writes a hash-chained record before deployment, and we measure the gate in simulation, with a simulated agent and a seeded-search proposer rather than language models. Across three families of supervisory re-interpretation at three severities, 10 seeds each, the gated loop admitted 144 of 7,449 candidate changes, none of which worsened error on held-out history, and restored the false-positive rate to the oracle level without raising missed flags in every low- and mid-severity cell. With the gate replaced by the check an unbounded system applies (fewer errors visible in recent traces), the same loops admitted 309 harmful changes and left missed flags above 10% in 49 of 90 runs: false positives fell because the screen was loosened. Evaluated on pre-shift labels, the gate rejected every candidate, so a re-interpretation must be encoded as a rule that relabels history. Parametric and scope shifts were repaired locally, a structural one only by primitive replacement; at the highest structural severity the gate's fixed tolerance blocked the correct replacement in half the seeds. We map the mechanisms to the EU AI Act's provisions for high-risk credit scoring and note that the April 2026 US model-risk guidance excludes agentic AI from its scope.

AI.tldr: 论文主张自进化LLM代理只有将演化限定在运行时harness（指令文本、工具调用逻辑、原语组合）而固定模型权重，才可审计；提出双环引擎与哈希链记录的准入闸门，并在仿真中验证其安全性。
AI.motivation: 自进化代理能适应规则变化，但自我重写会破坏监督者审查所需的工件（具名变更、记录测试、审批），导致不可审计。
AI.method: 提出受限自我演化的双环引擎：演化限于运行时harness，权重固定；部署前由准入闸门写入哈希链记录。以仿真代理与种子搜索提案者（非语言模型）进行实验，覆盖三类监督再解释家族、三种严重度、每项10个种子。
AI.result: 闸门环路在7,449个候选中仅接纳144个，均未恶化留出历史误差，并在所有低、中严重度单元中把假阳性率恢复到oracle水平且未提高漏报。对照的无限制检查则接纳309个有害变更，90次运行中49次漏报超10%，假阳性下降仅因筛查放宽。基于偏移前标签评估时闸门拒绝所有候选，说明再解释须编码为重新标注历史的规则。参数与范围偏移可局部修复，结构偏移只能靠原语替换；最高结构严重度下固定容忍度有一半种子阻挡了正确替换。
AI.conclusion: 可审计的自我演化应限定于harness并以带因果与测试的diff形式记录。研究映射到EU AI Act高风险信贷评分条款，并指出2026年4月美国模型风险指南将代理式AI排除在其范围之外。

title: When Routing Reveals Membership: Privacy Leakage from MoE Router Telemetry
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models produce routing information during inference that may be logged or exposed for monitoring, debugging, load analysis, and safety auditing. Unlike ordinary model outputs, this telemetry reveals a view of the model's internal computation, raising a privacy question: can it reveal whether an example was used to fine-tune the deployed model? We introduce a router-augmented membership inference attack that combines conventional output-side signals with aggregated routing features and applies a membership classifier learned from independently fine-tuned shadow models to the target model. Across three MoE architectures and three data domains, router telemetry consistently improves membership inference over a strong output-signal ensemble, increasing TPR at 1\% FPR by 2.7--9.4 percentage points across all nine settings. The leakage persists across full fine-tuning, frozen-router training, LoRA, and instruction tuning, and remains observable with only discrete expert selections, restricted telemetry, or a single shadow model. Mechanistic analysis further shows that the leakage does not require router-specific memorization: fine-tuning introduces membership information into hidden representations, while the router exposes a projection of this signal even when its parameters are frozen. Perturbing the telemetry reduces this additional leakage only as its fidelity degrades. Our results show that router telemetry can turn an operational signal into an additional privacy surface for fine-tuned MoE models.

AI.tldr: MoE模型的router遥测信息会泄露成员身份信息，router-augmented MIA在各设定下均优于纯输出信号的攻击。
AI.motivation: MoE推理时的路由信息常被记录用于监控、调试和安全审计，它暴露了模型内部计算视图。这引出隐私问题：路由遥测能否揭示某个样本是否被用于微调该模型？
AI.method: 提出router-augmented成员推理攻击，将传统输出侧信号与聚合路由特征结合，并用独立微调的shadow models训练成员分类器，再应用于目标模型。
AI.result: 在3种MoE架构和3个数据域共9个设定中，TPR@1%FPR提升2.7–9.4个百分点；泄露在全量微调、冻结router、LoRA、指令微调下持续存在，仅用离散专家选择、受限遥测或单个shadow model也可观测。
AI.conclusion: 机制分析表明泄露不依赖router特定记忆：微调将成员信息注入隐藏表示，router即使参数冻结也会投影出该信号；扰动遥测仅随其保真度下降而减少泄露。路由遥测将运维信号变成微调MoE模型的额外隐私面。

title: Cross-Provider Review as a Runtime Contract for Coding Agents: A Controlled Pilot and Fault-Injection Study
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Project page: https://openterminalagent.surge.sh/
summary: Coding agents increasingly share a workstation while drawing on separate providers and subscription allowances. A second agent can inspect a completed answer, but the call spends another pool and may provide no substantive finding. We describe an advisory cross-provider review contract: distinct resource pools, bounded execution, restricted reviewer capabilities, complete input delivery, usable semantic output, explicit failure states and durable per-attempt evidence. In a controlled, agent-authored pilot of 20 paired development turns, eight had a material reviewer finding (95% exact interval 19.1-63.9%). A boundary-condition scan across both reviewer backends reproduced a previously discovered false success on partial input: four truncation levels passed historically and failed after repair. The scan also found and repaired cancellation during process reaping. In real CLI probes, Claude had no writing tools; Codex attempted writes in five of five read-only trials, each write tool failed, and no disposable repository changed. These tests cover specified paths and versions, not field reliability. A preregistered shadow study of metadata-only review allocation accrued 25 formal observations before an exact-runtime regression found a third defect: a reviewer exiting nonzero with a well-formed verdict was counted as complete. Exit status was not recorded per attempt, so exposure cannot be resolved retrospectively. The 25 formal and two pending records remain an audit cohort; the measurement-valid cohort restarted at zero and collection has begun. No gate result is reported.

AI.tldr: 提出跨供应商"顾问式评审契约"（独立资源池、有界执行、受限评审权限、完整输入、可用语义输出、显式失败态、逐次可审计证据），并用20轮试点的实证结果说明其可行性边界。
AI.motivation: 编码代理常在同一工作站上使用不同供应商与订阅额度；额外让第二个代理检查已完成答案会消耗另一资源池，且可能毫无实质发现，因此需要一种受控、可审计的跨供应商评审机制。
AI.method: 设计顾问式跨供应商评审契约；在20对代理自撰的开发轮次中做受控试点；对两个评审后端做边界条件扫描（含部分输入截断、进程回收期取消）；真实CLI探针测试写权限；并开展预注册的"仅元数据"评审分配影子研究。
AI.result: 20轮中8轮出现实质性评审发现（95%精确区间19.1–63.9%）；复现了部分输入下的"假成功"（四个截断级别历史通过、修复后失败）；发现并修复了回收期取消缺陷；Claude无写入工具，Codex在5/5只读试验中尝试写入但均失败、无可丢弃仓库被改动；影子研究累积25条正式观察后发现第三处缺陷（非零退出但格式正确判定的评审被计为完成），由于未逐次记录退出状态，暴露无法回溯解析。
AI.conclusion: 25条正式记录与2条待定记录作为审计队列保留，测量有效队列从零重启；未报告任何门槛（gate）结果。当前结论仅覆盖指定路径与版本，不代表真实场景可靠性。

title: DOGS: Design-Space Sampling for Prompt-Driven Logo Generation
summary: Prompt optimization for text-to-image (T2I) generation has been pursued almost entirely as text rewriting, in which a short user brief is expanded into a longer, model-preferred token sequence. We argue that such a language-space formulation is ill-suited to structured visual design tasks such as logo creation, where a one-line brief leaves most design decisions unspecified. These decisions depend on relational priors that a linear sequence cannot encode, and they leave an uncontrolled channel through which protected marks may be reproduced. We therefore recast logo prompting as sampling within a structured design space, and instantiate this idea as DOGS (Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler). From a large corpus of real-world logos, we mine a typed, graph-structured design grammar whose edges record empirical co-occurrence. A GFlowNet sampler then generates design graphs with probability proportional to a terminal reward that combines recognizability, aesthetics, and corpus-relative originality. Every slot draws only from a closed design-level vocabulary, and any infringement-inducing or harmful token is removed during parsing. The originality reward further penalizes proximity to existing logos, thereby incorporating infringement avoidance into the method by construction. On two open-source renderers and against nine baselines, DOGS produces logos that are more recognizable and aesthetic, substantially more diverse, and far less prone to trademark infringement.

AI.tldr: 将logo提示优化从文本改写重新表述为结构化设计空间采样，提出DOGS方法。
AI.motivation: 文本改写式提示优化不适合logo等结构化视觉设计任务：一句话简介未指定的设计决策依赖关系先验，无法用线性序列编码，且存在受保护标记被复现的不可控通道。
AI.method: 从真实logo语料挖掘带类型的图结构设计语法（边记录共现），用GFlowNet采样器按终态奖励（可识别性、美学、语料相对原创性）比例生成设计图；每个槽位仅从封闭设计级词表取词，解析时移除侵权/有害token，原创性奖励惩罚与已有logo的接近度。
AI.result: 在两个开源渲染器上、对比九个基线，DOGS生成的logo更可识别、更美观、多样性显著更高，且更不易涉及商标侵权。
AI.conclusion: 在结构化设计空间中进行提示采样可有效提升logo生成质量，并通过构造融入侵权规避。

title: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking
summary: Similar agent skills can share instructions but differ in their conditions of use. Query-based text selection may retain shared instructions and omit these distinctions. We introduce SkillContrast, a training-free selector that compares retrieved skills and retains their differing text with local context for a pretrained reranker. On 1,235 requests from SameCapRisk-Bench, it yields 54-72 more clean hits (requests that retrieve a helpful skill without its marked risky sibling) than TF-IDF query selection at identical per-candidate input lengths, across 2 retrievers and 2 reranker sizes. Length-matched component replacements identify differing text as the main contributor in the primary setting, with smaller, mixed context effects. Relative to full skill bodies, SkillContrast uses 51.1-58.8% fewer model-input tokens, with 10-18 fewer clean hits at 0.6B and matching or higher observed clean-hit counts at 4B. Candidate-relative differences thus complement query relevance in selecting compact reranking inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillContrast：一种免训练的技能选择器，通过比较检索到的相似技能、保留差异文本及局部上下文，供预训练重排器使用。
AI.motivation: 相似智能技能可共享指令但在使用条件上有差异，基于查询的文本选择可能保留共享指令而遗漏这些区别。
AI.method: SkillContrast 比较检索到的技能，保留其差异文本及局部上下文，供预训练重排器使用（免训练）。在 SameCapRisk-Bench 的 1,235 条请求上，跨 2 种检索器和 2 种重排器规模，与 TF-IDF 查询选择在相同候选输入长度下对比；并做长度匹配的组件替换实验。
AI.result: 在相同每候选输入长度下，比 TF-IDF 查询选择多 54-72 个 clean hits（检索到有用技能且不含其标记的高风险兄弟技能）。长度匹配组件替换显示差异文本是主要贡献因素，上下文效应较小但混合。相比完整技能正文，SkillContrast 少用 51.1-58.8% 的模型输入 token；在 0.6B 模型上少 10-18 个 clean hits，在 4B 上达到或更高的观测 clean hits。
AI.conclusion: 候选间的相对差异可补充查询相关性，用于选择紧凑的重排输入。

title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
summary: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.

AI.tldr: LadderEdit通过按需提升LoRA秩来压缩终身编辑的存储，在保持编辑契约的同时减少内存占用。
AI.motivation: 终身编辑LLM需要累积数千次编辑，逐条LoRA适配器方案存储量线性增长，亟需压缩而不损失编辑效果。
AI.method: 每个编辑先以低秩草图形式存储，通过探针提示检验其是否满足重写、泛化和局部性契约；不满足的编辑沿"阶梯"逐级提升秩直至达标。
AI.result: 在ZsRE、CounterFact、WikiBigEdit及LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B上，以5.2倍更少内存达到精确LoRA存储效果，在5万次顺序编辑下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: LadderEdit在保持覆盖的同时仅让难编辑消耗更多秩，实现了高效可扩展的终身编辑存储。

title: Clarify, Then Focus: Statement Normalization for Conversation Analytics at Scale
summary: Enterprise conversation analytics asks many questions of millions of interactions. Each question can require reconstructing what people mean and identifying which information matters, repeating costly interpretive work across the same transcripts. We propose a simple principle: clarify the text, then focus the reader. Statement normalization transforms dialogue into short, speaker-attributed statements with source references and semantic tags. The statements make meaning more explicit; the tags support selecting evidence for a particular question. Downstream models can use the full representation or a relevant subset, depending on what helps them make the decision. In an offer-suppression task on customer-service calls, normalization improves a supervised classifier without selection, while weaker prompted readers benefit from both normalization and selection. A small model can learn the normalization contract, while lightweight encoders handle tagging and downstream decisions. Sharing this preparation across questions supports an inference pipeline built entirely from small models, making analytics over millions of conversations substantially less expensive.

AI.tldr: 提出"先澄清文本，再聚焦读者"原则：将对话归一化为带说话人归属、来源引用和语义标签的短陈述，供下游模型按问题选用全量或子集表示，实现全小模型推理管线，大幅降低百万级对话分析成本。
AI.motivation: 企业对话分析需对海量交互反复回答不同问题，而每问都要重建语义、甄别关键信息，导致在同一批转录上重复做昂贵的解释性工作。作者希望把这种准备工作一次性完成并跨问题复用。
AI.method: 语句归一化：把对话转成简短的、带说话人归属的陈述句，附来源引用与语义标签。标签用于针对具体问题筛选证据；下游模型可选用完整表示或相关子集。小模型学习归一化契约，轻量编码器负责打标签与下游决策。
AI.result: 在客服电话的报价抑制任务上：归一化无需筛选即可提升监督分类器；较弱的提示式阅读器则同时受益于归一化与筛选。
AI.conclusion: 将这一准备步骤跨问题共享，可构建完全由小模型组成的推理管线，使百万级对话的分析显著降本。

title: Speaking the Navigator's Language: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents
summary: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents are typically trained on detail-rich, trajectory-aligned commands, whereas users issue short, intent-driven instructions; on a frozen OpenFly navigator, this \emph{instruction gap} drops success rate (SR) from $31.03\%$ to $11.33\%$. To scale translator training, we prompt a language model with human-written style examples to convert original commands into paired, intent-centered Weak commands, which yield $15.27\%$ SR. We introduce the \textbf{Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT)}, a front-end that keeps the navigator frozen and translates Weak inputs into agent-executable commands by learning from its trajectory outcomes. The resulting Weak-trained translator raises Weak-input SR to $37.93\%$ and transfers zero-shot to real human instructions ($11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$); it also improves held-out OpenFly ($4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$) and yields recovery on CityNav and AirVLN.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对空中视觉语言导航中"指令鸿沟"问题，提出轨迹接地指令翻译器（TGIT），将简短意图指令翻译为导航器可执行指令，大幅提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 空中VLN代理通常基于细节丰富、与轨迹对齐的命令训练，而用户实际发出的是简短、意图驱动的指令。这种"指令鸿沟"导致在冻结的OpenFly导航器上成功率从31.03%骤降至11.33%，亟需一种方法弥合差异。
AI.method: 提出TGIT——一种前端翻译器：保持导航器冻结，利用语言模型以人类风格示例将原始命令转为成对的、以意图为中心的Weak命令；再通过从导航器的轨迹结果中学习，将Weak输入翻译为代理可执行的命令。
AI.result: Weak训练的翻译器将Weak输入SR提升至37.93%；零样本迁移到真实人类指令（11.33%→32.51%）；在留出OpenFly上提升（4.95%→20.79%），并在CityNav和AirVLN上取得恢复。
AI.conclusion: TGIT有效弥合空中VLN的指令鸿沟，无需微调导航器即可显著提升Weak及真实人类指令的成功率，并具备跨数据集泛化能力。

title: Self-Organization from Constrained Geometric Radiation
summary: How does dynamic order emerge spontaneously in closed systems without external driving? Existing paradigms all require external energy flows, temperature quenching, or slow driving. Here we report constraint-induced self-organization via geometric radiation in coupled metric evolution systems. Simulations reveal a universal four-stage cycle: stress accumulation, super-exponential radiation, chaotic collapse, and convergence to a fractal limit cycle, a novel attractor topology we term the wedge-shaped attractor, with five quantized curvature states and fractal micro-fluctuations. We identify four jointly sufficient conditions: an irreversible geometric horizon, persistent stress injection from quantum coherence, endogenous geometric tension between incompatible curvatures, and effective fluctuations. Their synergy triggers a critical avalanche at the horizon boundary. We prove three theorems: the Geometric Horizon Theorem, the Geometric Energy Dissipation Theorem (implying wave-like entropy evolution in closed systems), and the Radiation as Phase Transition Channel Theorem. We further establish the Constraint-Induced Self-Organization Theorem: these conditions guarantee the complete cycle with probability one. Systematic scans reveal a critical noise threshold and power-law scaling of radiation onset. We verify universality across 12 configurations, multiple noise types, and three geometric flows. This work establishes a new paradigm for closed-system self-organization, forging an exact mathematical duality between classical nonlinear constraints and gravitational horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需外部驱动的封闭系统自组织新机制——几何辐射诱导的约束自组织，揭示普适四阶段循环与"楔形吸引子"，并证明四个充分条件及三个定理。
AI.motivation: 现有封闭系统自组织范式均依赖外部能量流、温度淬火或缓慢驱动，无法解释无外部驱动时动态秩序如何自发涌现，故需新范式。
AI.method: 研究耦合度量演化系统中的约束诱导自组织，通过模拟扫描分析四阶段循环、吸引子拓扑与噪声阈值，并建立经典非线性约束与引力视界间的数学对偶。
AI.result: 发现四阶段循环（应力积累、超指数辐射、混沌坍缩、收敛至分形极限环）及含五个量子化曲率态的楔形吸引子；识别四个充分条件与临界雪崩；证明三个定理及约束自组织定理；发现临界噪声阈值与辐射起始的幂律缩放；在12种配置、多种噪声类型和三种几何流下验证普适性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了封闭系统自组织的新范式，并建立了经典非线性约束与引力视界之间的精确数学对偶。

title: Probabilistic Sensing, Deterministic Authority: Admitting Model-Produced Observations into Sufficiency-Checked Governance Contracts
comment: 23 pages. Sixth paper of the SARC series. Preregistered; external reviews and an independent reproduction are committed in the repository. Code, caches and checkers: https://github.com/besanson/gigo-jev-probe (tag v1.0.1), archived at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23224016
summary: When a field that an authority contract needs exists only in unstructured evidence, a model can sense it. We admit the model's output only as an observation record with a score. An admission policy, with thresholds fitted on a held-out split at a declared false-positive ceiling, maps each score to true, false or unknown. Unknown denies. A deterministic, sufficiency-checked contract decides. The probability that sensing changes the verdict is bounded by the sum, over the contract's sensed fields, of the admitted-wrong and unknown rates. This is an instantiation of union-bound reasoning, indexed by the contract. Minimising the estimated bound is a valid cost model for choosing among sufficient contracts. In a registered study on two constructed domains with two sensor families (36,000 model calls), no cell refuted the bound. Deny-to-allow changes from sensing appeared for the first time in this programme: 13 of 21,000 test verdicts, all from 3 contradictory records; each flip in a cell with a registered bound lay under it. Sensing-aware selection picked the lower-exposure contract in 4 of 4 registered tests. Both sensors' scores were informative but not calibrated. Correctness is relative to the declared loss model, candidate representation and reachable states; all domains are constructed.

AI.tldr: 提出将模型对非结构化证据的感知结果作为带分数的观测记录，通过准入策略映射为真/假/未知（未知即拒绝），在声明假阳率上限下拟合阈值；用确定性充分性校验合约决策，并以合约感知字段的错误率之和作为感知改变判决概率的上界。
AI.motivation: 权限合约所需字段仅存在于非结构化证据中，模型可感知这些字段；需要一种可控风险的方式引入模型感知，而不让模型直接决定判决。
AI.method: 模型输出仅作为带分数的观测记录，经准入策略（按声明假阳上限在留出集拟合阈值）映射为真/假/未知，未知即拒绝；由确定性且经充分性校验的合约判决。以并集界思想按合约索引，将感知改变判决概率上界为各感知字段准入错误率与未知率之和；最小化该估计界作为选择充分合约的成本模型。
AI.result: 在两个构造域、两类传感器家族、36,000次模型调用的注册研究中，无单元格反驳该上界；首次出现由感知导致的拒绝转允许变化：21,000个测试判决中13个，且均来自3条矛盾记录；每个有注册界的单元格翻转均低于上界；感知感知选择在4/4注册测试中选中低暴露合约；两类传感器分数有信息量但未校准。
AI.conclusion: 正确性相对于声明的损失模型、候选表示与可达状态，且所有域均为构造域；该框架为在权限合约中可控地引入模型感知提供了带风险上界的成本模型与选择依据。

title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs),
  but it typically assumes a static training environment. As the actor improves, fixed tasks drift out of its learning frontier: many
  become trivial, others remain unsolvable; and the learning signal collapses. We argue that VLM post-training should evolve the
  visual environment alongside the actor, not just the actor itself. We propose VICO, a co-evolutionary framework in which an actor
  and an Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) are trained jointly: the EnvRewriter edits verifiable image-side structures, such as
  scene graphs, chart tables, or protected region masks, and re-renders them to produce label-valid training samples whose difficulty
  is calibrated to the actor's current ability through a pass-rate-based reward. This loop continuously realigns task difficulty with
  actor capability without any additional human annotation. Across nine multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and
  visually grounded understanding, VICO-8B improves over its base model by up to +5.0% on out-of-domain tasks, surpasses the strongest
  self-evolution and text-editing co-evolution baselines by +4.3% and +8.4% respectively, and stays comparable to chart-specialized
  RLVR methods using 16-160 times fewer labeled samples. By shifting from human-labeled supervision to image-editing co-evolution,
  VICO offers a scalable path beyond static-corpus RLVR for visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: VICO提出一种actor与环境重写器(EnvRewriter)协同进化的框架，通过编辑可验证的图像结构动态调整任务难度，提升VLM后训练效果。
AI.motivation: 传统RLVR假设训练环境静态，随着actor能力提升，固定任务会变得过于简单或无法解决，导致学习信号崩溃。作者认为VLM后训练应让视觉环境与actor共同进化。
AI.method: VICO联合训练actor与EnvRewriter。EnvRewriter编辑可验证的图像侧结构（如场景图、图表表格、保护区域掩码）并重新渲染，生成标签有效的训练样本，通过基于通过率的奖励将难度校准到actor当前能力，无需额外人工标注。
AI.result: 在九个多模态基准（数学推理与视觉理解）上，VICO-8B在域外任务上提升最高+5.0%，超过最强自进化和文本编辑协同进化基线分别+4.3%和+8.4%，并用少16-160倍的标注样本达到图表专用RLVR方法相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 从人工标注监督转向图像编辑协同进化，VICO为视觉推理提供了超越静态语料RLVR的可扩展路径。

title: Autoregressive Retriever: Improving Query Understanding from Item Feedback for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval typically encodes a query once and ranks independently indexed items by embedding similarity. This design supports efficient search, but leaves the query representation unchanged even when retrieved items could help clarify the information need. We introduce the AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR), a multimodal retrieval model that learns both to select informative items and to use their content to refine subsequent retrieval. ARR alternates between retrieving an item and updating the query embedding, then uses the final embedding to rank the collection. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the encoder to use feedback through stepwise contrastive supervision. Reinforcement learning treats feedback items as actions and optimizes their selection using the final reciprocal rank of a relevant item. A query-side adapter enables this optimization against a fixed item index. ARR demonstrates strong retrieval performance on both in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, outperforming the compared baselines on average. Further analyses show that feedback improves retrieval at inference time and that training with feedback also improves the initial query embedding, before any item is observed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARR（自回归检索器），一种多模态检索模型，可在检索过程中利用反馈项内容迭代更新查询表示，并联合优化项选择与查询精炼。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态检索对查询仅编码一次，即使检索到的项有助于澄清信息需求，查询表示也保持不变，限制了检索效果。
AI.method: ARR在检索项与更新查询嵌入之间交替进行，最终用更新后的嵌入对集合排序。通过逐步对比监督进行微调，使编码器学会利用反馈；用强化学习将反馈项视为动作，以相关项的最终倒数排名优化其选择；并通过查询侧适配器支持在固定项索引上的优化。
AI.result: ARR在域内与零样本基准上均表现强劲，平均优于对比基线；分析表明反馈在推理时提升检索效果，且带反馈的训练也改善了初始查询嵌入。
AI.conclusion: 反馈式迭代查询精炼能有效提升多模态检索性能，且训练阶段的反馈利用可迁移到初始查询表示中。

title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
summary: A core challenge in short-video fact-checking is identifying which evidence is sufficient to support a verification conclusion. Existing approaches either give the verifier all available evidence, introducing noise, or select evidence by topical relevance, which conflates relatedness with sufficiency. We identify evidential sufficiency as the selection criterion: whether a subset of evidence is adequate to support a confident verdict without redundancy. We introduce MiniVer-V, a benchmark of 195 short videos with three-way verdict annotations (supported, refuted, insufficient) and 5,510 multimodal evidence units spanning visual keyframes, speech transcripts, and web-retrieved external sources. We propose a two-layer verification framework that separates claim-video consistency, assessed from internal evidence, from factual verdict determination, which additionally requires external corroboration. On top of it, a sufficiency-driven greedy search assembles evidence until a sufficiency threshold is met and outputs insufficient when the candidate pool is exhausted, rather than forcing a verdict. With Claude Sonnet 4, the method reaches a Macro-F1 of 0.510 using 4.5 evidence units on average (16% of the full evidence set), statistically indistinguishable from the full-evidence baseline (0.518 with 27.7 units), while significantly improving recognition of insufficient cases over the same search without abstention. The efficiency result replicates with GPT-5.5 and holds only partially with an open-weight Qwen2.5-72B verifier. Ablations show that external evidence is indispensable for factual determination, while internal video evidence grounds the verdict in claim-video consistency. These findings suggest that evidence-efficient verification is achievable, and that explicit abstention is needed when evidence is genuinely inadequate.

AI.tldr: 提出证据充分性作为短视频事实核查的证据选择标准，构建MiniVer-V基准与两层验证框架，用充分性驱动的贪心搜索仅用16%证据达到接近全证据基线的效果，并支持证据不足时的弃权输出。
AI.motivation: 现有短视频事实核查方法要么把全部证据交给验证器引入噪声，要么按主题相关性选择证据，混淆了"相关"与"充分"。核心挑战在于判定哪些证据足以支撑验证结论。
AI.method: 定义证据充分性为选择标准：某证据子集是否足以在无冗余下支撑置信判决。构建MiniVer-V基准（195个短视频，三分类标注：支持/反驳/不足，5,510个多模态证据单元，涵盖视觉关键帧、语音转录与网络检索外部来源）。提出两层验证框架，分离基于内部证据的"声明-视频一致性"与额外需外部佐证的"事实判决"；其上用充分性驱动贪心搜索累积证据直至满足充分性阈值，候选池耗尽时输出"不足"而非强行判决。
AI.result: Claude Sonnet 4下Macro-F1达0.510，平均仅用4.5个证据单元（全证据集的16%），与全证据基线0.518（27.7单元）统计上无差异，且显著提升对"不足"案例的识别；效率结果在GPT-5.5上可复现，在开源Qwen2.5-72B上仅部分成立。消融显示外部证据对事实判决不可或缺，内部视频证据则将判决锚定于声明-视频一致性。
AI.conclusion: 证据高效的事实验证是可行的，且当证据确实不足时需要显式弃权。

title: Grammar Concept Annotation at Scale: Deployed Fine-Tuned Small Language Models Outperform Prompted Frontier Models
summary: Corrective feedback is among the best-evidenced drivers of second-language acquisition, yet corrections delivered during lessons rarely accumulate into an actionable view of grammar mastery. Prompted frontier models can provide such a view from learner--tutor lesson transcripts, but they are costly at scale. We close this gap by fine-tuning Qwen3.5 small language models (SLMs) on filtered and rebalanced teacher-generated supervision, then deploying an efficient 0.8B model in an end-to-end grammar mastery tracker for all English learners on our platform. Internalizing the annotation contract into adapter weights enables pairing the 0.8B model with a compact matched prompt rather than verbose instructions. On two human-curated benchmarks, both the deployed 0.8B model and a 4B reference comparator outperform prompted GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6 Sol in precision and recall under nested matching criteria of increasing strictness: concept, evidence span, and correctness. The deployed 0.8B SLM reduces serving cost by approximately 16$\times$. A feature-level online experiment shows significant gains in learner engagement ($+15.8\%$) and key business metrics, including scheduled hours ($+2.1\%$) and GMV from new lessons ($+13.2\%$).

AI.tldr: 通过微调Qwen3.5小型模型（含0.8B）在过滤并重平衡的教师监督数据上，并在平台端到端语法掌握追踪器中部署，0.8B模型在两个人工基准上优于提示式GPT-5.4/5.6 Sol，服务成本降低约16倍，在线实验显示学习参与度+15.8%、预约时长+2.1%、新课程GMV+13.2%。
AI.motivation: 纠正性反馈是二语习得最有力的驱动因素之一，但课堂中的纠正很少能沉淀为可操作的语法掌握视图。提示式前沿模型虽可从师生对话转录中生成该视图，但大规模使用成本高昂。
AI.method: 在过滤并重平衡的教师生成监督数据上微调Qwen3.5小型语言模型（SLM），将标注契约内化到适配器权重中，从而用简洁匹配提示替代冗长指令；部署0.8B模型于端到端语法掌握追踪器，并以4B模型作参考对比。
AI.result: 在两个人工标注基准上，0.8B部署模型与4B参考模型在概念、证据片段、正确性三层递进严格匹配标准下的精确率与召回率均超过提示式GPT-5.4和GPT-5.6 Sol；服务成本降低约16倍；线上实验显示学习参与度+15.8%、预约时长+2.1%、新课程GMV+13.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将标注契约蒸馏进小型适配器并以匹配的紧凑提示部署，可在语法掌握追踪任务上以极低成本超越前沿提示模型，并带来可观的业务收益。

title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
summary: Planning is increasingly important for long-horizon agents, where successful execution requires coordinating subgoals, tool use, and intermediate outcomes over many steps. Yet assumptions made during planning may be invalidated by the environment, tools may return unexpected results, or actions may fail. Effective agents must therefore not only generate plans, but also revise them. Such revisions often affect only part of a plan, leaving the preceding and subsequent structure intact. Rather than regenerate the entire plan and risk unnecessary changes, repair can regenerate the affected region conditioned on the preserved prefix and suffix. We introduce Plan-and-Patch, a plan-and-act framework in which a diffusion language model (dLLM) generates a structured, program-like plan through parallel unmasking and repairs it by filling in selected regions while keeping the surrounding steps fixed. We compare DreamReasoner-8B and Qwen3-8B as diffusion and autoregressive (AR) planners. On Natural Plan without task-specific training, diffusion (53.7%) achieves nearly twice the plan repair success rate of AR (27.0%). After task-specific training on agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and TextCraft, the planners achieve similar observed success in plan generation, while diffusion reduces mean plan-generation latency by 39-46% relative to AR. Our results show that Plan-and-Patch provides a framework for faster plan generation and effective plan repair in long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 Plan-and-Patch 框架，用扩散语言模型生成结构化计划并通过局部填充修复，在长时程智能体中实现更快的计划生成和更有效的修复。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体的规划中，环境变化、工具异常或动作失败会使原计划假设失效，需要修复。整体重新生成会引入不必要改动，而修复通常只需改动部分区域，保留前后结构。
AI.method: Plan-and-Patch：扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过并行去掩码生成程序式结构化计划，并在修复时仅填充选定区域，保持前后步骤固定。以 DreamReasoner-8B 为扩散规划器、Qwen3-8B 为自回归规划器进行对比。
AI.result: 在 Natural Plan 上无任务特定训练时，扩散修复成功率 53.7%，约为自回归 27.0% 的两倍；在 ALFWorld 和 TextCraft 上训练后计划生成成功率相近，但扩散将平均计划生成延迟降低 39-46%。
AI.conclusion: Plan-and-Patch 为长时程智能体提供了更快的计划生成与有效计划修复框架。

title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) offer a parameter efficient approach to scaling reasoning by reusing shared parameters across recurrent computation steps. Despite their promise, effective post-training of LoopLMs remains challenging. Existing approaches either provide reward based supervision that is sparse or costly to extend across loops, or rely on external teachers or privileged information, leading to limited teacher availability or teacher-student context mismatch. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopOPD, a cross-loop on-policy distillation framework that uses additional recurrent computation within a LoopLM as its own source of supervision. LoopOPD uses a frozen terminal loop policy as a compute privileged teacher for an intermediate loop student on student generated rollouts, providing dense supervision without an external teacher or privileged information. We further propose Dynamic LoopOPD (D-LoopOPD), which continually refreshes the terminal loop teacher as the shared model parameters are updated, enabling recurrent self-improvement. We characterize how distillation updates propagate across loop depths and derive sufficient conditions under which a single update yields simultaneous local improvement at both loop depths. Experiments on Ouro-Thinking models show that LoopOPD improves mathematical reasoning, while D-LoopOPD yields further gains through dynamic teacher updates. Despite being trained only on mathematical data, the resulting models also improve on general reasoning and code generation benchmarks, demonstrating that recurrent computation can serve as an effective source of supervision for LoopLMs. Our code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopOPD跨循环在线策略蒸馏框架，利用LoopLM内部终端循环作为教师为中间循环提供密集监督，无需外部教师，并提出动态版本D-LoopOPD实现循环自我改进。
AI.motivation: Looped Language Models参数高效但后训练困难，现有方法依赖稀疏奖励或外部教师/特权信息，存在教师可用性受限和师生上下文不匹配的问题。
AI.method: LoopOPD以冻结的终端循环策略作为计算特权教师，在中间循环学生于学生生成轨迹上进行在线策略蒸馏；D-LoopOPD持续刷新终端循环教师随共享参数更新。理论刻画了蒸馏更新在循环深度间的传播，并推导单次更新同时改善两深度循环的充分条件。
AI.result: 在Ouro-Thinking模型上，LoopOPD提升数学推理，D-LoopOPD通过动态教师更新进一步提升。仅用数学数据训练，模型在通用推理和代码生成基准上也取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 循环计算可成为LoopLM的有效监督来源，跨循环自蒸馏框架实现无需外部教师的密集监督与自我改进。

title: Following Breadcrumbs in Code: What Accidentally Committed Ad-Hoc Logs Reveal about Developer Comprehension
summary:
Developers frequently insert temporary print or log statements, known as **ad-hoc logs**, to better understand program behavior at runtime, particularly when facing unexpected issues or complex control flows. Despite being a nearly universal practice, systematic study has been limited because these logs are ephemeral: they usually remain only in local environments and are removed before code is committed, making them difficult to capture. In this work, we addressed this challenge by mining accidental commits where developers unintentionally left ad-hoc logs and later deleted them, and by analyzing live-streamed programming sessions to observe their use in practice.
  Using these methods, we constructed a large dataset across three major programming languages (Java, JavaScript, and Python), enabling the large-scale investigation of logging practices.
  Our analysis reveals both common and language-specific patterns in where and how developers rely on ad-hoc logs. Across languages, ad-hoc logs tend to appear in program regions that are harder to reason about at runtime. We also identify distinctive language-level patterns, such as frequent use in asynchronous and callback functions in JavaScript and in thread-related classes in Java. In addition, functions containing ad-hoc logs generally have higher cyclomatic complexity than the overall function population. Production logs show a similar association, consistent with logging serving as a means of observing runtime behavior in structurally complex functions. Together, these findings provide empirical insight into developers' runtime comprehension practices and offer a valuable dataset for researchers and tool builders seeking to better support debugging and logging.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过挖掘意外提交和直播编程，构建了跨 Java、JavaScript、Python 的 ad-hoc 日志大规模数据集，揭示了开发者临时插入日志的通用及语言特定模式。
AI.motivation: 开发者常插入临时打印/日志语句（ad-hoc logs）以理解运行时行为，但因其短暂性（提交前被删除、仅存本地）导致系统性研究受限。
AI.method: 通过挖掘开发者意外提交后删除 ad-hoc 日志的提交，并分析直播编程会话，构建跨三大语言（Java、JavaScript、Python）的大规模数据集进行分析。
AI.result: 发现跨语言的通用模式：ad-hoc 日志多出现在难以推理的运行时区域；语言特定模式如 JS 中异步/回调函数、Java 中线程相关类频繁使用；含 ad-hoc 日志的函数圈复杂度高于整体，生产日志呈类似关联。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现提供了开发者运行时理解实践的实证洞见，并为研究者和工具开发者提供了支持调试与日志的宝贵数据集。

title: Velocity Scaling in Flow Matching
summary: Scaling a learned flow-matching velocity field $v_θ$ by a gain $γ(t)$ was recently shown to greatly improve generation quality. Prior work argued that velocity fields trained with mean-squared error (MSE) systematically underestimate velocity magnitude and that scaling corrects this error. We show that MSE training does not create a velocity-magnitude deficit. We find instead that velocity scaling reduces population time lag: sampled states at model time $t$ resemble training states from an earlier time. Velocity scaling and moving model time back are two ways to address this population time lag. Across architectures and model sizes, measuring population time lag and using it to select a gain greatly improves generation quality, reducing FID from 28.0 to 12.2 (estimated by linear interpolation between FID measurements at neighboring gains) on ImageNet-256 at NFE 25 without guidance.

AI.tldr: MSE训练不会导致速度幅度不足；速度缩放实际是减少"群体时间滞后"，通过测量滞后选择增益可大幅提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 先前工作认为MSE训练会使速度幅度被系统性低估，需用增益γ(t)缩放来纠正；本文质疑这一解释并探究速度缩放的真正作用。
AI.method: 分析MSE训练的速度幅度，提出"群体时间滞后"概念，证明速度缩放与将模型时间回退等价，并通过测量群体时间滞后选择增益。
AI.result: 在多种架构和模型规模上，测量群体时间滞后并据此选增益显著提升生成质量，ImageNet-256在NFE 25无引导下FID从28.0降至12.2。
AI.conclusion: 速度缩放的作用在于缓解群体时间滞后，而非修正速度幅度不足；基于滞后的增益选择是一种有效的质量提升手段。

title: Chaos in the Text: Revealing the Modality Preference in Mixed-Modality Retrievers
summary: Dense retrievers have made significant progress on text and image corpora, but whether these capabilities extend reliably to mixed corpora containing text, image, and fused text-image documents remains unclear. In this paper, we systematically examine retrievers across architectures and find that their performance is highly sensitive to modality composition. As image documents are progressively replaced with semantically corresponding text representations, retrieval performance follows a pronounced V-shaped curve, remaining strong on single-modality corpora but degrading substantially when modalities coexist. In particular, irrelevant text causes more severe degradation than an equal number of irrelevant images, a phenomenon we term Chaos in the Text. Further analysis reveals modality preference, whereby text representations receive systematically higher similarity scores, allowing irrelevant text to outrank relevant images. To mitigate this bias, we introduce Trident, which constructs text, image, and fused text-image views of each document as co-equal positives and jointly optimizes relevance discrimination and positive-view balance through Multi-Positive View InfoNCE. Experiments across visual document and natural image benchmarks show that trident improves mixed-modality retrieval on both CLIP-based and VLM-based architectures, reduces sensitivity to modality composition and text distractors, and increases average single-modality retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了密集检索器在混合模态语料上的表现，发现其性能高度依赖模态组成并呈V型曲线，提出Trident方法缓解模态偏好偏差。
AI.motivation: 密集检索器在纯文本和纯图像语料上表现优异，但当语料同时包含文本、图像和文本-图像融合文档时，其能力是否可靠尚不明确。作者发现图像文档逐渐被对应文本替换时，检索性能呈V型曲线，且无关文本比无关图像造成更严重的性能下降（Chaos in the Text），根源在于文本表示获得系统性更高的相似度分数（模态偏好）。
AI.method: 提出Trident方法：为每个文档构建文本、图像和文本-图像融合三种视图，作为共等正样本，通过Multi-Positive View InfoNCE联合优化相关性判别与正样本视图平衡。
AI.result: 在视觉文档和自然图像基准上，Trident提升了CLIP基和VLM基架构的混合模态检索性能，降低了对模态组成和文本干扰项的敏感度，并提升了平均单模态检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 混合模态检索的核心挑战是模态偏好导致的偏差，Trident通过多视图共等正样本训练有效缓解该问题，实现更鲁棒的跨模态检索。

title: SignRAG: Unified Retrieval-Augmented Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
summary: Contemporary decoder-only large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of domains. However, existing pretraining paradigms for gloss-free sign language translation (SLT) are largely designed around conventional encoder-decoder pretrained language models, which limits their direct applicability to decoder-only LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose SignRAG, a unified framework combining hierarchical pretraining, target-domain retrieval augmentation, and retrieval-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. Hierarchical pretraining first learns linguistically grounded sign representations and then jointly aligns the sign encoder with an LLM, mitigating cross-modal optimization imbalance. For downstream adaptation, SignRAG complements parameter-based fine-tuning with a target-domain retrieval gallery that provides instance-specific translation cues. To ensure that retrieved contexts are used appropriately, we further introduce Retrieval Utility-Guided Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RUG-RFT), which combines translation-quality and retrieval-utility rewards to encourage beneficial retrieval use while suppressing harmful reliance. Experiments on multiple SLT benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art performance. In particular, to the best of our knowledge, SignRAG is the first gloss-free approach to outperform gloss-supervised methods across all reported metrics on CSL-Daily. Our code has been released at \href{https://github.com/shahelaojieraozhi/SignRAG}{GitHub}, together with models of different sizes to support future academic research.

AI.tldr: SignRAG 是一个统一框架，通过分层预训练、目标域检索增强和检索感知强化微调，将无注释手语翻译适配到 decoder-only LLM，并在多个基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有无注释手语翻译预训练范式多基于传统 encoder-decoder 语言模型，难以直接应用到 decoder-only LLM，存在适配性限制。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：1）分层预训练，先学习语言学手语表示，再联合对齐手语编码器与 LLM，缓解跨模态优化不平衡；2）下游目标域检索库提供实例级翻译线索；3）提出 RUG-RFT，结合翻译质量与检索效用奖励，促进有益检索、抑制有害依赖。
AI.result: 在多个 SLT 基准上取得新 SOTA。在 CSL-Daily 上，据作者所知是首个在所有报告指标上超越注释监督方法的无注释方法。
AI.conclusion: SignRAG 有效弥合了无注释 SLT 与 decoder-only LLM 的鸿沟，代码与多尺寸模型已开源以支持后续研究。

title: Real Long-Term Memory for AI: A 50-Million-Token Window That Is Faster and Cheaper Than Recompute
summary: A large language model can only use the text that fits in its context window, and it recomputes its internal key-value (KV) state for a prompt every time the prompt is sent. We test a memory layer, the public package galahad-kv, that saves the KV state of each block of about 16,000 tokens to encrypted local NVMe disk and loads it back later, byte-exact, without recomputing it. We ran it on 50,000,000 tokens of real public text, served through vLLM on one NVIDIA H100, with Gemma 4 12B and Gemma 4 31B. Every block we probed was loaded back from the encrypted store with no recompute (100 of 100, at depths from 0 to 50M tokens) on both models. Loading a block was 2.8x to 4.3x faster than recomputing it and used 8.8x to 12.3x less GPU energy, and GPU memory stayed flat over the whole 50M-token stream. Asked about facts planted millions of tokens earlier, the 12B model gave the right answer 82 times out of 100 and the 31B model 98 times out of 100. Neither model made up an answer. The limits are as follows. This is reuse of stored state, not a wider attention window: one block is loaded at a time, and how well a question is answered depends on the model. Writing the memory is a one-time cost, and the store takes terabytes of local NVMe disk. We describe the test protocol, which is built to resist common ways of gaming long-context benchmarks, and give a single-GPU reproduction that uses public software and a free licence for the package.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了公共包 galahad-kv 的记忆层，将约 16,000 token 块的 KV 状态字节精确保存到加密本地 NVMe 并可加载复用，在 50M token 真实文本、H100、Gemma 4 12B/31B 上验证了性能与事实召回。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型受限于上下文窗口，且每次发送提示都需重新计算 KV 状态，导致长上下文的算力、能耗与内存浪费。
AI.method: 使用 galahad-kv 将每约 16,000 token 块的 KV 状态保存到加密本地 NVMe，之后字节精确加载而无需重算；在单张 NVIDIA H100 上通过 vLLM 服务 Gemma 4 12B 和 31B，处理 50M token 公开文本，并设计抗基准作弊的测试协议。
AI.result: 探测的 100/100 个块均从加密存储加载且无重算（深度 0 至 50M）；加载比重算快 2.8–4.3 倍，GPU 能耗低 8.8–12.3 倍，显存全程平稳。对百万 token 前植入事实，12B 正确 82/100，31B 正确 98/100，均未编造答案。
AI.conclusion: 该方案能高效复用存储状态，但并非扩大注意力窗口，每次仅加载一个块，答题效果依赖模型；写入是一次性成本且需 TB 级 NVMe 存储。论文提供单 GPU 复现方案。

title: Whose Ground Truth? Embracing Ambiguity in Human-Centered AI
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
summary: As AI systems increasingly interact with people and make decisions about them, understanding human interpretations becomes an important part of developing human-centered AI. Conventional machine learning and AI systems are largely developed under the assumption that a single definitive ground truth exists, with variability in human annotations often resolved through aggregation or treated as noise. However, for many human-centered tasks, human interpretation is inherently ambiguous, and multiple interpretations of the same input may be simultaneously reasonable and valid. Reducing such ambiguity to a single target risks overlooking meaningful information about the diversity of human perception, judgment, and experience. In this position paper, we call for a shift towards modeling the interpretation space of plausible human judgments, while distinguishing meaningful ambiguity from annotation noise. We argue that this perspective should guide how AI systems are represented, learned, evaluated, deployed, and governed, supporting more human-centered AI that better reflects the diversity of human interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文立场论文呼吁AI建模不应强求单一"真值"，而应建模人类合理解释的解释空间，并区分有意义模糊性与标注噪声。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习假设存在唯一ground truth，把人类标注差异通过聚合消解或视为噪声。但在人本任务中，人类解释本身具有歧义性，多种解释可能同时合理，压缩为单一目标会丢失人类感知、判断与经验的多样性信息。
AI.method: 立场论文（position paper），非实证方法：主张转向建模"合理解释空间"（interpretation space），并提出需区分有意义模糊性与标注噪声，从表征、学习、评估、部署与治理五个方面指导AI系统设计。
AI.result: 提出以解释空间为中心的AI研发框架，主张在系统表示、学习、评估、部署和治理各环节体现人类解释的多样性。文中未报告实验或定量结果。
AI.conclusion: AI应超越单一真值假设，建模人类合理解释空间并区分模糊性与噪声，从而构建更贴合人类中心理念、更能反映人类解释多样性的AI系统。

title: Exact SO(3)-Equivariant Isotropic Kernels for Rotation-Robust Neural Dynamics
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop NeurReps (Proceedings Track)
summary: Neural surrogates for vector-valued partial differential equations can fit training data yet change their predictions when the same physical state is expressed in a rotated coordinate frame. We study this failure on three-dimensional Navier--Stokes dynamics observed at irregularly placed points. We introduce the Invariant-Conditioned Isotropic Kernel Neural Operator (IKNO), a compact graph model that builds local interactions from scalar quantities unchanged by rotation and vector directions that rotate with the data. Consequently, rotating the positions and velocities rotates the predicted velocity change in exactly the same way. On a held-out test set fixed after model design, training unconstrained graph models on randomly rotated examples reduces but does not eliminate their coordinate dependence. In contrast, IKNO is consistent to numerical precision, matches the forecasting accuracy of a general rotation-aware Tensor Field Network with $5.6$ times fewer parameters, and outperforms a parameter-matched graph simulator. These results show that a compact, PDE-specialized model can remove coordinate dependence without sacrificing forecasting accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出IKNO，一种紧凑的图神经算子，通过旋转不变的标量和随数据旋转的矢量构建局部交互，使三维Navier-Stokes预测严格等变，消除坐标系依赖。
AI.motivation: 传统神经代理模型能拟合训练数据，但当同一物理状态在旋转坐标系中表示时，预测会改变，缺乏旋转不变性/等变性，这是物理一致性的重要缺陷。
AI.method: IKNO从旋转不变的标量量和随数据旋转的矢量方向构建局部交互图模型；对不规则采样点上的三维Navier-Stokes动力学建模，保证位置和速度旋转时预测的速度变化以相同方式旋转。
AI.result: 在固定测试集上，无约束图模型用随机旋转样本训练仅减少但不消除坐标依赖；IKNO在数值精度上保持一致，以比旋转感知Tensor Field Network少5.6倍的参数达到相同预测精度，并优于参数匹配的图模拟器。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑、面向PDE特化的模型可在不牺牲预测精度的前提下消除坐标依赖，验证了等变结构设计的有效性。

title: IRONPROOF: COBOL-to-Python Transpilation with SMT-Based Equivalence Checking
comment: 13 pages, 6 tables, 1 figure. Code and data: https://github.com/dom-omg/ironproof-cobol
summary: Translating COBOL to a modern language can change what a program computes, and LLM translations carry no guarantee of equivalence. We present IRONPROOF, which parses COBOL into an intermediate representation, generates Python, encodes both as Z3 formulas over shared inputs, and emits either a machine-checkable equivalence certificate (UNSAT) or a counterexample (SAT). On 2,345 COBOL files (GnuCOBOL tests, NIST CCVS85, open-source collections, and programs we generated or wrote), 782 enter the checking path: 606 (77.5%) are proved equivalent, 101 are partially verified, none is refuted, and 75 fail inside our pipeline and stay in the denominator. On independently authored programs the rate is 52.6% (153 of 291), against 92.3% on programs we wrote. Of the 153 independent proofs, 37 cover a single execution of a program that reads input the encoder does not model, and across all 606 proofs only 14 quantify over an input that a proved output depends on. On two public business-application corpora (AWS CardDemo and IBM GenApp), the encoder models no program end to end. An April 2026 LLM-only baseline failed on 54 of 94 independently authored programs, counting translations our encoder could not verify. PIC-bounded overflow detection flags an out-of-range output in 22.1% of the programs it can analyze, an upper bound. An earlier confrontation with GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 found 24 of 49 executable independent proofs disagreeing with the runtime on a variable in the proof's domain. A proof establishes that the generated Python computes what our intermediate representation says the COBOL computes, not equivalence to a COBOL implementation.

AI.tldr: IRONPROOF通过将COBOL与生成的Python编码为Z3公式,为COBOL→Python翻译提供机器可检验的等价性证明或反例,但证明范围有限(仅14个证明量化了被依赖输入,且不针对真实COBOL实现)。
AI.motivation: COBOL翻译成现代语言可能改变程序语义,LLM翻译无等价性保证,需要可验证的等价性证书。
AI.method: 解析COBOL为中间表示,生成Python,将二者编码为共享输入上的Z3公式,输出UNSAT等价证书或SAT反例。
AI.result: 2345个COBOL文件中782个进入检查路径,606个(77.5%)证明等价,101个部分验证,0个被反驳,75个管线内失败。独立编写程序仅52.6%(153/291),自写程序92.3%。153个独立证明中37个仅覆盖单次执行,606个证明中仅14个量化了被依赖输入。两个公开商业语料(AWS CardDemo、IBM GenApp)无一端到端建模。LLM-only基线在94个独立程序中54个失败。PIC溢出检测在22.1%可分析程序中标记越界(上界)。GnuCOBOL 3.2.0对比中49个可执行独立证明有24个与运行时不一致。
AI.conclusion: 证明仅表明生成的Python计算了中间表示所声称的COBOL语义,而非与COBOL实现等价;真实业务程序的验证覆盖严重不足。

title: Enabling Preference-driven Unlearning in Few-step Distilled Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distilled into few-step variants and being deployed to enable fast inference. However, their ability to generate harmful or undesired content poses significant safety risks. Data-driven unlearning methods suppress targeted generations by fine-tuning model weights using specialized unlearning objectives. Crucially, these objectives implicitly rely on multi-step denoising dynamics, an assumption that breaks down for few-step distilled (FSD) models, resulting in ineffective forgetting. Furthermore, performing unlearning on the non-distilled base model and subsequently re-distilling it to obtain an unlearned FSD model incurs substantial computational and time overhead, making it impractical in many settings. Hence, we address this limitation with a preference-driven unlearning framework that revisits Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for diffusion models. We show that standard DPO and its unlearning derivatives, formulated around noise-prediction error, transfer poorly to FSD models due to their altered generation dynamics. To overcome this, we introduce a modified preference optimization formulation explicitly aligned with the few-step generation properties, enabling direct concept removal in FSD models while preserving few-step efficiency and maintaining strong retention of desirable (non-targeted) capabilities. We evaluate our framework primarily on identity and NSFW (nudity) removal tasks and also extend our method to object-level unlearning. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent and effective forgetting, and strong retention performance, establishing our method as a practical and principled solution for unlearning in FSD models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种偏好驱动的遗忘框架，用于少步蒸馏(FSD)扩散模型的概念移除，通过改进DPO以适配少步生成动态，实现有效遗忘且保持效率与保留能力。
AI.motivation: FSD扩散模型因推理快被广泛部署，但会生成有害/不良内容，存在安全隐患。现有数据驱动的遗忘方法依赖多步去噪动态，该假设在FSD模型中失效导致遗忘无效；而先在基模型遗忘再重蒸馏的方式计算与时间开销巨大，不实用。
AI.method: 提出偏好驱动的遗忘框架，重新审视用于扩散模型的DPO。指出现有基于噪声预测误差的标准DPO及其遗忘变体因生成动态改变而难以迁移到FSD模型，因而引入与少步生成特性显式对齐的改进偏好优化公式，实现FSD模型中的直接概念移除。
AI.result: 主要在身份移除与NSFW(裸体)移除任务上评估，并扩展到物体级遗忘。大量实验显示一致的、有效的遗忘效果与强保留性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为FSD模型的遗忘提供实用且有原则的解决方案，兼顾少步效率与对非目标能力(理想能力)的保留。

title: Project Greenhouse: Progress Toward Fully Open and Sovereign Agentic Search
summary: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.

AI.tldr: Project Greenhouse 提出用少量 GPU 从头训练完全开放、自主可控的 agentic search 模型，首个里程碑是一个点式解码器重排序器，采用"预训练+监督微调"两步配方，仅用公开数据集，不依赖第三方开放的权重骨干，并开源数据、代码、配置及 Gaggle 系列检查点。
AI.motivation: 主流做法依赖第三方开放权重骨干，无法完全掌控端到端训练。作者希望验证：仅用有限算力即可构建完全开放且自主可控（sovereign）的 agentic search 模型。
AI.method: 两步配方：从零开始预训练（pre-training from scratch），随后进行监督微调（SFT），仅使用常见公开数据集，不使用第三方开放权重骨干。大部分实验仅用少量 GPU 完成。
AI.result: 成功构建了具有竞争力的点式仅解码器重排序器，并发布 Gaggle 系列模型的检查点；同时开源数据、代码和配置以支持透明、独立的复现。
AI.conclusion: 证明了以有限算力、完全开放方式训练竞争性搜索模型是可行的，是验证其"开放且自主的 agentic search 模型"更宏大命题的第一步。

title: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization via Complex-Valued Fusion
comment: Accepted to British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization (OV-AVEL) labels each video segment with an event class, including classes that were never seen during training. The dominant pipeline uses a frozen multimodal foundation model (e.g. ImageBind) to embed the visual frame, the audio mel-spectrogram, and each candidate class name into a shared space, then computes two cosine similarities for each segment against each class: visual-text and audio-text. Existing methods then collapse this pair into a single scalar score with a fixed rule (geometric mean, weighted average) before taking the argmax. Instead, we compute complex-valued similarities and learn their fusion using a complex-valued neural network (CVNN). Each modality's standard representation becomes the real part of our pipeline, and a paired companion stream supplies the imaginary part. We use imaginary part of iHSV for visual modality and CycleGAN-translated phase spectrogram for audio modality as these companion streams. This results in two complex similarities, which are then fused. While the vision and audio encoders remain frozen, only the temporal-attention blocks and the fusion CVNN are trained. The four-stream complex architecture sets a new state of the art on both OV-AVEL benchmarks. On the open (unseen-class) split of OV-AVEBench we reach 66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1 (+1.6/+4.1/+6.6 over the previously reported fine-tuned baseline), with consistent gains for seen classes as well. We also modify AVE dataset for this task and observe that our architecture reaches 60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1, achieving state-of-the-art OV-AVEL results on it as well. We also propose a two-stream alternative, which also sees great improvements over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用复数神经网络融合视觉-文本与音频-文本相似度，用于开放词汇音视频事件定位（OV-AVEL），在两个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有OV-AVEL方法将视觉-文本和音频-文本两个余弦相似度用固定规则（几何平均、加权平均）合并为单一标量，缺乏可学习的融合方式。
AI.method: 用冻结的多模态基础模型（如ImageBind）嵌入视觉帧、音频梅尔谱和类名，计算复数相似度。每个模态的标准表示作为实部，配对伴随流提供虚部：视觉用iHSV虚部，音频用CycleGAN转换的相位谱。得到两个复数相似度后用CVNN融合。仅训练时间注意力块和融合CVNN，编码器冻结。另提出双流替代方案。
AI.result: 在OV-AVEBench开放（未见类）划分上达到66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1（较微调基线提升+1.6/+4.1/+6.6），已见类也有一致增益。在修改后的AVE数据集上达到60.7/51.9/50.4%，同样取得SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 四流复数架构在OV-AVEL任务上刷新两个基准的SOTA，验证了学习式复数相似度融合优于固定规则。

title: Disentangling Linguistic and Paralinguistic Information with Routed Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Self-supervised speech encoders contain linguistic and paralinguistic information in a shared, entangled representation space. We combine a TopK sparse autoencoder with route-specific supervision and cross-factor adversaries. Across frozen SPEAR and WavLM encoders, independent probes show factor-specific retention and suppression: linguistic information remains stronger in the linguistic route, while paralinguistic factors, including speaker identity, emotion, and prosody, are retained in the paralinguistic route and substantially reduced in the linguistic route. The route organisation learned on LibriSpeech persists on MSP-Podcast without representation-side retraining. Feature-space route interventions further transfer the swapped factor while largely preserving the information carried by the unchanged route. These results show consistent route-selective separation across encoders, corpora, independent probes, and representation-level interventions.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过TopK稀疏自编码器结合路由监督与跨因子对抗，在冻结的自监督语音编码器中实现语言与副语言信息的路由分离。
AI.motivation: 自监督语音编码器将语言与副语言信息纠缠在同一表示空间中，缺乏可解释的解耦机制，阻碍了下游任务对特定因子的独立利用。
AI.method: 将TopK稀疏自编码器与路由特定监督及跨因子对抗相结合，在冻结的SPEAR和WavLM编码器上学习语言/副语言路由表示。
AI.result: 独立探针显示各因子在对应路由中保留更强（语言路由保留语言、副语言路由保留说话人/情感/韵律），语言路由中副语言显著降低；LibriSpeech学到的路由组织无需表示端重训即可迁移到MSP-Podcast；特征空间路由干预能转移被交换因子并大体保留未变路由信息。
AI.conclusion: 路由选择性分离在多种编码器、语料、独立探针及表示级干预下表现一致。

title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI. 23 pages
summary: We study whether small LLM agents can operate effectively under explicit wall-clock time budgets by both respecting the allocated runtime and using available time productively. We evaluate Qwen3.6-27B on five competitions from MLE-Bench Lite and Qwen3-4B on Zork I (Jericho), two agentic benchmarks where additional computational time can meaningfully improve performance. In the simplest setting, where the budget is stated only in the prompt, agents fail to translate the stated budget into controlled use of time. These failures arise from gaps in time awareness, since the harness provides no timing feedback, but also because they cannot reliably anticipate the duration of actions, and do not have a learned mapping from available time to an appropriate strategy. We investigate two complementary classes of interventions: harness-based mechanisms that expose timing information and enforce deadlines, and reinforcement learning with budget-aware rewards. Injecting timing information through the harness substantially improves budget adherence for Qwen3.6-27B without measurable loss in performance, while enforcement hooks tighten adherence further. RL with GRPO achieves near-perfect budget adherence on Zork I and generalizes to held-out budgets not seen during training, but does not improve task performance over the untrained harness on MLE-Bench. Once agents are made to respect the budget, they still fail to use additional time to improve task performance. RL-trained policies learn when to stop but often fill extra time with repeated actions, and GRPO training on multiple budgets tends to collapse toward the strategy learned for the shortest budget. Our results reveal a gap between time adherence and productive time allocation, which remains a central challenge for budget-conditioned agents.

AI.tldr: 小型LLM智能体在明确墙钟时间预算下难以兼顾遵守预算与高效利用时间；harness注入计时信息可显著提升守时性，RL可近完美守时但无法将额外时间转化为性能提升。
AI.motivation: 研究LLM智能体能否在显式墙钟时间预算下有效工作，即既遵守运行时限又能高效利用时间。现有智能体缺乏时间感知、行动时长预估及"时间-策略"映射能力，作者希望探究干预手段能否弥补该缺陷。
AI.method: 在MLE-Bench Lite五个竞赛上评测Qwen3.6-27B，在Zork I（Jericho）上评测Qwen3-4B。基线为仅在prompt中声明预算；两类干预：(1) harness机制，注入计时反馈并设置强制截止钩子；(2) 基于GRPO的强化学习，使用预算感知奖励，并在多预算上训练。
AI.result: 仅prompt声明预算时，agent无法将预算转化为受控时间使用。harness注入计时信息后Qwen3.6-27B的预算遵守率大幅提升且性能无损，强制钩子进一步提升遵守率。GRPO在Zork I上达到近完美遵守并泛化到未见预算，但在MLE-Bench上未提升任务表现。遵守预算后，agent仍无法用额外时间提升性能：RL策略学会何时停止，却常用重复动作填充时间；多预算GRPO训练趋向坍缩到最短预算策略。
AI.conclusion: 时间遵守与高效时间分配之间存在关键鸿沟，后者仍是预算条件智能体的核心挑战。

title: Sample-Efficiency of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Deep reinforcement learning has achieved substantial performance gains over classical control approaches. Yet, a central challenge to learning in real-world applications is acquiring costly samples. Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks are a recently proposed architecture that can learn physical relationships in control problems effectively, with significantly higher parameter efficiency and interpretability when compared to Multi-Layer-Perceptron architectures. In this work, we systematically study sample-efficiency using computational experiments, covering the Feynman dataset and the Gymnasium RL benchmark. The results show that similar performance can be achieved with 40% fewer samples using the Kolmogorov-Arnold architecture, and that relative performance improvements up to 50% occur during the training process. The observed gains are robust to varying levels of noise in rewards. These results highlight the potential of the Kolmogorov-Arnold architectures for more sample-efficient reinforcement learning. Code: https://github.com/DerKevinRiehl/neurips26_kan_training

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KAN)在强化学习中的样本效率，实验表明相比MLP可减少40%样本量，训练过程中相对性能提升最高达50%，且对奖励噪声稳健。
AI.motivation: 实际应用中强化学习面临样本成本高昂的核心挑战。
AI.method: 通过计算实验系统性研究样本效率，涵盖Feynman数据集和Gymnasium强化学习基准。
AI.result: 使用KAN架构可减少40%样本量达到相似性能，训练过程中相对性能提升最高达50%，且性能增益对奖励噪声稳健。
AI.conclusion: KAN架构在实现更样本高效的强化学习方面具有潜力。

title: Skill Constellations: Tracing the Supply Chain of Agent Skills on GitHub
summary: Agent skills are SKILL.md instructions and scripts that AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex run with the permissions of their user. Developers share skills by copying them between repositories, which makes them a software supply chain without a registry, versions or provenance. The origin of a copied skill, the reach of a security fix and the repositories that warrant review are therefore unknown. Studies that record which repositories hold a skill at a single point in time cannot reveal who copied it from whom. We contribute the first dated copy network of agent skills, built from the git history of every SKILL.md in GitSkills and covering 2,193,119 skill adoptions across GitHub, together with an interactive viewer. A few repositories are the source of almost all copies, and GitHub stars do not identify them. Skill copies almost never change with their source, and a fix at the source therefore rarely reaches them. We fit a model of which repositories others copy from and use it to rank repositories for audit. Reviewing the 100 repositories it ranks highest prevents 14.9% of later adoptions of high-risk skills, against 0.5% for the 100 most starred, which gives security engineers a short list to check before a skill spreads. Platforms should therefore distribute versioned references rather than copies. Project Website: https://fahdseddik.github.io/Skill-Constellations/

AI.tldr: 该文构建了首个有日期的AI agent技能复制网络，基于GitSkills中所有SKILL.md的git历史，覆盖GitHub上219万次技能采用，并配交互式查看器，揭示技能的供应链风险。
AI.motivation: 开发者通过仓库间复制SKILL.md指令与脚本共享AI agent技能，但由于没有注册表、版本管理和来源信息，技能形成了一条不可追溯的软件供应链。被复制技能的来源、安全修复的传播范围以及需要审查的仓库都无法确定，而仅记录某一时点技能分布的静态研究也无法揭示谁复制了谁。
AI.method: 作者从GitSkills中每个SKILL.md的git历史出发，构建带时间戳的技能复制网络，覆盖GitHub上2,193,119次技能采用，并提供交互式查看器；同时拟合一个“哪些仓库被他人复制”的模型，用其对仓库进行审计优先级排序。
AI.result: 少数仓库是几乎所有副本的来源，且GitHub星标无法识别它们；技能副本几乎不随来源变化，因此源头的修复很少能传播到副本。按模型排名审查最高的100个仓库，可阻止14.9%后续高风险技能采用，而100个星标最多的仓库仅能阻止0.5%。
AI.conclusion: 平台应分发带版本的引用而非副本；所提出的审计短名单能帮助安全工程师在技能扩散前进行检查。

title: SPLIT-RL: Staged Perception-Language Reasoning Training with Claim-Level Advantages
summary: Vision-Language (VL) reasoning requires a model to both extract relevant and accurate information from an image (visual reasoning, VR), and to infer the answer from it (language reasoning, LR). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically trains both through a single chain-of-thought with a final-answer reward. This gives every CoT token the same sequence-level advantage, failing to distinguish capability specific errors. We propose SPLIT-RL, a staged post-training approach that trains VR and LR in disjoint phases. Because a group's rollouts differ along one capability at a time, the group-relative advantage isolates it, and each phase is optimized using phase-specific reward. We further introduce Claim-Level Advantage (CLA-GRPO), which decomposes VR-phase rollouts into atomic visual claims and provides a fine-grained advantage at claim level based on visual-type group formation. Although trained in two phases, trained policy is evaluated like GRPO model, with a single CoT call at inference time. Under this protocol, SPLIT-RL improves average accuracy over GRPO by 1.4-6.1 points across Qwen3-VL models from 2B to 30B-A3B and InternVL3.5-8B. Evaluating each capability using an oracle based diagnostic shows that answer-only GRPO leaves perception unchanged, whereas SPLIT-RL improves both VR and LR.

AI.tldr: 提出SPLIT-RL，将视觉推理与语言推理分阶段训练，并引入Claim-Level Advantage(CLA-GRPO)，在多种VL模型上平均准确率比GRPO提升1.4-6.1个点。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证奖励的强化学习只用单一思维链和最终答案奖励训练，导致所有CoT token共享同一序列级优势，无法区分视觉推理(VR)与语言推理(LR)两类能力各自产生的错误。
AI.method: SPLIT-RL分阶段后训练，将VR与LR在互不重叠的阶段分别训练：由于一组rollout在同一时间只变化一种能力，组相对优势可将其隔离，每阶段用专属奖励优化。进一步提出CLA-GRPO，在VR阶段把rollout分解为原子视觉主张(claim)，基于视觉类型分组形成claim级细粒度优势。推理时仍像GRPO一样只做一次CoT调用。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL(2B至30B-A3B)和InternVL3.5-8B上，SPLIT-RL平均准确率比GRPO提升1.4-6.1个点。基于oracle的诊断显示：仅答案的GRPO对感知无改善，而SPLIT-RL同时提升VR与LR。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段解耦VR与LR训练、并采用claim级优势，能更有效提升VL推理能力，且不增加推理成本。

title: NativeScope: Relation-Localized Retrieval over Native Topology with a Correct Anchor
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Includes an appendix with reproduction information and an evidence inventory
summary: Dense retrieval usually ranks text chunks by their semantic similarity to a question. This ignores structure that many data systems already store, including section membership, session boundaries, and native order. We propose NativeScope, a scope-then-rank method for queries with a known anchor and relation. It represents a query as q -> (A, r, B). The anchor A and relation r select native units through belonging, before, or after operators, and the target term B ranks only chunks that overlap the selected scope. An internal variant, NS-FullQ, ranks the same candidates with the full question. We evaluate both methods on 200 controlled document and memory records derived from QASPER and LongMemEval under a 1,024-token budget. NativeScope attains native-unit recall of 89.28 percent for documents and 72.50 percent for memories, improving over instance-wide Dense RAG by 42.75 and 22.00 percentage points. NS-FullQ reaches 87.78 percent and 68.50 percent; its differences from NativeScope are inconclusive, locating the primary gain in relational scoping rather than the shorter ranking query. With automatic Top-1 anchors, memory recall falls to 35.50 percent. NativeScope is therefore effective when anchor coordinates and native relations are reliable, but hard scoping inherits errors from the localization interface.

AI.tldr: NativeScope是一种"先定位范围后排序"的检索方法，利用数据结构原生关系（如章节、会话边界、顺序）将查询拆解为锚点A、关系r和目标B，先通过关系算子筛选原生单元，再在其中排序目标术语，从而提升检索召回率。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索通常仅按文本块与问题的语义相似度排序，忽略了数据系统中已有的结构信息（如章节归属、会话边界、原生顺序）。论文希望利用这些结构信息来提升检索的准确性。
AI.method: 提出NativeScope方法，将查询表示为q -> (A, r, B)：锚点A和关系r通过belonging、before、after算子选择原生单元，目标术语B仅在所选范围内对块进行排序。另设内部变体NS-FullQ，用完整问题对相同候选进行排序。在QASPER和LongMemEval派生的200条受控文档与记忆记录上，于1,024 token预算下评估。
AI.result: NativeScope在文档上的原生单元召回率为89.28%，记忆为72.50%，分别比实例级Dense RAG提升42.75和22.00个百分点。NS-FullQ为87.78%和68.50%，与NativeScope的差异不显著，表明主要增益来自关系范围定位而非更短的排序查询。使用自动Top-1锚点时，记忆召回率降至35.50%。
AI.conclusion: 当锚点坐标与原生关系可靠时，NativeScope有效；但硬范围定位会继承本地化界面的错误，锚点定位精度对最终效果影响显著。

title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS'26. Project page: https://vincie-next.github.io/
summary: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: VINCIE-NExT 通过图-视频上下文视觉示例，将图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑，缓解配对视频数据短缺问题。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑比视频生成更难，因为需要昂贵的 (源, 指令, 编辑后) 三元组数据，难以合成；而图像编辑已有数百万配对数据且成熟。
AI.method: 将视频编辑分解为可组合子任务链 Video→Image→Image→Video，把编辑意图路由到图像域，统一扩散目标下联合训练异构图像与视频语料；将图像编辑对作为上下文视觉示例前置，并引入共享空间坐标系的新型位置编码，使外观修改像素级传播到每帧；Chain-of-Editing 支持测试时通过渐进扩散阶段扩展算力而无需重训。
AI.result: 在 OpenVE-Bench 上跨多种编辑类别达到 SOTA，消融实验验证各组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以图像编辑能力迁移实现可扩展、可测试时扩展的视频编辑，减少对大规模配对视频数据的依赖。

title: Sparse Attention Is Matrix Approximation, Not Choosing from a Bag of Values
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many domains, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic cost of attention with respect to prompt length.
