Sparse attention reduces this cost by retaining only a small fraction of query-key interactions to approximate the full attention matrix. However, existing methods are trapped in a mathematically wrong view: they simply keep large scalar entries or high-mass regions of the attention matrix. This treats the attention matrix as a bag of values, ignoring that it is used as a structured matrix whose entries jointly determine the attention output through multiplication with value vectors. We argue that this is the core conceptual issue: sparse attention should be formulated as matrix approximation, not as blindly choosing the largest values from a bag of entries. Based on this view, we propose Matrix Approximation Sparse Attention (MASA). MASA replaces raw attention-mass ranking with a closed-form score that measures how much each sparse unit reduces matrix-product approximation error. As a theory-grounded plug-in correction, MASA can be added to existing sparse attention frameworks without changing their sparse kernels or budgets. Extensive experiments across multiple sparse attention methods, benchmarks, and LLM backbones show consistent accuracy gains, supporting both MASA and the matrix-approximation view of sparse attention.

AI.tldr: 本文将稀疏注意力重新表述为矩阵近似问题，提出MASA方法，用闭式评分衡量各稀疏单元对矩阵乘积近似误差的贡献，作为即插即用修正提升现有方法精度。
AI.motivation: LLM效率受限于注意力对提示长度的二次成本。现有稀疏注意力方法仅保留注意力矩阵中大标量值或高质量区域，将其视为"值的集合"，忽略了注意力矩阵是通过与value向量相乘共同决定输出的结构化矩阵，这一数学观点是错误的，是核心概念问题。
AI.method: 提出Matrix Approximation Sparse Attention (MASA)。用闭式评分替代原始注意力质量排序，衡量每个稀疏单元对矩阵乘积近似误差的减少程度。作为理论支撑的插件式修正，可加入现有稀疏注意力框架，不改变其稀疏核或预算。
AI.result: 在多种稀疏注意力方法、基准和LLM主干上实验，均获得一致的精度提升，支持MASA方法及稀疏注意力的矩阵近似观点。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力应被表述为矩阵近似而非盲目选择最大条目；MASA作为通用插件有效提升现有多方法的精度。

title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) in non-Markovian environments is a challenging problem because policies have to reason over contextual information over long horizons. Existing policy architectures rely on recurrent or attention-based mechanisms to capture long-term dependencies. However, recurrent models suffer from hidden-state collapse and gradient instability under backpropagation through time, while attention-based models are fundamentally limited by context length. To address these issues, we propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a novel self-supervised method that $\textit{discovers}$ a set of information-critical observations ($\textit{mnemonics}$) by learning an objective from randomly sampled past observations and using it as a reward for keyframe selection. We then train a BC policy that conditions on the discovered keyframes to model the action distribution. Under certain task-structure assumptions, our formulation provides context retention guarantees over an infinite horizon, while maintaining a small set of decision-relevant keyframes in the policy's working memory. We evaluate our method on synthetic memory domains, where mnemonic-conditioned BC policies achieve $100$% success rates (SR) and generalize to horizons orders of magnitude beyond training without performance degradation. Additionally, we evaluate on memory-intensive robot manipulation benchmark, achieving a $13.9$% average absolute SR improvement over the strongest baseline across $23$ tasks and retaining $80$% SR at $20\times$ longer horizons on a real robot. Code and videos are available at https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出Keyframe Mnemonics，一种自监督方法，通过从随机采样的过去观测中学习目标来发现信息关键帧（mnemonics），并用其作为奖励进行关键帧选择，从而训练以关键帧为条件的BC策略，实现无限视野下的上下文保持。
AI.motivation: 非马尔可夫环境下的行为克隆（BC）要求策略对长视野的上下文信息进行推理。现有策略架构中，循环模型面临隐状态坍缩和BPTT梯度不稳定问题，注意力模型则受限于上下文长度。
AI.method: 提出Keyframe Mnemonics：一种自监督方法，通过从随机采样的过去观测中学习一个目标，来"发现"一组信息关键观测（mnemonics），并将其用作关键帧选择的奖励。随后训练一个以所发现关键帧为条件的BC策略来建模动作分布。
AI.result: 在合成记忆任务上，以mnemonic为条件的BC策略达到100%成功率，并能泛化到远超训练数量级的视野而无性能下降。在记忆密集型机器人操作基准的23个任务上，平均绝对成功率比最强基线提升13.9%；在真实机器人上，视野延长20倍时仍保持80%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 在特定任务结构假设下，该公式提供了无限视野的上下文保持保证，同时在策略工作记忆中维持一小组决策相关的关键帧。代码和视频见 https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io。

title: Phase-HDC: Replacing Optimizer History with Gradient Thresholds in Discrete Phase Learning
summary: Training a compact model often needs far more memory than storing it, because the optimizer keeps its own records of past gradients. For a hyperdimensional classifier whose learned parameters are low-bit angles, which we call a \emph{phase memory}, these records take several times more memory than the model itself. We ask whether such a model can be trained while storing nothing but the model. The proposed method, Phase-HDC, turns each stored angle by at most one step per update, against the sign of its current gradient, and only when that gradient is large enough. We show that this simple rule is the exact solution of a first-order loss model in which every changed parameter pays a fixed cost. When everything except the update rule is held fixed, Phase-HDC matches the accuracy of Adam with 6-bit moments while storing three times less. Across eleven image, tabular, and text datasets, it stores 16--23$\times$ less than standard float32 Adam and 4--6$\times$ less than 8-bit Adam. The price is an average loss of about five accuracy points against float32 Adam, while Phase-HDC is more accurate than 8-bit Adam on six of the eleven datasets, including byte-level text prediction, where 8-bit Adam collapses. Instrumented training runs explain these outcomes. Once parameters must sit on a discrete grid, Adam's moments mainly decide whether a parameter moves at all, a decision that a threshold on the current gradient can make without memory, and coarse quantization of the moments breaks this decision for inputs that the data rarely contain. The storage savings are logical state rather than measured hardware memory.

AI.tldr: 提出Phase-HDC，一种仅存储模型本身（不保留优化器状态）即可训练低位角度分类器（phase memory）的方法，通过每步最多移动一个量化步长、沿当前梯度反方向、且仅在梯度足够大时更新。
AI.motivation: 训练紧凑模型的显存开销远大于存储模型本身，因为优化器需保存梯度历史（动量等）。对于学习参数为低位角度（phase memory）的超维分类器，这些记录占用内存是模型本身的数倍。本文探究：能否在仅存储模型本身的情况下完成训练。
AI.method: Phase-HDC：将每个存储角度在每次更新时朝当前梯度的反方向最多移动一个步长，且仅在梯度足够大时触发。作者证明该简单规则是一阶损失模型的精确解——该模型假设每个被改变的参数都付出固定代价。
AI.result: 在其余设置固定的情况下，Phase-HDC达到6-bit动量Adam的精度，但存储少3倍；在11个图像、表格和文本数据集上，比标准float32 Adam存储少16–23倍，比8-bit Adam少4–6倍。代价是相对float32 Adam平均损失约5个精度点；但在11个数据集中的6个上优于8-bit Adam，包括8-bit Adam崩溃的字节级文本预测。
AI.conclusion: 一旦参数必须落在离散网格上，Adam的动量主要决定参数是否移动，而这一决定可通过当前梯度阈值在无内存情况下做出；动量的粗量化会在数据中少见的输入上破坏该决定。所报告的存储节省是逻辑状态层面的，而非实测硬件内存。

title: Who Pays the Review Cost? Triage, Fairness, and Accountability in AI-authored Pull Requests
summary: AI coding agents are moving from local code assistance into pull-based workflows, where generated contributions must be reviewed, explained, and maintained within existing project norms. Although recent work has begun to characterize AI-authored pull requests (AIPRs), less is known about how reviewers govern their entry into review, how AI authorship reshapes credibility and fairness, and what intake mechanisms protect review sustainability. We report a mixed-method questionnaire survey of 239 practitioners from 31 countries with code-review experience and varying exposure to AIPRs. In the scenarios and self-reports elicited by the survey, AI authorship was not a categorical rejection signal. Instead, respondents described review effort as conditional on whether an AIPR arrived as an accountable contribution, with bounded scope, project-grounded rationale, validation beyond Continuous Integration (CI), contributor responsiveness, and identifiable post-merge ownership. This conditional logic extended to newcomer AIPRs, where respondents emphasized visible participation in the current review process over profile-level reputation alone. Qualitative responses further described shifts in mentoring, scrutiny, deferral, and routing when human stewardship was difficult to observe. We conceptualize missing rationale, validation, and ownership as reviewability debt, the work reviewers must absorb when generated code lacks sufficient human grounding. These findings reframe AIPR governance around making human judgment observable before generated contributions consume scarce reviewer attention.

AI.tldr: 通过对31国239名代码评审者的混合方法问卷调查，发现AI作者身份并非拒绝信号，评审者依据"可问责性"条件决定评审投入，并提出"评审债"概念。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体正从本地辅助转向基于Pull Request的协作流程，AI生成的贡献需在既有项目规范下被评审、解释和维护。现有研究虽已初步刻画AI作者PR（AIPR），但对评审者如何管控其进入评审流程、AI作者身份如何重塑可信度与公平性、以及何种准入机制能保护评审可持续性仍知之甚少。
AI.method: 对来自31个国家的239名有代码评审经验、且接触AIPR程度不同的从业者开展混合方法问卷调查，通过情境题与自我报告获取数据，并进行定性分析。
AI.result: AI作者身份并非一票否决的信号；评审投入取决于AIPR是否作为"可问责的贡献"出现，具体包括范围受限、项目相关理据、CI之外的验证、贡献者响应性、以及可识别的合并后归属。该条件逻辑同样适用于新人AIPR，受访者更看重在当前评审过程中的可见参与，而非仅凭画像层面的声誉。定性反馈还揭示了当人类主导难以观察时，指导、审查、延迟与分流的转变。
AI.conclusion: 作者将缺失的理据、验证与归属概念化为"评审债"（reviewability debt），即生成代码缺乏充分人类根基时评审者被迫承担的工作。研究将AIPR治理重新聚焦于：在生成贡献消耗稀缺评审注意力之前，使人类判断变得可观察。

title: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
summary: Video-language models commonly assume that more temporal observations lead to more reliable reasoning. We question this assumption and argue that the key challenge is not merely processing more video frames efficiently, but learning to reason reliably under limited temporal evidence. We propose SAVER, a dense-to-sparse post-training framework that uses dense video views as training-time references for sparse-frame inference. During reinforcement post-training, paired dense and sparse views are optimized with grounding rewards and a reliability-gated reference reward, encouraging sparse view predictions to preserve task-relevant temporal evidence. Notably, SAVER is trained only on 1,250 randomly sampled temporal grounding examples, without using any video question answering annotations. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks and six video question-answering benchmarks, SAVER consistently improves performance across frame budgets. In particular, SAVER can match or surpass dense-frame Qwen3.5 baselines while using substantially fewer frames. These results show that temporal grounding can serve as an effective evidence-localization proxy for learning sparse video reasoning that transfers to broader video understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: SAVER是一个从稠密到稀疏的后训练框架，用稠密视频视图作为训练参考，使稀疏帧推理能保留任务相关的时间证据，从而在有限时间证据下实现可靠推理。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型通常假设更多时间观测带来更可靠推理。本文质疑该假设，认为核心挑战不是更高效地处理更多帧，而是在有限时间证据下学习可靠推理。
AI.method: 提出SAVER框架：在强化后训练中，使用成对的稠密与稀疏视频视图，结合grounding奖励和可靠性门控的参考奖励进行优化，使稀疏视图预测保留任务相关的时间证据。仅用1250个随机采样的时间定位样本训练，不使用任何视频问答标注。
AI.result: 在三个时间定位基准和六个视频问答基准上，SAVER在不同帧预算下持续提升性能。特别地，SAVER能用显著更少的帧匹配或超过稠密帧Qwen3.5基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明时间定位可作为有效的证据定位代理，用于学习可迁移至更广泛视频理解任务的稀疏视频推理。

title: Compact and Efficient Indexes for Learned Sparse Retrieval
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering 2027 (IEEE ICDE 2027)
summary: This paper investigates how to substantially reduce the memory footprint of learned sparse retrieval indexes without sacrificing the efficiency of state-of-the-art retrieval data structures. Building on SEISMIC, we revisit both levels of its design: the inverted index used to select candidates and the forward index used to score them. For the inverted index, we replace costly per-block summaries with medoids, namely existing documents elected as block representatives, collapsing the per-block metadata from a sparse vector to a single document identifier. For the forward index, we compress both components and values. We reorder the vocabulary to place co-occurring components closer together and encode the resulting $Δ$-gaps with DOTPACKING8, a SIMD-friendly bit-packing scheme that fuses decompression with dot-product evaluation; values are quantized with compact per-component 4-bit codebooks fitted to each component's distribution. We further introduce JUMPDOT, a blocked dot-product kernel tailored for queries that contain only a few non-zero entries. Our forward-index compression is independent of SEISMIC and can be plugged into any system relying on forward-index-based scoring, as we demonstrate by integrating it into KANNOLO. A comprehensive evaluation on MS MARCO with three state-of-the-art learned sparse encoders shows that our solutions markedly improve the speed-space trade-off of learned sparse retrieval: at equal accuracy, our indexes answer queries up to 5.3x faster than the best competitor while using about 3x less memory, and in the most memory-constrained regime, they remain up to 1.9x faster while using up to 3.9x less memory.

AI.tldr: 本文通过改进SEISMIC倒排索引与正排索引设计,大幅降低学习稀疏检索索引的内存占用,同时保持高效检索。
AI.motivation: 学习稀疏检索索引内存占用大,需在保持检索效率和精度的同时显著压缩内存。
AI.method: 倒排索引用medoids替代每块摘要,将元数据压缩为单个文档标识;正排索引压缩组件与值:重排词表使共现组件靠近,用DOTPACKING8编码Δ-gap并融合解压与点积,值用4-bit码本量化;还提出JUMPDOT用于少量非零项的查询。
AI.result: 在MS MARCO上,三种先进学习稀疏编码器测试:同等精度下查询速度快5.3x且内存少约3x;内存最受限时仍快1.9x且内存少3.9x。正排索引压缩可独立集成到KANNOLO。
AI.conclusion: 所提方案显著改善学习稀疏检索的速度-空间权衡,正排索引压缩具有通用性。

title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
summary: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用相对位姿引导的RGB-D图像复用替代邻近视角重复渲染的框架，将场景渲染与局部视角更新解耦，实现低延迟交互式场景探索。
AI.motivation: 交互式场景探索需要频繁更新视角，但小幅度相机运动时可见内容大部分重叠。传统3D Gaussian Splatting对每个目标视角都重新渲染，未利用这种图像重叠，效率低。
AI.method: 基于单场景框架：用深度和相对位姿的几何warping传输源内容；用轻量多尺度网络预测RGB残差，修正伪影并推断新暴露内容；缓存源特征以减少重复计算。
AI.result: 在GS-render上，残差细化比纯warping提升PSNR约0.72 dB；在真实采集和渲染场景上均展示出低查询延迟。
AI.conclusion: 将场景渲染与局部视角更新分离，可支持响应式场景探索，在AR/VR等应用中具有潜力。

title: Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from a stronger teacher to a student language model through dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts and has shown promise on complex tasks such as mathematical reasoning. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student decisions shape subsequent observations, causing early errors to accumulate across turns. The resulting trajectories can drift away from the teacher's rollout distribution, making the teacher's token-level supervision less reliable or even counterproductive for OPD training. To address this issue, we introduce STI-OPD, a stochastic teacher intervention framework for multi-turn agentic OPD. During multi-turn interaction, STI-OPD uses teacher intervention guided by teacher-student policy discrepancy to replace the student's proposed action with a teacher-generated one to maximize the acquisition of reliable supervision. We further develop a stochastic intervention strategy, addressing the limitations of previous threshold-based or fixed-schedule approaches, that estimates policy discrepancy using KL divergence and maps it to an intervention probability. By sampling whether to intervene from this probability, STI-OPD adaptively balances teacher control with student exploration. To learn from the resulting mixed-policy trajectories, we introduce an Importance-Weighted Reverse KL objective that corrects the token sampling mismatch between teacher-generated responses and the student policy to preserve the original OPD objective. Across tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon interaction, STI-OPD outperforms the strongest prior OPD baseline on every evaluated benchmark and student size. Ablations further show that both discrepancy-guided intervention and importance weighting contribute to these gains.

AI.tldr: 提出STI-OPD框架，通过基于师生策略差异的随机教师干预解决多轮智能体on-policy蒸馏中的轨迹漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体任务中，学生决策影响后续观测，早期错误逐轮累积导致轨迹偏离教师分布，使教师token级监督不可靠甚至有害。
AI.method: STI-OPD：用KL散度估计师生策略差异并映射为干预概率；随机采样是否干预，用教师动作替换学生动作以平衡教师控制与学生探索；引入重要性加权反向KL目标，校正混策略轨迹中的token采样不匹配，保持原始OPD目标。
AI.result: 在工具集成推理与长程交互任务上，STI-OPD在所有评测基准和不同学生规模上均超越最强OPD基线；消融实验表明差异引导干预与重要性加权均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: STI-OPD通过差异引导的随机干预与重要性加权目标，有效缓解多轮智能体OPD的轨迹漂移问题，提升蒸馏效果。

title: Reading the Room: Foundations, Design, and Challenges of Normative Competence in LLMs
summary: Human communities are governed by normative systems: shared standards that produce \textit{norms} dictating acceptable behavior, enforced through community sanctioning. Aligning increasingly autonomous AI systems with these norms is a central alignment challenge, complicated by the fact that norms are vast in number, change quickly, and are often arbitrary (e.g., dress or language conventions). Thus, alignment requires \textit{normative competence}: the ability to discern from interaction alone what norms a community enforces without relying on static pretrained knowledge. We introduce a multi-agent community debate setting, where access to debate is governed by synthetic norms, to study normative competence in isolation from pretraining exposure. We show that baseline LLM agents fail to learn norms even when doing so would improve their accuracy. We then experiment with various \textit{normative modules} -- architectural components for norm inference -- finding that norm-following is highly sensitive to both the style of norm and the model powering the normative module, suggesting a lack of generalizability. Furthermore, when idiosyncratic, non-normative behaviors accompany the true norm, LLM agents exhibit an unselective attribution failure: they indiscriminately copy idiosyncratic noise alongside enforced rules, a pattern that persists even when imitating unnecessary behaviors is explicitly penalized. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to operationalize and evaluate normative competence in LLMs, demonstrating that current AI systems excel at behavioral mimicry but lack the capacity to discern socially enforced order.

AI.tldr: 本文首次操作化并评估LLM的"规范能力"（normative competence），即仅通过交互推断社区所执行的规范。作者构建了一个多智能体社区辩论场景（辩论准入由合成规范管控），发现基线LLM即使学习规范能提升准确率也学不会；规范模块效果高度依赖规范风格与模型能力，缺乏泛化性；且当真实规范伴随特异性行为时，LLM会不加区分地模仿噪声。
AI.motivation: 人类社区由规范系统治理，而规范数量庞大、变化快且常为任意约定（如着装、语言惯例）。对齐日益自主的AI系统需要"规范能力"，即不依赖静态预训练知识、仅通过交互辨别社区所执行的规范。现有研究缺乏对该能力的操作化与评估。
AI.method: 提出多智能体社区辩论场景，辩论准入由合成规范控制，从而将规范能力与预训练暴露隔离研究。测试基线LLM智能体；实验多种"规范模块"（norm inference的架构组件）；并在真实规范伴随特异性（非规范）行为时考察其归因表现。
AI.result: 基线LLM智能体即使学习规范能提升准确率也失败；规范遵循对规范风格和规范模块所用模型极为敏感，表明缺乏泛化性；当存在特异性非规范行为时，出现"无选择性归因失败"，即连同噪声一起盲目模仿，且在明确惩罚模仿无用行为时依然如此。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次操作化并评估LLM的规范能力，表明当前AI系统擅长行为模仿，却缺乏辨别社会所执行秩序的能力。这揭示了对齐研究中的关键缺口。

title: D-SLR: The Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank Decomposition
summary: Compressing a matrix for reconstruction still defaults to the truncated SVD, approximating the data with a single low-rank structure. It is common to reduce the residual further by adding an overlapping row-sparse component, but methods that solve this joint problem often require iterative solvers and tuning of regularization parameters. We propose the Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank (D-SLR) decomposition, a closed-form drop-in for the truncated SVD that improves or exactly matches it. D-SLR restricts rows to either being stored verbatim or approximated by the low-rank fit, never both. Under squared error this restriction costs nothing: the joint optimum is attainable disjointly with fewer parameters at every non-trivial rank and stored row count (shape). With zero stored rows D-SLR reduces to the truncated SVD, so it never does worse at equal cost. The algorithm scores the entire error-versus-parameters tradeoff, and the solution is chosen afterwards by a supplied error target or parameter count, or by a selection rule. The grid and solution together cost three SVDs, with no tuning or regularization. We derive an assumption-free, a-posteriori lower bound on the error at every shape, giving each solution a computable certificate on the potential gain of any other choice of rank and stored rows. Experiments on synthetic and real data (LLM embedding tables, network traffic, hyperspectral images) confirm the gains and quantify the certificate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 D-SLR 分解：一种闭式、无需调参的截断 SVD 替代方案，将行严格划分为“逐字存储”或“低秩近似”两部分，在平方误差下可达到与一般联合优化相同的联合最优，且参数更少、永不劣于截断 SVD。
AI.motivation: 矩阵压缩重建默认使用截断 SVD，仅用单一低秩结构逼近数据；为进一步降低残差常加入重叠的行稀疏成分，但此类联合问题多依赖迭代求解器和正则参数调优，代价高且不实用。
AI.method: 提出 Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank (D-SLR) 分解：将行限制为要么逐字存储、要么用低秩拟合近似，二者不重叠。算法一次性给出整个“误差-参数”权衡曲线，随后可由给定误差目标、参数数量或选择规则确定解。整个网格与求解仅需三次 SVD，无需调参或正则化。并推导了每个形状下无假设的、后验误差下界，为每个解提供可计算证书，衡量其他秩/存储行选择的潜在收益。
AI.result: 在平方误差下，该行互斥限制不带来损失：联合最优可在更少参数下以互斥方式达到，且在任意非平凡秩与存储行数（形状）均成立；存储行数为零时退化为截断 SVD，故同成本下永不更差。在合成数据及真实数据（LLM 嵌入表、网络流量、高光谱图像）上验证了收益并量化了证书。
AI.conclusion: D-SLR 可作为截断 SVD 的闭式直接替换，在无需调参的前提下改善或至少匹配其性能，并提供误差下界证书以指导秩与存储行数的选择。

title: Characterizing Overconfident Failure in LLM-Based Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated code generation, but generated programs can appear syntactically plausible while still failing execution-based correctness checks. Existing validation methods, such as testing and program analysis, remain essential but are often incomplete, costly, or applied only after generation. Model-derived uncertainty is therefore a natural early reliability signal. This paper studies the dilemma of overconfidence in code LLMs where incorrect programs are often generated with token-level confidence comparable to correct programs. We study this dilemma across four open-source code models and three execution-based benchmarks. Our analysis begins by investigating whether existing uncertainty metrics provide reliable proxies for execution correctness in code generation. We then characterize overconfidence at both global and local token levels, asking whether incorrect programs remain indistinguishable from correct ones under confidence and entropy summaries, including selective generation and the limits of instruction tuning. Finally, we evaluate whether common mitigation strategies reduce this failure mode. Our study yields four findings. First, existing uncertainty signals provide only partial and model-dependent evidence of execution failure. Second, overconfidence persists at both program and token levels, and uncertainty-based selection does not consistently improve accepted-set accuracy. Third, instruction tuning can increase certainty on failing generations without consistently improving correctness discrimination. Fourth, common mitigation techniques improve specific aspects of reliability but do not reliably resolve overconfident failure. Our exploratory latent analysis suggests that hidden representations may encode correctness-related signals that output confidence does not expose.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代码大模型"过度自信"问题：错误程序常与正确程序具有相近的token级置信度，现有不确定性能否作为执行正确性的可靠代理存在明显局限。
AI.motivation: LLM生成代码虽句法合理却常在执行正确性上失败；测试与程序分析等验证方法不完整、成本高且多在生成后使用，因此模型自身的不确定性成为自然的早期可靠性信号，但其可靠性尚不明确。
AI.method: 在4个开源代码模型与3个基于执行的基准上，先检验现有不确定性指标是否可靠代理执行正确性；再从全局与局部token两个层面刻画过度自信（含选择性生成、指令微调的局限）；最后评估常见缓解策略，并做探索性潜层分析。
AI.result: 四项发现：(1) 现有不确定性信号对执行失败的指示仅部分有效且依赖模型；(2) 过度自信在程序与token层面均持续存在，基于不确定性的选择不能稳定提升接受集准确率；(3) 指令微调会提高失败生成的确定性，却未稳定改善正确性判别；(4) 常见缓解技术只能改善特定方面，无法可靠解决过度自信的失败。潜层分析显示隐藏表示可能编码了输出置信度未暴露的正确性信号。
AI.conclusion: 输出层置信度不足以可靠反映代码执行正确性，过度自信是代码LLM的顽固失效模式；未来方向可探索利用隐藏表示等内部信号来更可靠地检测生成代码的正确性。

title: GHARP: Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 35 pages (14 main + references + 15 pages supplementary), 14 figures, 17 tables
summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject's geometry and appearance offline, and an animation stage that predicts expression-dependent residuals on top of it at runtime. This separation offers a favorable trade-off with respect to fidelity, quality and runtime: the identity stage can be expensive while the animation stage runs a lightweight network, optimized for mobile devices. Our method performs animation in a semantically structured latent space of a pretrained reconstruction model, where expression changes remain spatially contained, making residual prediction efficient. This reconstruction prior provides a consistent spatial layout, allowing fusion of multiple input views into a compact, fixed-size canonical Gaussian representation. While this two-stage design improves the runtime-quality trade-off, it still inherits a problem common to all expression-driven avatar methods: expression codes describe only the face and thus omit body pose and clothing position, making these regions underspecified in the input. The animation network faces an ill-posed mapping and resorts to averaging over conflicting body appearances, producing blur and temporal flicker. We address this with a body alignment network that learns to align the person's body in the target image with the input reference images, removing the ambiguity from the training signal. Our method achieves state-of-the-art quality on the Ava-256 benchmark while running up to 13x faster on an A100 GPU with 8x fewer Gaussians.

AI.tldr: GHARP通过两阶段（离线身份重建+实时动画）在预训练重建模型的语义潜空间中实现3D人头实时动画，并用身体对齐网络解决身体姿态和衣物位置未定义导致的模糊与闪烁问题，在Ava-256上达到SOTA且速度快13倍、高斯数少8倍。
AI.motivation: 表达式驱动的头像方法中，表情编码只描述面部，忽略了身体姿态和衣物位置，导致这些区域输入欠定义，动画网络面对病态映射只能对冲突的身体外观取平均，产生模糊和时间闪烁。
AI.method: 将问题解耦为离线身份阶段（构建主体的几何与外观表示，融合多视图为紧凑固定大小的规范高斯表示）和运行时动画阶段（在预训练重建模型的语义结构潜空间中预测表情相关残差，轻量网络适合移动端）；并引入身体对齐网络，将目标图像中的人物身体与输入参考图对齐，消除训练信号中的歧义。
AI.result: 在Ava-256基准上达到最先进质量，在A100 GPU上运行速度最高快13倍，且使用的高斯数量少8倍。
AI.conclusion: 分离身份与动画阶段可在保真度、质量和运行时之间取得有利权衡，语义潜空间使残差预测高效，身体对齐网络有效去除歧义，从而实现高质量实时3D人头动画。

title: Language Models for Page-Level Layout Decisions in E-commerce Search
comment: Accepted at the OARS Workshop, ACM RecSys 2026
summary: E-commerce search pages are critical touchpoints for millions of online shoppers. While traditional search engines return a ranked list of results, modern E-commerce search pages increasingly incorporate recommender system modules -- for example, secondary stacks that surface alternative product groupings at specific positions. When introduced appropriately, secondary stacks can improve user engagement; however, suboptimal placement may disrupt browsing flow and degrade the primary results. Unlike traditional search ranking, where evaluation techniques such as interleaving are well established, evaluating page-level layout changes e.g., when and where to insert a secondary stack remains challenging without costly online A/B testing. To address this, we study offline methods for evaluating whether a given layout decision -- specifically, the inclusion of a secondary stack at a particular position -- is beneficial to users. We investigate language models as scalable evaluators by comparing direct prompt-based, prompt-derived feature, and representation-based methods. Our results show that representation-based approaches consistently outperform prompt-based judging in predicting user engagement, suggesting they provide a reliable foundation for offline layout evaluation in E-commerce search.

AI.tldr: 研究离线评估电商搜索页面布局决策（是否在特定位置插入二级堆叠模块）的方法，比较语言模型的直接提示、提示衍生特征和表征方法，发现表征方法预测用户参与度最佳。
AI.motivation: 电商搜索页中二级堆叠等推荐模块的布局位置影响用户参与度，但评估此类页面级布局变化缺乏像传统搜索排序那样成熟的离线评估技术（如interleaving），依赖昂贵的在线A/B测试。
AI.method: 研究离线评估特定布局决策（二级堆叠是否加在某位置）是否有益。以语言模型作为可扩展评估器，对比三类方法：直接基于提示的判断、提示衍生特征、以及基于表征的方法。
AI.result: 在预测用户参与度上，基于表征的方法一致优于基于提示的判断方法。
AI.conclusion: 表征方法为电商搜索的离线布局评估提供了可靠基础，可替代昂贵的在线A/B测试。

title: Large Language Models for Machine Translation Quality Annotation: Humans and Models Are Both Challenged
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are considered to be a more efficient and cost-effective alternative to human judgment for Machine Translation (MT) evaluation. With MT evaluation spanning a large number of language pairs, domains and levels of annotation granularity, LLMs must be thoroughly evaluated across these dimensions before being reliably used as alternatives to human evaluation. In this paper, we evaluate the performance of LLMs for two prominent MT quality evaluation schemes: Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) and Error Span Annotation (ESA) by comparing their agreement with human annotators. We present results on a long-context test set of 70 language pairs and the publicly available WMT23 and WMT25 data, investigating both score and error span annotation agreement across a variety of language pairs and domains. Our results show that while LLM agreement with human annotators exceeds agreement between human annotators for some evaluation tasks, both vary substantially across annotation schemes, language pairs and domains and remain unreliable for most settings. Furthermore, we identify challenges facing both human and LLM annotators: humans are particularly challenged by fine-grained MQM annotations and low-resource language pairs, while LLMs struggle with minor errors, wrong language variants and error span annotation. Our results highlight the potential for improvement for both human and LLM annotation performance, possibly through human-LLM collaborative annotation pipelines that address the reliability issues identified in this work.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估LLM在机器翻译质量评估（MQM与ESA两种方案）中的表现，发现LLM与人工标注的一致率虽然在某些任务上超过人工间一致率，但整体随标注方案、语言对和领域波动大，多数场景仍不可靠，并指出人工与LLM各自的薄弱环节。
AI.motivation: LLM被视为比人工判断更高效、成本更低的机器翻译评估替代方案，但MT评估涉及大量语言对、领域和标注粒度，LLM需在这些维度上被充分评估后才能可靠替代人工评估。现有工作缺乏跨方案、跨语言对、跨领域的系统比较。
AI.method: 针对MQM和ESA两种主流MT质量评估方案，比较LLM与人工标注者的一致性。使用70个语言对的长上下文测试集，以及公开的WMT23和WMT25数据，在多种语言对和领域上同时考察分数标注一致性与错误片段（error span）标注一致性。
AI.result: LLM与人工的一致性在某些评估任务上超过人工标注者之间的一致性；但该一致性在标注方案、语言对和领域间差异显著，多数设置下仍不可靠。人工标注者尤其受细粒度MQM标注和低资源语言对困扰；LLM则难以处理细微错误、错误语言变体和错误片段标注。
AI.conclusion: 人工与LLM标注性能均有提升空间；本文识别出的可靠性问题或可通过人工-LLM协作标注流程加以缓解。

title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning environments are now a primary lever for improving large language model (LLM) capabilities in post-training, yet most agentic benchmarks remain static: the world moves only when the agent acts, the reward is a terminal verdict, and the pass bar is set arbitrarily. We introduce StoreBench, a live-commerce environment in which an agent runs a mid-size online apparel store on a production-grade commerce backend, testing long-horizon planning and economic judgment under uncertainty. Customers order around the clock, suppliers reprice and fail, and market shocks arrive with partial or no warning. The agent acts through the same 29 merchant tools a human operator would use, under a windowed operation budget that makes simulated time a function of actions taken, so model latency cannot influence simulated time. Pass thresholds are calibrated against scripted anchor policies, the reward is hardened against a catalogue of reward hacks, and every episode replays identically given a sequence of actions. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs on 11 scenarios of 30 to 45 days and a full simulated year, over three world seeds at matched reasoning effort. No model matches the scripted smart-triage policy on average: the best, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, passes 49% of task-seed cells against the heuristic's 97%. Human experts working through the same tools and budgets outscore every model (mean composite 0.708 vs. 0.700). Over a full simulated year under the Claude Code harness, most models show dramatic performance improvement. In a GRPO post-training run, Qwen3.5-27B trained on only five disjoint tasks raises its mean composite on the held-out evaluation tasks from 0.136 to 0.373. We release five example training-split tasks, ten sample trajectories, and the scoring and verification tooling; the full environment and evaluation suite are withheld to keep the benchmark uncontaminated.

AI.tldr: 提出 StoreBench 实时电商环境，检验 LLM 长程规划与经济决策能力，发现无模型能匹敌脚本启发式策略。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准多为静态：世界仅在智能体行动时变化，奖励为终止性判定，通过门槛任意设定，无法真实评估长程规划与不确定性下的经济判断。
AI.method: 构建生产级电商后端的在线服装店环境，客户全天候下单、供应商调价或失约、市场冲击无预警；智能体使用与人类相同的 29 个商家工具，受窗口化操作预算约束使模拟时间仅由动作决定；通过脚本锚定策略校准通过阈值，加固奖励防作弊，并保证逐动作可复现。
AI.result: 七个前沿 LLM 在 11 个场景（30-45 天及整年）、三个世界种子下评测：最佳 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 仅通过 49% 任务-种子单元，而启发式为 97%；人类专家平均综合分 0.708 高于所有模型 0.700；整年模拟下多数模型性能大幅提升；GRPO 后训练中 Qwen3.5-27B 仅用五个任务将留出集均值从 0.136 提至 0.373。
AI.conclusion: StoreBench 揭示了当前 LLM 在动态经济环境中的显著短板，同时证明后训练可有效提升表现；公开五个训练任务、十条示例轨迹及评分验证工具，完整环境与评测套件暂不公开以防污染。

title: Visible Reasoning Is Not a Universal Optimizer: Persona- and Thinking-Dependent Effects in Analytics Code Generation
summary: Visible Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is often treated as a broadly useful reasoning instruction, yet analytics code generation combines natural-language ambiguity, schema grounding, target-language constraints, and model-specific inference behavior. Because the same analytics request can be expressed in two distinct target languages-SQL and Python (pandas)-this setting provides a natural test of a common but under-examined assumption: that visible reasoning is more effective when its representation matches the requested target, as in "think in SQL" or "think in Python." Together with generic instructions such as "think step-by-step," such recommendations remain insufficiently evaluated under controlled, execution-based comparisons. We study a query matched SQL-pandas benchmark that crosses persona phrasing, target language, visible-CoT format, control prefixes, direct generation, and internal-reasoning configurations. The results do not support either a universal accuracy advantage from visible CoT or a consistent benefit from matching the reasoning representation to the target language. Instead, the effects depend on the persona, target, model configuration, and internal-reasoning setting. The control ablations further distinguish effects of reasoning content from those of prompt format. These findings indicate that reasoning strategies should be selected jointly for the model, persona, target, and internal-reasoning configuration rather than adopted as universal defaults. More broadly, the study provides a controlled framework for identifying when visible reasoning improves executable generation, when it primarily perturbs model behavior, and when the internal-reasoning configuration is the more consequential factor.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究可见思维链(CoT)在分析代码生成中的有效性，发现在SQL与Python(pandas)任务中，可见CoT和"推理表示与目标语言匹配"均无普遍优势，效果依赖persona、目标语言、模型配置和内部推理设置。
AI.motivation: 可见CoT被广泛视为通用推理指令，但分析代码生成涉及自然语言歧义、模式接地、目标语言约束等问题。SQL与Python双目标语言为检验"推理表示匹配目标语言更有效"这一未充分验证的假设提供了天然测试场景。
AI.method: 构建query-matched的SQL-pandas基准，交叉考察persona措辞、目标语言、可见CoT格式、控制前缀、直接生成及内部推理配置，进行受控且基于执行的比较，并通过控制消融区分推理内容与提示格式的效应。
AI.result: 结果既不支持可见CoT的通用准确率优势，也不支持推理表示匹配目标语言的一致性收益；效果依赖persona、目标、模型配置与内部推理设置。
AI.conclusion: 推理策略应针对模型、persona、目标语言与内部推理配置联合选择，而非作为通用默认。该研究提供了识别可见推理何时改善可执行生成、何时仅扰动模型行为的受控框架。

title: Closed-loop evaluation of LLM agents for embedded software development
comment: Published in Journal of Systems Architecture 179 (2026) 103937. 23 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/jgcarrasco/closed_loop_evaluation_agents_embedded
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as coding agents that edit files, run builds and tests, inspect execution results, and repair software iteratively. Embedded firmware is a demanding target because correctness depends on closed-loop behavior under sensing, timing, and safety constraints, not only on static source quality. Yet embedded-agent evaluation remains limited and often emphasizes one-shot synthesis or offline correctness.
  We present a benchmark for closed-loop evaluation of embedded coding agents. Each task provides a plain-text engineering description, constrained workspace, and visible build-and-runtime surface. The agent must translate requirements into implementation and self-verification steps, then iterate until the required device behavior is achieved. The suite contains five embedded-control tasks and four feedback scenarios: one-shot generation, realistic self-verification, CI-style red/green feedback, and oracle-style detailed feedback.
  The implementation targets simulated ESP32 firmware for reproducibility. We evaluate seven GPT-family and Qwen-family configurations across five tasks and four scenarios, with three repetitions per condition for 420 runs. gpt-5.4 has the highest pass rate among evaluated configurations but does not saturate the benchmark; qwen3.5-27B is the strongest observed local model; and smaller local models degrade sharply in pass rate and search efficiency. These results suggest that capable local embedded coding agents are emerging.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向嵌入式编码智能体的闭环评估基准，包含5个嵌入式控制任务和4种反馈场景，在模拟ESP32上评测7种GPT/Qwen模型共420次运行，发现gpt-5.4通过率最高但未饱和，本地模型能力正在提升。
AI.motivation: LLM编码智能体越来越多用于编辑文件、运行构建测试并迭代修复软件。嵌入式固件是困难目标，因为其正确性依赖感知、时序和安全约束下的闭环行为，而非静态源码质量。然而现有嵌入式智能体评估有限，多偏重一次性合成或离线正确性。
AI.method: 构建闭环评估基准，每个任务提供纯文本工程描述、受限工作区和可见的构建运行接口。智能体需将需求转化为实现与自验证步骤并迭代，直到达到所需设备行为。套件含5个嵌入式控制任务和4种反馈场景：一次性生成、真实自验证、CI式红绿反馈、oracle式详细反馈。实现基于模拟ESP32固件以保证可复现。
AI.result: 在5个任务和4种场景下评测7种GPT族与Qwen族配置，每个条件重复3次，共420次运行。gpt-5.4在被评测配置中通过率最高但未使基准饱和；qwen3.5-27B是观察到的最强本地模型；较小本地模型在通过率和搜索效率上急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明具备能力的本地嵌入式编码智能体正在兴起。

title: GPU-Accelerated Computation of Persistent Homology for Topological Analysis of Image Data
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Includes supplementary material (8 pages) after the main paper. Code: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data
summary: In recent years, persistent homology has seen rapid adoption in deep learning, yet its computation remains a major bottleneck in network training. This paper introduces TopoGPU, a GPU streaming pipeline that computes persistence diagrams of cubical complexes induced by 2D and 3D images. TopoGPU streams the input image chunk by chunk, processing each chunk with massively parallel GPU kernels on a grid of GPU blocks; the resulting boundary relations are accumulated in host memory, where the CPU performs the boundary matrix reduction. TopoGPU introduces a stratification-aware discrete Morse matching that provably preserves persistent homology under streaming, together with a parallel topological sorting algorithm and a parallel V-path parity algorithm for deriving Morse boundaries on the GPU. TopoGPU outperforms Cubical Ripser, a state-of-the-art method for persistent homology computation, on every benchmark evaluated, achieving an average end-to-end speedup of 53.24x and a maximum of 198.01x. We further integrate TopoGPU into a topology-preserving deep network, demonstrating that it substantially reduces the cost of persistent homology computation during network training. TopoGPU is open source, with pre-built binaries, Google Colab notebooks, and Docker images available at the project's GitHub page: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data.

AI.tldr: TopoGPU 是一个 GPU 流式流水线，用于计算 2D/3D 图像立方复形的持久图，平均加速 53.24x，最高 198.01x。
AI.motivation: 持久同调在深度学习中应用日益广泛，但其计算是网络训练的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: TopoGPU 逐块流式处理图像，用大规模并行 GPU 核处理每个块，边界关系累积到主机内存由 CPU 做边界矩阵约简；提出保持持久同调的层化感知离散 Morse 匹配、并行拓扑排序算法和并行 V-path 奇偶性算法。
AI.result: 在所有评测基准上均优于 Cubical Ripser，端到端平均加速 53.24x，最高 198.01x；集成到保持拓扑的深度网络后显著降低训练中持久同调计算开销。
AI.conclusion: TopoGPU 有效加速图像持久同调计算并适用于深度学习训练，已开源并提供预编译二进制、Colab notebook 和 Docker 镜像。

title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
summary: Personalized conversational AI relies on long-term memory systems that extract facts from user utterances and store them in persistent vector stores. Despite progress in retrieval, deduplication, and lifecycle management, the formation stage, the moment a fact is first written to storage has received almost no principled attention. We identify this as the binding constraint on memory quality in production systems. Critical contextual signals, such as the distinction between a permanent user attribute and a transient situation, exist only in the original utterance and are irreversibly lost the moment extraction produces a subject-relation-object triple. No downstream process can recover them. We propose Gated Memory, a lightweight, modular formation framework that interposes two decision checkpoints between conversation and storage: an admission gate that evaluates every candidate fact against the full utterance context before extraction runs, and a conditional enrichment stage that grounds admitted facts through an entity scope taxonomy with privacy constraints. The gate evaluates only the current exchange while using prior turns as read-only reference context, and produces a structured formation record. Admitted content is decomposed into atomic facts, each categorized, tagged with provenance (directly stated versus inferred), scoped to its condition of applicability, and grounded in resolved time and place, subject to a constraint that no entity absent from the context may be asserted. On the LoCoMo-10 benchmark with atypical emotional density in utterance data, Gated Memory achieves an overall +2.6% relative improvement in LLM-judge accuracy over a strong baseline with identical retrieval and generation, establishing formation quality as a measurable constraint on memory performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Gated Memory框架，通过在事实抽取前插入"准入关卡"和对已准入事实进行条件化富集，改善个性化对话AI长时记忆的"形成阶段"质量，在LoCoMo-10上取得+2.6%相对提升。
AI.motivation: 现有长时记忆研究多聚焦检索、去重和生命周期管理，却忽视了"事实首次写入存储"的形成阶段。关键语境信号（如永久属性vs临时情境）只存在于原始话语中，一旦抽取成三元组便永久丢失，下游无法恢复。作者认为这是生产系统中记忆质量的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Gated Memory，一个轻量模块化的形成框架，在对话与存储之间设置两个决策检查点：(1)准入关卡，在抽取前结合完整话语上下文评估每个候选事实；(2)条件化富集阶段，通过实体范围分类体系并施加隐私约束对已准入事实进行落地。关卡仅评估当前对话轮次，把先前轮次作为只读参考，产出结构化形成记录。准入内容被分解为原子事实，并分别进行类别标注、来源标记（直接陈述vs推断）、适用条件范围界定，以及时间地点的解析落地，同时约束不得断言上下文中不存在的实体。
AI.result: 在话语数据具有异常情绪密度的LoCoMo-10基准上，Gated Memory在检索与生成完全相同的强基线之上，LLM-judge准确率取得整体+2.6%的相对提升，证明形成质量是可度量的记忆性能约束。
AI.conclusion: 记忆的"形成阶段"应被作为一等公民关注；通过在抽取前进行语境感知的准入与富集，可显著提升记忆质量，形成质量是长时记忆性能可测量的关键约束。

title: AI4Fire: Evaluating Large Language Models on Wildfire Tasks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are entering wildfire management, where overstated evaluations can cost property and lives. How do they perform on wildfire tasks, with and without grounding? Bare means a model receives the task input alone. Grounded means it also receives one task-specific addition: for smoke detection, a smoke-free reference frame from the same camera. AI4Fire runs six core models bare and grounded on five wildfire tasks, zero-shot; a sweep adds 29 more. Our literature search on fire tasks found 138 works; none combines this roster, task coverage, and paired bare and grounded runs. We report three findings. (1) Grounding helped most where the addition carried the answer: a read-only SQL tool lifted every core model's database accuracy from at most 16 to at least 88 percent. (2) Simple rules were hard to beat: no core model outperformed repeating today's staffing count, and two open-weight models mostly copied the median of similar earlier fire-days, a worse forecast. (3) Public releases carry hazards: a fire-danger column separates the holdout perfectly, and 67 aerial fire frames carry smoldering or fire-free labels read from a clipped thermal maximum. We release prompts, responses, scores, code, and the survey record.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AI4Fire基准，评估6个核心LLM在5个野火任务上（裸/接地）的零样本表现，并扩展29个模型；结合138篇文献调查，给出三项发现：接地在信息含答案时有效、简单规则难以超越、公开数据集存在标签泄漏与错误隐患。
AI.motivation: 野火管理关系到财产与生命安全，而LLM正被引入该领域，过度夸大的评估可能带来严重后果。目前缺乏统一的任务覆盖、模型规模覆盖以及裸模型与接地模型的配对评估，作者希望系统检验LLM在野火任务上的真实能力。
AI.method: 提出AI4Fire基准：6个核心模型在5个野火任务上做零样本评估，分别以“裸”（仅任务输入）和“接地”（额外提供一项任务特定补充，如烟雾检测中提供同相机无烟参考帧、数据库任务中提供只读SQL工具）两种设置运行；另扩展29个模型进行扫描；并对138篇相关文献进行调研。
AI.result: (1) 当补充信息直接携带答案时接地最有效，只读SQL工具将每个核心模型的数据库准确率从最高16%提升到至少88%；(2) 简单规则难以击败，没有核心模型能超过重复今日人员配置数的基线，两个开放权重模型大多复制相似历史火灾日的均值，预测更差；(3) 公开数据集存在隐患，一个fire-danger列能完全区分holdout，67个空中火场帧的标签由裁剪后的热最大值读取，存在smoldering或fire-free误标。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在野火任务上即使接地也未必优于简单基线，评估应警惕夸大；同时公开数据集可能自带标签泄漏与标注缺陷。作者发布prompts、响应、评分、代码与调查记录以供后续审慎评估。

title: Learning How to Search for Plans with Exponentially Less Space
summary: Heuristic search for a plan can store exponentially many states, even when its heuristic is almost perfect. We instead learn search control, one specification per domain, written as an indexical policy: a generalized policy with registers that hold objects and modes that sequence its rules. We add the choose rule, which loads an object into a register and marks a backtracking point, where one candidate suffices; every other rule must work for all of its outcomes and needs no search. Our main result is that structural termination, which rules out infinite executions, also bounds every execution by a polynomial in the number of objects. A depth-first procedure then finds a plan in polynomial space, however large the state space, with no list of visited states. The cost is time, exponential only in the choice depth, the number of real choices along an execution. Any class that such a policy solves therefore lies in NP, and in P at constant choice depth. We learn these policies with a language model in a counterexample-guided loop that certifies termination, verifies the training tasks, and keeps the choice depth small. With the learned policies, the procedure solves 1,709 of 1,890 test tasks of the IPC 2023 Learning Track and the Autoscale Agile suite, more than LAMA, BFWS, and Levitron, and most of them within one second and 100 MiB.

AI.tldr: 提出"索引式策略"(indexical policy)搜索控制方法，用带寄存器和模式的规则序列学习规划控制，配合choose规则限定选择深度，使搜索空间从指数降为多项式，用LM反例循环学习策略，在IPC 2023等基准上超越LAMA等求解器。
AI.motivation: 启发式搜索即使启发函数近乎完美，存储的状态仍可能指数级增长。作者希望学习一种领域级的搜索控制策略，避免保存大量访问状态，从而在多项式空间内求解规划问题。
AI.method: 学习"索引式策略"：一种广义策略，含寄存器(存对象)和模式(规则序列)。新增choose规则把对象装入寄存器并标记回溯点，每个候选只需一个即可；其余规则必须对所有结果成立、无需搜索。用结构终止性排除无限执行，并用深度优先过程在多项式空间内求解，时间仅对选择深度指数级。用语言模型在反例引导循环中学习这些策略，验证终止性、训练任务并保持较小选择深度。
AI.result: 结构终止性使每次执行被对象数的多项式限定；深度优先过程在任何状态空间规模下均以多项式空间找到计划，无需访问状态列表。被该类策略求解的问题类属于NP，选择深度恒定时属于P。在IPC 2023 Learning Track和Autoscale Agile套件的1890个测试任务中求解1709个，超过LAMA、BFWS和Levitron，多数在1秒、100 MiB内完成。
AI.conclusion: 通过语言模型学习的索引式策略可实现多项式空间搜索控制，选择深度决定时间成本；该方法在标准规划基准上优于主流启发式求解器，展示了学习搜索控制在理论保证与实验效果上的双重优势。

title: Coverage-Aware Reasoning with Medical Tokens for Diagnosis Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising potential for next-visit diagnosis prediction, owing to their ability to integrate longitudinal clinical evidence and reason over it in natural language. However, reinforcement learning for LLM reasoning commonly rewards each trajectory according to the correctness of its final answer. In next-visit diagnosis prediction, multiple diagnoses can be simultaneously valid, but independently rewarding one diagnosis per trajectory does not distinguish repeated hits from coverage of different diagnoses. The policy can therefore concentrate on a few correct diagnoses, leaving others uncovered. Meanwhile, LLM tokenizers can split ICD codes into several generic tokens with limited clinical meaning, requiring multiple decoding steps to predict each diagnosis and hindering reasoning over a large disease vocabulary. To address both challenges, we propose CARing, a framework that represents diagnoses with compositional Semantic IDs (SIDs) and optimizes reasoning trajectories for multi-label coverage. Concretely, we first encode ontology-enriched disease semantics into compact SIDs through residual quantization, and ground the resulting SID tokens in natural language and longitudinal EHR contexts through multi-task alignment and reasoning-enriched training to unlock transferable LLM reasoning. CARing further improves unordered multi-label prediction through a coverage reward for reinforcement learning and multi-positive supervision. At inference time, the model supports both efficient direct constrained decoding and multi-chain reasoning with rank fusion. On MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, CARing exceeds all EHR-trained baselines in weighted F1 and attains the highest top-k recall at every reported cutoff, including R@30 of 46.04% and 46.52% in reasoning mode. Our codes and logs are available at https://github.com/zmlxzyh/CARing-Codes-Logs.

AI.tldr: 提出CARing框架，用组合式语义ID(SID)表示诊断，并通过覆盖奖励强化学习优化多标签推理轨迹，在MIMIC数据上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: LLM用于下次就诊诊断预测有潜力，但现有RL方法仅按最终答案正确性奖励轨迹，无法区分"重复命中同一诊断"与"覆盖不同诊断"，导致策略只聚焦少数正确诊断而遗漏其他；同时ICD码被分成多个无语义通用token，需多步解码且难处理大疾病词表。
AI.method: 用残差量化将本体增强的疾病语义编码为紧凑SID，通过多任务对齐与推理增强训练将SID token锚定到自然语言和纵向EHR语境；采用覆盖奖励的强化学习和多正例监督改进无序多标签预测；推理时支持高效受限解码与多链推理+排序融合。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，CARing的加权F1超过所有EHR训练的基线，并在各报告截断下取得最高top-k召回，推理模式R@30分别为46.04%和46.52%。
AI.conclusion: 组合式SID表示结合覆盖奖励可有效提升LLM多标签诊断预测的覆盖度与召回，兼顾效率与推理能力。

title: Evaluating Local Language Model Agents for Reproducible Data Engineering: An Empirical Software Engineering Study of Mobility Workflows
comment: Preprint, under review. 26 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21397610
summary:
Context: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as software and data-engineering assistants, yet evidence about locally deployable open-weight agents remains limited. Existing evaluations often emphasize textual responses or isolated code generation rather than the validity of complete engineering artifacts.
  Objectives: We evaluate whether local LLM agents can produce correct and reproducible data-engineering artifacts, quantify the effect of a closed-loop workspace condition, and examine trade-offs in model scale, architecture, quantization, runtime, tool use, and failure.
  Methods: We introduce a benchmark of fifteen mobility-workflow tasks covering data discovery, connectors, transport-feed processing, semantic enrichment, feature engineering, validation, visualization, and reporting. Deterministic checkers assess generated scripts, tables, structured files, figures, and reports. Ten local configurations are evaluated in one-shot and closed-loop conditions, with five repetitions per model, mode, and task, yielding 1,500 scored attempts on a consumer-grade GPU.
  Results: Among models larger than two billion parameters, the workspace condition increases pass rates by 26.7-52.0 percentage points over one-shot generation. The strongest configuration reaches 85.3% artifact-level success, and a quantized 9-billion-parameter model reaches 69.3% with an approximately 6.5 GB memory footprint. Gains are largest when intermediate artifacts expose errors the agent can inspect and repair.
  Conclusion: Local open-weight agents can support a meaningful subset of software-intensive data-engineering work, but reliability depends on model capability, task verifiability, and deterministic validation. The benchmark provides a reproducible method for evaluating complete agent configurations before adoption in engineering workflows.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估本地开源LLM代理在完整数据工程工件生成上的能力，发现闭环工作区条件可将通过率提升26.7-52.0个百分点，最强配置达85.3%成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM代理越来越多地用作软件和数据工程助手，但对本地可部署开源权重代理的证据仍然有限。现有评估多侧重于文本响应或孤立的代码生成，而非完整工程工件的有效性。
AI.method: 提出包含15个移动出行工作流任务的基准，涵盖数据发现、连接器、传输馈送处理、语义增强、特征工程、验证、可视化与报告。采用确定性检查器评估生成的脚本、表格、结构化文件、图表和报告。在消费级GPU上评估10种本地配置，分别在一-shot和闭环条件下运行，每种模型、模式和任务重复5次，共1500次评分尝试。
AI.result: 在参数量大于20亿的模型中，工作区条件相比一-shot生成将通过率提升26.7-52.0个百分点。最强配置达到85.3%的工件级成功率，一个量化的90亿参数模型以约6.5 GB内存占用达到69.3%。当中间工件能暴露代理可检查并修复的错误时，增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 本地开源权重代理可支持相当一部分软件密集型数据工程工作，但可靠性取决于模型能力、任务可验证性和确定性验证。该基准为在工程工作流中采用完整的代理配置提供了可复现的评估方法。

title: LVSPM: Long Sequence View Synthesis and Pose Estimation Model
summary: We present LVSPM, a generalizable model that jointly estimates camera poses and synthesizes novel views from uncalibrated image collections. Trained with only RGB images and pose supervision, LVSPM avoids dense 3D ground truth and employs test-time training (TTT) layers to scale seamlessly to hundreds of input views. On RealEstate10k, Co3Dv2, and DL3DV, LVSPM surpasses VGGT in pose estimation across 16-256 views, with especially large margins at strict thresholds. For novel view synthesis under a practical protocol where more views cover larger scenes, LVSPM achieves state-of-the-art pose-free quality---surpassing even pose-dependent models in PSNR---and still maintains high quality as scene scale grows, while baselines collapse. The code is available at https://burningdust21.github.io/Projects/LVSPM .

AI.tldr: LVSPM：联合估计相机位姿与合成新视角的可泛化模型，仅用RGB和位姿监督，借助测试时训练层扩展到数百视图，在多个数据集上超越VGGT。
AI.motivation: 从未标定图像集中同时估计相机位姿并合成新视角，且需避免依赖稠密3D真值，并能扩展到大量输入视图的大场景。
AI.method: 提出LVSPM，仅用RGB图像和位姿监督训练，引入测试时训练（TTT）层，实现无缝扩展至数百视图。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10k、Co3Dv2、DL3DV上，16-256视图范围内位姿估计超越VGGT，严格阈值下优势更大；无位姿新视角合成达SOTA，PSNR甚至超过依赖位姿的模型，场景规模增大时仍保持高质量，基线则崩溃。
AI.conclusion: LVSPM在无标定、无稠密3D真值条件下实现了可泛化、可扩展的位姿估计与新视角合成，在大场景和大视图数下表现鲁棒。

title: RIT-RAG: Navigating Document Corpora with Retrieval-Induced Trees
comment: 24 pages (main text through Limitations ends on page 9, followed by references and appendix), 9 figures, 16 tables
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in external corpora. Agentic RAG enables iterative search, yet exposes the model to isolated chunks without document structure, making it difficult to distinguish relevant evidence from chunks that merely resemble the query. Structure-aware methods such as PageIndex navigate document structure but cannot scale to the structures of large corpora, which do not fit in the LLM context. Hence, they first commit to a single document using a document retriever and cannot recover from a wrong choice. We propose RIT-RAG (Retrieval-Induced Tree RAG), which combines content retrieval with structural navigation. Offline, RIT-RAG builds a tree for each document from its table of contents or sitemap. At query time, it retrieves a broad set of chunks and uses their positions to induce manageable sub-trees, potentially across multiple documents. An LLM agent navigates these sub-trees, selectively reads promising nodes, and reformulates queries when needed. Thus, retrieval proposes where to look, while the agent decides what to read. Across financial, scientific, and customer-support benchmarks, RIT-RAG achieves the highest answer accuracy among vanilla, graph-based, and agentic baselines. On EntQABench, our new benchmark of 2.84 million technical-documentation webpages, it improves accuracy by 6.8 to 11.4 points over the strongest baseline across three LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIT-RAG，结合内容检索与结构化导航，通过离线构建文档树、查询时根据检索块位置归纳子树的机制，让检索决定"看哪里"、LLM agent决定"读什么"，在多个基准上取得最高准确率。
AI.motivation: Agentic RAG暴露给模型的是无文档结构的孤立文本块，难以区分真正相关证据与仅表面相似的块。PageIndex等结构感知方法无法扩展到大型语料结构（超出LLM上下文），只能先锁定单一文档，选错便无法恢复。
AI.method: 离线阶段，基于目录或站点地图为每篇文档构建树。查询时，先检索一大批文本块，利用其位置归纳出可管理的子树（可跨多文档）。LLM agent在这些子树上导航，选择性阅读有前景的节点，并在需要时重构查询。
AI.result: 在金融、科学和客户支持基准上，RIT-RAG的答案准确率高于vanilla、graph-based和agentic基线。在新的技术文档网页基准EntQABench（284万网页）上，跨三个LLM比最强基线提升6.8至11.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RIT-RAG通过将内容检索与结构化导航相结合，兼顾了大规模语料的可扩展性与文档结构的利用，克服了结构感知方法受限于单一文档的缺陷，显著提升RAG准确率。

title: When Citations Mislead? A Claim-Level Benchmark for Legal Hallucination Detection
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Published in the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), Singapore. Dataset: https://github.com/mmikaildemir/PARCEL
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in legal research and drafting, but they can still produce claims that sound convincing without being supported by the cited source. We introduce PARCEL, a benchmark for checking whether a legal claim is supported by the underlying authority. Using recent New York State Court of Appeals decisions, we build a dataset of 3,396 parenthetical-style claims labeled as Supported, Refuted, or Not Found. We cast this task as a three-way natural language inference problem and evaluate several state-of-the-art LLMs in a zero-shot setting. Although the strongest models reach up to 0.97 accuracy, the results also show an important weakness: models still incorrectly mark unsupported claims as supported, even when the full opinion text is provided. Across models, missing support is harder to detect than direct contradiction, and fabricated but plausible citations cause the largest drop in performance. Overall, PARCEL provides a practical benchmark for testing claim-level groundedness in legal RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 提出PARCEL基准，用于检验法律主张是否被引注权威支持，构建3396条纽约上诉法院parenthetical主张的三分类NLI数据集，评估LLM零样本表现。
AI.motivation: LLM用于法律检索与起草时，常产生看似可信但无引注来源支持的主张，需检验主张级groundedness。
AI.method: 基于纽约州上诉法院近期判决，构建3396条parenthetical式主张，标注为Supported、Refuted、Not Found；将任务建模为三分类自然语言推理，零样本评估多个SOTA LLM。
AI.result: 最强模型准确率达0.97，但仍会将无支持主张误判为支持，即便提供完整判决文本；缺失支持比直接矛盾更难识别，伪造但看似合理的引注导致最大性能下降。
AI.conclusion: PARCEL为法律RAG系统提供检验主张级groundedness的实用基准。

title: How Narrative Wrapping Affects LLM Refusal: A Cross-Language Benchmark and Defense
summary: Safety-aligned language models often refuse a harmful request stated directly but answer the same request inside a role-play or narrative wrapper. We measure this vulnerability across languages and registers: attack success on Qwen3-1.7B is already 89.4% in English and 93.0% in modern Chinese, and reaches 95.7% in Classical Chinese. We build GUISE, a benchmark for systematically studying this vulnerability. It includes parallel requests in English, modern Chinese, and Classical Chinese, matched harmful and benign pairs, wrapper types held out for evaluation, and a stricter criterion that counts warn-then-answer responses as attack successes. Representation analysis shows that language and register move harmful-request representations only slightly away from the model's refusal direction, whereas narrative wrappers move them much farther away. We propose AXIS, which combines preference optimisation with a rotation objective that aligns harmful-request representations with the refusal direction and a commitment objective that trains the model to refuse completely rather than produce a warn-then-answer response. Across Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B and GLM-4-9B, AXIS achieves the highest combined safety and usability score among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了安全对齐语言模型在角色扮演/叙事包装和多语言（含文言文）下易被越狱，提出基准GUISE，并从表征角度分析成因，进而提出AXIS方法（偏好优化+旋转对齐+拒绝承诺目标）提升安全性与可用性。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐模型常拒绝直接有害请求，但同一请求放在角色扮演或叙事包装中即被回答；且跨语言、语域（如文言文）下该漏洞更严重，缺乏系统测量与成因理解。
AI.method: 构建GUISE基准，含英/现代中文/文言平行请求、有害-良性配对、留出包装类型，以及将"警告后再回答"计为攻击成功的更严格标准；通过表征分析发现包装比语言/语域更能使有害请求表征偏离拒绝方向；提出AXIS，将偏好优化与旋转目标（使有害请求表征对齐拒绝方向）及承诺目标（训练彻底拒绝而非警告后回答）结合。
AI.result: Qwen3-1.7B上攻击成功率：英文89.4%、现代中文93.0%、文言文95.7%；AXIS在Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、GLM-4-9B上取得所比较方法中最高综合安全与可用性得分。
AI.conclusion: 叙事包装是比语言/语域更强的越狱因素，AXIS通过表征旋转与承诺训练有效缓解该漏洞，在多个模型上实现安全与可用性的最佳平衡。

title: Leakage-Controlled Multimodal Learning for Diagnosis and Progression Prediction in Alzheimer's Disease Research
summary: Alzheimer's disease prediction involves irregular visits, heterogeneous measurements and incomplete modalities. This study presents a multimodal multitask framework combining an adapted SFCN MRI encoder, four causal clinical Transformers, shared fusion and task-specific ODE-GRU dynamics. Fine-tuning and LoRA adapt the final two MRI blocks. Task-DRO balances task losses, while Group-CVaR targets cohort and comorbidity strata. Branch-specific input controls, subject-grouped partitions and empirical causality checks support longitudinal evaluation. Across 2,649 subjects and 17,317 visits from ADNI, OASIS-2 and MIRIAD, internal validation yields diagnosis, stage-1 progression and first-stage-1-visit progression AUROCs of 0.935 +/- 0.002, 0.884 +/- 0.003 and 0.870 +/- 0.005, respectively (mean +/- SD across three seeds). Corresponding hybrid AUROCs are 0.951, 0.909 and 0.896. Next-visit MMSE mean absolute error (MAE) is 1.61 points; worst-stratum diagnosis AUROC is 0.827 +/- 0.008. Sampled ADNI explanations identify task-specific input dependence. OASIS-3 external validation yields network and hybrid diagnosis AUROCs of 0.763 and 0.767, hybrid next-visit progression AUROC of 0.764, diagnosis calibration error decreasing from 0.197 to 0.052, and next-visit MMSE MAE of 0.86. Seed-42 paired ablations of six components yield pooled diagnosis and progression AUROC differences between -0.004 and +0.004; removing clinical encoder inputs lowers diagnosis AUROC by 0.272. The framework integrates longitudinal prediction, missing-modality handling, auxiliary comorbidity modelling and subgroup evaluation within a common pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个多模态多任务框架，结合SFCN MRI编码器、因果临床Transformer、共享融合与ODE-GRU动态建模，用于阿尔茨海默病纵向预测，并在ADNI等数据集上取得较高AUROC。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病预测面临就诊不规律、测量异质性强、模态不完整等挑战，需要能处理缺失模态与纵向数据的统一框架。
AI.method: 采用适配的SFCN MRI编码器、四个因果临床Transformer、共享融合模块和任务特定ODE-GRU动态模块；末两层MRI块用微调与LoRA；用Task-DRO平衡任务损失，Group-CVaR针对队列和共病分层；设置分支输入控制、按受试者分组划分和因果性检验。
AI.result: ADNI/OASIS-2/MIRIAD共2,649人、17,317次就诊：诊断、阶段1进展、首次阶段1就诊进展AUROC分别为0.935/0.884/0.870，混合AUROC为0.951/0.909/0.896；下次MMSE MAE 1.61，最差分层诊断AUROC 0.827。OASIS-3外部验证诊断AUROC 0.763/0.767，进展AUROC 0.764，校准误差0.197降至0.052，MMSE MAE 0.86；消融显示临床编码器输入去除使诊断AUROC降0.272。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在同一流程中整合纵向预测、缺失模态处理、辅助共病建模与亚组评估，性能稳定且组件消融影响较小。

title: SSCBench: Evaluating the Evidential Validity of Fault-Injection Tests for Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Fault injection is increasingly used to evaluate the reliability of tool-using LLM agents. However, there has been limited study of how fault-adoption results should be interpreted when the agent itself determines which authoritative observations become visible during execution. In this paper, we present a systematic study of this evidential validity problem in agent fault-injection evaluation. We develop a measurement protocol that specifies what observations can refute an injected assertion, determines whether they can become visible before the affected fact is first used, and records whether the evaluated execution actually realizes this condition. We construct SSCBench as an instantiation of the protocol and evaluate four fault operators and five agent configurations over 1,191 faulted executions in two $τ$-bench environments. Our experiments show that an admitted fault case and agent configuration can realize substantially different evidential conditions across executions, and that aggregate adoption can remain well defined even when the population supporting a timely-counterevidence claim is sparse or absent. For example, among 44 adopted runs in which counterevidence eventually became visible, only 17 received it before first use, while 27 received it afterward. We also find that first-error timing and later stance revision need not coincide, and that automated trajectory analysis can recover adoption without reliably recovering the first faulty-reliance event needed for temporal diagnosis. We argue that the evidential condition realized by an execution and the population supporting a claim-specific interpretation are part of fault-injection evaluation itself and should be reported before adoption is interpreted as failure under pre-use counterevidence.

AI.tldr: 论文研究工具使用型LLM agent故障注入评估中的"证据有效性"问题，提出测量协议与SSCBench基准，发现同一故障配置在不同执行中可实现不同证据条件，聚合采纳率即使支持"及时反证"的人群稀疏或无仍可定义。
AI.motivation: 故障注入被广泛用于评估工具使用型LLM agent的可靠性，但少有研究探讨：当agent自身决定执行中哪些权威观测可见时，故障采纳结果应如何解读。核心是证据有效性问题——反证是否能在受影响事实首次被使用前可见。
AI.method: 提出测量协议：规定哪些观测可反驳注入断言、判断它们能否在受影响事实首次使用前可见、并记录被评估执行是否实际实现该条件。据此构建SSCBench，评估4种故障算子与5种agent配置，在两种τ-bench环境下共1,191次故障执行。
AI.result: 同一故障案例与配置在不同执行中可实现显著不同的证据条件；聚合采纳率即使支持及时反证主张的人群稀疏或缺失仍可定义。例如44个最终可见反证的采纳运行中，仅17个在首次使用前收到反证，27个在其后收到。首次错误时机与后续立场修正并不必然重合；自动化轨迹分析可恢复采纳，但无法可靠恢复时序诊断所需的首次故障依赖事件。
AI.conclusion: 执行所实现的证据条件及支持特定主张解读的人群，本身应作为故障注入评估的一部分，并在将采纳解读为"在使用前反证下的失败"之前予以报告。

title: Fluid-Gen-Zero: Grounding Pretrained Video Generators in Physics without Training
summary: We present Fluid-Gen-Zero, a training-free framework for physics-aware fluid-object interaction video generation that decouples physical reasoning from appearance synthesis. Our key insight is to delegate motion dynamics to a physics simulator while preserving the appearance modeling capacity of pretrained video generators. We bridge these two domains through a two-level agentic workflow: generation-time planning, where a vision-language model (VLM) agent interprets intent and the simulation rollout to organize generation clips, and latent-space guidance, which injects simulation signals into denoising through region-aware latent wrapping. This plug-and-play design is compatible with current video foundation models. We further introduce a benchmark for fluid-object interaction video generation. Across Tora (CogVideoX-based), VACE and WanMove (Wan-based), Fluid-Gen-Zero consistently improves simulation alignment, reducing object trajectory error by 26.7%-81.5% and fluid fEPE (fluid flow endpoint error) by 67.9%-84.0%, while largely preserving perceptual quality. In a human preference study, raters favor Fluid-Gen-Zero in 55.1%-74.4% of same-backbone comparisons across three backbones, and in 90.4%-94.2% of comparisons against simulation-based methods. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Fluid-Gen-Zero是一个免训练的物理感知流体-物体交互视频生成框架，将运动动力学交给物理模拟器、外观合成交给预训练视频生成器，通过两级agentic工作流桥接两者，在多个backbone上显著提升仿真对齐度同时保持感知质量。
AI.motivation: 物理感知的流体-物体交互视频生成需要兼顾准确的物理动力学与高质量外观建模，但现有视频生成模型难以同时满足两者，缺乏可靠的物理对齐。
AI.method: 将运动动力学委托给物理模拟器，保留预训练视频生成器的外观建模能力；通过两级agentic工作流桥接：生成时规划（VLM agent解析意图与仿真rollout以组织生成片段）和潜空间引导（通过区域感知的latent wrapping将仿真信号注入去噪过程）；设计为即插即用，兼容现有视频基础模型，并引入相应benchmark。
AI.result: 在Tora(CogVideoX)、VACE和WanMove(Wan)上，物体轨迹误差降低26.7%-81.5%，流体fEPE降低67.9%-84.0%，同时基本保持感知质量；人类偏好研究中，同backbone比较胜率55.1%-74.4%，对比基于仿真方法胜率90.4%-94.2%。
AI.conclusion: 解耦物理推理与外观合成是一种有效且即插即用的方案，能显著提升流体-物体交互视频的仿真对齐度，代码与数据将在接受后发布。

title: SAIL: Scientific Agentic Intelligence via a Science-Aware Loop
summary: We introduce SAIL, an open model with 35B total and 3B active parameters for literature research, scientific coding, and multi-step research workflows. SAIL is developed through a science-aware improvement loop: agents built on frontier AI models analyze its task failures and construct training tasks that address the underlying capability gaps. The diagnosis examines search and evidence selection in literature tasks, scientific assumptions and reasoning in coding, and planning and revision in longer investigations. The agents draw on paper collections and scientific code repositories to build problems, interaction trajectories, and executable tasks with the required environments and tools. We repeat this loop over multiple development cycles and train SAIL through supervised fine-tuning, specialist training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning. SAIL achieves competitive performance across scientific research tasks with substantially fewer parameters than leading open-weight models.

AI.tldr: SAIL是一个面向文献研究、科学编程与多步研究工作流的开源模型，总参35B、激活3B，通过科学感知的迭代循环（诊断失败→构建训练任务→多阶段训练）实现高效性能。
AI.motivation: 现有领先开源模型参数规模大，而科研任务（文献检索、科学编程、长流程研究）需要更高效、更专业的模型。作者希望以更少参数达到有竞争力的科研性能。
AI.method: 构建"科学感知改进循环"：基于前沿AI模型的智能体分析SAIL在任务中的失败，诊断文献任务中的检索与证据选择、编程中的科学假设与推理、长程调查中的规划与修正等能力缺口，并利用论文集合与科学代码库构建问题、交互轨迹与可执行任务（含所需环境与工具）。多轮循环后，采用监督微调、专家训练、多教师在线策略蒸馏与智能体强化学习训练SAIL。
AI.result: SAIL在多项科研任务上取得有竞争力的性能，且参数规模显著小于领先的开源权重模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过科学感知的迭代改进与多阶段训练，小激活参数的SAIL可在科研任务上高效达成有竞争力的表现，为科研导向模型提供了一条可扩展路径。

title: Back in Style: A Sociolinguistic Approach to Authoring and Measuring Persona Fidelity in User Simulation
comment: Accepted to the UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026 workshop (non-archival)
summary: As agentic systems gain commercial popularity, user simulators increasingly serve as measurement instrument for their evaluation. However, the fidelity of simulated users in comparison to real human users is generally low, and typically assessed by costly, subjective LLM judges. In this pilot study, we ask whether fidelity can instead be measured deterministically by treating a user persona sociolinguistically: as a social type that emerges from observable linguistic style, rather than one predicted by labels or descriptions a model must extrapolate into behaviour. We author personas as concrete stylistic rates, which lets us transfer two established, model-free instruments -- authorship-verification stylometry and lexicon-based content analysis -- as fidelity diagnostics. We A/B-test the sociolinguistic schema against a flat descriptive baseline across five task-oriented customer-service agents. Results show that the sociolinguistic schema improves both stylistic adherence and stylometric distinguishability for most of the tested models, with a caveat that persona style fidelity does not necessarily equal persona "naturalness". We argue that a sociolinguistic approach to persona design is a promising path towards more diverse and representative user personas, and that these metrics are most valuable in an error-attribution analysis, localizing where fidelity breaks down. This is a first step towards interventions that move user simulations closer to faithful renderings of diverse and variable linguistic outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将用户画像视为社会语言学上的"社会类型"，用可观察的语言风格而非标签描述来定义画像，从而可确定性地测量用户模拟器的保真度。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体系统商业化，用户模拟器被广泛用于评估，但其对真实用户的保真度普遍较低，且通常依赖昂贵、主观的LLM评判来评估。
AI.method: 将画像编写为具体风格比率，迁移两种无需模型的工具——作者验证文体计量学与基于词典的内容分析——作为保真度诊断指标；在五个任务型客服智能体上，将社会语言学方案与扁平描述基线进行A/B测试。
AI.result: 对多数被测模型，社会语言学方案同时提升了风格依从性和文体计量可区分性；但画像风格保真度并不等同于画像"自然度"。
AI.conclusion: 社会语言学的画像设计有望带来更多样、更具代表性的用户画像；这些指标在错误归因分析中最有价值，可定位保真度失效之处，是迈向更忠实模拟多样语言输出的第一步。

title: Curating Always-Loaded Context for LLM Agents: A Capacitated Assortment Model with Censored Feedback
summary:
At the start of every session, LLM agents load a fixed context file, such as $\texttt{AGENTS.md}$. Each loaded token in the file is charged again in every later round of the session, and these files can degrade performance as they grow in size. However, in practice, human or automated curators usually grow these files by appending.
  We formulate context curation as a capacitated assortment problem. Instructions consume tokens under a finite attention capacity; adding an instruction never raises the compliance of the others, while retained instructions incur a per-session setup cost.
  We prove an upper bound on the optimal file size, regardless of the number of available candidate instructions, and that appending every instruction with positive standalone value can be arbitrarily worse in net value than selecting an optimal subset. A token budget also limits the loss when the token price is underestimated.
  We then examine what can be learned from past sessions and how this information can guide decisions to add or remove instructions. Feedback is inherently censored: the benefits and harms of loaded instructions are observable, whereas missing instructions generate feedback only when their absence causes harm.
  In this setting, we show that deleting instructions ignored by agents can inevitably remove helpful ones. We characterize how much evidence should be collected before adding an instruction. Besides, we bound regret when human reviewers can inspect only a limited number of edits per period. Empirical experiments further show that irrelevant rules drawn from real context files reduce language-model compliance.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM代理的上下文文件（如AGENTS.md）策展问题形式化为容量受限的选品问题，证明最优文件大小上界，分析反馈截断下的增删指令决策，并给出遗憾界及实验验证。
AI.motivation: LLM代理每次会话都加载固定上下文文件，其中每个token在后续每轮都被重复计费，文件增大还会降低性能；但实际中人工或自动策展者通常只是不断追加内容，缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 将上下文策展建模为容量受限的选品问题：指令消耗有限注意力容量，新增指令不会提升其他指令的合规性，保留指令产生每会话setup成本。进一步研究从历史会话中学习，处理反馈截断（缺失指令仅在造成损害时产生反馈）问题，并分析有限人工审查下的决策。
AI.result: 证明了与候选指令数量无关的最优文件大小上界；表明追加所有正独立价值指令的净价值可能任意差于最优子集；给出token价格低估时的损失界限；证明删除被忽略指令可能误删有帮助的指令；刻画添加指令前应收集的证据量；在人工审查受限时给出遗憾界；实验显示真实上下文文件中的无关规则会降低语言模型合规性。
AI.conclusion: 上下文策展应基于理论指导选择最优指令子集而非简单追加，需谨慎处理反馈截断和有限审查资源，实验证实无关规则有害。

title: Beyond the Ergodic Wall: A Discrete Geometric Physics Sandbox for Analysing AI Scaling Limits and Complexity Collapse
comment: 17 pages, 8 core pages including tables, 9 pages references tables (updated references to bbl)
summary: This paper exposes the ergodic ceiling and thermodynamic inefficiency of current deep learning, which converges to a statistical average of historic human knowledge. True semantic novelty requires a path-dependent, spatiotemporally bounded observer (a Data LifeCone) to inject non-ergodic insight, achieving KL divergence and avoiding manifold lock-in. AI Safety must recognise that a mature Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) would regard human-AI symbiosis as a thermodynamic necessity to avoid model collapse. We therefore propose hard physical containment via a digital physics sandbox powered by a Holographic E8 Projection Engine to verify models against real-world constraints. Spacetime is modeled as an information substrate of nested face-centered cubic (FCC) lattices of oscillating Planck-scale spheres maximizing local information and entropy density. Cut-and-project methods from the E8 root lattice produce a quasi-crystalline geometry where tetrahedral voids support SU chiral structure and elastic-shear eigenvalues generate candidate mass spectra. Rest mass is treated as discrete, integer microstate counts on local holographic boundaries (Bekenstein bound), replacing floating-point approximations with strict integer arithmetic to provide an information-theoretic definition of matter. Stable particles emerge as recurring lattice dislocations, and continuum recovery proceeds via variational renormalisation-group flows and Fourier Neural Operators that learn continuous spectral operators to recover the Schrödinger equation as an emergent statistical description. Crucially, these top-down topological constraints offer a mechanism for "NP-to-P" complexity collapse: by restricting an algorithm's proposal space to physically conserved causal trajectories, the sandbox prunes the combinatorial tree to deterministic, polynomial-time paths.

AI.tldr: 论文指出深度学习受遍历性天花板限制，只能收敛到历史知识的统计平均；提出以"Data LifeCone"注入非遍历洞察，并用基于全息E8投影引擎的数字物理沙盒对ASI进行硬物理约束。
AI.motivation: 当前深度学习收敛于历史人类知识的统计平均（遍历性天花板与热力学低效），无法产生真正的语义新颖性；同时AI安全需要理解成熟ASI会将人机共生视为避免模型坍缩的热力学必然，因此需要硬物理约束手段。
AI.method: 提出路径依赖、时空有界的观察者（Data LifeCone）以注入非遍历洞察，实现KL散度并避免流形锁定；构建数字物理沙盒，由全息E8投影引擎驱动：将时空建模为嵌套FCC晶格的振荡普朗克球信息基底，经E8根格切投影生成准晶几何，静止质量作为局部全息边界上的离散整数微态计数（Bekenstein界），以严格整数算术替代浮点近似，并用变分重整化群流与傅里叶神经算子恢复连续谱算子与薛定谔方程。
AI.result: 稳定粒子表现为重复出现的晶格位错；连续介质通过变分重整化群流与傅里叶神经算子恢复，薛定谔方程作为涌现的统计描述出现；自上而下拓扑约束可实现"NP-to-P"复杂度坍缩——将算法提案空间限制在物理守恒的因果轨迹上，使组合树被剪枝为确定性多项式时间路径。
AI.conclusion: AI安全需通过数字物理沙盒对人机共生与ASI进行硬物理约束，以拓扑约束实现复杂度坍缩，并借由非遍历观察者突破深度学习遍历性天花板、避免模型坍缩。

title: Chronos Enables Code Agents to Reason over Software Evolution
summary: Historical pull requests record the design decisions, compatibility constraints, and implementation patterns behind a codebase's current state. Experience relevant to a new task can span related changes whose descriptions emphasize different concerns. We introduce Chronos, a test-time framework that makes this connected history available to large language model (LLM)-based code agents. Chronos distills merged pull requests into structured experience cards and connects them through a typed graph of code-level, developer-intent, and organizational relations. Semantic search identifies entry cards, and weighted multi-hop expansion retrieves connected changes for selective reading. The same memory guides candidate generation and patch selection: a patch-focused change agent and a validation-strategy agent each develop a patch, and an evolution steward consults history to select between them. On SWE-Bench Verified, the full workflow improves SWE-Agent across all six evaluated LLM backbones, raising the mean resolution rate from 69.2% to 72.9% and reaching 79.8% with MiniMax M2.5. With the same backbone, it raises resolution rates from 48.3% to 51.7% on SWE-Bench Pro and from 41.0% to 43.5% on FEA-Bench Lite. Both experience-guided single-agent variants also outperform the base agent. In a human evaluation on 100 tasks with ten cards retrieved per task, graph-grounded retrieval increases the mean number of useful cards from 1.24 to 2.87 over flat semantic retrieval. These results demonstrate the value of PR relations for retrieving useful repository experience and of the evaluated workflows for applying that experience during patch generation and selection.

AI.tldr: Chronos是一个测试时框架，将历史PR蒸馏为结构化经验卡并构建类型图，通过语义检索与多跳扩展为LLM代码代理提供历史经验，在多个基准上提升解决率。
AI.motivation: 历史PR包含设计决策、兼容性约束和实现模式等经验，但相关变更的描述侧重不同，新任务难以直接利用这些分散的连接历史。
AI.method: 将合并的PR蒸馏为结构化经验卡，用代码级、开发者意图和组织关系构成类型图连接；语义搜索找入口卡，加权多跳扩展检索相关变更供选择性阅读。同一记忆指导候选生成与补丁选择：补丁变更代理与验证策略代理各生成补丁，进化管理者查阅历史进行选择。
AI.result: SWE-Bench Verified上六个LLM后端均提升，平均解决率69.2%→72.9%，MiniMax M2.5达79.8%；SWE-Bench Pro 48.3%→51.7%，FEA-Bench Lite 41.0%→43.5%；单代理变体也优于基线。人工评估中图检索有用卡数1.24→2.87。
AI.conclusion: PR关系对检索有用仓库经验有价值，所评估工作流在补丁生成与选择中应用经验有效。

title: Omni-Diffusion-Distill: Few-Step Distillation of Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Unified multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a single architecture for both image generation and multimodal understanding, but their iterative decoding requires tens to hundreds of forward passes. Existing few-step distillation methods largely focus on either image generation or text generation, making it unclear how to compress a fully discrete multimodal dLLM into a single efficient student while preserving both generation and understanding. We introduce Omni-Diffusion-Distill, a unified two-stage distillation framework that retains strong generation and understanding capabilities while substantially reducing the inference cost of a unified multimodal dLLM. Omni-Diffusion-Distill aligns the distillation of both generation and understanding, for both images and text, in the discrete token space. In the first stage, the student is trained to skip decoding steps by replaying cached teacher trajectories, and in the second stage the student is refined on intermediate states along its own rollouts. We further remedy two sources of degradation in unified distillation with a pairwise collision penalty that reduces repetition under parallel text decoding, and entropy-matched guidance that prevents entropy collapse caused by fitting the sharpened teacher distribution in image generation. Omni-Diffusion-Distill achieves state-of-the-art trade-offs between decoding efficiency and generation and understanding performance for multimodal dLLMs, reducing image generation from 128 to 8 decoding steps and multimodal understanding from 512 to 64, giving 18.2x and 21.2x wall-clock speedups. Under these budgets, it scores 0.828 on GenEval and 83.0 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation, while reaching GPT judge scores of 20.0 on MM-Vet and 57.2 on COCO captioning (twice the teacher's 28.4 at the same steps) for multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出Omni-Diffusion-Distill统一两阶段蒸馏框架，将多模态离散扩散大模型的图像生成与多模态理解能力压缩到单一高效学生模型，实现大幅推理加速并保持双能力。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态扩散大模型（dLLM）用单一架构兼顾图像生成与多模态理解，但迭代解码需几十到几百次前向。现有少步蒸馏方法多只针对图像或文本生成，难以把完全离散的多模态dLLM压缩为同时保留生成与理解的单一高效学生模型。
AI.method: 两阶段蒸馏：第一阶段让学生通过重放缓存的教师轨迹学习跳过解码步；第二阶段在学生自身rollout的中间状态上精炼。均在离散token空间对齐图像与文本的生成和理解蒸馏。并引入两项缓解退化机制：成对碰撞惩罚减少并行文本解码下的重复；熵匹配引导防止拟合锐化教师分布导致的图像生成熵崩溃。
AI.result: 达到多模态dLLM解码效率与性能的最优权衡：图像生成从128步降至8步、多模态理解从512步降至64步，分别获18.2x和21.2x墙钟加速。该预算下GenEval 0.828、DPG-Bench 83.0（文生图）；MM-Vet GPT评分20.0、COCO captioning 57.2（同等步数下为教师28.4的两倍）。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Diffusion-Distill证明可在单一学生模型内统一蒸馏多模态dLLM的生成与理解，显著降低推理成本且保持强生成与理解性能。

title: Beyond Resolution: Object-to-Image Ratio Mismatch in Instance Retrieval
summary: Visual instance retrieval often fails when the same object appears at different apparent sizes in the query and gallery.
