Also, we introduce the KD-tree and coordinate-template acceleration to scale to large models as well as outlier identification to control the error. Experiments on ResNet-18 and Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B validate that DS-based compression achieves competitive compression ratios without post-hoc retraining, with controllable decompression error and flexible state-space design, establishing it as a principled and practical compression approach.

AI.tldr: 将模型压缩重新概念化为"紧凑权重表示"，用动态系统(DS)轨迹索引编码高维权重，理论上证明无理缠绕轨迹可构成ε-net，并统一四类DS家族构建通用压缩框架。
AI.motivation: 预训练网络规模激增，在严格的内存与计算约束下，模型压缩成为部署的前提。传统方法（剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、低秩分解）各有局限，需要一种原理上截然不同的压缩范式，将压缩视为紧凑的权重表示而非单纯的参数削减。
AI.method: 提出DS(动态系统)压缩：用动态系统产生轨迹的索引来编码高维参数，解压时由轨迹恢复向量。理论上在Diophantine条件下证明无理缠绕的有限轨迹(M=O(ε^{-(d+ν)}))是d维权重空间的ε-net，从而关联状态分辨率、解压误差与压缩比。统一四类DS家族：空间填充曲线(Hilbert/Peano/Morton/Snake)、混沌系统(Lorenz)、同余与伪随机生成器(LCG/PCG)、低差异序列(Halton)。引入KD-tree与坐标模板加速以扩展到大模型，并用离群点识别控制误差。
AI.result: 在ResNet-18与Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B上验证，DS压缩在无需事后重训练的情况下达到有竞争力的压缩比，解压误差可控，状态空间设计灵活。
AI.conclusion: DS压缩是一种原理清晰且实用的压缩方法，兼具理论基础与工程可扩展性，可作为传统压缩范式的替代方案。

title: FloorSAV: Elucidating Spatial Audio-Visual Context with 2D Floormap for AV-LLMs
summary: While 3D spatial reasoning in dynamic egocentric environments is crucial for embodied intelligence, audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) lack explicit mechanisms to process and internalize global geometry directly from raw sensory streams. Existing approaches either require costly fine-tuning or underutilize the model's cross-modal reasoning capacities. In this paper, we propose FloorSAV, a novel framework that explicitly grounds spatial audio-visual context by rendering a dynamic 2D floormap. By integrating 3D point clouds, camera trajectories, spatial audio cues, and semantically grounded object landmarks, we inject this floormap into the AV-LLM as a synchronized stream with an egocentric video. AV-LLMs utilize their multi-modal capabilities to jointly reason over visual, auditory, and geometric cues in a single inference with floormap interpretation guidance. We further introduce SAVED-Bench (Spatial Audio-Visual Egocentric Benchmark with Dynamic Agents), constructing essential tasks of spatial capability in real-world scenarios: dynamic relativity, regional, and path reasoning QAs. FloorSAV improves AV-LLMs' spatial reasoning on various tasks from both SAVED-Bench and SAVVY-Bench. Studies with ground-truth floormaps demonstrate the substantial potential of FloorSAV with accurate spatial information.

AI.tldr: 提出FloorSAV框架，通过渲染动态2D平面图将空间音视频上下文注入AV-LLM，实现单次推理的3D空间推理，并构建SAVED-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 动态自我中心环境中的3D空间推理对具身智能至关重要，但现有音视频大模型缺乏从原始感知流中直接处理全局几何的机制；已有方法要么依赖昂贵的微调，要么未充分利用跨模态推理能力。
AI.method: FloorSAV将3D点云、相机轨迹、空间音频线索和语义物体地标整合，渲染成动态2D平面图，作为与自我中心视频同步的流注入AV-LLM，模型借助多模态能力结合平面图解读引导进行视觉、听觉和几何线索的联合推理。同时提出SAVED-Bench基准，包含动态相对性、区域和路径推理问答任务。
AI.result: FloorSAV在SAVED-Bench和SAVVY-Bench多项任务上提升了AV-LLM的空间推理能力；使用真实平面图的研究显示了FloorSAV在准确空间信息下的巨大潜力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式以动态2D平面图grounding空间音视频上下文，FloorSAV为AV-LLM提供了有效且无需昂贵微调的空间推理方案，并提出配套基准推动该领域发展。

title: DPPM: Dual-Path Parametric Memory for Personalized Language Models
summary: Long-term personalization requires language models to use interaction history to track users' preferences across sessions. Parametric memory encodes this interaction history into model parameters or adapters, reducing the need to include it in the inference context. However, independent context compilation leaves cross-session integration unspecified, while recurrent updates can attenuate earlier evidence. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM). Its Evidence path directly pools representations of the interaction history to preserve earlier evidence, while its Delta path sequentially updates an associative state to capture changes. Fusing both outputs produces history-conditioned LoRA adapters that combine evidence accumulation with ordered revision. Across multiple backbones, DPPM outperforms the evaluated baselines, achieving 54.22% on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% on PrefEval. These results suggest that DPPM provides a simple and effective design choice for cross-session personalized parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 提出Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM)，通过Evidence路径保留早期证据、Delta路径捕获偏好变化，融合生成历史条件LoRA适配器用于长期个性化。
AI.motivation: 长期个性化需利用交互历史跨会话追踪用户偏好。参数化记忆将历史编码进参数或适配器，但独立上下文编译无法整合跨会话信息，循环更新又会衰减早期证据。
AI.method: DPPM包含双路径：Evidence路径直接池化交互历史的表示以保留早期证据；Delta路径顺序更新关联状态以捕获变化；融合两路输出生成历史条件LoRA适配器，兼顾证据累积与有序修正。
AI.result: 在多个骨干模型上优于基线，PersonaMem-v2达54.22%，PrefEval达86.79%。
AI.conclusion: DPPM为跨会话个性化参数化记忆提供了一种简单有效的设计选择。

title: Workerville: Towards an Organizational Behavior Account of Agent Safety
summary: LLM-based agents now interact with their environments continuously, shaped by such organizational channels as user instructions, peer messages, and long-term memory. Existing safety research has examined these influences, but largely as separate agent components. How such factors jointly shape an agent's safety behavior from a unified perspective remains unmeasured. To bridge this gap, we advocate organizational behavior (OB) as a framework for studying the safety of advanced agents, reorganizing the objects of study, theoretical foundations, and experimental design around the relational structure in which agents operate. We present the first systematic formalization of counterproductive work behavior (CWB), a canonical safety-relevant subfield of OB, as Agentic Counterproductive Behavior (ACB). ACB specifies three organizational antecedents (vertical supervisor relations, horizontal peer norms, and internal cognitive structures) and maps them onto three counterproductive outcome dimensions (unauthorized disclosure, destructive operations, and production deviation). To operationalize ACB, we introduce Workerville, a controlled benchmark that manipulates organizational conditions over shared tasks, applying 16 organizational configurations to 210 tasks to yield 3,360 challenges, evaluated by human-validated agentic judges. Benchmarking 6 frontier LLMs, we find that (I) negative organizational antecedents exhibit non-monotonic amplification when combined, with the unauthorized-disclosure rate rising from 16.5% under no negative antecedent to 60.1% under two and falling back to 50.3% under three; (II) agents reproduce typical behavioral patterns predicted by human CWB research; (III) these results establish OB as a systematic framework for agent safety research, pointing toward a new research agenda.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以组织行为学(OB)作为研究高级智能体安全性的统一框架，形式化"智能体反生产行为(ACB)"，并构建Workerville基准，揭示组织前因对智能体安全行为的非单调放大效应。
AI.motivation: 现有安全研究虽考察了用户指令、同伴消息、长期记忆等组织渠道对LLM智能体的影响，但多将其视为彼此分离的组件，缺乏从统一视角衡量这些因素如何共同塑造智能体安全行为的研究。
AI.method: 作者将OB中的反生产工作行为(CWB)形式化为ACB，定义三类组织前因（纵向上级关系、横向同伴规范、内部认知结构）并映射到三类反生产结果（未授权披露、破坏性操作、生产偏差）。据此构建Workerville可控基准，对共享任务施加16种组织配置、210个任务，共3,360个挑战，由人工验证的智能体评判器评估，并对6个前沿LLM进行基准测试。
AI.result: 负面组织前因组合时呈现非单调放大：未授权披露率在无负面前因时为16.5%，两个前因升至60.1%，三个前因回落至50.3%；智能体还重现了人类CWB研究预测的典型行为模式。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为OB作为智能体安全研究的系统性框架提供了依据，并指向一条新的研究议程。

title: Machine Learning Optimization for Enhanced OS Fingerprinting
summary: Operating System (OS) Fingerprinting is a technique that can be used to identify a network's operating systems by evaluating network traffic in the form of TCP/IP packets. This research will explore the effectiveness of passively identifying operating systems on the CIC-IDS2017 dataset, a collection of over 47 gigabytes of pcap files with their corresponding operating systems. This research also proposes a new command line interface, OsirisML, which uses nPrint to preprocess the data into tabular data and XGBoost to apply ML to the data to generate, retrain, and test ML models. When packets are split randomly between training and testing, OsirisML models reach an accuracy of 97.66% on a down-sampled subset of the Friday capture and 84.69% on the entire capture. On the entire Monday capture, which contains no attacks, OsirisML reaches an accuracy of 73.83% and an F-1 score of 79.38%.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索在CIC-IDS2017数据集上被动识别操作系统，并提出OsirisML工具，利用nPrint预处理和XGBoost建模，准确率最高达97.66%。
AI.motivation: OS指纹识别可通过分析TCP/IP流量识别网络中的操作系统，但需验证其在真实大规模数据集上的被动识别有效性。
AI.method: 基于超过47GB的CIC-IDS2017 pcap文件，使用nPrint将数据预处理为表格形式，并采用XGBoost训练、重训和测试机器学习模型；同时提出命令行工具OsirisML。
AI.result: 随机划分训练/测试时，周五捕获的下采样子集准确率达97.66%，完整捕获达84.69%；无攻击的周一完整捕获准确率为73.83%，F-1分数为79.38%。
AI.conclusion: OsirisML在被动OS指纹识别上表现良好，且所提方法在含攻击与无攻击流量上均具可行性。

title: It's Always 10:10: Reference Images Break a Bias That Prompts Only Dent
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Data and code: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23224681
summary: Text-to-image models appear to reproduce the habits of the photographs they learned from. Analog clocks are an extreme case: in advertising, watches almost always show 10:10, and generated clocks return to 10:10 even when another time is requested. We measure this bias and test three ways of overcoming it on 52 models available on the Magnific platform, with a replication on Higgsfield. Every image shows three identical clocks that must show 2:35, 6:50 and 11:20. The description of the object is fixed and only the request about the time changes: no time (A), the time in digits (B), the hand positions described by construction relative to the dial numerals (C), or the same description plus a drawn reference dial (D). Two AI readers read all 1,799 images blind from coded copies, with a third reader and the author settling disagreements (dial-level agreement 96.0% and 97.3%). With no time requested, 67% of the images have all three clocks at 10:10. On the 20 current models, all three clocks are correct in 34% of the images with digits, 30% with the hands described in words and 75% with the reference dial (D-B: +37 points, 95% CI +28 to +45); we found no evidence that describing the hands in words beats the digits (C-B: -4 points, CI -10 to +1). The replication on the 12 models shared by both platforms gives the same picture (B 54%, C 50%, D 81%). Writing the time reduces the bias but leaves two thirds of the images of the 20 current models with at least one wrong clock; adding a drawn reference raises full accuracy to three quarters and almost eliminates images entirely at 10:10. We release all images, prompts, raw readings and a script that recomputes every result.

AI.tldr: 文本到图像模型继承训练数据中的摄影习惯，广告中手表多为10:10，生成时钟也倾向回到10:10。研究测量该偏差并测试三种克服方法。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像模型似乎复现了从训练照片中学到的习惯，模拟时钟是极端案例：广告中手表几乎总是显示10:10，即使要求其他时间，生成的时钟也会回到10:10。作者希望测量这一偏差并寻找克服方法。
AI.method: 在Magnific平台的52个模型上测试，并在Higgsfield上复现。每张图显示三个相同时钟，需分别显示2:35、6:50和11:20。固定物体描述，仅改变时间请求：无时间(A)、数字时间(B)、用表盘数字描述指针位置(C)、或加绘制参考表盘(D)。两名AI读者盲读全部1,799张编码图像，第三名读者与作者裁定分歧（表盘级一致率96.0%和97.3%）。
AI.result: 未请求时间时，67%的图像三个时钟全为10:10。在20个当前模型上，数字请求下三个时钟全对占34%，文字描述指针占30%，参考表盘占75%（D-B：+37点，95% CI +28至+45）；无证据表明文字描述优于数字（C-B：-4点，CI -10至+1）。12个共享模型的复现结果相同（B 54%，C 50%，D 81%）。
AI.conclusion: 写出时间可减少偏差，但20个当前模型中仍有三分之二的图像至少一个时钟错误；加入绘制参考表盘可将完整准确率提高到四分之三，并几乎消除全部为10:10的图像。作者发布所有图像、提示词、原始读数和重算脚本。

title: From Sparse Representations to Behavioral Insights for Multimodal Depression Assessment
summary: Multimodal depression assessment offers a promising approach to analyzing behavioral patterns associated with depression. However, existing methods often rely on dense and opaque multimodal representations, making it difficult to interpret the behavioral patterns underlying their predictions. In this work, we introduce BehavDep, a sparse factor-based framework that decomposes multimodal behavioral representations into sparse latent factors and associates them with behaviorally meaningful concepts through a semantic bridge. To address the mismatch between user-level annotations and heterogeneous video-level behaviors, BehavDep further learns video-level depression tendency scores under weak supervision and aggregates information across multiple observations for user-level assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BehavDep achieves the best overall assessment performance while revealing complementary modality contributions, heterogeneous behavioral patterns across observations, and prediction responses to concept-level editing. These results show that BehavDep provides a structured and interpretable approach to analyzing multimodal behavioral representations for depression assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出稀疏因子框架BehavDep，将多模态行为表示分解为稀疏潜在因子并映射到语义概念，实现可解释的抑郁评估。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖稠密且不透明的多模态表示，难以解释预测背后的行为模式（缺乏可解释性）。
AI.method: 稀疏因子分解将多模态行为表示分解为稀疏潜在因子，通过语义桥与行为概念关联；在弱监督下学习视频级抑郁倾向分数，并跨多次观察聚合进行用户级评估。
AI.result: 取得最佳整体评估性能，同时揭示互补的模态贡献、跨观察的异质行为模式以及概念级编辑的预测响应。
AI.conclusion: BehavDep为多模态行为表示提供了结构化且可解释的抑郁评估方法。

title: Scaling to Tens of Thousands of Test-Time Iterations with Loop-Native Attention Residuals
summary: In this paper, we argue that looped Transformers need their own residual connections to prevent performance degradation as the number of iterations grows. We observe that increasing loop iterations can reduce reasoning accuracy: noisy state updates overwrite correct intermediate deductions and even undo completed solutions. This leaves subsequent iterations to recover lost information from an already degraded representation: once an error arises in an earlier loop, often as a result of long-range propagation through the recurrence, later loops find it difficult to correct. In this paper, we introduce InfiLoop, a loop-native residual connection that learns which past computations to retain and how much to accept from each new update. InfiLoop combines content-based weighting with learned temporal decay to maintain a running summary of recurrent states. An exact streaming recurrence keeps its persistent aggregation memory constant as the loop count grows. The resulting adaptive update suppresses unreliable proposals and preserves useful intermediate states. Across extensive reasoning tasks, a 7M-parameter InfiLoop model outperforms existing recursive architectures, reaching 97.9% exact accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme, and 13.6% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2. Notably, on Sudoku-Extreme, InfiLoop continues to improve with test-time looping beyond 20,000 effective steps, showing that added depth translates directly into stronger reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/pixeli99/InfiLoop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InfiLoop，一种为循环 Transformer 设计的原生残差连接，通过内容加权与学习到的时序衰减维持递归状态的运行摘要，防止循环迭代增多导致的性能退化。7M 参数模型在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达 97.9% 准确率，ARC-AGI-2 上达 13.6% pass@2，且测试时循环超 20,000 步仍持续提升。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 随迭代次数增加会出现推理精度下降：噪声状态更新会覆盖正确的中间推导，甚至撤销已完成解；一旦早期循环因长程传播产生错误，后续循环难以从已退化表示中恢复。因此循环 Transformer 需要专属残差连接。
AI.method: 提出 InfiLoop，一种循环原生残差连接，学习保留哪些过去计算以及从每次新更新中接受多少。它结合基于内容的加权与学习到的时序衰减，维持递归状态的运行摘要；采用精确流式递归，使持久聚合内存在循环次数增长时保持恒定，自适应更新可抑制不可靠提议并保留有用的中间状态。
AI.result: 在大量推理任务上，7M 参数的 InfiLoop 超越现有递归架构，Sudoku-Extreme 达 97.9% 精确准确率，ARC-AGI-2 达 13.6% pass@2；在 Sudoku-Extreme 上测试时循环超过 20,000 有效步仍持续改进，表明增加深度可直接增强推理。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 循环 Transformer 需专用残差机制以避免迭代带来的性能退化，InfiLoop 通过自适应、内存恒定的循环残差聚合有效保留中间状态并抑制噪声，使测试时增加循环深度直接转化为更强推理能力。

title: QUILT: Rethinking Sparse-Attention Prefill through Shared Query Execution
summary: Sparse attention reduces the cost of long-context attention, but existing kernels typically process queries independently, repeatedly loading and dequantizing KV entries shared across queries. We observe substantial overlap in the KV entries selected by neighboring queries, creating opportunities for cross-query reuse. We present QUILT, a workload-aware sparse-attention execution mechanism that jointly processes neighboring queries and reuses shared KV entries to reduce redundant memory traffic and computation. QUILT introduces Shift-and-Compare Set Decomposition (SCSD), which transforms irregular set operations into regular data-parallel primitives suitable for modern accelerators, and pipelines SCSD with attention computation to hide its overhead. Cascaded sharing captures reuse hierarchically at multiple granularities. A tile-aware execution strategy balances sharing granularity with hardware tile utilization and selectively removes low-importance query-specific tails to eliminate underutilized tiles. We evaluate QUILT on LongBench using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-3.2 under both tensor and sequence parallelism. Compared with the state-of-the-art sparse-attention kernel, QUILT reduces average kernel latency by up to 55.1% and processed KV data by up to 55.9%, while reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency by up to 36.8% with negligible accuracy degradation.

AI.tldr: QUILT 是一种工作负载感知的稀疏注意力执行机制，通过联合处理相邻查询并复用共享的 KV 条目来减少冗余内存流量与计算。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏注意力内核独立处理查询，导致相邻查询共享的 KV 条目被重复加载与反量化，造成冗余开销。
AI.method: QUILT 联合处理相邻查询以复用共享 KV 条目；提出 Shift-and-Compare Set Decomposition (SCSD) 将不规则集合操作转为规则数据并行原语并与注意力计算流水线化；采用级联共享分层捕获复用；使用 tile-aware 执行策略平衡共享粒度与硬件利用率，并去除低重要性的查询特定尾部。
AI.result: 在 LongBench 上使用 GLM-5.3 与 DeepSeek-3.2（张量并行与序列并行下）评测：相比最先进稀疏注意力内核，内核延迟降低最多 55.1%，处理的 KV 数据减少最多 55.9%，TTFT 延迟降低最多 36.8%，精度损失可忽略。
AI.conclusion: QUILT 通过跨查询 KV 复用显著提升稀疏注意力效率，在几乎不损失精度的情况下大幅降低延迟与内存流量。

title: PathLang: A Language-Centered Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Computational Pathology
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong visual perception ability, but their robustness in the language domain remains poorly characterized. Existing pathology VLM benchmarks largely rely on canonical closed-set prompts or perturb only generic templates, treating language as a fixed evaluation component rather than a variable axis of model behavior. In clinical practice, however, diagnostic language varies across reports, institutions, and candidate diagnoses. We introduce PathLang, a language-centered and clinically grounded zero-shot benchmark. PathLang holds the underlying slides, ground-truth labels, and image-text evaluation direction fixed while systematically varying only the diagnostic language, so that performance differences reflect how a diagnosis is phrased rather than what is imaged. The language variation follows how pathologists actually rephrase diagnoses (terminology, specificity, and reporting style), and all prompts and candidate pools are validated by six board-certified pathologists. PathLang covers four task families: (1) zero-shot classification with image-text alignment analysis, (2) cross-modal retrieval, (3) paraphrase robustness, including semantic-equivalence paraphrases, length and reporting-style variation, and prompt ensembling, and (4) open-vocabulary diagnosis retrieval over four candidate pools with distinct forms of semantic competition. Across nine VLMs and five public datasets spanning four organs, we find that performance is highly sensitive to clinically equivalent paraphrases, varies substantially across forms of semantic competition, and that image-text alignment quality does not necessarily translate into inter-class separability. We release the prompt corpus, candidate pools, pre-computed text embeddings, and evaluation code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PathLang.

AI.tldr: PathLang是一个以语言为中心、临床驱动的病理VLM零样本基准，固定图像与标签仅变化诊断语言，揭示性能对措辞高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 病理VLM视觉感知强，但语言域鲁棒性研究不足；现有基准多用封闭集提示或仅扰动通用模板，未将语言作为模型行为变量，而临床诊断语言随报告、机构、候选诊断而变化。
AI.method: 构建PathLang：固定切片、真值标签与图文评估方向，仅系统变化诊断语言（术语、具体度、报告风格），提示与候选池由6位认证病理医生验证；涵盖四类任务——零样本分类与图文对齐、跨模态检索、改写鲁棒性（语义等价改写、长度与风格变化、提示集成）、四类候选池的开词汇诊断检索。
AI.result: 在9个VLM、5个公开数据集（覆盖4种器官）上，性能对临床等价改写高度敏感，随语义竞争形式显著变化，且图文对齐质量不必然转化为类间可分性。
AI.conclusion: 语言是病理VLM评估中不可忽视的变量维度，现有模型的语言鲁棒性存疑；已开源提示语料、候选池、预计算文本嵌入与评估代码。

title: Easy to anticipate, hard to compute: boundary dependence finds the computed outputs that entropy patching misses
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, logs and results: https://github.com/nicoveraz/segresearch (archived: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23238215)
summary: Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) group bytes into patches and run their large global model once per patch. BLT starts a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high, so global compute goes where the next byte is hard to predict. We show that this rule has a systematic blind spot: positions whose type is predictable but whose value must be computed, such as the number after "=" in a worked math solution. Under tight patch budgets, entropy-triggered layouts skip these positions, and accuracy on them collapses. In Meta's BLT-1B with patch starts on 10% of bytes, the entropy rule puts a patch start at 16% of the computed results in GSM8K solutions and gets 19.0% of them exactly right; a boundary after each "=" at the same patch count gets 51.8%, and entropy combined with a label-free boundary-dependence signal gets 67.1% (default layout at 26% of bytes: 76.8%). The gap survives adapting BLT-1B to the budget with low-rank fine-tuning (32.9% vs 72.7%, three runs per rule, paired p < 1e-200) and grows with model size in byte models trained from scratch at a 10% budget: at 1M, 12M and 50M parameters, boundary dependence beats entropy on final answers by -1.6, +10.1 and +19.8 points, and at 50M it gets 35.9% of computed results against 13.9% (3 seeds each). BLT's entropy-jump rule helps neither target at 50M. The entropy trigger of Scratchpad Patching is likewise indistinguishable from random scratchpads on final answers (5.6% vs 5.9%, 5 seeds), while answer-start scratchpads give 38.1%. The effect is specific to computed values: copies and lookups gain little, and values the model cannot compute gain nothing. Boundary dependence, the rise in the model's own loss when a patch start is removed, measured per two-byte context, finds these positions without labels: combined with entropy it beats the hand-written rule on computed results.

AI.tldr: BLT等字节级语言模型用熵触发划分patch，会系统性跳过"类型可预测但数值需计算"的位置（如等号后的数字），导致计算类位置准确率崩溃；一种无标签的"边界依赖"信号可有效定位这些位置。
AI.motivation: Byte Latent Transformer等字节级模型按小模型下一字节熵高低启动patch，把全局算力分配给难预测位置。但该规则存在系统性盲点：那些"类型可预测、数值需计算"的位置熵值不高而被跳过，在紧张patch预算下准确率崩塌。作者希望诊断这一问题并寻找更好的边界定位信号。
AI.method: 在Meta的BLT-1B（10%字节启动patch）上对比熵规则、每个"="后加边界、以及熵+无标签边界依赖信号三种布局；用低秩微调适配预算；从头训练1M/12M/50M参数字节模型；检验Scratchpad Patching的熵触发；定义"边界依赖"为移除patch起点后模型自身损失的上升量，按两字节上下文测量以无标签定位关键位置。
AI.result: BLT-1B(10%)下，熵规则仅在16%计算结果处加起点、准确率19.0%；"="后边界51.8%；熵+边界依赖67.1%（默认26%布局76.8%）。低秩微调后33.3% vs 72.7%（p<1e-200）。从零训练中边界依赖在1M/12M/50M上分别领先熵-1.6/+10.1/+19.8分，50M时35.9% vs 13.9%。Scratchpad Patching熵触发近似随机(5.6% vs 5.9%)，答案起点则达38.1%。
AI.conclusion: 熵触发划分存在系统性盲点，尤其伤害需计算的数值位置；该效应具有特异性（复制、查找类获益小，无法计算的数值无增益）。无标签的边界依赖信号能有效定位这些位置，与熵结合后优于人工规则，为字节级模型的patch布局设计提供了更优方案。

title: Memory Type Varies: Empowering LLM Agents for Long-Term Memory with Diverse Strategies
summary: The memory capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have garnered increasing attention recently. Despite great success achieved, existing retrieval-based memory approaches typically overlook the differences between memories and employ a unified strategy to process all memories, leading to suboptimal performance. Thus, an intuitive question arises: can we categorize memory into different types and select appropriate strategies? However, given the topic-rich, scenario-complex, and boundary-blurred nature of memory scenarios, achieving precise classification of memories is not easy. To address this challenge, we propose a memory multi-class dataset in this paper, termed TriMEM, which provides precise annotations for memory types across diverse scenarios. Building upon this foundation, we propose a novel memory framework, named MemoType, which can adaptively recognize each memory and query type with the learned router model. With the memory and query routing, MemoType can retrieve the memory with corresponding query types and design tailored retrieval strategies, thereby enhancing the retrieval performance. Moreover, we theoretically prove that any single retrieval strategy is subject to a fundamental upper bound on its expected retrieval precision in multi-class corpora, leading to systematic precision degradation. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that MemoType consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 16.18% improvement in Recall@1.

AI.tldr: 提出TriMEM记忆多类数据集与MemoType自适应路由框架，并理论证明单一检索策略在多类语料下的精度上界。
AI.motivation: 现有基于检索的记忆方法忽视记忆之间的差异，统一策略处理所有记忆，导致性能次优。
AI.method: 构建TriMEM数据集提供跨场景记忆类型精确标注；设计MemoType框架，用学习到的router模型自适应识别记忆与查询类型，按对应查询类型检索并设计定制化检索策略。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上持续超越现有方法，Recall@1最高提升16.18%；理论上证明多类语料下任何单一检索策略的期望检索精度存在基本上界。
AI.conclusion: 记忆类型分类与自适应路由能有效缓解精度退化，为检索式LLM记忆提供新思路。

title: Point-Focused Attention Meets Context-Scan State Space: Robust Biological Visual Perception for Point Cloud Representation
summary: Synergistically capturing intricate local structures and global contextual dependencies has become a critical challenge in point cloud representation learning. To address this, we introduce PointLearner, a point cloud representation learning network that closely aligns with biological vision which employs an active, foveation-inspired processing strategy, thus enabling local geometric modeling and long-range dependency interactions simultaneously. Specifically, we first design a point-focused attention, which simulates foveal vision at the visual focus through a competitive normalized attention mechanism between local neighbors and spatially downsampled features. The spatially downsampled features are extracted by a pooling method based on learnable inducing points, which can flexibly adapt to the non-uniform distribution of point clouds as the number of inducing points is controlled and they interact directly with point clouds. Second, we propose a context-scan state space that mimics eye's saccade inference, which infers the overall semantic structure and spatial content in the scene through a scan path guided by the Hilbert curve for the bidirectional S6. With this focus-then-context biomimetic design, PointLearner demonstrates remarkable robustness and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple point cloud tasks.

AI.tldr: PointLearner是一种模仿生物视觉（中央凹聚焦+眼跳）的点云表征学习网络，通过点聚焦注意力和上下文扫描状态空间同时建模局部几何与全局依赖，在多个点云任务上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 点云表征学习中同时捕获精细局部结构与全局上下文依赖是关键挑战。现有方法难以兼顾二者，作者借鉴生物视觉的主动、中央凹式处理策略来解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: 提出点聚焦注意力：在视觉焦点处模拟中央凹视觉，通过局部邻居与空间下采样特征之间的竞争归一化注意力机制实现；下采样特征由基于可学习诱导点的池化方法提取，可灵活适应点云非均匀分布。另提出上下文扫描状态空间：模拟眼跳推理，通过Hilbert曲线引导的扫描路径驱动双向S6推断整体语义结构与空间内容。整体为"先聚焦后上下文"的仿生设计。
AI.result: PointLearner展现出显著鲁棒性，并在多个点云任务上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过聚焦-上下文仿生设计，PointLearner有效兼顾局部几何建模与长程依赖交互，验证了生物视觉启发的点云表征学习方案的有效性。

title: Detecting Spin in Clinical Trials with Large Language Models
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at the 29th International Multiconference Information Society (IS 2026), AI in Healthcare track, Ljubljana, Slovenia. Code: https://github.com/ta5946/Spin
summary: Spin in clinical trials includes reporting practices that distort the presentation of results. This is particularly critical in medicine, where spin is present in more than 50% of randomized controlled trials that fail to reach statistical significance. The comparison of primary and reported outcomes is crucial for detecting several types of spin, including outcome switching. We used 300 pairs of outcomes labeled with semantic similarity to develop a system for automatic detection of outcome switching. We evaluated baseline text similarity models and open-source LLMs using generated similarity scores and the Youden index to determine the classification threshold. The proposed approach involves prompt engineering, classification based on token probabilities, and majority voting for the final decision. The results on the test set of 2,496 examples with an F1 score of 0.78 and an accuracy of 0.90 outperform baseline text similarity models but trail behind fine-tuned versions of BERT. We used LLMs to generate natural language explanations for the classified instances and manually assessed their quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用开源LLM自动检测临床试验中的结局切换（outcome switching），通过提示工程、token概率分类和多数投票实现，测试集F1为0.78、准确率0.90。
AI.motivation: 临床试验中的"spin"（报告偏倚）会歪曲结果呈现，在未达统计显著性的随机对照试验中超过50%存在此问题。比较主要结局与报告结局对检测结局切换等spin至关重要，但目前缺乏自动检测手段。
AI.method: 使用300对带语义相似度标注的结局构建检测系统。评估基线文本相似模型与开源LLM，利用生成的相似度分数和Youden指数确定分类阈值；方法包含提示工程、基于token概率的分类以及多数投票得出最终决策。
AI.result: 在含2,496个样本的测试集上，F1为0.78，准确率0.90，优于基线文本相似模型，但落后于微调版BERT。此外用LLM为分类实例生成自然语言解释，并人工评估其质量。
AI.conclusion: 基于开源LLM的方法可有效自动检测结局切换并生成可解释说明，虽略逊于微调BERT，但为临床试验报告偏倚检测提供了可行的自动化方案。

title: Error-Propagation Modeling for Failure Attribution in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) are increasingly used to solve complex tasks through coordinated reasoning, tool use, and interaction with external resources. However, attributing failures in such systems remains challenging because the observed outcome often does not directly reveal the error responsible for the failed execution. In this work, the attribution target is the decisive error, defined as the agent--step pair whose correction would recover the failed execution. Existing approaches largely identify suspicious steps without explicitly modeling how errors propagate across interactions or persist in unresolved loops, making decisive errors difficult to distinguish from downstream failure symptoms. We propose \textbf{E}rror-Propagation \textbf{M}odeling for \textbf{F}ailure \textbf{A}ttribution (\textbf{EMFA}). EMFA constructs a structured representation of the failed trajectory, models both cascading propagation and persistent interaction loops, and uses propagation-aware candidate screening followed by counterfactual verification to identify the decisive agent--step pair. On the Who\&When benchmark, EMFA achieves state-of-the-art step-level attribution accuracy and remains competitive at the agent level. It improves the previous best step-level results by 3.45 and 4.40 percentage points on the Hand-Crafted and Algorithm-Generated subsets, respectively.

AI.tldr: EMFA通过建模错误传播与持续交互循环，结合传播感知筛选和反事实验证，定位多智能体系统中的决定性错误，在Who&When基准上达到SOTA步级归因精度。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统失败归因困难，因观测结果不直接暴露错误根源；现有方法只识别可疑步骤，未显式建模错误跨交互传播或未解循环中的持续存在，难以区分决定性错误与下游失败症状。
AI.method: 提出EMFA：构建失败轨迹的结构化表示，建模级联传播与持续交互循环，采用传播感知的候选筛选，再用反事实验证确定决定性的智能体-步骤对。
AI.result: 在Who&When基准上取得SOTA步级归因精度，智能体级保持竞争力；相比此前最佳步级结果，Hand-Crafted和Algorithm-Generated子集分别提升3.45和4.40个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模错误传播是提升多智能体系统失败归因的有效途径，EMFA能更准确区分决定性错误与失败症状。

title: Ranking Prior Alignment for Credit Risk Modeling: When Do External Priors Matter?
summary:
Cold-start credit scoring -- deploying models with scarce labeled data, weak features, or minimal capacity -- is a recurring problem in financial machine learning. When a new lending product launches, labeled default data is scarce, feature pipelines are immature, and models must be deployed with minimal capacity to avoid overfitting. Standard defenses operate on the same limited data; what is needed is a source of external regularization grounded in domain knowledge.
  We propose Ranking Prior Alignment, a model-agnostic framework that distills external ranking priors (from domain experts, teacher models, or LLMs) into any scoring model via a temperature-scaled KL divergence loss. The framework unifies neural (MIL attention) and tree-based (XGBoost custom objective) architectures through a single formulation: L = L_task + gamma(t) * KL(P_agent || P_model), where gamma(t) follows an exponential decay schedule. The method requires no external model at inference, and its tree-based instantiation tolerates annotation noise up to eta = 0.5.
  On an industrial dataset of over 1.5M merchants, MIL alignment achieves 7/7 positive evaluation cells at 3K bags (1 ID + 3 OOT + 3 degradation metrics; peak Delta AUC = +0.020 on OOT-1), and XGBoost ablation achieves 9/9 positive metrics at 300 bags. Cross-dataset validation on public Amex shows 5/5 positive folds (avg Delta AUC = +0.041). Four model families (MIL, XGBoost, LightGBM, Logistic Regression) and four teacher architectures show that the framework is both model-agnostic and prior-source-independent.
  We further observe that alignment gains exhibit an inverse-scaling pattern: benefits grow as data abundance N, model capacity C, and feature quality Q decrease, helping practitioners decide when to invest in prior annotation.

AI.tldr: 提出Ranking Prior Alignment框架，用外部分排序先验（专家/教师模型/LLM）通过温度缩放KL散度损失蒸馏进任意评分模型，缓解金融信贷冷启动问题。在150万商户工业数据上MIL达7/7正向指标、XGBoost达9/9，Amex上5/5折正向，且收益随数据、容量、特征质量下降而增大。
AI.motivation: 金融信贷冷启动场景中标注数据稀缺、特征管线不成熟、模型容量受限，标准防御只能在同一有限数据上操作，缺乏基于领域知识的外部正则化来源。
AI.method: 提出模型无关的Ranking Prior Alignment：将外部排序先验（专家、教师模型、LLM）通过温度缩放KL散度损失蒸馏到评分模型，损失为L=L_task+gamma(t)*KL(P_agent||P_model)，gamma(t)指数衰减。统一神经（MIL注意力）与树模型（XGBoost自定义目标）架构，推理时无需外部模型，树版本可容忍η=0.5的标注噪声。
AI.result: 150万+商户工业数据：MIL对齐在3K bags下7/7评估单元正向（OOT-1峰值ΔAUC=+0.020），XGBoost消融在300 bags下9/9指标正向；Amex公开数据5/5折正向（平均ΔAUC=+0.041）。四种模型族与四种教师架构验证了模型无关性与先验来源无关性。
AI.conclusion: 对齐收益呈现逆缩放规律：数据量N、模型容量C、特征质量Q越低，收益越大，可帮助从业者判断何时投资先验标注。

title: EgoPhys: Estimating Peak Contact Force and Mechanical Work from Egocentric Manipulation Video
summary: Physically grounded manipulation of articulated objects requires understanding both the maximum forces encountered during contact and the work performed as their parts move. Peak contact force and mechanical work quantify these complementary aspects, but estimating them from egocentric video is challenging because physical interaction cues are local and indirect. Moreover, peak force is associated with brief contact events, whereas mechanical work depends on force-motion coupling throughout the contact duration. To address these challenges, we propose EgoPhys, an RGB-only framework comprising Contact-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CASA) and Target-Specific Multi-Expert Temporal Routing (TMTR). CASA integrates appearance and geometry features to emphasize interaction-relevant cues, while TMTR models semantic, event, and motion cues with specialized temporal experts and routes them separately for force and work prediction. On the test split from Hoi! dataset, EgoPhys substantially improves predictions of peak force and mechanical work, achieving MAEs of \(5.205 \pm 0.584\) $N$ and $0.894 \pm 0.081$ $J$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用RGB视频的EgoPhys框架，通过CASA和TMTR两个模块从自我中心视频估计接触峰值力与机械功。
AI.motivation: 物理落地的铰接物体操作需要理解接触时的峰值力和部件运动所做的功。但从自我中心视频估计这两者困难：物理交互线索局部且间接；峰值力对应短暂接触事件，而机械功依赖整个接触过程的力-运动耦合。
AI.method: EgoPhys为仅用RGB的框架，包含两个模块：Contact-Aware Spatial Aggregation（CASA）融合外观与几何特征以突出交互相关线索；Target-Specific Multi-Expert Temporal Routing（TMTR）用专门的时序专家建模语义、事件与运动线索，并分别为力和功预测进行路由。
AI.result: 在Hoi!数据集测试集上，EgoPhys显著改善峰值力与机械功预测，MAE分别为5.205±0.584 N和0.894±0.081 J。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，针对力与功的不同物理特性设计专用时空特征建模与路由，可有效从自我中心RGB视频中估计峰值接触力与机械功。

title: AgentEvolver: System-Wide Self-Evolution Through Task Execution
summary: An agent can complete a task without improving how it works. Turning task experience into reusable capability requires connecting the changed component to its evaluation and subsequent use. We present AgentEvolver, a system for developing capabilities during task execution while keeping the foundation model fixed. Eight entity families expose reusable operations, methods, agents, control flow, interfaces, and supporting state to revision through a common versioned lifecycle. A shared Runtime coordinates ongoing work, while persistent planning and recoverable context preserve task direction and supporting evidence. We evaluate task outcomes on SWE-bench Pro Public and examine capability changes in six application cases. The team reports an 82.08\% resolution rate with evolution, exceeding its reported baseline without evolution. The cases show retained capabilities entering later website, game, and research work, while also documenting incomplete objectives and an unsuccessful strategy. These findings distinguish improvement in a reusable component from success on the final task. AgentEvolver provides a concrete basis for studying capability accumulation through execution; independent-task transfer and total development cost remain open questions.

AI.tldr: AgentEvolver 提出一个在任务执行中积累可复用能力的系统：固定基础模型，让八类实体通过统一的版本化生命周期被修订，从而把任务经验转化为可复用能力。在 SWE-bench Pro Public 上报告 82.08% 解决率，并展示能力在后续网站、游戏与研究任务中的延续，同时指出部分目标未完成与一次失败策略。
AI.motivation: 完成任务不等于提升能力。要让任务经验变成可复用能力，需要把被改动的组件与其评估、后续使用连接起来，并能在执行过程中持续发展能力而不改动基础模型。
AI.method: AgentEvolver 保持基础模型固定；八类实体族（可复用操作、方法、智能体、控制流、接口及支持状态等）通过统一的版本化生命周期被修订；共享 Runtime 协调进行中的工作；持久化规划与可恢复上下文保留任务方向与支撑证据。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Pro Public 上，报告 82.08% 解决率，超过其报告的未进化基线；六个应用案例显示保留下来的能力进入后续网站、游戏和研究工作，同时记录到未完成目标和一次不成功策略。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现区分了“可复用组件的改进”与“最终任务上的成功”。AgentEvolver 为研究通过执行实现能力积累提供了具体基础；独立任务迁移与总开发成本仍是未解决问题。

title: Do LLMs Learn from Rewards in Context? : Rethinking the role of reward in In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: LLM agents increasingly improve at inference time by accumulating experience in context rather than by updating parameters. This process is often described as in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL). Whether in-context learning (ICL) can actually play the role of RL, however, has not been tested. We study this question in its simplest form, direct ICRL, where the model conditions directly on raw trajectory-reward pairs, and ask whether the reward acts as a learning signal. Through controlled experiments on four benchmarks across six models, we find that the reward is read, but its effect is small: flipping, randomizing, or removing the reward leaves the improvement curve almost unchanged, and this holds even under meta-prompts that explicitly instruct the model to explore, exploit, or reason over rewards. Trajectories drive improvement, but not through their semantic content: shuffled or corrupted trajectories work as well as real ones. These patterns closely mirror those known in ICL, suggesting that direct ICRL is better understood as a special case of ICL than as inference-time RL. This reframing has implications for agent memory design: ICL factors such as input distribution and demonstrations may matter more than RL elements such as reward shaping and exploration.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究直接上下文强化学习(ICRL)中奖励是否真正作为学习信号起作用。通过四个基准、六个模型的受控实验发现，奖励对性能提升影响极小，轨迹本身的语义内容也不重要，说明直接ICRL更像是上下文学习(ICL)的特例而非推理时RL。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地通过在上下文中累积经验(而非更新参数)来提升推理时性能，这被称为上下文强化学习(ICRL)。但ICL是否真能扮演RL的角色尚未被验证，作者希望在最简单的直接ICRL形式下检验奖励是否作为学习信号。
AI.method: 在四个基准、六个模型上进行受控实验，检验直接ICRL(模型直接以原始轨迹-奖励对为条件)。测试翻转、随机化或移除奖励，以及使用显式指示探索、利用或推理奖励的元提示，并对轨迹进行打乱或破坏以检验语义内容的作用。
AI.result: 奖励确实被读取，但效果很小：翻转、随机化或移除奖励几乎不改变改进曲线，即使在明确指示模型探索/利用/推理奖励的元提示下也是如此。轨迹驱动了改进，但并非通过其语义内容——打乱或破坏的轨迹与真实轨迹效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 这些模式与ICL中已知现象高度一致，表明直接ICRL更应被理解为ICL的特例，而非推理时RL。对智能体记忆设计的启示是：输入分布和演示等ICL因素可能比奖励塑造和探索等RL元素更重要。

title: Adaptive Adversarial Augmentation for Controllable Face Synthesis
summary: Synthetic data provides a scalable alternative to real-world datasets for training face recognition models, particularly under challenging conditions such as low resolution, occlusion, and masks. Yet, most approaches lack diversity and fail to generalize effectively. We propose Ensemble Feedback Controllable Synthesis (EFCS), a guided framework that generates diverse and challenging samples while preserving visual realism. EFCS expands distributional variability, often reflected in higher FID and KID scores compared to single-feedback and random synthesis, while maintaining high precision. Recognition models trained on EFCS data consistently outperform baselines across multiple benchmarks, showing improved generalization to real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we introduce an analytically motivated formulation linking perturbation-induced difficulty, sample utility, and performance degradation, offering principled insights into balancing synthetic data complexity for optimal training. Together, these contributions establish EFCS as an effective and analytically grounded approach for bridging the gap between synthetic and real datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EFCS框架，通过集成反馈可控合成生成多样且具挑战性的人脸识别训练数据，并给出扰动难度与样本效用的理论分析。
AI.motivation: 真实人脸数据在低分辨率、遮挡和口罩等困难条件下稀缺，合成数据虽可扩展但现有方法多样性不足、泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出Ensemble Feedback Controllable Synthesis (EFCS)引导式框架，在保持视觉真实性的同时生成多样且具挑战性的样本；并引入分析性公式，关联扰动难度、样本效用与性能退化。
AI.result: EFCS 扩展了分布多样性，FID/KID 高于单反馈与随机合成，同时保持高精度；在 EFCS 数据上训练的识别模型在多个基准上持续超越基线，提升了对真实场景的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EFCS 是有效且有分析依据的方法，可弥合合成数据与真实数据之间的差距，并为平衡合成数据复杂度提供理论指导。

title: Can Decision Models Understand Stance? Evaluating Jev Against General-Purpose LLMs
summary: Stance detection requires identifying an author's attitude toward a given target, sometimes based on conversational context. Jev, a specialized decision model designed for structured decision-making, offers an alternative to general-purpose large language models (LLMs). In this work, we evaluate Jev on two stance detection datasets, VAST (English texts) and ZS-CSD (Chinese conversations), comparing it with four general-purpose LLMs and two fine-tuned models. Results show that Jev achieves competitive performance on VAST, matching GPT-5.6 and outperforming the other general-purpose LLMs. However, it falls behind stronger LLMs on ZS-CSD, particularly in distinguishing favor from against. Further analysis suggests that this limitation may be related to understanding reply relationships and stance direction rather than conversation length alone. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of Jev for stance detection.

AI.tldr: 本文评估专用决策模型Jev在两个立场检测数据集（VAST英文、ZS-CSD中文对话）上的表现，并与四个通用LLM及两个微调模型对比。
AI.motivation: 立场检测需识别作者对给定目标的态度，有时依赖对话上下文。Jev作为专用决策模型，提供了通用LLM之外的替代方案，但其在立场检测上的能力尚不明确。
AI.method: 在VAST（英文文本）和ZS-CSD（中文对话）两个数据集上评估Jev，与四个通用LLM和两个微调模型进行对比。
AI.result: Jev在VAST上表现有竞争力，与GPT-5.6相当并优于其他通用LLM；但在ZS-CSD上落后于更强的LLM，尤其在区分支持与反对方面。进一步分析表明该局限可能与理解回复关系和立场方向有关，而非仅由对话长度导致。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了Jev在立场检测上的潜力与局限。

title: Where to Adapt Matters: Layer-Selective Fine-Tuning for Capability Retention
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to specialized tasks, but often at the cost of degrading general capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing approaches primarily mitigate this trade-off through data replay or regularization, relying on additional data or explicit optimization constraints. We instead focus on a different question: where should adaptation be applied? We find that fine-tuning different Transformer layers produces different target-task gains and degrees of capability degradation, suggesting that not all layers are equally suitable for adaptation. To characterize this difference, we use layer-wise empirical Fisher information to measure target-task sensitivity. However, computing Fisher scores requires backward computation and becomes increasingly expensive for large models. We therefore introduce input--output cosine similarity as a lightweight, forward-only proxy for ranking layer sensitivity. Across models and tasks, layers with lower input--output similarity consistently exhibit higher empirical Fisher scores. Building on this observation, we propose Layer-Selective LoRA (LS-LoRA), which places trainable LoRA adapters only in layers with low input--output similarity. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that LS-LoRA improves average target-task performance while retaining substantially more commonsense reasoning capability than standard all-layer LoRA, demonstrating that carefully choosing where to adapt can provide a simple and effective way to balance target-task adaptation and general capability retention.

AI.tldr: 论文发现微调不同Transformer层对目标任务增益和通用能力退化影响不同，提出用输入-输出余弦相似度作为前向代理来定位高敏感层，并据此只在低相似度层插入LoRA适配器（LS-LoRA），在数学推理和代码生成任务上兼顾目标性能与常识能力保留。
AI.motivation: PEFT让LLM适配专业任务时往往损害预训练获得的通用能力。现有做法依赖数据回放或正则化，需要额外数据或显式优化约束。作者转而追问：适配应该施加在哪里？因为不同Transformer层的目标增益与能力退化程度并不相同。
AI.method: 用逐层经验Fisher信息衡量目标任务敏感度，但Fisher需反向计算且对大模型开销大；因此提出输入-输出余弦相似度作为轻量、仅前向的敏感度排序代理。观察到低相似度层对应更高Fisher分数，据此提出LS-LoRA，仅在低输入-输出相似度的层放置可训练LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 跨模型与任务，低输入-输出相似度层一致表现出更高的经验Fisher分数。在数学推理和代码生成实验中，LS-LoRA相比标准全层LoRA提升了目标任务平均性能，同时保留显著更多常识推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 精心选择适配位置是一种简单有效平衡目标任务适配与通用能力保留的方式，LS-LoRA验证了层级选择在PEFT中的价值。

title: RideBench: A Large-Scale Exogenous-Aware Benchmark for Ride-Hailing Time Series Forecasting
summary: We release Ride-Hailing, a large-scale ride-hailing time series dataset synthesized from DiDi's marketplace data across 200 spatial areas. Ride-Hailing spans four consecutive years at half-hourly granularity and covers three representative exogenous scenarios: Weather Disturbance, Holiday Effect, and Large-scale Event Impact. Built upon Ride-Hailing, we introduce RideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for exogenous-aware ride-hailing forecasting, covering both regular week-ahead forecasting and long-horizon 8-week-ahead forecasting with up to 2,688 prediction steps. RideBench evaluates over 30 representative forecasting methods, including endogenous-only models, exogenous-aware models, and time series foundation models. Our results show that future-known exogenous variables provide clear benefits in regular week-ahead forecasting, especially under weather, holiday, and large-scale event (e.g., major sporting events and concerts) scenarios. However, current exogenous-aware models still struggle to fully capture disturbance-induced pattern changes under complex external contexts. For long-horizon forecasting, existing models cannot simultaneously achieve low pointwise errors, accurate broad trends, and reliable near-term forecasts. These findings reveal a clear mismatch between existing forecasting models and real-world ride-hailing requirements, highlighting the need for models that can better exploit future-known exogenous information, scale across heterogeneous areas, and support long-horizon planning. By introducing Ride-Hailing and RideBench, we aim to encourage the community to study these practical challenges in real-world ride-hailing forecasting.

AI.tldr: 发布大规模网约车时序数据集Ride-Hailing及基准RideBench，评估30余种预测方法，揭示外生变量预测价值与现有模型在长期预测上的不足。
AI.motivation: 真实网约车预测需求涉及外生情境、异构区域和长期规划，但现有模型与真实需求存在明显不匹配，缺乏相应数据集与基准。
AI.method: 构建来自滴滴200个区域、四年、半小时粒度的Ride-Hailing数据集，覆盖天气、节假日、大型活动三类外生场景；提出RideBench基准，含周前预测和8周长期预测（最多2688步），评测30余种内生模型、外生感知模型和时序基础模型。
AI.result: 已知未来外生变量在周前预测中带来明显收益，尤其天气、节假日和大型活动场景；但外生感知模型难以捕捉扰动引起的模式变化；长期预测中现有模型无法同时兼顾低逐点误差、准确整体趋势和可靠近期预测。
AI.conclusion: 现有预测模型与真实网约车需求存在错配，需更好利用未来已知外生信息、跨异构区域扩展并支持长期规划，以Ride-Hailing和RideBench推动该方向研究。

title: FlyMark: Training-Free Invisible Watermarking of 3D Gaussian Splatting via a Fruit Fly Connectome
summary: A trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene ships as a portable parameter array that can be copied, pruned, requantized, or repackaged outside its training pipeline, so ownership evidence is most useful when it lives in the released parameters and remains checkable long after the embedding tooling is gone. Existing 3DGS watermarks typically tie embedding or extraction to scene optimization, a learned decoder, or rendered views, so the evidence survives only as long as a second trained artifact does. FlyMark instead writes a keyed message into the parameters a 3DGS file already stores. Its carrier directions are derived from the photoreceptors of a published connectome, a citable versioned artifact that fixes the geometry exhaustively and leaves nothing to tune per scene. A virtual observer reads cone-wise apparent luminance along a scene-normalized orbit from stored centers, colors, and opacities; a keyed dithered quantization-index-modulation code replicates each message bit across these observations; and one sparse bounded least-squares solve realizes the targets through achromatic shifts of existing degree-zero colors under a hard per-channel linear-RGB bound. All geometry and higher-order appearance parameters are preserved bit-identically, and extraction needs only cone queries, rounding, and majority voting. Under a model-domain threat model on synthetic and real scenes, FlyMark attains high clean bit accuracy and visual fidelity while cleanly separating matched from wrong keys.

AI.tldr: FlyMark 提出一种无需训练解码器的 3DGS 水印方法，将密钥消息直接写入文件中已有的参数，提取仅需锥体查询、取整与多数投票。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 场景作为可移植参数数组会被复制、剪枝、重量化或重新打包，现有水印依赖场景优化、学习解码器或渲染视图，导致证据存活依赖第二个训练产物；需要让证据长期存于已发布参数中并在嵌入工具消失后仍可检查。
AI.method: 载体方向来自已发表连接组的感光细胞，几何固定且可引用、无需逐场景调参；虚拟观察者沿场景归一化轨道由存储的中心、颜色和不透明度读取锥体表观亮度；使用密钥抖动量化索引调制码将每个消息比特复制到观测；通过仅对已有零阶颜色做消色差偏移的稀疏有界最小二乘求解实现目标，受逐通道线性 RGB 硬界约束。
AI.result: 所有几何与高阶外观参数保持比特级不变；提取只需锥体查询、取整和多数投票。在模型域威胁模型下，于合成与真实场景中达到高干净比特准确率和视觉保真度，并能清晰区分匹配密钥与错误密钥。
AI.conclusion: FlyMark 将所有权证据扎根于已发布 3DGS 参数本身，避免依赖第二个训练产物，实现可长期检查、参数保留且无需学习解码器的水印方案。

title: Not Every Change Is Necessary: Recoverable Drift in Large Language Model Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning in large language models aims to remove unwanted knowledge while preserving the model's remaining capabilities. Although existing methods use retention objectives or restrict where edits occur, achieving the desired forgetting level can still leave collateral changes that impair non-target behavior. Our recovery comparisons suggest that some of these changes can be reversed while preserving observed forgetting performance. In this work, we present Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U), a framework that combines targeted forgetting with the recovery of non-target capabilities. PTP-U first applies local analytic edits to weaken target knowledge associations, then aligns non-target output distributions with those of the original model to recover capabilities while maintaining fixed forgetting constraints. Both stages serve a common goal: satisfying the forgetting requirements while preserving fluent generation and performance on non-target tasks. Across three benchmarks, PTP-U achieves the strongest forgetting-retention trade-off among evaluated methods, reaching 81.22%-91.03% forgetting while preserving 94.20% non-target utility on average. At matched forgetting, PTP-U consistently retains higher non-target utility.

AI.tldr: PTP-U框架通过“先编辑后投影”两阶段实现LLM遗忘，在满足遗忘约束的同时恢复非目标能力，实现最优遗忘-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法虽然使用保留目标或限制编辑位置，但在达到遗忘目标时仍会产生损害非目标行为的附带变化。研究发现这些变化中部分可在保持遗忘效果的前提下被逆转。
AI.method: 提出Propose-Then-Project Unlearning（PTP-U）：先对目标知识关联进行局部解析编辑以削弱它，再将非目标输出分布与原模型对齐以恢复能力，同时保持固定的遗忘约束。
AI.result: 在三个基准上取得最优遗忘-保留权衡，遗忘率81.22%-91.03%，平均保留94.20%非目标效用；在相同遗忘水平下始终保有更高非目标效用。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段共同服务于在满足遗忘要求的同时保持流畅生成与非目标任务性能，验证了恢复非目标能力的有效性。

title: Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for Expertise-Adaptive Qualitative Interviews Using Local LLMs
comment: Accepted to be part of the book titled: AI in Education : Pedagogy, Ethics, and Society which will be published by Springer Nature in the Book series: Transactions on Computational Science and Computational Intelligence
summary: Automated interviewers and conversational agents are increasingly used in research, recruitment, customer service, and education. However, many existing systems rely on fixed question sequences and provide limited context-based personalization without considering participants' knowledge, which can lead to repetitive or irrelevant follow-up questions. Therefore, there is a need for an adaptive interviewing system that can adjust question depth while maintaining conversational continuity and semantic progression. To address this, an Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture is presented using a locally hosted Large Language Model (LLM), with the interview continuously adapted throughout the entire conversation based on the participant's responses and evolving context. The interviewer profiles participants' expertise in real time to generate knowledge-appropriate questions, well-articulated responses, and smooth transition messages that support conversational continuity. A five-module prompt-driven architecture and persistent interview-state record support these functions. The interviewer was evaluated with 246 participants. Expertise Profiling module (M3) showed 78.9% exact agreement with independently reported participant expertise, with a weighted Cohen's K of 0.80. Generate Iterative Questions module (M4) showed a strong expertise-complexity association (p=.79, p<.001), and participants reported high relevance (mean 4.41), engagement (mean 4.32), and satisfaction (mean 4.38), providing evidence that the architecture's adaptive components operated consistently with their intended functions while participants reported a positive interview experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于本地大语言模型的"证据可追溯动态访谈架构"，通过五模块提示驱动设计与持久化访谈状态，实现实时专业知识画像和自适应提问，在246名参与者中验证了其一致性与良好体验。
AI.motivation: 现有自动访谈与对话系统多依赖固定问题序列，缺乏基于参与者知识与上下文的个性化能力，导致追问重复或不相关，亟需能在保持对话连贯性与语义推进的同时动态调整问题深度的自适应访谈系统。
AI.method: 采用本地部署的大语言模型构建证据可追溯动态访谈架构，基于参与者回答与演化上下文在整段对话中持续调整访谈；架构由五个提示驱动模块及持久化访谈状态记录组成，其中M3负责实时专业知识画像，M4负责生成迭代性问题、得体的回应与平滑过渡消息。共246名参与者参与评估。
AI.result: 专业知识画像模块(M3)与参与者独立报告的专业水平精确一致率为78.9%，加权Cohen's K为0.80；迭代问题生成模块(M4)显示专业知识与问题复杂度强关联（ρ=.79, p<.001）；参与者对相关性(均值4.41)、参与度(4.32)和满意度(4.38)评分均较高。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该架构的自适应组件按预期功能稳定运行，且参与者对访谈体验评价积极，验证了证据可追溯动态访谈架构在自适应访谈中的可行性与有效性。

title: CARE: A Lightweight Plug-in Gated Correction and Uncertainty-aware Module for Long-term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate long-horizon forecasting is critical to electricity load scheduling and traffic flow management, and to financial risk control. Existing deterministic backbones output a single trajectory, masking heterogeneous prediction difficulty across horizons and channels and providing no localized reliability signal. We present CARE (Corrective branch with Aligned context and Relative-error Estimation), a lightweight plug-in that enhances any deterministic forecaster without architectural redesign. Operating in parallel with the base model, CARE resamples historical context to match the forecast horizon, learns residual correction patterns from this aligned history, and applies scale-aware bounded updates modulated by per-coordinate sigmoid risk gates. A multi-objective loss jointly optimizes forecast accuracy, residual tracking, risk alignment, and base-model anchoring. Across eight benchmarks with three representative backbones, CARE improves accuracy with marginal parameter and latency overhead. Its risk gates reliably identify high-error regions: on Weather, the highest-gate tertile exhibits nearly four times the error of the lowest-gate tertile, offering planners an interpretable per-step trust signal. Code is available at https://github.com/CG-BNYC/CARE.

AI.tldr: CARE是一个轻量级插件，通过校正分支、对齐上下文和相对误差估计增强任意确定性预测器，在多变量长时程预测中提升精度并输出可解释的逐坐标风险信号。
AI.motivation: 现有多变量长时程确定性预测模型只输出单一轨迹，掩盖了不同时程与通道间的预测难度差异，且无法提供局部可靠性信号，难以支持电力调度、交通管理、金融风控等需要可信度的决策场景。
AI.method: CARE与基础模型并行运行：重采样历史上下文以匹配预测时程，从对齐历史中学习残差校正模式，并通过逐坐标sigmoid风险门控施加尺度感知的有界更新；采用多目标损失联合优化预测精度、残差追踪、风险对齐和基础模型锚定。
AI.result: 在八个基准和三个代表性骨干模型上，CARE以极小的参数与延迟开销提升精度；风险门控可可靠识别高误差区域，Weather数据集上最高门控三分位误差约为最低三分位的四倍。
AI.conclusion: CARE是一种无需重构架构的通用轻量插件，兼顾精度提升与可解释的逐步信任信号，适合规划类应用。

title: Rethinking Contrastive Loss in CLIP Post-training: A Complementary Framework with Frozen Text Encoder
summary: CLIP serves as a foundational vision-language model and the de facto vision encoder for downstream VLMs such as LLaVA. Post-training offers a lightweight route to refine CLIP, but recent work argues that the standard contrastive loss is unsuitable for post-training due to catastrophic forgetting under small batches, motivating designs that abandon the contrastive objective in favor of distillation. We revisit this premise and find that, for the InfoNCE objective, the reported forgetting is driven primarily not by insufficient negatives but by an inappropriate magnitude of the contrastive temperature $τ$: with $τ$ set sufficiently small, contrastive post-training improves rather than degrades the pretrained CLIP, which we explain through the temperature dependence of the InfoNCE gradient. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ComCLIP}, a lightweight single-epoch post-training recipe that freezes CLIP's text encoder---so the refined vision encoder is a drop-in replacement with unchanged architecture and inference cost---and trains the vision encoder with a properly-tempered contrastive loss, an MSE anchoring loss against the original CLIP, and a relational distillation loss from DINOv2. Over multiple seeds, ComCLIP matches the self-distillation baseline CLIP-Refine on zero-shot classification while significantly improving the transferability of visual features, measured by linear probing ($48.99$ vs.\ $42.28$ on ViT-B/16), and on ViT-L/14 it also improves MMVP over CLIP-Refine ($24.20$ vs.\ $19.01$); CLIP-Refine remains stronger on image-text retrieval. Used as a drop-in vision encoder for LLaVA-1.5-7B without re-aligning the projector or LLM, ComCLIP yields no net change across $8$ VLM benchmarks, i.e., the refinement does not break downstream compatibility. Code and models are available at https://github.com/showstarpro/ComCLIP.git.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了"对比损失不适合CLIP后训练"的观点，发现遗忘主要源于温度τ设置不当，并提出ComCLIP单轮后训练方案。
AI.motivation: 近期工作认为标准对比损失在小批量下会导致灾难性遗忘，故转向蒸馏。作者重新审视这一前提，探究遗忘的真正原因。
AI.method: ComCLIP冻结文本编码器，仅训练视觉编码器，结合适当温度τ的对比损失、对原始CLIP的MSE锚定损失，以及来自DINOv2的关系蒸馏损失。
AI.result: 零样本分类匹配CLIP-Refine，线性探测显著提升（ViT-B/16: 48.99 vs 42.28），ViT-L/14上MMVP提升（24.20 vs 19.01），但检索较弱。作为LLaVA-1.5-7B编码器时8个基准无净变化。
AI.conclusion: 对比损失后训练遗忘的根源在于温度τ过大而非负样本不足，适温的对比后训练可提升CLIP且保持下游兼容性。

title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories. To address these limitations, we propose QGMem, a novel memory construction and activation framework motivated by human memory, in which experience is organized into events and query-relevant events are modeled by graph as working memory. QGMem converts long dialogue histories into event-indexed atomic memory units that preserve individual experiences and consolidates related units into dynamic memory traces that retain state trajectories and current states. When a query arrives, hybrid memory retrieval gathers complementary candidate memories, and query-aware reranking activates the most relevant units as a compact working memory. To expose relational dependencies in the working memory and support conflict-aware reasoning, QGMem organizes the working memory as a local graph, which is then encoded as a graph token and provided to the LLM together with the textual working memory to improve evidence utilization during answer generation. Experiments across six benchmarks validate the framework and show consistent gains in retrieval, multi-hop evidence composition, conflict resolution, and ultra-long dialogue reasoning with compact contexts and moderate inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出QGMem记忆框架，将对话历史组织为事件索引的原子单元并整合为动态记忆痕迹，查询时通过混合检索与查询感知重排激活紧凑工作记忆，并以局部图编码为图token增强LLM推理，在六个基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统分两类：扁平结构记忆轻量但事件关系与状态更新隐式；图结构记忆显式建模但构建成本高且长历史中引入无关关系。两者均不足，需兼顾轻量与关系建模。
AI.method: 受人类记忆启发，QGMem将长对话转为事件索引的原子记忆单元，保留个体经验并整合为动态记忆痕迹（含状态轨迹与当前状态）；查询时混合检索收集候选，查询感知重排激活最相关单元为紧凑工作记忆；再将工作记忆组织为局部图，编码为图token与文本工作记忆一起输入LLM。
AI.result: 在六个基准上验证，检索、多跳证据组合、冲突消解和超长对话推理均有一致提升，且上下文紧凑、推理成本适中。
AI.conclusion: QGMem通过事件化记忆、混合检索与图化工作记忆，有效平衡了记忆的结构性与效率，提升了持久个性化对话代理的长历史推理能力。

title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
summary: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent's failure composition: labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a self-evolving harness loop lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44; for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% while content failures are left for the weights. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model. The loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where the gain lives in what the model sees and adapters do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition to choose between harness and weights, then read what the accepted edits changed to decide which gains to train in. Scores are four-rollout means against fresh anchors, same-night except where marked, across eight models from six families and two benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 通过失败成分诊断决定让"自进化框架"还是"权重训练"来提升长时程LLM智能体能力的方法与验证。
AI.motivation: 提升长时程LLM智能体可循两条路径：演化冻结模型外围的harness，或训练模型权重。本文旨在厘清到底该用哪个杠杆，以及训练后的模型能保留哪些增益。
AI.method: 提出以"首个触发信号"标注失败轨迹，将失败分为过程失败（调用受阻、循环、步数超限）与内容失败（交付的规划质量差）。先运行自进化harness循环，再将其与基础/训练权重交叉组合，用LoRA在演化轨迹上训练适配器，并设答案打乱的安慰剂适配器对照。
AI.result: DeepPlanning上，自进化harness将Qwen3.5-4B从0.16提到0.30、9B从0.32到0.44；4B交付率55%→90%。LoRA适配器在原始harness下两尺寸均+0.13；4B上与harness叠加使分数翻倍以上，9B上适配器单独即匹配完整演化线，内容失败从1/4降至1/20。安慰剂适配器低于基础模型。WebArena-Lite迁移+0.09（117个未见任务），增益源于模型所见，适配器无额外贡献。
AI.conclusion: 得出"先诊断再干预"的两步法则：读失败成分以选择harness或权重，再读已被接受的编辑改变了什么以决定训练哪些增益。结论基于8个模型、6个家族、2个基准的四次采样均值验证。

title: PIVOT: Perplexity-Informed KD-to-RL Transition Scheduling for Vertical-Domain Few-Shot Distillation
summary: Vertical-domain few-shot classification remains challenging for small language models, as limited supervision makes it difficult to acquire domain-specific decision knowledge. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) can improve teacher-guided adaptation by supervising student-generated rollouts, while GRPO-based reinforcement learning can further refine downstream predictions. However, existing KD-to-RL pipelines typically rely on globally fixed transition schedules, ignoring that different samples may require different amounts of teacher-guided acquisition before reward-driven refinement. We propose PIVOT (Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization), a dynamic transition framework that routes samples between OPD and GRPO according to teacher-evaluated sequence perplexity. PIVOT moves low-perplexity samples to GRPO for reward-driven refinement while keeping high-perplexity samples under OPD for continued domain knowledge acquisition. Experiments on Banking77 and HWU64 show that PIVOT consistently outperforms continued OPD and globally synchronized OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO baselines under the same number of post-warm-up student optimization steps, achieving stronger downstream performance and more stable training dynamics.

AI.tldr: PIVOT提出一种基于困惑度的动态转换框架，在OPD与GRPO之间按样本路由，提升垂直领域小模型少样本分类性能。
AI.motivation: 垂直领域少样本分类对小型语言模型困难，监督有限难以获取领域决策知识。现有KD-to-RL流程采用全局固定转换进度，忽视不同样本所需教师引导量差异。
AI.method: PIVOT（Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization），依据教师评估的序列困惑度在样本间动态路由：低困惑度样本转至GRPO进行奖励驱动精炼，高困惑度样本保留在OPD继续获取领域知识。
AI.result: 在Banking77与HWU64上，相同预热后学生优化步数下，PIVOT持续优于持续OPD及全局同步OPD→GRPO基线，下游性能更强、训练动态更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 按样本困惑度动态调整教师引导与强化学习转换，优于全局固定调度，能有效提升垂直领域少样本分类。

title: CRISP: Fixing Flying Pixels in Latent LiDAR Generation via Diffusion Decoding
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 41 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://andrea25512.github.io/CRISP/
summary: Latent LiDAR pipelines suffer from flying pixels: convolutional VAEs blur sharp radial depth discontinuities, yielding edge depths that back-project to points floating between surfaces. We identify this as a major, directly correctable decoder bottleneck and introduce CRISP: a pixel-space diffusion decoder with a backbone-agnostic latent adapter, DiT-based denoiser, and support mask predictor. CRISP replaces video-VAE and LiDAR-native decoders alike while keeping the encoder and latent generator fixed. Across KITTI-360, SemanticKITTI, and nuScenes, replacing only the decoder reduces FSVD/FPVD by 50.5% on average across frozen backbones; for generic video VAEs, the reductions reach 71%/74%. On the LiDAR-native LiDM backbone, FRID drops by 71%, with the largest gains at depth discontinuities. In a pretrained LiDM world model, the same zero-shot replacement improves FSVD by 15.5%, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.

AI.tldr: 提出CRISP，一种像素空间扩散解码器，解决潜在LiDAR管线中因卷积VAE模糊导致的flying pixels问题，可即插即用地替换各类解码器。
AI.motivation: 潜在LiDAR管线中，卷积VAE会模糊尖锐的径向深度不连续处，产生"flying pixels"（边缘深度反投影后悬浮于表面之间的点）。作者将其识别为解码器的主要且可直接修正的瓶颈。
AI.method: CRISP由三部分组成：主干无关的潜在适配器、基于DiT的去噪器、以及支撑掩码预测器。它保持编码器和潜在生成器不变，仅替换解码器，可替代视频VAE和LiDAR原生解码器。
AI.result: 在KITTI-360、SemanticKITTI、nuScenes上，仅替换解码器使FSVD/FPVD平均降低50.5%；对通用视频VAE降幅达71%/74%；在LiDM主干上FRID降低71%，深度不连续处增益最大；零样本替换预训练LiDM世界模型使FSVD改善15.5%。
AI.conclusion: 解码器是潜在LiDAR管线的关键可修正瓶颈，CRISP作为即插即用模块显著减少flying pixels并缩小仿真到现实的差距。

title: When History Helps and Hurts: Selective History Use across Multimodal Turns
summary: Reliable multimodal interaction depends on selective use of conversational history: an earlier question may remain relevant while its previous answer is outdated, whereas a current request may depend on historical evidence despite conflicting new observations. Existing multi-turn evaluations rarely separate these history-use demands from underlying question difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce ReTurn, a benchmark of 7,000 base tasks spanning visual and audio evidence for evaluating selective history use. For task-carrying history, Reconfirm/Reground require applying a historical question to current media while varying historical agreement; for evidence-carrying history, Retrieve/Rebind require answering a current question using historical media while varying current-media competition. Each pair preserves the target question, media, and answer. Tasks support open-ended and multiple-choice evaluation, with matched single-turn counterparts serving as answerability references. Across 13 omni-modal, vision-language, and audio-language models, median model-level open-ended accuracy falls from 93.7% with direct input to 72.3% in conversation. Behavioral probes show that high question recall can coexist with weaker task application, while competing media can redirect answers away from historical targets. Supervised adaptation yields only partial gains. ReTurn provides a controlled framework for assessing whether multimodal models select and use the historical information required by each request.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReTurn基准（7000个基础任务，覆盖视觉与音频），用于评估多模态模型对对话历史的"选择性使用"能力；结果显示模型从单轮93.7%准确率下降至多轮72.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮评估难以将"历史使用需求"与"问题本身的难度"分离，缺少对选择性利用对话历史的受控评测。
AI.method: 构建ReTurn基准，含任务承载型历史（Reconfirm/Reground：将历史问题应用于当前媒体，并变化历史一致性）与证据承载型历史（Retrieve/Rebind：用历史媒体回答当前问题，并变化当前媒体竞争）；每组保持目标问题、媒体和答案不变，支持开放与选择题评测，并配单轮对照。
AI.result: 13个全模态/视觉语言/音频语言模型中，中位开放准确率从直接输入的93.7%降至对话中的72.3%；行为探针显示高问题回忆率与较弱任务应用可共存，竞争媒体可使答案偏离历史目标；监督微调仅带来部分提升。
AI.conclusion: ReTurn为评估多模态模型能否选择并使用每次请求所需历史信息提供了受控框架。

title: Lamarck's Driving School: Discovering Autonomous Driving Training Strategies through Evolutionary Competition
summary: Autonomous driving capabilities depend strongly on the distribution of scenarios encountered during training. Existing methods commonly construct or dynamically adapt training scenario distributions using surrogate criteria such as realism, difficulty, or risk. However, these predefined surrogates may misrepresent training value, leading to inefficient use of training resources. To address this limitation, we propose a Lamarckian evolutionary framework that replaces surrogate-based guidance with competition among candidate distributions. We formulate training strategy discovery as a multi-stage bilevel optimization problem and use Lamarckian evolution algorithm to approximate its solution. At the outer level, Darwinian crossover, mutation, and selection explore the scenario distribution space; at the inner level, policy learning acquires new capabilities, and Lamarckian inheritance transfers them to subsequent stages, allowing scenario distributions and policy capabilities to co-evolve. The resulting evolutionary trajectories reveal recurring stage-wise regularities among high-value distributions, characterized by capability accumulation through stage-wise challenge rotation. We further distill these regularities into a lightweight, reusable Lamarckian Training Strategy. Experiments show that, compared with the baseline, the complete framework reduces performance loss by up to 25.07%, while the lightweight strategy still achieves a 19.13% reduction. These results demonstrate that evolutionary competition can both discover effective training strategies and reveal reusable stage-wise patterns in how the value of training distributions changes with policy capability. Code is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出Lamarckian进化框架，用候选分布间的竞争取代代理指标来发现自动驾驶训练策略，实现场景分布与策略能力协同进化。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶能力依赖训练场景分布，但现有方法用真实性、难度或风险等预设代理指标构建/调整分布，这些代理可能无法真实反映训练价值，导致训练资源利用低效。
AI.method: 将训练策略发现建模为多阶段双层优化问题，用Lamarckian进化算法近似求解：外层用Darwinian交叉、变异、选择探索场景分布空间；内层进行策略学习获取新能力，并通过Lamarckian继承传递到后续阶段，使分布与策略能力协同进化。进一步将进化轨迹中的规律蒸馏为轻量可复用的Lamarckian Training Strategy。
AI.result: 相比基线，完整框架性能损失最多降低25.07%，轻量策略仍降低19.13%。进化轨迹显示高价值分布存在阶段性规律：通过阶段式挑战轮换实现能力积累。
AI.conclusion: 进化竞争既能发现有效训练策略，也能揭示训练分布价值随策略能力变化而变化的可复用阶段性模式。

title: SACQ: Structured Decoding with Memory-Conditioned Refinement for Long-Horizon Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) models predominantly employ patch-based encoders terminated by a flatten readout head that maps the entire encoded historical memory to all future steps through a single shared projection. This implicit coupling of future positions obscures position-specific historical-to-future alignment and amplifies sensitivity to corrupted inputs and extreme supervision noise. We present SACQ, a plug-in structured prediction head that replaces flatten readout while keeping the encoder unchanged. SACQ adopts a two-stage decoding pipeline: it first establishes a coarse patch-grid forecast scaffold, then refines each future position through cross-attention over historical memory and merges the attention-derived correction with the coarse scaffold via a learned per-patch gate. To stabilize optimization under long horizons and noisy labels, we further propose a batch-adaptive scaled log-cosh loss that automatically calibrates robustness to the current residual scale, suppressing outlier gradients while preserving MSE-like sensitivity for typical errors. SACQ attains top-tier test MSE/MAE across PatchTST, DLinear, and patch-Mamba backbones with only modest incremental overhead in parameters and latency. Under inference-time input corruption and training-set label-noise stress tests, SACQ substantially outperforms flatten readouts, with ablation studies validating each architectural component.

AI.tldr: 提出SACQ,一种即插即用的结构化预测头,替代flatten读出,并配合批自适应scaled log-cosh损失,在多个LTSF骨干上取得领先精度并增强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LTSF模型多用patch编码器加flatten读出,共享投影将历史记忆一次性映射到所有未来步,隐式耦合了未来位置,使位置特定的历史-未来对齐不清晰,且对输入损坏和极端监督噪声敏感。
AI.method: SACQ为两阶段解码:先用粗patch网格构建预测脚手架,再通过cross-attention对历史记忆逐位置细化,并用学习的per-patch gate将注意力修正与粗脚手架融合。同时提出batch-adaptive scaled log-cosh损失,按当前残差尺度自适应校准鲁棒性,抑制异常梯度,兼顾MSE式敏感性。
AI.result: 在PatchTST、DLinear和patch-Mamba骨干上,SACQ取得顶尖测试MSE/MAE,参数和延迟开销仅小幅增加。在推理时输入损坏和训练集标签噪声压力测试下,显著优于flatten读出;消融研究验证了各架构组件的作用。
AI.conclusion: SACQ作为即插即用模块可无改动编码器地提升LTSF精度与鲁棒性,结构化两阶段解码与自适应损失是关键。

title: FastJEV: Understanding Redundancy for Compact JEV Inference
summary: JEV models make multimodal decisions by directly scoring candidates. Although the common context is encoded once, candidate evaluation can still repeat matching token histories, duplicate inference states, and execute the full backbone. In this paper, we study these sources of redundancy and present FastJEV for compact candidate evaluation. We jointly organize history reuse and state storage, since sharing computation requires preserving states for later branches. We first introduce shared context anchoring to reuse recurrent initial states and omit unused final recurrent caches. We extend this reuse through candidate prefix sharing, retaining the intermediate states needed by subsequent branches. To further reduce the depth of these paths, we apply decision guided pruning based on relative score changes measured on a small unlabeled set. Our method retains full context encoding and all candidates without additional training. We evaluate FastJEV across three OmniJev model sizes on five public benchmarks and reconstructed LIBERO-10 offline questions. At the selected pruning budgets, the complete method reduces candidate depth by 43.75% to 45.83%, while retaining 93.66% to 97.52% of the original task scores on average across the six evaluation sets. Through controlled experiments, we show how candidate overlap and branching structure affect the execution cost of history reuse. In our implementation, candidate prefix sharing can reduce repeated computation while increasing latency. These findings motivate designing sharing granularity and execution schedules together for efficient JEV inference.

AI.tldr: FastJEV通过共享上下文锚定、候选前缀共享与决策引导剪枝，减少JEV候选评估中的冗余计算，在几乎不损失任务分数的情况下降低候选深度约44%。
AI.motivation: JEV模型通过直接为候选打分做多模态决策，虽然共享上下文只编码一次，但候选评估仍会重复匹配token历史、复制推理状态并执行完整骨干网络，造成大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 方法联合组织历史重用与状态存储：1）共享上下文锚定，重用循环初始状态并省略未使用的最终循环缓存；2）候选前缀共享，保留后续分支所需的中间状态；3）基于小型无标签集上相对分数变化的决策引导剪枝，进一步降低路径深度。全程无需额外训练，保留完整上下文编码与所有候选。
AI.result: 在三种OmniJev模型规模和五个公开基准及重建的LIBERO-10离线问题上评估。在选定剪枝预算下，完整方法将候选深度降低43.75%–45.83%，同时在六个评估集上平均保留93.66%–97.52%的原始任务分数。受控实验显示候选重叠与分支结构影响历史重用的执行成本；候选前缀共享可减少重复计算但会增加延迟。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明JEV推理效率应通过联合设计共享粒度与执行调度来实现，而非单独优化计算共享。

title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.

AI.tldr: MiMo-V2.6系列通过扩展强化学习算力（更大批量、更多样环境、更强评分算力）提升全模态模型智能，并开源训练动态、环境和框架。
AI.motivation: 强化学习是推动大型基础模型自我提升的核心范式，作者希望沿算力扩展方向推进模型智能前沿。
AI.method: RL前进行多模态中期训练并提供探索空间；基于预训练hybrid-SWA架构构建基础设施。RL算力沿三维扩展：异步训练大批量（每步1568样本、2.7-3.7B token、上下文达1M）、跨代码/通用/视觉/网络域的多环境与agent harness、groupwise agentic grading评分算力。为稳定训练冻结MoE路由并多层防御奖励攻击，构建混合任务agentic RL基础设施。
AI.result: 实现面向长时任务的更准确奖励信号，引导模型产生更短、更省token的解，并在大规模下保持训练稳定。
AI.conclusion: MiMo-V2.6系列展示扩展RL算力可提升模型智能，并开源以促进复现与后续研究。

title: Constrained Command-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Strategy Selection in Real-Time Strategy Games
summary: Deep reinforcement learning agents reach strong performance in real-time strategy games but can be brittle against opponents outside their training distribution. Separating strategic command selection from learned unit control allows different strategies to be selected for different opponents while reusing the same execution policy. This requires an executor that can follow different commands and measurable criteria for assessing whether it does so. We introduce a constrained command-conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy, the executor, for MicroRTS, a real-time strategy environment. Discrete commands specify strategic objectives and behavioral requirements for economy, army composition, military posture, and worker policy over multiple environment steps; the executor determines the unit-level actions used to fulfill them. A Thompson-sampling bandit acts as the strategist, selecting command tuples from an estimate of the opponent's strategy built from in-game observations rather than opponent identity. In a controlled comparison with a flat PPO baseline trained with the same architecture, budget, curriculum and self-play league, the strategist-executor system wins significantly more often against three of the four strongest opponents on a training map, including the two strongest held-out ones (0.55 to 0.97 and 0.01 to 0.34), with no significant difference against the others.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个战略-执行分离的框架：用约束的命令条件PPO作为执行器，配合Thompson采样bandit作为战略选择器，在MicroRTS中提升了对训练分布外对手的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在实时策略游戏中表现优异，但面对训练分布之外的对手时表现脆弱。将战略命令选择与单元控制分离可让不同对手选用不同策略并复用同一执行策略，但这需要能遵循不同命令的执行器以及可量化的评估标准。
AI.method: 在MicroRTS环境中引入约束的命令条件PPO策略作为执行器。离散命令指定经济、军队构成、军事姿态和工人政策等战略目标与行为要求，跨越多个环境步；执行器决定实现这些目标的单元级动作。Thompson采样bandit作为战略家，基于从游戏内观测估计的对手策略（而非对手身份）选择命令元组。与相同架构、预算、课程和自对弈联盟训练的扁平PPO基线进行受控比较。
AI.result: 在训练地图上对四个最强对手中的三个显著获胜更多，包括两个最强的留出对手（胜率从0.55提升到0.97，从0.01提升到0.34），对其他对手无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 战略-执行分离架构能有效提升智能体对分布外对手的鲁棒性和胜率，命令条件执行器可复用同一执行策略配合不同战略选择。

title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
summary: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored.
