Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

AI.tldr: FateMultiplicity提出无标签Rashomon集框架衡量单细胞轨迹推断中的命运多重性；多重性大且取决于模型空间多样性，但基于无标签Rashomon集的逐细胞命运认证并未提升可靠性。
AI.motivation: 单细胞轨迹推断中，多个拟合效果相当的模型配置可能给出冲突的细胞命运分配，需要一种无需谱系标签的方法来量化这种多重性并评估其可认证性。
AI.method: 构造统计上可接受的无标签Rashomon模型集：用交叉拟合的留出基因上的模型偏差、经随机种子变异校准的非劣性检验筛选配置；并定义逐细胞认证命运margin FM，检验其是否优于拟合模型自身margin。
AI.result: 多重性规模大且由模型空间多样性主导（第二算法12个配置暴露20.0%细胞，而第一算法24个配置仅3.8%）。FM认证未改善可靠性：模拟真值下FM判别错误分配的AUC仅0.682，低于基线自身margin的0.965（p=0.003）和种子离散基线的0.854；信息量由集广度而非基数决定。两项构造有效：margin-erosion ratio区分真假分支点（AUC 0.890，未在真实数据测试），以及克隆观察命运中未认证细胞比认证细胞与克隆结局不一致率高16.4个百分点（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹推断中的多重性值得测量与报告，但基于无标签Rashomon集的逐细胞认证并非获得更可靠命运判断的途径；仅margin-erosion ratio和克隆一致性两项构造经过验证。

title: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics. Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoKnow，一种无回放的持续AI生成图像检测框架，将检测建模为取证知识演化，通过共享取证基、隔离残差专家和解析增量路由器实现跨生成器泛化与长期持续适应。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器多在固定生成器域上训练，新生成模型不断出现导致维护困难。持续适应面临挑战：回放历史生成图像代价高，而用有限当前域数据更新共享参数会覆盖既有取证知识。
AI.method: EvoKnow不依赖回放：保留从基础域学到的共享取证基；增量添加隔离的残差专家以捕获互补的生成器相关证据；通过Analytical Incremental Router (AIR)检索专家，AIR利用当前阶段生成图像与累积充分统计量以闭式解更新。
AI.result: 展现有效的跨生成器泛化、少样本扩展和长期持续适应能力。每个新生成器仅用十张图像时，在非基础GenImage生成器上达96.70%平均准确率，Chameleon上达94.48%（无目标基准适应）。严格无回放持续学习协议下，达SOTA：96.32%平均阶段准确率，平均遗忘仅4.32%。
AI.conclusion: EvoKnow以无回放方式有效缓解持续适应中的灾难性遗忘，实现跨生成器泛化与长期持续检测，性能领先。

title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
summary: Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.

AI.tldr: Jev作为一种"系统1"式专用决策模型，在知识与常识类多选基准上可与前沿LLM竞争，但在数学文字题上明显落后。
AI.motivation: 探究专用决策模型（返回选项而非生成文本）与通用大语言模型的对比表现，明确其适用边界。
AI.method: 在13个多选基准（覆盖知识、推理、多语言理解）上评估Jev，并与19个LLM（前沿、代表、小型三档）比较。
AI.result: 在知识与常识基准上与前沿LLM相当，MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge取得最佳；除数学外超越多数代表模型及所有小型模型；但MathQA比前沿中位数低17.7分，低于全部19个LLM。
AI.conclusion: 专用决策模型可在主要依赖知识的决策上匹配通用LLM，但无法胜任需多步计算的决策任务。

title: A 3D Characterization Framework for Intelligent Sequential Decision Making
summary: Puzzles are widely used to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) systems for sequential decision making, yet approaches originating from different paradigms are rarely compared under unified conditions. To address this gap, we introduce a three-dimensional characterization framework that enables the analysts of AI methods by 1) projecting them to the Markov decision process (MDP) sequential decision making formalism, 2) degree of autonomy through human prior ranking of their designs and, 3) skill and computational cost. Using this framework, we analyze how representative graph-based, reinforcement learning, and large language model (LLM)-based approaches differ in their design choices and performance characteristics, instantiated respectively by Neurosolver, forward-backward reinforcement learning (FBRL), and automated thought-of-search (AutoToS), including a double-agent extension of thought-of-search (DA-ToS). The analysis relies on the Tower of Hanoi puzzle that provides a controlled benchmark with well-defined rules and scalable complexity, enabling consistent comparison across increasing problem sizes. The 3D characterization reveals that LLM-based methods, due to their weakly constrained action-space design, shift complexity from architecture to inference-time verification, leading to substantially higher memory and runtime costs than Neurosolver and FBRL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个三维刻画框架，将图搜索、强化学习与LLM方法统一投影到MDP形式化下进行比较，并用汉诺塔基准分析其设计选择与性能特征。
AI.motivation: AI解谜方法来自不同范式，却很少在统一条件下比较，缺乏公正对照的分析手段。
AI.method: 构建三维刻画框架：1）将方法投影到MDP序贯决策形式化；2）通过人工先验对其设计排序评估自主程度；3）评估技能与计算成本。用该框架分析Neurosolver（图方法）、FBRL（强化学习）、AutoToS及DA-ToS（LLM方法），在规则明确、复杂度可扩展的汉诺塔上进行一致比较。
AI.result: LLM类方法因动作空间约束弱，将复杂度从架构转移到推理时验证，导致内存和运行时间成本显著高于Neurosolver和FBRL。
AI.conclusion: 三维刻画框架实现了跨范式的统一比较，揭示了LLM方法在解谜任务上的成本代价与设计权衡。

title: Do Flatter Minima Drive Better Generalization? An Algorithmic Separation in Grokking
summary: Flat loss landscapes have long been linked to better generalization in neural networks. However, its role as a causal mechanism for generalization is less established. Grokking provides an unique testbed to understand this distinction: models are prone to fit observed data using non-generalizing structure and remain in that regime for prolonged periods, transitioning to generalization only under particular training conditions. In this work, we study whether flat loss landscapes can act as a driving mechanism in this transition. While recent work has argued for flatness as a necessary geometric condition for this transition, we find that biasing training toward flatter solutions using sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) is insufficient to reliably induce this transition, despite producing flatter solutions. However, when SAM is paired with mechanisms that drive generalization such as weight decay, an interesting property emerges: SAM can accelerate the transition to generalizing solutions by up to 4x at the epoch-level. We theoretically untangle this relationship between SAM and weight decay using a minimal interpolating two-layer ReLU model with both memorizing and generalizing solutions. We show that even in this simple setup, flatness alone cannot distinguish a memorizing solution from a generalizing one, while weight decay favors generalizing solutions. However, under a local stability analysis, there exists a window where a memorizing interpolant is locally stable under gradient descent but unstable under SAM in the low-norm regime, which can explain SAM's ability to accelerate this transition. Overall, our results provide a more interpretable account of the role of flatness in driving generalization, especially in settings where models are vulnerable to minimizing loss through learning non-generalizing structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平坦损失景观是否因果驱动泛化，利用grokking作为测试平台，发现SAM单独不足以诱导泛化转变，但与权重衰减结合可加速转变达4倍。理论分析用两层ReLU模型揭示平坦性无法区分记忆与泛化解，而权重衰减偏好泛化解；SAM在低范数区域可使记忆插值解不稳定。
AI.motivation: 平坦损失景观长期被认为与更好的泛化相关，但其作为泛化因果机制的角色尚不明确。Grokking现象提供了一个理想测试平台：模型倾向于用非泛化结构拟合数据并长期停留，仅在特定训练条件下才转向泛化。作者想探究平坦性是否是这一转变的驱动机制。
AI.method: 使用sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) 将训练偏向更平坦解，并与权重衰减等驱动泛化的机制结合。理论上采用一个最小的两层ReLU插值模型（同时含记忆解和泛化解），进行局部稳定性分析。
AI.result: SAM单独使用不足以致 reliably 诱导泛化转变，尽管产生更平坦的解。SAM与权重衰减结合可在epoch级别将泛化转变加速高达4倍。理论表明平坦性本身无法区分记忆解与泛化解，而权重衰减偏好泛化解；在低范数区存在一个窗口，记忆插值解在梯度下降下局部稳定但在SAM下不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 平坦性在驱动泛化中的作用需要更细致的解释：它并非充分条件，但与权重衰减配合可加速泛化转变。结果提供了关于平坦性在模型易学非泛化结构时作用的更可解释的说法。

title: GroundSight at GroundLM 2026 Shared Tasks: GoldenViewVQA
summary: GoldenViewVQA requires models to jointly answer driving-scene questions and identify the camera view containing the supporting visual evidence, making precise evidence localization as important as answer correctness. We present \textbf{CoVeR-VQA}, a training-free multi-stage verification and correction framework for grounded multi-view VQA. Starting from GPT-5.6 zero-shot predictions, CoVeR-VQA progressively applies view-specific verification with Gemini-3.6-Flash, prior-guided joint verification with Claude-Opus-5, and cross-split group-level verification that exploits semantically filtered question groups from shared multi-view scenes and validation-derived prior knowledge. On the official GoldenViewVQA test set, the four-stage CoVeR-VQA pipeline achieves 84.75\% Joint Accuracy, improving the GPT-5.6 zero-shot baseline by 13.56 percentage points, while reaching 94.92\% Answer Accuracy and 86.44\% View Accuracy. The final submitted run achieves 88.14\% Joint Accuracy after two additional evaluator-informed post-hoc corrections. Our analysis shows that supporting-view localization remains the primary source of residual errors, highlighting the importance of explicit evidence verification for reliable multi-view multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练多阶段验证纠正框架CoVeR-VQA，提升多视图VQA的证据定位和答案准确率。
AI.motivation: GoldenViewVQA要求同时回答驾驶场景问题并定位含证据的相机视图，证据定位与答案正确性同等重要，因此需要显式的证据验证。
AI.method: 免训练多阶段验证纠正框架：从GPT-5.6零样本预测出发，依次进行Gemini-3.6-Flash的视图级验证、Claude-Opus-5的先验引导联合验证，以及利用语义过滤问题组的跨划分组级验证，并辅以后验纠正。
AI.result: 测试集上四阶段流程达84.75%联合准确率（较基线提升13.56个百分点），答案准确率94.92%、视图准确率86.44%；最终提交经两次后验纠正达88.14%。
AI.conclusion: 支持视图定位仍是残余错误的主要来源，凸显显式证据验证对可靠多视图多模态推理的重要性。

title: Examining Social Attribution in LLM Reasoning: A Theory-Guided Probing Methodology
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sociotechnical systems where social attribution, the reasoning process attributing external events to the causes and reasons of agents' social behaviors, plays a critical role. These processes involve judgments of social cause, responsibility, and blame/credit to agents. Although attributional models are well-studied in social psychology and cognition through Attribution Theory, social attribution remains underexplored in AI, particularly LLM social reasoning. This paper provides the first systematic exploration of LLM social attribution. Our work focuses on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs' judgments and their underlying internal mechanisms. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a social attribution benchmark consisting of a Vignette subset based on classic scenarios from attribution theory research and a Reality subset based on real-world social narratives, yielding 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs and 5 basic non-LLM baselines. To further explore the internal mechanisms underlying the LLM judgment process, we develop a probing-based methodology to investigate the latent-space representations of 5 key attribution dimensions and the consistency of their influences on LLM judgments compared to those in human social attribution. Our research findings reveal that current LLMs exhibit measurable but incomplete agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments, and meanwhile, this agreement is positively correlated with model size. Some attribution dimensions are systematically decodable from specific positions in LLM hidden states, and their influences on the final judgment are consistent with those indicated by human Attribution Theory. The dataset and associated code are available at https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统探索LLM的社会归因能力，构建7,639题的归因基准，评估32个LLM，并通过探针方法揭示其内部机制。
AI.motivation: 社会归因（将事件归因于行为主体的原因、责任与责备/功劳）在社会技术系统中至关重要，但LLM的社会推理中该能力研究不足。
AI.method: 基于归因理论构建SAB基准（Vignette经典情景子集+Reality真实社会叙事子集，共7,639题）；评估32个LLM与5个非LLM基线；用探针方法研究5个归因维度的隐空间表征及其对判断的影响一致性。
AI.result: LLM判断与人类责任/责备判断存在可测量但不完全一致，且一致性与模型规模正相关；部分归因维度可从隐藏状态特定位置系统性解码，其影响与人类归因理论一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备初步但有限的社会归因能力，其内部机制部分对齐人类归因理论，为AI社会推理研究提供基准与方法。

title: Intervention anchors and scientific verification in synthetic vascular predictive representations
comment: Technical Note; 18 pages, 8 figures; reproducibility source and data archive included
summary: Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates do not by themselves bind a latent direction to a named intervention. We present a mathematical and synthetic audit motivated by vascular device-vessel suitcordance. Capacity-matched least-squares predictors were exactly equivalent under complete fixed output transforms, whereas an anchor-only observer recovered interpretations only within the span of known perturbation signatures. Six three-dimensional configurations across 64 seeds gave a maximum paired prediction discrepancy of 6.7e-15 but a median untransported edit error of 1.513. Coordinate transport removed that error. Noisy and weak anchors constrained calibration stability, and changing the representation basis required recalibration or verified transport. Across 256 additional fits in dimensions 3-24, prediction equivalence persisted within 4.0e-15. We then evaluated nine deliberate runnable fault classes across 64 seeds. All 576 faulty executions completed, but each violated at least one reconstruction, prediction, delivered-edit or scope contract; all 320 valid control records passed. Repeating a faulty implementation gave exact self-agreement despite error against the separately computed simulator expectation. For one omitted-direction defect, probe coverage followed its analytic law, and rank-aware abstention protected unsupported interpretations. Scalar-noise experiments exposed both missed weak faults and excessive rejection under narrow relative tolerances. These controls provide an executable separation of prediction, semantic support and scientific acceptance. They are synthetic numerical audits, not clinical validation, neural JEPA-Anything replication, agent learning or patient treatment-effect estimation.

AI.tldr: 论文通过数学与合成数值审计，说明完全正交的预测坐标本身并不能把潜在方向绑定到具体干预语义；预测等价并不等于语义支持，需引入坐标变换（transport）、锚点约束和弃权机制来分离预测、语义支持与科学接受。
AI.motivation: 动机源自血管器械-血管适配（vascular device-vessel suitcordance）问题：即使预测器在完全固定的输出变换下等价，也可能无法将潜在方向对应到已命名的干预，因此需要区分"预测正确"与"解释有效"。
AI.method: 采用容量匹配的最小二乘预测器、仅锚点观察者，在64个种子、6组三维配置下测试；对比配对预测差异与未transport的编辑误差；加入噪声/弱锚点、表示基变换、3-24维的256次额外拟合；并评估9类可运行故障（64种子，共576次故障执行）与320条有效对照记录，检验重建、预测、delivered-edit和范围契约；还做标量噪声容差实验。
AI.result: 固定输出变换下预测完全等价，最大配对预测差异仅6.7e-15（高维下4.0e-15），但未transport的中位编辑误差达1.513，坐标transport可消除该误差。576次故障执行全部完成但均违反至少一项契约，320条对照全部通过；重复故障实现自身完全一致，却与独立模拟器期望不符。省略方向缺陷的探针覆盖符合解析规律，rank-aware弃权保护了无支持解释；标量噪声实验同时暴露漏检弱故障与窄相对容差下过度拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 这些对照提供了预测、语义支持与科学接受的可执行分离。但研究属合成数值审计，并非临床验证、神经JEPA-Anything复现、智能体学习或患者治疗效果估计。

title: Bridging KV-Cache Quantization and Linear Attention: From Theory to Pretrained Weight Migration
summary: KV-cache quantization and linear attention are two representative approaches to tackling the storage and computational costs of Transformers. KV-cache quantization compresses individual KV entries into discrete codes but retains all entries, whereas linear attention recurrently aggregates multiple historical KV contributions into a fixed-size continuous state but can introduce interference. This contrast raises the question of whether per-KV compression and multi-KV aggregation can be bridged within a single mechanism for efficient attention. We identify RAM-Net as such a bridge through soft assignments over a discrete address space. These assignments determine recurrent updates to the continuous slot state associated with each address. Under a restricted RAM-Net construction, we prove that soft address assignments extend hard quantized matching to a separable read-write overlap that locally approximates full-attention similarity and supports recurrent aggregation. These connections further enable Transformer-to-RAM-Net weight migration through a new path based on a soft-quantized intermediate construction. Across nine pretrained Transformer models from 0.3B to 7B parameters, RAM-Net recovers an average of 87.1% of the teachers' accuracy gains over random guessing across six commonsense and knowledge tasks using only a 500M-token budget per model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAM-Net作为桥接KV缓存量化与线性注意力的统一机制，通过离散地址空间上的软分配实现高效注意力，并支持从Transformer迁移权重。
AI.motivation: KV缓存量化保留所有KV条目但压缩单个条目，线性注意力将多个历史KV聚合为固定大小的连续状态但会引入干扰。本文探究是否能在一个机制中同时桥接"逐KV压缩"与"多KV聚合"。
AI.method: 识别RAM-Net为桥梁：通过离散地址空间上的软分配决定对每个地址对应的连续slot状态的循环更新。在受限构造下证明软地址分配将硬量化匹配扩展为可分离的读写重叠，局部近似全注意力相似度并支持循环聚合。提出基于软量化中间构造的Transformer到RAM-Net权重新迁移路径。
AI.result: 在9个0.3B到7B参数的预训练Transformer上，每模型仅用500M token预算，RAM-Net在六项常识与知识任务上平均恢复教师模型相对随机猜测准确率增益的87.1%。
AI.conclusion: RAM-Net统一了逐KV压缩与多KV聚合，建立了与全注意力的理论联系，并实现了可行的权重迁移，在大规模模型上验证了高效注意力的有效性。

title: Fresco++: Frequency-Guided and Canonical-Consistent Optimization for Fine-Grained Head Avatar Modeling
summary: We propose Fresco++, a unified optimization framework for fine-grained and view-consistent head avatar reconstruction. Head avatar optimization is typically driven by per-view image supervision, which can lead to premature fitting of unstable high-frequency details and inconsistent local appearance across viewpoints. Fresco++ addresses these challenges by regulating both the progression of visual detail and the formation of cross-view supervision during optimization. For frequency-aware optimization, a progressive curriculum first stabilizes low-frequency structures and then introduces high-frequency constraints to recover fine facial and hair details without amplifying spurious responses at early stages. For cross-view optimization, we introduce Canonical Group Consensus, which associates local observations through shared canonical surface regions and establishes correspondence across different viewpoints. Geometric and visibility-aware screening removes unreliable observations, while the remaining multi-view evidence is aggregated in feature space to form a consensus target for supervising the current rendering. This design enforces local consistency without relying on a specific image-space parameterization and avoids additional rendering of the auxiliary view. Together, the frequency curriculum and canonical consensus provide stable optimization from coarse structures to fine details while maintaining coherent appearance across viewpoints. Extensive experiments on NeRSemble demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and cross-view consistency, while evaluations across diverse avatar representations further confirm the generality and transferability of Fresco++.

AI.tldr: Fresco++ 是一个统一的细粒度、视角一致的头像重建优化框架，通过频率课程学习和规范空间共识机制稳定优化过程。
AI.motivation: 现有头像优化依赖逐视角图像监督，容易过早拟合不稳定的高频细节，并导致不同视角间局部外观不一致。
AI.method: 两方面优化：一是频率感知的渐进课程，先稳定低频结构再引入高频约束以恢复细节；二是跨视角的 Canonical Group Consensus，通过共享规范表面区域建立视角对应，配合几何与可见性筛选剔除不可靠观测，在特征空间聚合多视角证据形成共识目标。
AI.result: 在 NeRSemble 数据集上提升了重建质量和跨视角一致性，并在多种头像表示上验证了通用性与可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 频率课程与规范共识共同实现了从粗结构到细细节的稳定优化，同时保持跨视角外观连贯，具备良好的通用性。

title: Natural Language to First-Order Logic LLM-based Autoformalization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have renewed interest in autoformalization. Yet, when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism, the field still lacks a unified task formulation and a systematic survey. This paper addresses this gap: we first provide a principled definition for the FOL-autoformalization task by distinguishing Ontology Extraction from Logical Translation, showing how their conflation obscures (cross-study) evaluation; we review existing datasets, evaluation metrics, and LLM-based methods, including fine-tuning, prompting, and verification-based refinement; we identify open challenges in benchmarking, semantic evaluation, ontology-aware methods, and end-to-end applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对一阶逻辑（FOL）自动形式化领域缺乏统一任务定义和系统综述的问题，提出原则性定义并梳理现有工作，指出开放挑战。
AI.motivation: LLM重新激发了自动形式化的兴趣，但当目标形式化为一阶逻辑（FOL）时，该领域仍缺乏统一的任务表述和系统性综述。
AI.method: 首先通过区分"本体提取"与"逻辑翻译"给出FOL自动形式化任务的原则性定义，揭示两者混淆如何影响跨研究评估；然后回顾现有数据集、评估指标及基于LLM的方法（包括微调、提示和基于验证的改进）。
AI.result: 系统梳理了FOL自动形式化领域的数据集、评估指标与LLM方法，并识别出基准测试、语义评估、本体感知方法和端到端应用方面的开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为FOL自动形式化提供了统一的任务框架，明确了当前研究的不足与未来方向。

title: DeltaReplay: Task-Relative Memory Reuse for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Memory-augmented mobile GUI agents store successful execution trajectories and reuse them in later tasks, but a stored trajectory rarely matches a new task exactly. The new task may use different parameters, share only some of its steps with a stored trajectory, or have no relevant record in memory. Forcing the agent to use irrelevant memory can mislead it, whereas discarding memory that may still be useful deprives it of guidance from past experience. To address this dilemma, we propose DeltaReplay, a step-level memory reuse framework that decides how to use existing memory without modifying it. We observe that the reusable part of a stored record is determined not by the record itself but by its relation to the new task, mainly through two factors: page-level consistency and action-level generality. We therefore store execution trajectories as paths in a transition graph, whose nodes (pages) and edges (actions between pages) capture these two factors. At reuse time, the action on each edge is split into a task-independent operation and task-specific parameters. DeltaReplay then compares each recorded step with the new task and the current screen, and decides whether to follow it, execute it after replacing its parameters, or leave it to the base agent. On AndroidWorld and SPA-Bench, DeltaReplay improves the task success rate over a base agent with the same backbone by up to 10.3 and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. These results indicate that deciding at each step how to use retrieved memory lets agents benefit even from partially matching trajectories.

AI.tldr: DeltaReplay 提出步骤级记忆复用框架，通过转移图存储执行轨迹，并在每步比较记录步骤与新任务及当前屏幕，决定跟随、替换参数后执行或交由基础智能体，从而在部分匹配轨迹下也能获益。
AI.motivation: 移动 GUI 智能体存储的成功轨迹很少与新任务完全匹配（参数不同、仅部分步骤相同或无相关记录）。强制使用无关记忆会误导智能体，而丢弃可能有用的记忆又失去过往经验指导，因此需要解决这一两难。
AI.method: 将执行轨迹存为转移图中的路径，节点（页面）和边（页面间动作）分别捕捉页面级一致性与动作级通用性；复用时把每条边上的动作拆分为任务无关操作和任务特定参数，再对每个记录步骤与新任务和当前屏幕比较，决定跟随、替换参数后执行，或留给基础智能体。
AI.result: 在 AndroidWorld 和 SPA-Bench 上，使用相同主干时相较基础智能体任务成功率分别最多提升 10.3 和 25.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在每一步决定如何使用检索到的记忆，能使智能体即便面对部分匹配的轨迹也能受益。

title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
summary: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph's treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws.

AI.tldr: 本文将扩散、自回归及混合模型统一为“腐蚀格”上的路径，定义解码调度代价，揭示最少步数由数据几何（图树深）决定，并可用预训练权重估计的依赖核对不同调度排序进行预测。
AI.motivation: 扩散擅长连续场、自回归擅长离散token，已有混合模型各有固定解码调度，但无法在解码前预测不同调度在固定步数下的表现。作者希望找到统一理论来预测调度性能。
AI.method: 将扩散、AR及中间模型建模为腐蚀格上的路径，定义调度代价为并行步骤所丢弃的依赖；用图上马尔可夫数据证明最少零代价步数等于图的treedepth；用预训练权重估计的成对依赖核来预测低于treedepth时各调度的代价排序。
AI.result: 理论显示最少步数对序列对数增长、对网格边长线性增长；在文本、图像、视频生成任务上，跨不同指标和基准验证了多数关于调度排序的预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为AR、扩散及混合模型提供了解码设计原则，说明调度性能可在解码前预测。

title: Missing Modality-Aware Calibration for Trustworthy Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Multimodal brain tumor segmentation typically leverages multiple MRI modalities, yet incomplete modality acquisition is common in clinical practice due to protocol heterogeneity and scan failures. Although recent methods maintain segmentation accuracy under missing modality conditions, they frequently overlook prediction reliability, leading to miscalibrated confidence estimates that hinder clinical adoption. Existing calibration techniques are largely modality-agnostic or assume that prediction difficulty decreases monotonically as additional modalities become available. However, in brain tumor segmentation, prediction difficulty depends primarily on which modalities are absent rather than how many, leading to combination-specific and spatially heterogeneous calibration errors. To address this, we propose Missing Modality-Aware Local Temperature Scaling (MMA-LTS), a post-hoc voxel-wise confidence calibration method. It estimates a spatially adaptive temperature field conditioned on a modality-availability learnable token and a voxel-wise difficulty score. Experiments on BraTS 2020 and FeTS 2024 show that MMA-LTS improves calibration while preserving the segmentation accuracy of state-of-the-art models across diverse missing-modality scenarios, thereby enhancing trustworthiness toward clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出MMA-LTS，一种针对缺失模态的多模态脑肿瘤分割后处理体素级温度校准方法，提升置信度可靠性。
AI.motivation: 临床中MRI模态缺失常见，现有方法忽视预测可靠性，校准技术多为模态无关或假设模态越多越容易预测，但脑肿瘤分割的难度主要取决于缺失哪些模态而非缺失数量。
AI.method: MMA-LTS为后处理体素级置信度校准，基于模态可用性可学习token和体素级难度分数，估计空间自适应温度场，实现局部温度缩放。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020和FeTS 2024上，MMA-LTS在多种缺失模态场景下改善校准，同时保持最先进模型的分割精度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提升了分割结果的可信度，有助于推动临床部署。

title: ILM: An AI-Powered Storytelling Educational Tool
summary: Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.

AI.tldr: ILM是一个交互式教育平台，用于学习"先知故事"，结合阿拉伯语NLP、结构化知识表示和检索式问题生成，支持叙事探索、理解与评估。
AI.motivation: 数字技术虽使伊斯兰叙事更易获取，但现有平台对结构化学习与理解（尤其阿拉伯语及多语言场景）支持不足。
AI.method: 构建知识图谱构造引擎，从管理员审核的阿拉伯语叙事中识别实体与叙事关系，形成结构化知识；学习者可通过可视化故事地图探索，并回答基于KG生成的实体/关系问题。另有独立的多语言检索管道，从原始叙事中检索相关段落生成选择题和开放式理解题。开放式题采用LLM-as-a-Judge对照检索段落与参考答案评判。平台还引入古兰经内容作为独立增强层。
AI.result: 系统展示了结合结构化知识表示与检索式生成以支持伊斯兰叙事交互学习的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将结构化知识与基于段落的检索相结合，ILM在阿拉伯语及多语言内容中支持叙事探索、理解与评估，验证了该技术路线的可行性。

title: Internalizer: Portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping for Very Large Language Models
summary:
Hypernetworks that map a context directly to a LoRA adapter let a large language model carry that context in its weights, but prior work has demonstrated them only on base models of up to 14 billion parameters.
  We present the Internalizer, a state-of-the-art, portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping hypernetwork that generates document-specific LoRA adapters for the frozen 284B-parameter DeepSeek v4 Flash, a target two orders of magnitude larger than in any previous work. Most of its parameters live in a model-agnostic trunk with only thin entry and exit layers per base model, so it trains cheaply against small models before being ported to the large one.
  On unseen documents of up to 4096 tokens, the generated adapters reach 84.9% top-1 and 97.8% top-5 teacher-forced accuracy against 63.4% and 83.5% for the base model, with nothing in the context window but a three-word instruction.
  Once the hypernetwork is trained, a single forward pass turns any document into an adapter for such a model, which could be served alone for speed or alongside the document in the window to raise accuracy further.

AI.tldr: 提出 Internalizer 超网络，可将文档映射为 LoRA 适配器，首次在 284B 参数大模型（DeepSeek v4 Flash）上实现，规模较此前工作提升两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 已有超网络能将上下文直接映射为 LoRA 适配器，让模型"把上下文存进权重"，但此前仅在不超过 14B 参数的基座模型上验证，尚未证明其能扩展到更大规模模型。
AI.method: 设计名为 Internalizer 的可移植 Context-to-Parameter Mapping 超网络，为冻结的 284B 参数 DeepSeek v4 Flash 生成文档专属 LoRA 适配器。参数主要位于与模型无关的主干中，每个基座模型仅需少量入口/出口层，因此可先在小型模型上低成本训练，再迁移到大模型。
AI.result: 在最长 4096 token 的未见文档上，生成的适配器达到 84.9% top-1 和 97.8% top-5 teacher-forced 准确率，而基座模型仅为 63.4% 和 83.5%，且上下文窗口中仅有三个词的指令。
AI.conclusion: 训练完成后，单次前向即可将任意文档转为该大模型的适配器，可单独部署以提速，或与文档同时放入窗口以进一步提升准确率。

title: Multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Sequential Recommendation via Collaborative Filtering Paths
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for sequential recommendation through their ability to reason over complex multimodal data. However, existing approaches either rely solely on the target user's own interaction history, neglecting collaborative signals from neighboring users, or incur substantial computational overhead through repeated MLLM inference over long interaction histories. To address these challenges, we propose MGRASRec, a multimodal graph retrieval-augmented framework for sequential recommendation. MGRASRec injects collaborative filtering signals conditioned on the candidate item directly into the MLLM prompt by retrieving structured paths from a user-item interaction graph, extended via multimodal similarity to increase coverage beyond exact co-interaction overlap. This retrieval also surfaces the history items most relevant to the candidate at no additional cost, removing the need for recurrent summarization and keeping inference to a single forward pass per candidate. All components are unified into an augmented prompt for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an MLLM. Extensive evaluations across three publicly available datasets validate the effectiveness of MGRASRec, achieving the best performance on all metrics with particularly strong gains in ranking quality.

AI.tldr: MGRASRec：通过多模态图检索增强，将协同信号注入MLLM提示，实现单次前向传播的序列推荐。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM序列推荐方法要么只用目标用户自身历史、忽略邻居用户的协同信号，要么因在长历史上反复推理而产生巨大计算开销。
AI.method: 从用户-物品交互图检索结构化路径，并借助多模态相似度扩展覆盖范围（超越精确共交互）；将候选相关的协同过滤信号直接注入MLLM提示，同时检索与候选最相关的历史物品；所有组件统一为增强提示，对MLLM进行参数高效微调，每个候选仅需一次前向传播。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上全面评测，所有指标均取得最佳性能，尤其在排序质量上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: MGRASRec有效融合协同信号与多模态信息，兼顾效果与效率，验证了多模态图检索增强用于序列推荐的可行性。

title: EchoDiST: Self-distillation-based joint learning for diffusion-conditioned echocardiographic myocardial motion estimation
summary: Motion estimation in echocardiography is essential for quantitative assessment of cardiac function and myocardial mechanics, but remains challenging due to image artifacts, limited image information, speckle decorrelation, and the scarcity of ground-truth displacement fields. Anatomy-guided approaches can provide structural information, yet often rely on expert-labeled myocardial segmentations. We propose EchoDiST, a framework for unsupervised echocardiographic myocardial motion estimation that integrates self-distillation-based joint learning with a diffusion-conditioned motion estimation network. Here, unsupervised motion estimation refers to learning without ground-truth displacement fields. The self-distillation strategy jointly optimizes anatomical segmentation and myocardial motion estimation under limited anatomical annotations. Diffusion-based conditioning is used during training with stochastic perturbations, while inference requires only a single deterministic forward pass without iterative reverse-diffusion sampling. EchoDiST was evaluated on three echocardiographic datasets, including two external test datasets under cross-view and cross-dataset settings. Compared with seven representative learning-based methods, EchoDiST consistently improved anatomical alignment, myocardial strain assessment, and motion-derived functional and cardiac-phase assessment. These gains were statistically significant across the evaluated tasks and datasets. Overall, EchoDiST provides an effective approach for reliable myocardial motion estimation under limited anatomical supervision and supports downstream quantitative assessment of cardiac function.

AI.tldr: 提出EchoDiST，一种无监督超声心动图心肌运动估计框架，结合自蒸馏联合学习与扩散条件运动估计网络，在有限解剖标注下实现可靠的心肌运动估计。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图运动估计对评估心脏功能和心肌力学至关重要，但受图像伪影、信息有限、散斑去相关及ground-truth位移场稀缺等问题影响而困难。现有解剖引导方法依赖专家标注的心肌分割，标注成本高。
AI.method: EchoDiST将基于自蒸馏的联合学习与扩散条件运动估计网络相结合。自蒸馏策略在有限解剖标注下联合优化解剖分割与心肌运动估计；扩散条件在训练中引入随机扰动，而推理仅需单次确定性前向传播，无需迭代反向扩散采样。此处"无监督"指无需ground-truth位移场。
AI.result: 在三个超声心动图数据集（含两个跨视角和跨数据集的external测试数据集）上评估，与七种代表性学习方法相比，EchoDiST在解剖对齐、心肌应变评估以及运动衍生的功能和心动周期评估上均持续提升，且在各任务和数据集上具有统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: EchoDiST为在有限解剖监督下实现可靠的心肌运动估计提供了有效方案，支持心脏功能的下游定量评估。

title: All Verdicts are Not Equal: Rethinking LLM Judge Reliability
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge is the standard paradigm for NLP evaluation, yet its systemic reliability remains poorly understood despite being widely treated as a deterministic ground truth. We present a comprehensive reliability audit, stresstesting six frontier models across four benchmarks, five prompt formats, two presentation orders, three sampling temperatures, and ten repetitions per condition. Our empirical analysis reveals severe vulnerabilities: verdicts change across identical replications at temperature zero, position-order swaps flip the majority of verdicts on challenging tasks, and the most deterministic judge achieves perfect consistency by trivially repeating incorrect verdicts, agreeing with ground truth only 51% of the time. To formalize these multi-faceted failure modes, we introduce the trustworthy verdict rate (T ), a unified metric capturing the joint probability that an evaluation is reproducible, order-invariant, and accurate. UsingT , we derive a theoretical upper bound on accuracy imposed by position bias and show that reliability is item-specific rather than modellevel. Finally, we demonstrate that shifting from pairwise win-rate to holistic rubric scoring improves trustworthiness more than any single-format prompting intervention, offering an actionable framework for robust NLP evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了LLM-as-a-Judge的可靠性，发现其在重复性、位置不变性和准确性上存在严重缺陷，并提出统一指标T（可信判决率）及改进框架。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge被广泛当作确定性的评估真值使用，但其系统性可靠性仍缺乏深入理解，作者希望揭示其潜在失效模式。
AI.method: 对六个前沿模型在四个基准、五种提示格式、两种呈现顺序、三种采样温度、每种条件十次重复下进行压力测试；提出可信判决率T指标，并推导位置偏差下的准确率理论上界，分析条目级与模型级可靠性差异。
AI.result: 发现温度为零时判决仍会变化；交换位置顺序会翻转多数困难任务的判决；最"确定"的评测模型通过重复错误答案获得完美一致性，与真值一致率仅51%；可靠性是条目特定的而非模型级别的；从成对胜率转向整体性评分表比任何单一提示干预更能提升可信度。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-a-Judge并非可靠的确定性真值，需以T等指标量化其可复现性、顺序不变性与准确性，并通过整体性评分表等结构化框架实现更稳健的NLP评估。

title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
summary: Multiplayer world models must ensure that independently controlled views remain consistent with one shared and persistent world. We introduce MultiWorldBench, a diagnostic Minecraft benchmark containing 495 case configurations across seven task suites and ten capabilities, including independent control, cross-view motion, shared-state synchronization, persistence, structural reasoning, concurrent interaction, and delayed revisit. We evaluate Solaris, Gamma-World, and MineWorld, using Engine GT as a reference. Gamma-World achieves the highest ten-capability average among the generated systems at 21.39, followed by Solaris at 20.88 and MineWorld at 1.89, while Engine GT reaches 91.69. Gamma-World performs better on several control, shared-state, and revisit capabilities, whereas Solaris leads in cross-view motion and race-condition consistency. Nevertheless, all generated systems score at most 8.00 on state persistence and 1.33 on structural consistency, and none succeeds in spatial reasoning or building-identity preservation. Human preferences produce the same overall ranking and show strong alignment with the automatic evaluation, with a mean dimension-level Spearman correlation of 0.96. These results show that plausible individual views do not yet constitute a coherent multiplayer world.

AI.tldr: 提出MultiWorldBench，一个诊断多玩家世界模型的Minecraft基准，含495个案例、7个任务套件和10项能力。评估Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld，发现生成系统平均分远低于引擎真值。
AI.motivation: 多玩家世界模型需保证独立控制的视图与单一持久共享世界一致，但现有评估缺乏针对该问题的诊断工具，因此构建专门基准来检验视图一致性与共享状态等能力。
AI.method: 设计MultiWorldBench基准，覆盖独立控制、跨视图运动、共享状态同步、持久性、结构推理、并发交互、延迟重访等任务；评估Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld，并以Engine GT为参照，结合自动指标与人类偏好评价。
AI.result: Gamma-World十项能力均分最高（21.39），Solaris 20.88，MineWorld 1.89，Engine GT 91.69。Gamma-World在控制、共享状态和重访上较好，Solaris在跨视图运动与竞争条件一致性领先。但所有生成系统状态持久性≤8.00、结构一致性≤1.33，空间推理与建筑身份保持均失败。人类偏好排名一致，与自动评估平均Spearman相关0.96。
AI.conclusion: 单个视图看似合理并不等于形成了连贯的多玩家世界，当前生成式世界模型在共享状态持久性与结构一致性上仍有显著缺陷。

title: SteerCast: Retrieval-Based Latent Steering for Decoder-Only Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting aims to predict future values from historical observations and auxiliary features. We propose \textbf{SteerCast}, a retrieval-based latent steering method that improves decoder-only forecaster at inference time, without updating its parameters. SteerCast constructs a database from the training set by storing a representation of each history window together with a \emph{steering vector} computed in the forecaster's latent space, defined as the difference between representations induced by the ground-truth continuation and by the model's own prediction. At test time, SteerCast retrieves nearest neighbors for a query history, aggregates their steering vectors, and injects the resulting signal into the forecaster's hidden states at every step of autoregressive generation, guiding predictions toward trajectories consistent with similar training cases. Experiments across diverse multivariate benchmarks and multiple horizons show that SteerCast consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the fine-tuned backbone and retrieval-based baselines, while requiring no additional training beyond the original fine-tuning and using only the training set as a retrieval corpus.

AI.tldr: SteerCast是一种基于检索的潜在引导方法，在推理时改进decoder-only预测器而无需更新参数，通过检索训练集中的引导向量注入隐藏状态来提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测从历史观测和辅助特征预测未来值。现有方法受限于参数固定的decoder-only预测器，需要在不训练的情况下提升其推理性能。
AI.method: 构建训练集数据库，存储每个历史窗口的表示及其引导向量（真实续接与模型预测表示的差）。测试时检索最近邻，聚合引导向量并在自回归生成的每一步注入隐藏状态。
AI.result: 在多样化的多变量基准和多个预测跨度上，SteerCast持续优于微调骨干和基于检索的基线，无需额外训练，仅用训练集作为检索语料。
AI.conclusion: SteerCast通过检索引导有效提升了时间序列预测精度，且无需参数更新或额外训练，具有实用性和通用性。

title: DLC: A Metric-Guided Dynamic Loss Controller for Multi-Objective Training
summary: In this paper, we introduce a metric-guided dynamic loss controller (DLC) for multi-objective image restoration. Conventional image restoration pipelines usually train with a fixed weighted combination of multiple losses, without changing the relative importance of fidelity, perceptual similarity, and no-reference quality during optimization. DLC is an architecture- and loss-term-agnostic training-time controller: it does not modify the restoration architecture or introduce new differentiable loss terms, but dynamically reweights the existing training losses. During training, DLC periodically evaluates the current model on a small fixed feedback subset and uses the resulting quality metrics to update the loss-weight vector through an LLM-based controller. Because DLC operates on existing loss terms rather than task-specific architectures, the same controller formulation can be instantiated across diverse image restoration training pipelines. We evaluate DLC on three restoration domains: low-light image enhancement, deraining, and real-world super-resolution, using both reference-based and no-reference quality metrics. Across these settings, DLC considers metric-dependent trade-offs during optimization and guides training toward balanced operating points across fidelity and perceptual quality. The results show that DLC can move models toward more favorable operating points across different restoration domains, supporting its role as a practical plug-in controller for multi-objective image restoration.

AI.tldr: 提出 DLC——一种基于指标的动态损失控制器，用 LLM 在训练中动态重加权多个已有损失，实现多目标图像复原。
AI.motivation: 传统图像复原训练使用固定的多损失加权组合，无法在优化过程中调整保真度、感知相似度和无参考质量之间的相对重要性。
AI.method: DLC 是与架构和损失项无关的训练期控制器：不改变复原架构、不引入新可微损失，而是动态重加权已有训练损失。训练中周期性地在小型固定反馈子集上评估模型，用得到的质量指标通过 LLM 控制器更新损失权重向量。
AI.result: 在低光增强、去雨和真实世界超分三个领域、结合参考与无参考质量指标评估，DLC 能考虑指标间权衡，引导训练朝向保真度与感知质量更均衡的工作点。
AI.conclusion: DLC 可作为多目标图像复原的实用即插即用控制器，在不同复原领域中把模型推向更优工作点。

title: A persistent accuracy ceiling in automated verbal deception detection
summary: Automated methods have been proposed to overcome the limitations of human verbal deception detection, but evidence remains fragmented across disciplines. We systematically reviewed 25 years of research (289 reports, 6,136 classification models) and meta-analyzed 3,653 models nested within 97 datasets. Pooled accuracy was 74.4% (95% CI: 71.2%-77.4%) with substantial heterogeneity. Accuracy was driven by methodological quality (ground truth, data source, class balance, evaluation procedure) more than by model complexity: the adoption of embeddings and large language models has not translated into improved predictive performance. Only 12.46% of reports used data with verifiable ground-truth, and only 23.96% of models were evaluated on independent data. The pooled accuracy aligns with meta-analyses of manual approaches, suggesting a ceiling of 70-75%, unlikely to be lifted by current research conventions.

AI.tldr: 系统综述25年研究(289篇报告、6136个模型)并元分析3653个模型，自动欺骗检测汇总准确率74.4%，瓶颈在于方法学质量而非模型复杂度。
AI.motivation: 自动欺骗检测方法旨在克服人工言语欺骗检测的局限，但跨学科证据碎片化，缺乏系统性整合与统一评估。
AI.method: 系统综述25年研究(289份报告、6136个分类模型)，并元分析嵌套于97个数据集中的3653个模型，检验准确率及其异质性来源(方法学质量、数据来源、类别平衡、评估程序、模型复杂度等)。
AI.result: 汇总准确率74.4%(95% CI: 71.2%-77.4%)，异质性显著。准确率主要由方法学质量(真值、数据来源、类别平衡、评估程序)驱动，而非模型复杂度；嵌入与大型语言模型未带来性能提升。仅12.46%报告使用可验证真值数据，仅23.96%模型在独立数据上评估。
AI.conclusion: 汇总准确率与人工方法的元分析结果一致，表明约70-75%存在上限，且现有研究范式难以突破。

title: MemTrial: Learning When to Trust Memory in LLM Portfolio Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents for portfolio management learn from experience: they credit each experience in their memory with the outcome of the decisions that used it. In financial markets, however, this outcome mostly reflects the market move shared by all decisions on that date, so the credit tracks the market rather than the experience, and these agents often do worse than simply holding the equal-weight (1/$N$) portfolio. We ask how an agent can credit an experience with what it changes, and answer it by putting memory on trial: drafts of the same decision with and without an experience face the same market, so the outcome they share cancels in their difference. Our agent, MemTrial, drafts each decision with eight combinations of its retrieved experiences, chosen by a fractional factorial design, and credits each experience with its Banzhaf value, the average of these differences. As each date occurs once and each draft is a noisy LLM sample, these credits are noisy and may not hold on new dates. MemTrial therefore pools them across dates and similar experiences with a hierarchical Bayesian model, acts on them only after they have predicted unseen dates, and otherwise stays anchored at a conservative reference such as 1/$N$. On four benchmarks, MemTrial not only benefits from experiences that matter (the best of 15 methods on a semi-synthetic benchmark with known experience quality) but also limits its losses when its values do not hold (at most 2.2\% below 1/$N$ on PortBench and InvestorBench, against 15--38\% for the best experience-learning agent). Averaged over five settings, it improves the utility of the best experience-learning agent by 21.2\%, and with eight LLMs it beats every LLM-based baseline on InvestorBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 MemTrial：通过将记忆"上庭审判"（对比有无某经验的配对草案），用 Banzhaf 值给经验打信用分，并用层次贝叶斯跨日期池化，仅在预测到未见日期后才行动，否则锚定 1/N。四个基准上收益经验有效性，同时将损失限制在 1/N 之下最多 2.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM投资组合代理从经验中学习，但信用分配受市场共同涨跌干扰，导致"信用跟随市场而非经验"，表现常不如等权 1/N 组合。核心问题：如何让代理按"经验改变了什么"而非市场结果来给经验记功。
AI.method: 记忆审判法：对同一决策生成包含/不包含某经验的草案，二者面对同一市场，其共享结果在差值中抵消；用分式析因设计选 8 种经验组合，以 Banzhaf 值（这些差值的平均）作为经验信用。因日期唯一且 LLM 采样有噪声，用层次贝叶斯模型跨日期及相似经验池化信用，仅在信用能预测未见日期后才据其行动，否则锚定保守的 1/N 参考。
AI.result: 在半合成基准（已知经验质量）上为 15 种方法中最优；PortBench 与 InvestorBench 上损失最多低于 1/N 仅 2.2%，而最好的经验学习代理损失 15–38%。五设置平均将最佳经验学习代理效用提升 21.2%；用 8 个 LLM 时在 InvestorBench 上击败所有基于 LLM 的基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过配对草案差分隔离经验的真实贡献，并以贝叶斯池化与保守锚定控制噪声，MemTrial 既能利用有效经验，又能在信用失效时限制损失，优于现有经验学习代理。

title: Low-Cost Sensor Calibration for Indoor Air Quality Monitoring: A Dataset, Evaluation Scenarios, and a Lightweight Model
summary: Low-cost sensors enable scalable indoor air quality monitoring but require calibration because of nonlinear distortions, noise, and temporal drift. The conventional strict pairwise calibration setting requires a co-located reference sensor at each deployment location and does not account for spatial and temporal heterogeneity. To address these limitations, we introduce a six-month dataset comprising multivariate indoor air-quality measurements from low-cost and reference sensors with contextual metadata collected at five locations. Using this dataset, we define four evaluation scenarios. The reference-efficient and location-transfer scenarios evaluate spatial generalization, whereas the long-term drift and event-conditioned scenarios assess robustness to gradual and abrupt distribution shifts. Based on these scenarios, we derive design requirements and propose a lightweight temporal model that combines input-window compression with residual temporal and feature fusion. Experiments show strong calibration performance across all four scenarios with low edge-inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出六个月多地点室内空气质量数据集与四种评估场景，设计轻量时序模型实现跨场景低成本传感器校准。
AI.motivation: 低成本传感器存在非线性失真、噪声和时间漂移，需校准；传统严格配对校准要求每个部署点都配有共置参考传感器，且未考虑时空异质性。
AI.method: 构建包含五个地点、低成本与参考传感器多变量测量及上下文元数据的六个月数据集；定义参考高效、位置迁移、长期漂移和事件条件四种评估场景；提出结合输入窗口压缩与残差时序及特征融合的轻量时序模型。
AI.result: 在四种场景下均表现出较强的校准性能，且边缘推理成本低。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与场景为低成本室内空气质量传感器校准提供了系统性评估框架，轻量模型兼顾精度与边缘部署效率。

title: Learning to Retrieve: Internalizing Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
summary: Video world models aim to generate explorable, 3D-consistent scene videos conditioned on camera trajectories. Existing approaches often rely on external memory systems that explicitly retrieve previously observed content to mitigate scene drift during long-horizon generation. However, these auxiliary memory pathways operate outside the model's internal generative dynamics, preventing the model from intrinsically learning when and what historical information should be retrieved. We propose to internalize memory retrieval into the generation process, allowing retrieval to emerge as an intrinsic behavior of the video world model rather than relying on an external memory system. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R)}, which repurposes the model's persistent internal state as a memory for historical context. A camera-conditioned retrieval gate selectively accesses relevant historical information from this state, determining \textit{what to retrieve}, while a retrieval trigger determines \textit{when to retrieve}. We further supervise the trigger with a 3D re-visibility signal, activating retrieval when previously observed content re-enters the current view while otherwise preserving the existing context. Together, these components enable the model to intrinsically acquire memory retrieval behavior and incorporate relevant historical observations into generation without a separate retrieval pathway. Across multiple base models and camera-revisit benchmarks, L2R improves long-term scene consistency while eliminating the need for an external memory bank or 3D conditions. https://jkhu29.github.io/l2r

AI.tldr: 提出Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R)，将记忆检索内化为视频世界模型的内在生成行为，无需外部记忆库即可提升长时场景一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型依赖外部记忆系统显式检索历史内容来缓解长时生成中的场景漂移，但这些辅助记忆通路游离于模型内部生成动态之外，模型无法内在学习何时、检索何种历史信息。
AI.method: 将记忆检索内化到生成过程：复用模型持久内部状态作为历史上下文记忆；相机条件检索门选择要检索的内容，检索触发器决定检索时机；并用3D重可见性信号监督触发器。
AI.result: 在多个基础模型与相机重访基准上，L2R提升了长期场景一致性，同时无需外部记忆库或3D条件。
AI.conclusion: 记忆检索可作为视频世界模型的内在行为，无需独立检索通路即可融入相关历史观测，改进长时生成一致性。

title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
summary: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and it compresses faster than rereading the whole context.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑KV缓存压缩中"重读全部上下文"的主流做法，提出用自测（问答对）代替重读的免训练方法Attic-KV，在紧预算下显著优于重读并在多设置中取得最佳效果。
AI.motivation: 主流KV缓存压缩通过让模型重读上下文并按注意力保留条目，隐含"排练越完整、记忆越好"的假设。作者发现在紧预算下该假设失效：重读全部上下文反而分散预算，导致答案相关条目仅以接近随机的概率保留，效果甚至不如什么都不排练。
AI.method: 提出两条原则——排练将被读取的内容、排练尽可能多的内容，并实例化为免训练的Attic-KV：让模型用引用上下文的问答对进行自测，同时加入内容自适应数量的锚点token作为排练信号。
AI.result: 在RULER和LongBench自然文本任务的全部八个设置中，Attic是表现最佳的免训练方法；作为插件可使梯度法KVgrad和训练法RestoreKV+分别最高提升17.1和28.1分；优势随预算缩小而扩大，3%保留率下比全量重读高出41.9分；压缩速度也快于重读。
AI.conclusion: KV缓存"重读式"排练在紧预算下适得其反，改用"自测式"排练（Attic-KV）更有效地保留关键信息，兼容多种压缩框架且随预算收紧优势更明显。

title: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $Φ$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
summary: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $Φ$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and optional characterization of selected anomaly types. Before launch, the pipeline was trained and validated on simulated $Φ$sat-2 imagery to assess algorithmic performance and compatibility with resource-constrained onboard hardware. After integration and functional validation in the mission environment, early experiments on real $Φ$sat-2 acquisitions revealed a significant mismatch between simulated and in-orbit data. The pipeline was therefore retrained on real Level-1 imagery using an improved annotation strategy to better handle ambiguous marine regions, substantially enhancing performance. Beyond demonstrating the onboard feasibility of the application, the $Φ$sat-2 experience highlights the importance of robust annotation strategies and sensor-aware design, and shows that simulation-based development is valuable for pre-flight risk reduction, while reliable scientific validation requires representative in-orbit data and should be clearly distinguished from functional validation.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了在ESA Φsat-2卫星上部署轻量级海洋异常检测流水线的经验，涵盖开发、星上集成与发射后适配。
AI.motivation: 星上AI可提升对地观测系统的响应速度和带宽效率，通过在卫星上直接处理数据来实现。
AI.method: 流水线包含海陆分割、海洋区域自监督特征编码、基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测，以及可选的异常类型表征。发射前用模拟Φsat-2影像训练验证；集成后在真实影像上重新训练，并采用改进的标注策略处理模糊海洋区域。
AI.result: 发现模拟与在轨数据存在显著不匹配；用真实Level-1影像和改进标注策略重训后，性能大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 证明星上应用可行，并强调稳健标注策略与传感器感知设计的重要性；基于仿真的开发有助于降低飞行前风险，但可靠的科学验证需要代表性的在轨数据，且应与功能验证明确区分。

title: Read What Matters: Query-Adaptive Quantization for KV Caches
summary:
KV-cache entries are stored before their future queries are known, but each decoding query needs precision in different places. We study this mismatch using separate budgets for retained bits and bits fetched per query. ReadKV stores each key and value in a progressive code whose prefixes support different reconstruction precisions. For each query, it allocates key-channel prefixes using the query, computes attention from the reconstructed keys, and then allocates value-token prefixes using that attention. Stored entries remain unchanged. Each stage optimizes a calibrated distortion objective under a fixed budget; we prove exact allocation under diminishing refinement gains and relate these objectives to attention-output error. We also exhibit a finite-dimensional attention family where query-dependent access strictly outperforms every query-independent reader at the same read budget, even with unrestricted competing encoders and decoders.
  Across six base models, reading four bits on average from an eight-bit cache increases C4 perplexity by at most 0.66%, using about one quarter of the logical reads and half the retained capacity of a 16-bit cache. It is consistently more accurate than storing and fully reading four bits at the same payload-read budget. Retaining more bits than each query fetches is aimed at long-context decoding, where the cache bytes moved per step, rather than the weights, dominate cost. Long-context question answering and retrieval on two instruction-tuned models provide additional quality evidence. On the tested 8K-token, batch-one, single-layer workload on an NVIDIA A10G, a restricted eight-bit ReadKV reader with a two-bit mean payload-read budget has 39% lower latency than the tested TurboQuant codec.

AI.tldr: ReadKV 提出一种查询依赖的 KV-cache 读取方案：存储渐进编码的 key/value，每个查询按自身需求分配前缀比特，在固定读取预算下优化重构精度，从而比查询无关读取更高效。
AI.motivation: KV-cache 条目在生成前存储、未来查询未知，但不同解码查询需要精度的地方不同。论文研究“保留比特预算”与“每查询读取比特预算”分离下的这一不匹配问题，目标是降低长上下文解码中缓存字节搬运成本。
AI.method: ReadKV 将每个 key/value 存为渐进编码，前缀支持不同重构精度；对每个查询，先用查询分配 key-channel 前缀并重构 key 计算注意力，再用该注意力分配 value-token 前缀。存储条目不变。每阶段在固定预算下优化校准的失真目标，证明在递减细化收益下可达精确分配，并建立这些目标与注意力输出误差的关系。另构造一个有限维注意力族，证明在相同读取预算下查询依赖访问严格优于任何查询无关读取器。
AI.result: 六个基础模型上，从八比特缓存平均读四比特使 C4 困惑度最多增加 0.66%，逻辑读取约为 16 比特缓存的四分之一、保留容量约为一半。相同载荷-读取预算下，比存储并完整读取四比特更准。在 NVIDIA A10G 的 8K token、batch-one、单层负载上，受限八比特 ReadKV 读取器在二比特平均载荷读取预算下，延迟比对照 TurboQuant 编解码低 39%。
AI.conclusion: 保留比每查询实际读取更多的比特，适合长上下文解码场景，此时每步搬运的缓存字节而非权重主导成本。长上下文问答与检索任务也提供额外质量证据，表明 ReadKV 在精度与效率上均具优势。

title: ProtoSemImage: Image-Valued Prototypes with Deformable Row Alignment for Interpretable Document Classification
summary: Prototypes in classification models are almost always vectors, and a vector has no readable form. This paper asks what happens when a prototype is an image. Documents give the question a natural form, because a document can be rendered as a multi-channel image in which every token becomes a pixel, so a class representative can take the same shape and the same channel semantics as the inputs it stands for. ProtoSemImage represents each class by one or more visual archetypes: prototype images in a four-channel HSV space whose channels carry named linguistic factors. A Skip-Gram objective learns that color space end to end through a four-dimensional bottleneck, discourse boundary rows become differentiable typed difference rows, and classification reduces to 2D visual template matching: a deformable row alignment between a document image and the archetype bank, in the spirit of dynamic time warping. Because the match is a spatial pattern comparison rather than a linear readout, the model reports where an input departs from its archetype and along which channel, and a generative head decodes each archetype back into text. The image representation works: it beats an otherwise identical model with vector prototypes in all three paired seeds, by between 4.3 and 11.8 points on a ten-class task. The distance-based matching does not. A diagnostic that keeps the representation fixed and swaps only the classifier recovers the sequence baselines, which locates a 20.6-point shortfall in the matching rather than in the color compression, and a benchmark built so that a pair of documents shares a bag of words and differs only in arrangement confirms the layout-preservation it was designed for. We report both directions, because for a representation whose whole purpose is inspect ability, the failure modes are as informative as the gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProtoSemImage：用图像（四通道HSV、每通道对应命名语言因子）作为分类原型，将文档渲染为多通道图像，通过Skip-Gram端到端学习颜色空间并做可变形行对齐（类DTW）模板匹配，原型可由生成头还原为文本。十类任务上图像原型在三个配对随机种子中均优于向量原型4.3–11.8分，但基于距离的匹配反而失效，诊断显示20.6分差距来自匹配器而非颜色压缩。
AI.motivation: 分类原型通常为向量，缺乏可读形式；作者探索原型为图像时的效果，选择文档作为天然载体，因为文档可渲染为多通道图像（token即像素），从而类代表可与输入共享形状与通道语义，并具备可检验性。
AI.method: ProtoSemImage以一张或多张四通道HSV原型图像表示每个类，通道承载命名语言因子；用Skip-Gram目标经四维瓶颈端到端学习颜色空间；话语边界行变为可微的类型化差异行；分类化为2D视觉模板匹配——文档图像与原型库间的可变形行对齐（类似动态时间规整）。匹配属空间模式比较而非线性读出，故可报告输入偏离原型的位置与通道；生成头把原型解码回文本。
AI.result: 图像表示有效：在十类任务的三个配对种子上均胜过仅原型改为向量的同构模型，提升4.3–11.8分。但基于距离的匹配无效：固定表示只换分类器的诊断恢复到序列基线，说明20.6分缺口在匹配而非颜色压缩；专为“共享词袋、仅排列不同”的文档对构建的基准验证了其设计目标中的布局保持。
AI.conclusion: 图像式原型是可检验且有增益的表示，但当前的基于距离的对齐匹配是主要瓶颈。作者双向报告得失，因为对以可检验性为核心目的的表示而言，失败模式与增益同样有信息量。

title: Language-Specific Effects of Tokenizer Choice in Multilingual Language Models
summary: Tokenizer choice affects multilingual language modeling, but vocabulary capacity is finite and vocabulary size is often constrained: improving representation for some languages often comes at the expense of others. We therefore ask whether tokenizer choice matters equally across languages, a question that the current literature leave unanswered. To this end, we train 123 language models spanning 54 tokenizers. In the main comparison, architecture, training corpus, training-token budget, and optimization are held fixed, so the models differ only in their tokenizer. We find that tokenizer choice matters more for languages with less language-model training data: across the 54 tokenizers, the standard deviation of a language's bits-per-byte (BPB) increases as its model training-data share decreases (Spearman rho = -0.52 over the 31 trained languages and -0.69 over the 28 written with word boundaries). Leaving a language out of tokenizer training raises its BPB in every language we study, and the penalty tends to be larger for languages with less language-model training data. Giving lower-resource languages a larger share of tokenizer-training data, however, does not unconditionally help those languages: both equal weighting and an allocation inverting the shares with respect to the language model training data increase their BPB, particularly when language-model training repeats data. Finally, which intrinsic tokenizer properties are associated with better BPB differs across languages, providing further evidence that what makes a good tokenizer depends on the language. We find that the metrics quantifying these properties can be successfully used to predict downstream models' pairwise BPB rankings, suggesting a practical strategy for screening tokenizer candidates before training language models.

AI.tldr: 分词器选择对低资源语言的语言建模影响更大；将某语言排除出分词器训练会损害其性能，但简单加大其分词器训练占比并非无条件有益。
AI.motivation: 词汇容量有限，提升某些语言的表示常以牺牲其他语言为代价。现有文献未回答：分词器选择是否对所有语言同等重要。
AI.method: 训练123个语言模型，覆盖54个分词器，固定架构、训练语料、训练token预算与优化，仅改变分词器；并在分词器训练数据分配上做留一、等权、反转份额等实验。
AI.result: 某语言BPB的标准差随其模型训练数据占比下降而增大（Spearman rho=-0.52，31种语言；-0.69，28种有词边界的语言）。将语言排除出分词器训练会使其BPB升高，且低资源语言惩罚更大；等权或反转份额分配反而升高其BPB，尤其在模型训练数据重复时。不同语言中与更优BPB关联的分词器内在属性不同，这些指标可预测下游模型的成对BPB排名。
AI.conclusion: 分词器选择的重要性因语言而异，好的分词器取决于语言；内在指标可用于训练前筛选分词器候选。

title: Scalable AI Uncertainty Quantification via Generalized Laplace Active Subspaces
summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying neural networks in scientific and high-stakes applications, but full Bayesian inference over the network parameters is computationally infeasible. We propose a low-rank generalized Laplace approximation for neural-network UQ based on a small number of data-informed curvature directions. Starting from a generalized Bayesian posterior defined through an empirical loss, we construct a local Gaussian approximation around a pretrained set of weights in this active curvature subspace. The posterior variances in the retained subspace are available in closed form, and the prior variance is calibrated by an empirical Bayes procedure. The generalized Bayesian formulation allows us to compare two posterior scalings: the standard Bayesian scaling associated with the summed negative log likelihood, and a mean-loss scaling in which the empirical loss is normalized by the number of data. A central finding is that the standard scaling induces a data-size dependent contraction of the posterior variance in the leading active directions. In regression problems, this can force the low-rank framework to retain additional weak-curvature directions in order to achieve nominal coverage of calibration data. When posterior samples are propagated through the non-linear network, these additional directions can degrade the coherence of the predictive intervals and shift the posterior predictive mean away from the pretrained model. In contrast, the generalized mean-loss scaling yields a more stable, lower dimensional active subspace and produces calibrated, coherent predictive confidence intervals. These results indicate that generalized Laplace active subspaces provide a practical and scalable route to calibrated uncertainty quantification in neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于少量数据驱动曲率方向的低秩广义拉普拉斯近似方法，用于神经网络不确定性量化（UQ），并对比了标准贝叶斯缩放与均值损失缩放的后验效果。
AI.motivation: 在科学和高风险应用中，可靠的UQ对神经网络部署至关重要，但全贝叶斯推断在计算上不可行，因此需要可扩展的近似方法。
AI.method: 基于经验损失定义的广义贝叶斯后验，在预训练权重附近的活跃曲率子空间中构造局部高斯近似；保留子空间的后验方差有闭式解，先验方差通过经验贝叶斯校准；比较标准贝叶斯缩放与均值损失缩放两种后验缩放。
AI.result: 标准缩放会导致后验方差随数据规模在主导活跃方向上收缩，在回归中迫使框架保留额外弱曲率方向以达到标称覆盖率，从而降低预测区间的一致性并使预测均值偏离预训练模型；均值损失缩放则产生更稳定、更低维的活跃子空间，并给出校准且一致的预测置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 广义拉普拉斯活跃子空间为神经网络提供了一条实用且可扩展的校准不确定性量化路径。

title: Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables effective capability transfer between language models, yet the mechanisms underlying its failures are not fully understood. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning, OPD with larger-scale teachers exhibits early loss plateaus, with an average final loss reduction of 25.1% after 200 updates, compared with 96.2% for self-RL teachers, obtained by further reinforcement learning (RL) training of the initial student. To understand this difference, we analyze OPD as an idealized continuous-time dynamical system in the small-learning-rate limit. Our training-log diagnostics associate these plateaus with an early decline in a gradient-based learning-signal proxy while substantial loss remains; these measurements do not establish why the underlying gradient weakens. We further prove a local recovery guarantee for teachers sufficiently close to the initial student in a shared parameterization under regularity conditions, offering a conditional explanation for the success of self-RL teachers in our experiments. Across runs with and without loss plateaus, we observe small relative parameter changes (0.025-0.098%) and high similarity between the student's representations before and after OPD (linear CKA $>0.98$ across layers). These observations suggest that limited representation adaptation may contribute to learning-signal collapse, a hypothesis that remains to be tested. Code is available at https://github.com/leizhao7/opd-learning-signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏(OPD)失败的机制，发现大规模教师导致损失提前停滞，并将其归因于学习信号崩溃与表示适应不足。
AI.motivation: OPD能有效迁移模型能力，但其失败机制尚不清楚。实验观察到大规模教师的OPD出现早期损失停滞（200步后平均仅降25.1%，而自RL教师降96.2%），作者希望理解这一差异的成因。
AI.method: 将OPD建模为小学习率极限下的理想连续时间动力系统；通过训练日志诊断分析梯度学习信号代理；证明在共享参数化下教师足够接近初始学生时的局部恢复保证；测量学生参数与表示在OPD前后的变化。
AI.result: 训练日志显示损失停滞伴随基于梯度的学习信号代理早期下降且损失仍较高；自RL教师满足局部恢复条件因而成功；跨实验观察到极小参数变化(0.025-0.098%)和高度相似的表示(线性CKA>0.98)。
AI.conclusion: 有限的表示适应可能导致学习信号崩溃，从而解释OPD失败；作者指出该假设仍需进一步验证，测量结果尚不能确立梯度减弱的根本原因。

title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis for Visual Grounding in Vision-Language Decoders
summary: Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) pair a visual encoder with a large language model (LLM) and perform well on diverse image-text tasks, yet their reliability is often limited by decoder attention pathologies that suppress visual evidence and exacerbate hallucinations. In this paper, we revisit visual attention sinks and uncover a structured, layer-dependent behavior: across prompts, early and late decoder layers exhibit prompt-invariant attention collapse onto the same few image regions, which we term PIS (Prompt-Invariant Sinks), whereas mid layers become prompt-conditioned and drive vision-language alignment. This split suggests that treating sinks as a uniform effect is incomplete. Building on this insight, we propose SAGE (Sink-Aware Guided Emphasis), a lightweight intervention that steers decoder attention away from PIS and toward query-dependent regions of interest (ROIs) using token-aligned ROI masks derived from standard vision backbones such as CLIP, ViT, and DINOv3. Evaluated on diverse vision-encoder + decoder-only LLM VLM families, SAGE improves visual grounding, reduces hallucinations, and yields consistent gains across public downstream vision-language benchmarks, including fine-grained visual discrimination settings where localized evidence is crucial, when instantiated with backbone-derived ROI masks.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示VLM解码器注意力存在层依赖的"提示不变汇聚"(PIS)现象，并提出轻量干预方法SAGE，将注意力从PIS引导至查询相关ROI，提升视觉定位、减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型(VLM)虽性能优异，但解码器注意力存在病理问题，会抑制视觉证据并加剧幻觉。现有工作将注意力汇聚(sink)视为统一现象，忽略了其结构化、层依赖的特性。
AI.method: 作者重新审视视觉注意力汇聚，发现跨提示中层依赖行为：早期和晚期解码器层存在提示不变的注意力坍缩到少数相同图像区域(PIS)，而中间层则变为提示条件化并驱动视觉-语言对齐。基于此提出SAGE，一种轻量干预方法，利用CLIP、ViT、DINOv3等标准视觉骨干生成的token对齐ROI掩码，将解码器注意力从PIS引导至查询相关的感兴趣区域。
AI.result: 在多种视觉编码器+解码器LLM的VLM家族上评估，SAGE提升了视觉定位能力，减少了幻觉，并在多个公开视觉语言下游基准上取得一致提升，尤其在需要局部证据的细粒度视觉判别任务中效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力汇聚视为统一效应是不完整的；区分层依赖的PIS行为并采用SAGE引导注意力，是一种有效且轻量的提升VLM可靠性的方案。

title: SciTBERT: A family of chronologically consistent language models for scientific and technological language processing
summary: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.

AI.tldr: SciTBERT：时间一致的BERT系列模型，训练于论文/专利/教育网页文本，覆盖2013-2025年逐年截断，避免时间泄漏与领域偏差；并用引文进行时间一致后训练(SciTBERT-CI)。模型优于前代领域模型，并推出PatRepEval基准评估科技界面嵌入任务。
AI.motivation: 现有面向科学技术的预训练编码器虽优于通用模型，但训练语料的时间与来源分布不受约束，存在"前瞻"(lookahead)与领域偏差，难以研究科学、技术及其界面的时间依赖或档案性质。
AI.method: 构建SciTBERT系列：基于BERT，用论文、专利与高质量教育网页文本训练，逐年数据截断日期覆盖2013-2025；再用论文与专利引文做时间一致的后训练得到SciTBERT-CI。并设计PatRepEval基准（专利相关文本嵌入任务）。
AI.result: 模型总体优于前代领域专用编码器，即使受早期年份数据限制时亦然；在PatRepEval上，跨论文与专利的分类、回归、检索任务表明，对齐编码器表征与下游任务领域分布很重要，时间一致编码器可媲美或超越无时间约束训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 时间一致的科学/技术编码器能有效支持研究科学与技术的时间依赖与界面问题，性能不因时间约束而牺牲。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 论文研究树式推测解码中draft-target不匹配问题，通过target-flow视角提出最优精确验证器与draft-tree训练方法（TEV与ExitTrain），在保持固定树等价性下提升接受长度并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 树式推测解码一次可验证多个draft续写，但由draft分数构建的有限树存在draft-target不匹配，限制了接受率与效率。
AI.method: 提出target-flow视角，识别canonical exit law并给出期望输出块长度的界；据此设计TEV——使用一次exit-node决策与一次bonus-token决策的精确、层级并行验证过程；并以缺失target概率作为节点级反馈，提出ExitTrain在推理时draft树上进行exit-guided训练。
AI.result: 在对话、代码与数学推理任务上验证固定树等价性：ExitTrain使平均输出块长度提升13%，TEV使验证阶段延迟降低15%，相对DDTree实现14%端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了两类改进机会：更好的draft树以提高接受率，以及更直接的验证以降低延迟。

title: Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System for Mimicking Human-like Car Following Behavior
summary: This study presents the Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System (NeMeFIS), a hierarchical machine learning architecture that asymmetrically models acceleration and deceleration in car following behavior by integrating five human memory types procedural, working, episodic, semantic, and declarative. By linking external variables to memory functions via metaheuristics and validating them through factor and p-value analyses, NeMeFIS uncovers latent cognitive influences across Arterial, Collector, and Rural Highway corridors for different types of vehicles. Results from 54 different trained models emphasize cognitive thresholds shaped by driver perception limits and cognitive load. The trained NeMeFIS models outperform traditional statistical and conventional machine learning models in replicating realistic driving behavior, including comparisons with Linear Regression, ANFIS, and LSTM architectures. Fuzzy rule analysis reveals that declarative memory demands the highest rule, especially during deceleration, indicating complex braking decisions. Procedural memory drives acceleration, while semantic and declarative memory guide deceleration. Risk perception also emerges as a key factor, particularly on urban roads. Validated on both heterogeneous and homogeneous datasets, NeMeFIS offers a robust framework for modeling driver cognition. The findings support psychotherapeutic applications and the development of adaptive, human-like decision systems in Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) to enhance traffic safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeMeFIS分层机器学习架构，通过整合五种人类记忆类型不对称地建模跟驰行为中的加速与减速，在多个道路走廊和车辆类型上优于传统统计与机器学习模型。
AI.motivation: 传统跟驰模型难以刻画驾驶行为中加速与减速的不对称性，以及人脑记忆与认知对驾驶决策的潜在影响，需要更贴近人类认知的建模框架。
AI.method: 构建NeMeFIS分层模糊推理系统，整合程序性、工作、情景、语义、陈述性五种记忆；用元启发式方法将外部变量链接到记忆函数，并通过因子分析与p值检验验证；在不同道路走廊和车辆类型上训练54个模型。
AI.result: NeMeFIS模型在复现真实驾驶行为上优于线性回归、ANFIS和LSTM；模糊规则分析显示陈述性记忆需求最高（尤其减速时），程序性记忆驱动加速，语义与陈述性记忆引导减速，风险感知（尤其城市道路）为关键因素；在异质与同质数据集上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: NeMeFIS为建模驾驶员认知提供稳健框架，支持心理治疗应用及面向CAV的类人自适应决策系统开发，以提升交通安全。

title: Conditional Residual Prediction: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion without a Bidirectional Teacher
summary: Causal video diffusion models generate video autoregressively, which suits streaming, interactive, and long-video generation. Under standard training, however, they often yield lower generation quality than bidirectional models of the same size. Many existing approaches address this gap by initializing from or distilling a pretrained bidirectional teacher. We instead train a causal model from an image-model initialization, with no bidirectional video model at any stage. Because this path requires neither a large bidirectional teacher nor a complex distillation pipeline, it is simpler and more scalable. On this path, we find that a causal model trained on ground-truth history becomes strongly dependent on it, so that at inference errors in its own generated history propagate forward. We hypothesize that much of this dependence is unnecessary, because the current input already determines much of what the history provides. We propose Conditional Residual Prediction (CRP), a simple recipe for reducing a model's reliance on a condition: the model first predicts the target without the condition, and the condition may only add a residual on top of this prediction. Applied to history, CRP makes the model predict each chunk from the present as far as it can and use the past only for what the present cannot supply. In controlled experiments, CRP nearly closes the 6.14-point gap to a bidirectional model trained under the same setup. Scaling this recipe, we train Optica, a 2B-parameter causal video model that autoregressively generates 5-second 480p videos and reaches 82.78 on VBench with only about 15M training videos.

AI.tldr: 提出条件残差预测(CRP)，让因果视频扩散模型主要依赖当前输入、历史仅作残差，从图像模型初始化训练出2B模型Optica，在VBench达82.78。
AI.motivation: 因果视频扩散模型适合流式/交互/长视频生成，但同规模下质量低于双向模型。现有方法依赖预训练双向教师做初始化或蒸馏，需要大教师和复杂流程。作者希望走无需双向视频模型的更简单、可扩展路径，但发现因果模型在真实历史训练后会强烈依赖历史，推理时自身生成历史的误差会向前传播。
AI.method: 假设历史依赖大多不必要（当前输入已决定历史提供的大部分信息）。提出条件残差预测(CRP)：模型先在不使用条件下预测目标，条件只能在此预测之上添加残差。用于历史时，模型尽量从当前块预测，仅用过去补充当前无法提供的信息。全程无需双向视频教师，仅从图像模型初始化训练因果模型。
AI.result: 受控实验中，CRP几乎弥合了与同设置双向模型之间6.14分的差距。扩展该配方训练出Optica：2B参数因果视频模型，自回归生成5秒480p视频，仅用约1500万训练视频，VBench达82.78。
AI.conclusion: CRP能有效降低因果模型对历史的依赖、缓解误差累积，且无需双向教师或蒸馏即可接近双向模型质量。该路径简单可扩展，最终实现高性能的流式因果视频生成模型。

title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
summary: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型作为"研究世界模型"(RWM)，用于预测研究干预的实验结果，并验证其能支持受限预算下的自我改进。
AI.motivation: AI研究智能体提出实验的速度远超其执行实验的能力，因此结果预测成为有限实验预算下持续自我改进的关键能力。
