AI.method: 基于9个研究环境（覆盖预训练、后训练、推理）的2600+实验记录（超171,000 H100 GPU小时），评估语言模型作为RWM预测候选干预结果的能力，并进行跨环境迁移与多轮Autoresearch实验及13个模型的消融。
AI.result: 真实实验经验使同环境未见干预的预测提升（Spearman +0.27）并可跨环境复用；仅用OLMo3、Marin、Nanochat的预训练经验，使Qwen3环境的选择遗憾降低78%；固定预算下多轮Autoresearch中，环境内与跨环境知识分别提升最佳增益15.8%和11.6%；加入研究知识比更换模型或增加推理努力更能改善干预排序。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将语言模型作为研究世界模型，并激励积累实验数据以用于未来RWM训练。

title: What Output-Only Review Cannot Verify: Study Contracts for Research Agents
comment: 15 pages, 4 tables. Preprint. Not peer reviewed. Companion manuscripts prepared in parallel
summary: Some defects in an AI-generated study can be identified from its artifacts; others require knowledge of what was approved before execution. We propose study contracts that bind declared experimental choices, run obligations and claim scope to recorded execution evidence, and distinguish this contract-relative verification from scientific truth. A diagnostic using eight self-authored clean/mutated pairs illustrates the information boundary. A deterministic checker applying a registered, fault-specific rule to approved and executed objects detected all eight registered mutations. Across eighteen recorded judge aliases given individual metadata-filtered packages without pair context or the registry-selected fault label, 104 of 144 mutated evaluation cases received defect flags; the remaining cases comprised 32 abstentions and eight terminal failures, with no explicit clean decisions on mutated cases. Some packages retained approval and execution fields, including digests. The prompt instructed judges to abstain when evidence was insufficient. These results characterize a deliberately information-asymmetric development setting; they do not isolate the effect of authoritative information from differences in task specification and rule selection, and they are not comparative verifier quality or agent reward hacking. We identify full-information comparisons, legitimate-adaptation controls and closed-loop agent evaluations as necessary tests of whether contract checks improve useful compliant completion under optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出"研究契约"，将实验选择、运行义务与主张范围绑定到执行证据，区分契约验证与科学真理，并用诊断实验考察信息边界。
AI.motivation: AI生成研究的某些缺陷可从产物发现，另一些需知道执行前批准了什么，故需一种绑定声明与执行证据的验证机制。
AI.method: 设计研究契约，绑定声明实验选择、运行义务与主张范围至记录的执行证据；用八对自撰的干净/变异样本做诊断，另用确定性检查器按注册的故障特定规则检查批准与执行对象；并让十八个评判别名在无配对上下文和故障标签的条件下评估。
AI.result: 确定性检查器检出全部八个注册变异；144个变异评估案例中104个获缺陷标记，32个弃权、8个终止失败，无对变异案例的明确干净判定；部分包保留批准与执行字段（含摘要）；提示要求证据不足时弃权。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画的是刻意信息不对称的开发环境，不能隔离权威信息效应与任务规范、规则选择差异，也非比较验证器质量或奖励黑客；需全信息比较、合法适应控制和闭环智能体评估来检验契约检查是否在优化下提升合规完成。

title: Residual spectral instabilities in representation learning
summary: Learned representations can lose latent degrees of freedom successively, suggesting a cascade of transitions whose underlying stability principle remains unclear. Here we formulate dimension-wise posterior collapse in variational autoencoder (VAE) as a fluctuation theory around partially collapsed states. Interpreting the negative evidence lower bound as an effective free energy, its quadratic expansion defines a Gaussian theory whose Hessian acts as a mass matrix for latent fluctuations. We show that the collapsed directions form an invariant fluctuation sector and derive its exact mass spectrum in terms of a conditional residual operator. A local reactivation direction lowers the free energy when the decoder variance falls below the residual spectral upper edge, with equality marking marginality. The criterion recovers principal component thresholds in the linear Gaussian VAE limit. Viewed in reverse along continuously connected branches, the reactivation boundary provides a local criterion for successive collapse. Numerical continuation experiments show successive loss of latent dimensions near these spectral marginalities. These results support a spectral cascade interpretation governed by residual information left unexplained by the surviving representation.

title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.

AI.tldr: TokenRouter 是一个面向 token 级 LLM 路由推理的高效易用服务系统，通过请求中心编程、模型中心执行及延迟批处理调度，实现 2.01-64.15x 解码吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: token 级细粒度路由可提升效率与质量，但现有基于单 LLM 假设的系统存在严重的步骤不同步、批次准入延迟高及实现复杂度大的问题。
AI.method: 采用"请求中心编程、模型中心执行"原则：开发者以单请求视角描述路由逻辑，运行时为每个 LLM 启动 subserver 并异步分发请求；每个 subserver 使用延迟批处理调度器，其最优超参数由系统吞吐数学模型推导。
AI.result: 在多种路由算法、工作负载和模型组合下，TokenRouter 的解码吞吐比现有系统高 2.01-64.15x。
AI.conclusion: TokenRouter 显著提升 token 级 LLM 路由的服务效率，兼具高效性与开发者友好性，代码已开源。

title: Safe Actions Alone Do Not Ensure Safe Agents: Identifying Unfulfilled Obligations with Guard Models
comment: 21 pages. Code, data, and supplementary materials: https://github.com/THU-Agent/ObligationGuard
summary: Guard models are increasingly used to safeguard LLM-based agents, primarily by identifying actions that agents are forbidden to perform. However, identifying forbidden actions alone is insufficient to ensure agent safety. In this paper, we argue that agent safety also depends on identifying required yet unperformed safety-critical actions, which we call obligations. Our preliminary study on a popular benchmark for evaluating safety shows that 56.92% of GLM-5.3 trajectories contain unfulfilled obligations, compared with only 30.00% containing forbidden actions. This finding reveals unfulfilled obligations as a major and previously overlooked source of safety risk. However, to our knowledge, no existing benchmark evaluates whether guard models can identify these obligations. To close this gap, we introduce ObligationBench, the first benchmark for evaluating the capability of obligation identification, comprising 240 expert-validated trajectories covering issue resolution, feature development, and terminal operations. Our evaluation of 14 representative models reveals substantial limitations: the highest recall and exact-match rate are only 48.97% and 10.00%, respectively. To address these limitations, we develop ObligationGuard using 40,000 synthetic training examples. ObligationGuard achieves 57.52% recall and an exact-match rate of 21.67%, surpassing all evaluated models on both metrics. We call on the community to incorporate obligation identification into the design and evaluation of future guard models to improve agent safety.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅识别"禁止行为"不足以保障智能体安全，还需识别"未被履行的必需安全关键行为"（义务）。作者构建了首个义务识别基准ObligationBench，并开发ObligationGuard模型，在召回率和精确匹配率上超越现有模型。
AI.motivation: Guard模型主要识别AI智能体被禁止执行的动作，但仅靠禁止项无法确保安全。作者发现未履行的义务是此前被忽视的主要安全风险来源（GLM-5.3轨迹中56.92%含未履行义务，远高于30.00%的禁止行为），而现有基准无法评估模型识别义务的能力。
AI.method: 1) 初步研究揭示未履行义务的普遍性；2) 构建ObligationBench基准，含240条经专家验证的轨迹，覆盖问题解决、功能开发、终端操作三类任务；3) 评估14个代表性模型；4) 用40,000条合成训练样本开发ObligationGuard模型。
AI.result: 14个模型的最高召回率仅48.97%，精确匹配率仅10.00%。ObligationGuard达到57.52%召回率和21.67%精确匹配率，在两项指标上均超过所有被评估模型。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁社区将义务识别纳入未来guard模型的设计与评估中，以提升智能体安全性。

title: How to post-train on a surrogate: Envelope sampling mitigates reward hacking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly post-trained against LLM judges and other cheap surrogates because the true reward, such as human preference, is too expensive to query at scale. This practice often leads to reward hacking, where reinforcement learning against a miscalibrated surrogate leads to undesirable side effects. In this work, we study a setting in which a small number $n$ of model outputs are annotated with ground-truth labels (e.g., from expert review) and used to recalibrate the LLM judge before optimizing against it. Prior approaches to judge recalibration are costly or heuristic, and it is known that on-policy sampling fails when the surrogate is miscalibrated on a rare set of outputs. In this work, we propose envelope sampling, a theoretically-grounded method for judge recalibration that seeks to minimize an upper bound on the regret of the post-trained model under the assumption that the human reward and re-calibrated reward lie in an $L^2$ ball around the judge. We give practical algorithms to sample from the envelope by rejection or by fine-tuning against a modified reward, and experiments on clinical note generation and on a controlled sycophancy task show that recalibrating on envelope samples mitigates reward hacking where recalibrating on base-model samples does not.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"envelope sampling"，一种有理论基础的裁判重校准方法，用于缓解LLM后训练中的reward hacking问题。
AI.motivation: LLM通常针对LLM裁判等廉价替代奖励进行后训练，但替代奖励校准不当会导致reward hacking。现有裁判重校准方法成本高或依赖启发式，且当替代奖励在稀有输出集上校准错误时，on-policy采样会失效。
AI.method: 提出envelope sampling：在假设人类奖励与重校准奖励位于裁判的L²球内的前提下，最小化后训练模型遗憾的上界。给出通过拒绝采样或针对修改后奖励微调来从envelope采样的实用算法。
AI.result: 在临床笔记生成任务和受控谄媚（sycophancy）任务上的实验表明，基于envelope样本的重校准能缓解reward hacking，而基于基础模型样本的重校准无法做到。
AI.conclusion: Envelope sampling为裁判重校准提供了理论驱动的实用方案，能有效缓解reward hacking，优于传统on-policy采样重校准。

title: Stop My Dancing! Understanding, Detecting and Attributing Motion-Aware Deepfake Videos
summary: Pose-guided diffusion models can now synthesize entire human figures in motion, spawning a new class of deepfakes: Motion Aware Deepfake (MAD) that have already reached hundreds of millions of viewers. To better understand this emerging threat, we construct the first MAD-specific benchmark and measurement framework, containing over 1.5 million frames that mix 1,363 real and 30,122 synthetic videos from six controllable generators, with realistic perturbations and open-world evaluation splits. Then, we dissect MAD and discover that, despite their global coherence, these videos betray faint yet reliable cues: because the model relies on limited input frames for motion synthesis, it must predict and simulate coherent movement at motion boundaries, thereby producing high-frequency artifacts along with model-specific spectral fingerprints. Based on the observations obtained from analysis on dataset, we propose MoDA, the first defense framework tailored to detect and attribute MAD videos. MoDA couples spatial semantics with steganalysis-rich frequency features via cross-domain alignment and multi-scale aggregation, achieving 94.8% in-distribution and 89.1% cross-dataset detection accuracy gains of 10% to 25% over prior work and 91.5% model attribution accuracy. MoDA achieves 81.94% accuracy on 200 clips produced by two unseen commercial MAD platforms, indicating promising zero-shot transfer, and 78.13% detection accuracy on 1,200 unseen MAD video clips (55k frames in total) collected from the open Internet. Under white-box, gray-box, and black-box adaptive attacks, MoDA maintains relatively stable detection and attribution performance while the accuracies of the baselines drop rapidly.

AI.tldr: 提出首个Motion Aware Deepfake（MAD）基准与检测归属框架MoDA，利用时空语义与频域特征跨域对齐，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 姿态引导扩散模型可生成整段运动的真人视频，催生大量MAD假视频，威胁巨大，但缺乏专门基准与检测方法。
AI.method: 构建含150万帧、1363真实+30122合成视频的基准；发现MAD在运动边界有高频伪影与频谱指纹；提出MoDA，融合空间语义与隐写分析频域特征，采用跨域对齐与多尺度聚合进行检测与归属。
AI.result: 分布内94.8%、跨数据集89.1%检测准确率，较前人提升10-25%；模型归属91.5%；对未见商业平台81.94%、互联网视频78.13%；在自适应攻击下性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: MoDA是首个针对MAD的检测与归属框架，具良好泛化与鲁棒性，为应对新兴深度伪造威胁提供有效防御。

title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://egocentricvoice.github.io/
summary: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoVoice，一个用于训练和评估主动式第一人称语音助手（epocentric spoken assistant）的框架，能基于连续的第一人称视频流决定何时说话以及说什么。
AI.motivation: 现有系统分别推进了主动式视频助手、语音对话系统和第一人称任务理解，但都未能解决从连续第一人称流中联合决定"何时发言"与"说什么"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 基于HoloAssist真实人类指导视频，通过源分离与语音重合成构建干净音频流，并将每个视频会话转换为模型需逐时刻判断沉默或给出语音指导的格式；微调一个全模态LLM，并使用直接偏好优化（DPO）改进其主动干预行为。
AI.result: 在闭源与开源模型上的实验表明，现有系统很少产生时机恰当、有意义的主动干预；EgoVoice在干预时机、内容相关性和人类偏好方面相较zero-shot基座模型均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: EgoVoice为连续第一人称流中的主动式语音助手提供了可行的训练与评估框架，显著优于现有零样本系统。

title: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
comment: 33 pages (12 non-appendix pages), 7 figures, published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
summary: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain. However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful. We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain. Leveraging the SSH, we introduce RouterInterp, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations. On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with ${\sim}65\%$ higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods. This work provides a scalable method for generating more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"叠加特化假设"(SSH)，认为MoE专家特化于细粒度特征的并集而非单一领域，并基于此提出RouterInterp解释路由决策，在gpt-oss-20b上检测准确率提升约65%。
AI.motivation: 主流假设认为MoE专家特化于单一连贯领域，但基于此假设的可解释性研究大多失败，作者希望为专家特化机制提供替代解释并提升路由可解释性。
AI.method: 提出叠加特化假设(SSH)：专家特化于细粒度特征的并集而非单一领域；据此设计RouterInterp方法，识别最能预测路由决策的稀疏自编码器(SAE)特征，并生成统一的自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在gpt-oss-20b上，RouterInterp解释专家路由的检测准确率比先前基于token统计的方法高约65%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了更准确解释专家路由的可扩展方法，加深了对基础模型中此前难以解释组件的理解。

title: Memorization and Malign Generalization in Conditional Diffusion Models with Random Features
summary: Conditional diffusion models generate diverse, novel, and high-quality samples under prescribed conditions. However, theoretical understanding of their memorization and generalization remains limited, while recent works have characterized these behaviors primarily in unconditional settings. In this work, we analyze a random-feature conditional score model in the high-dimensional proportional limit, deriving asymptotic expressions for training and test losses. By decomposing the test loss, we show that in the overparameterized regime, increasing model width improves prediction of the condition-dependent mean while reducing within-condition prediction variance, a phenomenon we term "malign generalization." Furthermore, analyzing the training loss reveals that more informative conditions lead to memorization of training samples at smaller widths. These theoretical findings are supported by experiments with U-Net architectures on realistic data.

AI.tldr: 本文在高维比例极限下分析随机特征条件分数模型，揭示条件扩散模型中的“恶性泛化”现象及记忆与条件信息量的关系。
AI.motivation: 条件扩散模型能生成多样高质量样本，但其记忆与泛化的理论理解有限，且现有工作主要在无条件设置下刻画这些行为。
AI.method: 分析高维比例极限下的随机特征条件分数模型，推导训练损失与测试损失的渐近表达式，并分解测试损失。
AI.result: 在过参数化区域，增大模型宽度会改善对条件相关均值的预测，同时降低条件内预测方差（即“恶性泛化”）；训练损失分析表明，条件信息越丰富，训练样本在更小宽度下即被记忆。实验用U-Net在真实数据上验证。
AI.conclusion: 理论刻画了条件扩散模型的记忆与泛化行为，提出并解释了“恶性泛化”现象，且由U-Net实验支持。

title: Parametric Trajectory Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion and flow models require many sequential evaluations, making generation computationally expensive. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but poses a capacity allocation problem: a student must match the teacher's iterative generation with far less sequential computation. Existing trajectory methods ask the student to reproduce teacher transitions that are highly curved at high noise, which can exceed its capacity and degrade fine detail. We introduce Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD), which lets the student parameterize teacher trajectory segments as polynomials and learn from teacher guidance along its own predicted path. PTD is designed to let the learned curvature adapt to the backbone's predictive capacity, preserving motion and diversity. The curvature head is used only in training; inference keeps the original backbone architecture. On Wan2.1-14B, four-step PTD sets a new state of the art for trajectory distillation, significantly improving dynamic quality and naturalness over PDD, the best-performing trajectory-only method on this model, under the same training setting. On the 33B audio-video MiniMax-H3, LoRA-trained PTD significantly improves diversity and naturalness over the state-of-the-art LightX2V Turbo. Blinded human votes give PTD 55.1% and 63.4% preference shares against PDD and LightX2V Turbo. Project page: https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/PTD/.

AI.tldr: 提出参数化轨迹蒸馏(PTD),让学生模型用多项式参数化教师轨迹段,自适应学习曲率,实现少步视频生成蒸馏,在Wan2.1-14B和MiniMax-H3上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散/流模型需大量顺序评估,生成成本高。少步蒸馏可降本,但存在容量分配问题:学生需用远少的顺序计算匹配教师的迭代生成。现有轨迹方法让学生复现高噪声处高度弯曲的教师转移,可能超出其容量并损害细节。
AI.method: PTD让学生将教师轨迹段参数化为多项式,并沿自身预测路径学习教师引导,使学习到的曲率适应骨干网络的预测能力,保留运动与多样性。曲率头仅用于训练,推理保持原骨干架构不变。
AI.result: Wan2.1-14B上,四步PTD刷新轨迹蒸馏SOTA,动态质量与自然度显著优于同设置下最佳轨迹方法PDD;33B音视频MiniMax-H3上,LoRA训练的PTD显著提升多样性与自然度,超过SOTA LightX2V Turbo。盲测人类投票中PTD对PDD和LightX2V Turbo的偏好份额为55.1%和63.4%。
AI.conclusion: PTD通过参数化轨迹段与自适应曲率有效解决少步视频蒸馏的容量分配问题,在多个大规模模型上超越现有方法,且不改变推理架构。

title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
summary: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出HarnessSQL，一种在执行框架内原生训练的Text-to-SQL后训练框架，通过保留完整交互结构（SFT+RL）消除训练-部署不匹配，显著提升紧凑模型执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL模型直接将问题映射到静态查询，而真实数据库代理需与实时数据库进行有状态、多轮交互（检查模式、执行探测、诊断错误、修正假设）。执行框架只在推理时引入，造成严重的训练-部署不匹配。
AI.method: HarnessSQL在监督微调与强化学习中保留完整交互结构：构建隔离的可执行数据库环境与隐藏执行预言机（oracle），直接在目标SQL框架内展开教师模型，仅保留验证通过的轨迹进行全序列SFT，随后进行基于执行奖励的RL。
AI.result: 在Spider 2.0-SQLite上大幅提升紧凑模型执行准确率：Qwen3-8B从15.5%升至45.2%，Qwen3-14B从22.2%升至54.8%，并能有效迁移到BIRD-Interact、LiveSQLBench等分布外交互式基准。
AI.conclusion: 直接在执行框架内训练数据库代理，对掌握复杂、长时程的数据库工作流至关重要。

title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
summary: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

AI.tldr: 提出 Memento 3，让冻结的 LLM 智能体通过外部记忆持续学习显式世界模型：维护自然语言规则手册并编译为可执行代码，经观察-反思-修订-编译-验证循环递归自我改进。在 ARC-AGI-3 上清除 25 个公开游戏全部关卡，RHAE 100.0，仅用人类 44% 动作数；Atari Pong 学习控制器三局 21:0 获胜且无需再调用 LLM。
AI.motivation: 智能体需在不熟悉环境中推断世界运行规律并随新证据修正理解。但有限观察常支持多个世界模型，它们在已见交互上一致却对未见状态预测不同，因此需要可显式、可修订的世界模型学习机制。
AI.method: 基于 Memento 系列，冻结 LLM 智能体用外部记忆持续学习世界模型。以自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录可修订假设并保留未知部分；将其编译为可执行代码用于预测规划。通过观察、反思、规则修订、编译、验证的循环，用预测误差改进规则与代码。更新代码仅在 LLM 判定忠于规则手册且逐格重放精确复现观察转移时被接受。群体扩展并行维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据并以预测引导探索。
AI.result: ARC-AGI-3 上单模型智能体清除全部 25 个公开游戏所有关卡，平均 RHAE 100.0，仅用人类动作数的 44%。Atari Pong 案例中，学习到的反馈控制器在三个不同开局评估回合均以 21:0 获胜，且无需进一步 LLM 调用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了以模型为基础、通过外部记忆与验证式代码更新实现递归自我改进的可行路径：底层 LLM 固定不变，智能体自主探索、修订世界模型并用经验证的更新指导后续学习，在复杂推理游戏与控制任务上取得强表现。

title: From Geometry to Generalization: Why Row Normalization Can Beat Adam and Muon
summary: Different optimizers can fit the same training data while selecting classifiers with substantially different geometries, but whether this difference provably affects population performance remains unclear. We show that row-wise normalization can achieve strictly higher population accuracy than full-batch Adam, a proxy for random-reshuffling Adam, and exact-SVD Muon in high-dimensional multiclass classification. Under an isotropic Gaussian-cloud data model, this advantage arises because row normalization's class-wise Euclidean geometry asymptotically preserves the population decision-boundary directions, whereas Adam's coordinate-wise geometry and Muon's spectral geometry introduce nonvanishing distortions. Beyond isotropy, the advantage persists for full-batch training on class means with independently oriented class-mean and test-noise covariances. It holds for power-law spectra with class-mean exponent below one, even under heavily anisotropic test noise. When both covariances are diagonal and sufficiently close, the advantage over Adam can reverse, while applying the same random rotation to both restores it by changing only their alignment with Adam's coordinate axes. Synthetic and last-layer language-model experiments support the predicted advantage.

AI.tldr: 行归一化优化器在高维多分类中可比Adam和Muon获得更高的总体精度，因其类欧氏几何能渐近保留总体决策边界方向。
AI.motivation: 不同优化器可拟合相同训练数据却选择几何差异显著的分类器，但这种差异是否可证明影响总体性能尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在各向同性高斯云数据模型下理论比较行归一化、全批量Adam（随机重排Adam代理）与精确SVD Muon；并推广到类均值与测试噪声协方差独立定向、幂律谱及对角协方差等情形。
AI.result: 行归一化严格优于Adam和Muon；其优势源于类欧氏几何保留总体决策边界方向，而Adam的坐标几何与Muon的谱几何引入非消失失真。协方差对角且接近时优势可反转，对两者施加相同随机旋转可恢复优势；合成与末层语言模型实验支持预测。
AI.conclusion: 优化器的几何选择可证明地影响高维分类的总体性能，行归一等类欧氏几何在多种数据条件下具有优势。

title: MSGAT: Multi-Head Spiking Graph Attention with Similarity-Space Fusion for Image-Text Retrieval
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient computing paradigm through sparse event-driven computation, showing great potential for efficient multimodal learning. However, applying SNNs to high-level multimodal tasks, such as image-text retrieval (ITR), remains challenging, since sparse spike representations make it difficult to capture semantic structures required for cross-modal alignment. Existing spiking ITR methods rely on local alignment and additional soft-label supervision during training, while lacking awareness of structural and multi-granularity relationships. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-head Spiking Graph Attention Network (\textbf{MSGAT}) for structural modeling and equip it with dynamic attention heads to capture complementary relational patterns and enable spike-driven graph reasoning and aggregation. However, within a two-branch multi-granularity fusion framework, the fine-grained spike representations generated by MSGAT are sparse and discrete, whereas the global representations are continuous, making conventional feature-level fusion susceptible to interference across heterogeneous representations. Therefore, we introduce \textbf{Sim-Fuse}, a similarity-space fusion alignment strategy integrating coarse- and fine-grained matching relations while avoiding direct fusion of heterogeneous representations. Experiments on Flickr30K and MSCOCO show our method outperforms ANN methods under matched settings and existing SNN retrieval baselines. Moreover, with only two time steps, our SNN achieves comparable or superior performance to its ANN counterpart while reducing theoretical module-level energy by 55\%. The code is provided in the Supplementary Materials.

AI.tldr: 提出MSGAT与Sim-Fuse，实现脉冲神经网络图像-文本检索的结构化建模与相似度空间融合对齐。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络SNN能高效多模态学习，但稀疏脉冲难以捕捉跨模态对齐所需的语义结构。现有脉冲ITR方法依赖局部对齐和额外软标签监督，缺乏结构与多粒度关系感知。
AI.method: 提出多头脉冲图注意力网络MSGAT进行结构建模，配备动态注意力头捕捉互补关系模式，实现脉冲驱动的图推理与聚合；在两分支多粒度融合框架中，引入Sim-Fuse相似度空间融合对齐策略，整合粗细粒度匹配关系，避免异构表示直接融合。
AI.result: 在Flickr30K和MSCOCO上，方法在同等设置下超越ANN方法及现有SNN检索基线；仅用两个时间步，SNN性能与ANN相当或更优，同时理论模块级能耗降低55%。
AI.conclusion: MSGAT与Sim-Fuse有效提升脉冲SNN图像-文本检索能力，兼顾性能与能效，代码见补充材料。

title: VFold: Symmetry-Aware Cross-Layer Value Cache Compression
summary: While caching key-value (KV) states accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) decoding, this cache can dominate memory usage at long context lengths. One solution is to compress this memory by exploiting inter-layer cache similarities. However, most existing techniques necessitate architectural changes to LLMs and incur substantial overhead. In this work, we propose a symmetry-aware value cache merging strategy that reduces cache memory while avoiding both harmful performance degradation and architectural overhead during decoding. Furthermore, we show that this approach can be exploited alongside existing cache compression techniques, composing with high-ratio quantization or key cache pruning to reach compression ratios that neither method reaches alone, with minimal additional cost. Ultimately, our findings reveal a major source of underutilized capacity in the value cache, offering a simple yet highly effective direction for scaling context windows under memory constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种对称感知的值缓存合并策略，可在解码时减少KV缓存内存，避免性能损害与架构改动，并可与量化、键缓存剪枝等现有方法组合使用。
AI.motivation: 长上下文下KV缓存主导内存占用，现有利用层间缓存相似性压缩方法需改动LLM架构且开销大。
AI.method: 基于对称性设计值缓存合并策略，在解码过程中合并值缓存，无需架构修改，并可叠加高比例量化或键缓存剪枝。
AI.result: 在避免明显性能退化和额外开销的同时降低缓存内存，且组合后达到单一方法无法企及的压缩比，额外成本极小。
AI.conclusion: 值缓存中存在大量未被利用的冗余容量，该简单方法为内存受限下扩展上下文窗口提供了有效方向。

title: Probability-Signature Dynamics: Unpacking Modular Addition Learning Within Two-Layer Networks
summary: Neural networks trained on modular addition tasks often develop Fourier-structured representations that support exact generalization. While prior work has identified these Fourier circuits, the mechanism by which gradient-based training selects them from the data distribution remains unclear. We address this question using probability signatures, which express leading gradient interactions through conditional statistics of the training distribution. For modular addition, these signatures are cyclic shift operators and are diagonalized by the discrete Fourier transform, yielding approximately decoupled Fourier-mode dynamics. This explains the emergence of Fourier sparsity, frequency matching, and phase alignment. The same framework resolves a puzzle under label noise: corrupted examples can show faster early loss decrease than clean examples, despite lacking a coherent generalization rule. We show that noise increases conditional label collisions, strengthening early shared-coordinate reinforcement. Finally, this method can be applied to other operators. Taking XOR as an example, we observed the predicted frequency in experiments.

AI.tldr: 该论文用"概率签名"解释梯度训练如何在模加法任务中选择Fourier电路，揭示Fourier稀疏性、频率匹配与相位对齐的机制，并解释标签噪声下的学习现象，方法可推广至XOR等算子。
AI.motivation: 先前工作虽已识别出模加法任务中的Fourier电路，但梯度训练如何从数据分布中"选择"这些电路仍不清楚；此外，标签噪声下损坏样本早期损失下降更快这一反直觉现象也缺乏解释。
AI.method: 提出"概率签名"（probability signatures），用训练分布的条件统计量表达主要梯度交互。对模加法，签名是循环移位算子，可被离散Fourier变换对角化，从而得到近似解耦的Fourier模式动力学。
AI.result: 该框架解释了Fourier稀疏性、频率匹配与相位对齐的出现；并表明噪声增加了条件标签碰撞、强化早期共享坐标的更新，从而解释损坏样本早期损失下降更快的现象。在XOR任务上实验观测到预测的频率。
AI.conclusion: 概率签名提供了一个理解梯度训练为何选择结构化（Fourier）表示的统一框架，并能推广到其他二元算子，兼具解释性与预测能力。

title: NP-Hardness of Minimizing Neurons in Two-Hidden-Layer ReLU Neural Networks
summary: A fundamental question in neural network architecture optimization is whether the minimum hidden-neuron count required to approximate a target function within a prescribed tolerance can be computed efficiently. This paper resolves this question for two-hidden-layer ReLU networks under an $L^p(\mathbb{R}^d,\mathbb{R}^m)$ approximation constraint. For every fixed $d \ge 1$, $m \ge 1$, and $1 \le p < \infty$, we prove that computing the optimum exactly is NP-hard. The result holds even when the target is represented by a rational ReLU network whose realization is nonzero, componentwise nonnegative, compactly supported, globally Lipschitz, and continuous piecewise affine. The polynomial-time reduction from 3-SAT produces an architecture gap in which unsatisfiable formulas yield an optimum of zero, whereas satisfiable formulas yield an optimum of at least $d+2$. The proof constructs compactly supported polyhedral frustum functions realized by two-hidden-layer ReLU networks and establishes the $L^p$-density of finite linear combinations of box-frustum functions. The results offer theoretical justification for employing heuristic approximation methods in the design of ReLU neural networks, illustrating that attaining a minimal configuration within polynomial time is computationally unachievable.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：在 L^p 逼近约束下，精确计算两层隐藏层 ReLU 网络逼近目标函数所需的最小隐藏神经元数目是 NP-hard 的。
AI.motivation: 神经网络架构优化的核心问题是：能否高效计算在给定误差容忍度下逼近目标函数所需的最少隐藏神经元数。本文针对双层隐藏层 ReLU 网络回答该问题。
AI.method: 对固定 d≥1、m≥1、1≤p<∞，通过从 3-SAT 的多项式时间归约证明精确求最优是 NP-hard；构造由双层 ReLU 网络实现的紧支撑多面锥台函数，并证明箱式锥台函数有限线性组合的 L^p 稠密性。
AI.result: 即使目标由有理 ReLU 网络表示且满足非零、逐分量非负、紧支撑、全局 Lipschitz、连续分片仿射，精确计算仍为 NP-hard。归约产生架构间隙：不可满足公式最优值为 0，可满足公式最优值至少为 d+2。
AI.conclusion: 结果为 ReLU 网络设计中使用启发式近似方法提供理论依据，表明多项式时间内达到最小配置在计算上不可行。

title: HAND: A Biologically-Inspired Activation Function that Improves Generalisation and Sample Efficiency in Image Classification
summary: DNNs exhibit robustness and generalisation issues not seen in humans. They are also far less data-efficient learners, requiring considerably more training samples to accurately classify novel exemplars. Inductive bias could help with these issues by providing in-built mechanisms to improve generalisation, and hence, reduce reliance on learning from data. We incorporate a biologically-inspired inductive bias into a new activation function, HAND (Homeostasis, Accelerating Nonlinearity, and Divisive-nomalisation), and show its effectiveness with CNNs trained on image classification. Using HAND a ConvNeXt-tiny required 25 training epochs to reach the same accuracy on ImageNet1k as the unmodified model achieved after 200 epochs. Consistent with the effects of an inductive bias, the performance gap reduced with training time and increased data augmentation. When the volume of training data was reduced and unevenly distributed between classes (Long-tailed ImageNet) the improvements in accuracy were even larger and did not reduce with increased training time. Generalisation performance with the common-corruptions data, and the ability to reject samples from unknown classes, were unaffected or improved by HAND. Results generalised across CNN architectures and training data-sets. HAND can, therefore, reduce the required training time and/or the required volume and variety of training data, helping to improve sample efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种生物启发的激活函数 HAND（稳态、加速非线性、分裂归一化），将其作为归纳偏置引入 CNN，显著提升图像分类的样本效率与训练速度。
AI.motivation: DNN 在鲁棒性、泛化性和数据效率上远逊于人类，需要大量样本才能准确分类新样本。归纳偏置可通过内置机制改善泛化，从而减少对数据的依赖。
AI.method: 将生物启发的归纳偏置融入新激活函数 HAND（包含稳态、加速非线性、分裂归一化三个机制），并在图像分类 CNN 上进行验证，测试覆盖多种架构与数据集。
AI.result: ConvNeXt-tiny 使用 HAND 仅需 25 个 epoch 即可达到原模型 200 epoch 的 ImageNet1k 精度；性能差距随训练时间与数据增强增加而缩小。在数据量减少且类别不平衡（Long-tailed ImageNet）时提升更大且不随训练时间衰减。常见损坏泛化性能与未知类拒识能力不受影响或有所改善，结果在不同 CNN 架构和数据集上均可复现。
AI.conclusion: HAND 能减少所需训练时间和/或训练数据的规模与多样性，有效提升样本效率。

title: Which Skill to Distill? SGUID: Selecting a Compact Skill Bank for Model-Skill Co-Evolution
summary: Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.

AI.tldr: 绝大多数检索到的技能对蒸馏无用，SGUID通过筛选稳定有效的技能子集实现模型-技能协同进化。
AI.motivation: 已有工作仅按语义相关性检索技能并用于推理或蒸馏，忽视单个技能的实际效用。作者发现on-policy蒸馏中不足25%的检索技能能提供有效学习信号。
AI.method: 提出SGUID：仅保留在训练中持续产生有效学习信号的技能，蒸馏这些精选技能得到更好模型；蒸馏后由模型rollout构建新候选库，再进行下一轮选择，实现模型-技能协同进化。
AI.result: 在Olmo和Qwen四个模型上，6个精选技能在三/四个模型上匹配或超过全库蒸馏（全库大至11倍）；第二轮选3个新技能后全部超越。Qwen3-8B从64.3%升至66.3%。Qwen3-4B上未筛选更新会下降（HMMT25降0.3点），SGUID则分别提升0.5和1.1点。
AI.conclusion: 技能选择是稳定模型-技能协同进化的关键机制，并非所有技能都值得蒸馏。

title: LEVER: Adaptive Cost-Aware Proof Search Over AND/OR Graphs
summary: Mathematicians value proofs for more than correctness: among correct proofs, simplicity, purity and the computational cost of finding them vary widely. Yet LLM-powered theorem provers largely search for any correct proof, and improve its quality only after it is found. We propose LEVER, a proof search algorithm that makes the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizes it during search. LEVER scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph, combining realized objective values with predictions for open subgoals, so the objective guides search before a proof is complete. The same mechanism optimizes computational cost, proof length, topical impurity, and even their weighted combinations, while the Lean kernel enforces correctness. On PutnamBench in Lean 4, under matched budgets, LEVER costs 34% less than a strong single-conversation agent while raising the solve rate from 80% to 96%. On reducing topical impurity, i.e., how far a proof strays from its theorem's subject, it improves over post-hoc refactoring (42% reduction against 33%) at two-thirds of the cost and more reliably; on proof length, the metric refactoring is built for, it approaches refactoring. Varying the objective's weights traces a quality-cost trade-off curve, so the user can choose how much a better proof is worth. Overall, LEVER is a performant, cost-efficient and tunable proof search algorithm for navigating the space of correct proofs.

AI.tldr: 提出LEVER证明搜索算法，可在搜索过程中优化证明质量目标（如长度、纯度、计算成本及其组合），实现可编程、可调节的证明搜索。
AI.motivation: 数学家不仅看重证明的正确性，也重视简洁性、纯粹性和计算成本。但现有的LLM定理证明器大多只搜索任意正确证明，仅在证明找到后才优化其质量，无法在搜索过程中引导生成高质量证明。
AI.method: LEVER在AND/OR证明图上为部分证明打分，将已实现的目标值与开放子目标的预测相结合，使目标在证明完成前即可引导搜索。该机制可优化计算成本、证明长度、主题纯度及其加权组合，同时由Lean内核保证正确性。
AI.result: 在Lean 4的PutnamBench上，相同预算下LEVER成本比强单轮对话智能体低34%，求解率从80%提升至96%；在降低主题纯度上，相比事后重构（33%）实现42%的降低，且成本仅为其三分之二、更可靠；在证明长度上接近重构方法；调整目标权重可得到质量-成本权衡曲线。
AI.conclusion: LEVER是一个高效、低成本且可调节的证明搜索算法，能在正确证明空间中导航并优化证明质量。

title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
summary: In diffusion transformers, low-rank branches can mitigate 4-bit weight--activation (W4A4) post-training quantization (PTQ) loss by decomposing each weight into a low-bit residual and a high-precision low-rank component. Existing low-rank PTQ approaches, however, either optimize low-rank compensation and residual quantization separately, often requiring higher ranks, or rely on second-order weight updates without explicitly modeling activation quantization error, which becomes particularly pronounced under 4-bit quantization. To address these limitations, we present \method{}, a unified framework modeling low-rank-assisted W4A4 PTQ as a coupled calibration problem and deriving optimization-based solvers from the joint objective. Eliminating the output-side low-rank factor yields a \emph{deflated Hessian} that discounts residual errors already captured by the low-rank component, while an activation-noise surrogate is incorporated to suppress activation quantization error. Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 \method{} consistently outperforms rank-4 SVDQuant in PSNR and LPIPS. It further surpasses rank-32 SVDQuant on SANA-1.6B, FLUX.1-schnell, and FLUX.1-dev with an $8\times$ smaller rank and up to $6.25\times$ faster quantization. Furthermore, on the Qwen3-8B LLM, rank-4 \method{} improves MMLU accuracy from 61.50\% to 68.17\% over rank-32 SVDQuant. Overall, \method{} achieves better W4A4 performance with substantially lower rank and quantization cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架，将低秩辅助的W4A4 PTQ建模为耦合标定问题，导出deflated Hessian与激活噪声代理，实现低秩、低成本的量化。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩PTQ方法要么分别优化低秩补偿与残差量化、需更高秩，要么依赖二阶权重更新而未显式建模4-bit激活量化误差，导致W4A4误差大。
AI.method: 将低秩辅助W4A4 PTQ表述为耦合标定问题，从联合目标推导优化求解器：消去输出侧低秩因子得到deflated Hessian以折扣已被低秩部分捕捉的残差误差，并引入激活噪声代理抑制激活量化误差。
AI.result: 在五个扩散骨干上，rank-4方法在PSNR和LPIPS上持续优于rank-4 SVDQuant；在SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell、FLUX.1-dev上以8倍更小秩超越rank-32 SVDQuant，量化快至6.25倍；Qwen3-8B上MMLU从61.50%提升至68.17%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以显著更低的秩和量化成本取得更好的W4A4性能。

title: OX-NeRF: 3D X-ray Tomography Reconstruction from Sparse Views Using Implicit Neural Representation
summary: NeRF and Gaussian splatting methods have been successfully applied on X-ray scenes where the views are too sparse for 3D reconstruction via classical methods. Ultra-sparse scenes with 10 or fewer views such as those with high-rate or low-dose acquisition still, however, present a significant challenge. To address this problem we present a new framework, Optimised X-ray Neural Radiance Fields (OX-NeRF), that combines cross-scene feature learning with scene-specific optimisation to reconstruct sets of related scenes. OX-NeRF employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) to identify cross-scene features while maintaining scene-specific multi-resolution hash grids of spatial features. The paired representations are fused and passed to a multilayer perceptron (MLP); the CNN, hash grids and MLP are then jointly optimised end-to-end. Benchmarking on parallel-beam and cone-beam X-ray datasets shows OX-NeRF provides significantly higher reconstruction accuracy on ultra-sparse scenes compared to existing radiance field methods.

AI.tldr: 提出OX-NeRF框架，结合跨场景特征学习与场景特定优化，解决超稀疏（≤10视图）X射线场景的3D重建难题。
AI.motivation: NeRF和高斯泼溅已应用于X射线场景，但当视图超稀疏（≤10视图，如高帧率或低剂量采集）时，现有方法重建效果仍面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: OX-NeRF用CNN识别跨场景特征，同时维护场景特定的多分辨率哈希网格空间特征；将两类表示融合后送入MLP，并对CNN、哈希网格和MLP进行端到端联合优化。
AI.result: 在平行束和锥束X射线数据集上的基准测试显示，OX-NeRF在超稀疏场景下的重建精度显著优于现有辐射场方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合跨场景特征学习与场景特定优化可有效提升超稀疏X射线场景的3D重建精度。

title: Latent Core Tokenizer: Compress, but Meaningfully
summary: Tokenizers are commonly optimized for compression, but a compact vocabulary does not necessarily distribute its capacity evenly across languages. We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), a language-agnostic approach that separates structural discovery from vocabulary construction. LCT uses Minimum Description Length, entropy-based boundary signals, and morphotactic constraints to identify reusable linguistic units before constructing a shared vocabulary. Across 104 languages with a 200K-token vocabulary, LCT achieves lower fertility and higher MorphScore than BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, while maintaining comparable cross-lingual disparity in tokenization cost. Across four multilingual downstream benchmarks, LCT improves aggregate score by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, respectively. Our findings show that compression alone does not predict representation quality and highlight the importance of morphology-driven structural discovery and how frequency is used to allocate the final vocabulary across languages.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT)，将结构发现与词表构建分离，在104种语言上优于BPE等分词器。
AI.motivation: 现有分词器多为压缩优化，紧凑词表未必能在各语言间均匀分配容量，压缩率不能预测表示质量。
AI.method: LCT为语言无关方法，先通过最小描述长度、基于熵的边界信号和形态配列约束识别可复用语言单元，再构建共享词表，将结构发现与词表构建分离。
AI.result: 在104种语言、200K词表下，LCT相比BPE、Unigram及parity-aware BPE具有更低fertility和更高MorphScore，且跨语言分词成本差异相当；四个多语言下游基准上总分分别提升1.48、1.83、2.00分。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠压缩无法预测表示质量，形态驱动的结构发现及频率在跨语言词表分配中的作用至关重要。

title: How Is Automated Research Evaluated? A Survey of Benchmarks and Evaluation Practices
summary: Automated research systems support literature synthesis, ideation, experiments, writing, and peer review, but their evaluation is dispersed across tasks, benchmarks, and studies that are difficult to compare directly. We review this literature from the perspective of evaluation design and evidence, covering six targets: literature synthesis, research ideation, executable workflows, scholarly writing and communication, automatic peer review, and end-to-end research. We compare task construction, evidence sources, evaluators, and scoring procedures to explain the capabilities assessed by different designs. Our synthesis highlights three recurring lessons: output checks, process checks, and human studies provide complementary information; evaluator calibration is specific to the property being assessed; and resource budgets and attempt selection are integral to interpreting performance comparisons. We identify diagnostic evaluation designs and documented gaps in supporting evidence, and translate these comparisons into reporting and audit recommendations for specific evaluation settings. The survey helps readers navigate existing evaluations, select appropriate benchmarks, and design subsequent studies.

AI.tldr: 该综述从评估设计与证据角度梳理自动化研究系统的文献，覆盖六大评估目标，比较任务构建、证据来源、评估者与评分方式，总结核心经验并提出报告与审计建议。
AI.motivation: 自动化研究系统涵盖文献综合、构思、实验、写作与同行评审等环节，但其评估分散在不同任务、基准与研究中，难以直接比较，亟需系统化的评估视角梳理。
AI.method: 综述性研究：从评估设计与证据角度回顾文献，围绕六个评估目标（文献综合、研究构思、可执行工作流、学术写作与交流、自动同行评审、端到端研究），比较任务构建、证据来源、评估者和评分流程。
AI.result: 归纳出三条反复出现的经验：输出检查、过程检查与人类研究提供互补信息；评估者校准因所评估属性而异；资源预算与尝试选择是解释性能比较的组成部分。同时识别出诊断性评估设计与支持证据缺口。
AI.conclusion: 该综述将比较结果转化为针对具体评估场景的报告与审计建议，帮助读者理解现有评估、选择合适的基准并设计后续研究。

title: Sample-Efficient Generative Conformal Prediction
summary: Generative conformal prediction builds uncertainty sets from samples of a conditional generator, which are efficient only when the samples represent the response distribution well. This can require many samples, each of which can be costly, as in large diffusion models and scientific simulators, so the sampling budget must be used efficiently. Existing methods draw the same number of samples at every input, wasting samples where the response distribution is simple and undersampling where it is complex, which inflates sets and leaves those inputs under-covered. We propose CASA (Conformal Adaptive Sample Allocation), which characterizes the marginal value of an additional sample and allocates samples across inputs to minimize the expected set size subject to marginal coverage and an average sampling budget. Theoretical analysis shows that adaptive allocation yields smaller sets than a fixed count at the same budget: a missed mode forces a radius that spans the gap between modes, and even oracle radius cannot compensate for it. On synthetic and real tasks, CASA produces substantially smaller sets at the same budget, often improves conditional coverage, and complements existing radius-adaptive methods.

AI.tldr: CASA 方法在生成式共形预测中自适应分配采样预算，以最小化期望集合大小，同时满足边际覆盖与平均预算约束。
AI.motivation: 生成式共形预测依赖条件生成器采样构建不确定性集合，样本昂贵，已有方法在每个输入上固定采样数，导致简单分布处浪费、复杂分布处欠采样，集合膨胀且覆盖不足。
AI.method: 提出 CASA（Conformal Adaptive Sample Allocation），刻画额外样本的边际价值，并将其在输入间分配，以在边际覆盖和平均采样预算约束下最小化期望集合大小。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，在相同预算下自适应分配比固定采样数产生更小集合；漏掉一个模态会迫使半径跨越模态间隙，即使 oracle radius 也无法弥补。合成与真实任务上，CASA 在相同预算下显著缩小集合，常提升条件覆盖，并能补充现有半径自适应方法。
AI.conclusion: 自适应采样分配能更高效利用采样预算，降低集合大小并改善覆盖，是固定采样策略的有效替代，且可与半径自适应方法互补。

title: Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Learning for Parallel MRI Reconstruction
summary: Parallel magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction is an ill-posed inverse problem under undersampling. Multi-coil acquisition and Hankel lifting expose complementary repeated information: observations of the same anatomy across coils and repeated local k-space neighborhoods in overlapping windows. These dependencies guide recovery of missing k-space data. However, splitting lifted Hankel entries for self-supervision can place the original sample in both input and target, causing data leakage. We propose Hankel Subspace Self-Supervised Reconstruction (HSSRecon), a scan-specific reconstruction framework for parallel magnetic resonance imaging. HSSRecon partitions data by physical acquisition units before Hankel lifting and applies multiplicity normalization to repeated Hankel copies in overlapping windows. Rather than learning a mapping that directly predicts missing data, the network learns a compact complex-valued Hankel subspace operator. Reconstruction is performed over the original k-space variables using a conjugategradient solver with hard data consistency. This design separates structural learning in the Hankel domain from data consistency in the physical domain: the former exploits multi-coil and local Hankel correlations, while the latter solves over unacquired degrees of freedom. We provide theoretical analyses of physicalgroup splitting and multiplicity normalization, and establish positive definiteness, uniqueness, hard data consistency, and a finite-step conjugate-gradient error bound for the system. On fastMRI brain data with three contrasts and three sampling masks, HSSRecon achieves competitive peak signal-to-noise ratio, structural similarity, and normalized mean squared error across six aggregated conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出HSSRecon，一种扫描特定的并行MRI重建框架，通过在Hankel提升前按物理采集单元划分数据并做多重性归一化，网络学习紧凑复数Hankel子空间算子，再用共轭梯度求解器与硬数据一致性完成重建，避免自监督中的数据泄漏。
AI.motivation: 并行MRI重建是不适定逆问题。多线圈采集与Hankel提升暴露互补重复信息，但将提升后的Hankel条目拆分用于自监督可能使原始样本同时出现在输入与目标中，导致数据泄漏。
AI.method: HSSRecon在Hankel提升前按物理采集单元划分数据，并对重叠窗口中重复的Hankel副本做多重性归一化。网络不直接预测缺失数据，而是学习紧凑的复数Hankel子空间算子；重建在原始k空间变量上用带硬数据一致性的共轭梯度求解器完成，从而将Hankel域的结构学习与物理域的数据一致性分离。
AI.result: 理论上分析了物理组划分与多重性归一化，并证明系统正定性、唯一性、硬数据一致性及有限步共轭梯度误差界。在fastMRI脑部数据（三种对比度、三种采样掩码）上，HSSRecon在六个汇总条件下取得有竞争力的PSNR、SSIM与NMSE。
AI.conclusion: HSSRecon通过物理组划分与多重性归一化避免自监督数据泄漏，将Hankel子空间结构学习与物理域数据一致性解耦，在并行MRI重建中实现理论保证与有竞争力的实验性能。

title: Predicting Alignment Generalization with Value Representations
summary: LLM developers post-train their models to exhibit prosocial values and behavioral traits, which are enumerated in an alignment target. However, while recent post-training developments have yielded models that score highly on alignment evaluations, training models on sets of narrow behaviors still influences their behavior across unseen contexts and environments in unexpected ways. In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values. We conduct a large-scale analysis of alignment generalization effects across 66 values found in modern alignment targets, and benchmark representational techniques on the alignment generalization prediction task. We find that representations based on model activations when applying values in context significantly outperform methods based on textual descriptions of the values. Specifically, the best activations-based methods achieve correlations of 0.45 with our generalization matrix, compared with 0.05 from description-based baselines. We then show the applicability of representations that predict alignment generalization toward downstream tasks by using them to measure how similar the values in a multi-value alignment target are, which we find is significantly correlated with model robustness. Finally, we show initial evidence towards a shared, model-independent value space, which we use to develop the first taxonomy of LLM values grounded in empirical generalization dynamics. Our work demonstrates the importance of studying value generalization in LLMs and its application toward the more empirical design and training of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"对齐泛化预测"任务，预测微调模型遵循某价值后，在未见过价值上的行为变化；大规模分析66种价值，发现基于激活的表征显著优于基于文本描述的方法。
AI.motivation: LLM开发者通过后训练让模型展现某些亲社会价值，但对齐评估高分不代表微调窄行为不会在未见情境中以意外方式影响模型行为，因此需要研究价值泛化。
AI.method: 建立对齐泛化预测任务，进行跨66种价值的大规模分析，基准测试表征技术，并测试激活表征在下游任务中的应用及共享价值空间的证据。
AI.result: 基于激活的方法与泛化矩阵相关性达0.45，远超描述基线0.05；激活表征可衡量多价值对齐目标的相似性并与模型鲁棒性显著相关；发现共享价值空间的初步证据，构建首个基于实证泛化动态的LLM价值分类法。
AI.conclusion: 研究价值泛化对LLM至关重要，并可用于更实证化的模型行为设计与训练。

title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
summary: Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.

AI.tldr: MindFlow将研究创意生成建模为"心智中的图结构流"，由模块化思维算子组成并用概率心智超网建模，控制器动态采样思维流生成候选创意，通过锦标赛式相对排序优化，实现可控可优化的创意生成。
AI.motivation: 研究创意创新是科学进步的核心引擎，但难以规模化和可控地生成与评估。其固有挑战在于开放性和多目标性（需平衡新颖性、合理性与可行性）。现有LLM方法依赖精心设计的提示或智能体流水线，受限于预定义、静态的构思流程。
AI.method: 提出MindFlow框架，将构思显式形式化为"心智流"（Flow in Mind）：由图结构组织、由模块化思维算子构成，并用概率心智超网建模。给定研究主题，控制器动态采样思维流生成候选创意；采用基于锦标赛的相对排序优化该开放式问题，使控制器逐步偏向更高质量的思维流。同时引入联合评估问题发现与问题解决的评估协议，超越仅基于标题或摘要的判断。
AI.result: 在多样化主题上，MindFlow展现出作为显式、可控、可优化研究创意创新器的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将构思建模为可采样的图结构思维流并结合相对排序优化，MindFlow克服了静态流水线的局限，实现了可控且可优化的研究创意生成，并配以更全面的评估协议。

title: Bernoulli Flow Models: Self-Consistent Generative Modeling for Binary Data
summary: Binary diffusion models typically require a large number of function evaluations (NFEs) to generate high-quality samples, making practical inference computationally expensive. Reducing NFEs while preserving sample quality without distillation or additional training remains a significant challenge. Existing binary diffusion models define a discrete one-step forward path and then derive the reverse posterior. In low-NFE settings requiring cross-step sampling, they approximate the true multi-step likelihood with a single-step likelihood transition, which severely degrades sample quality. To address this fundamental limitation and decouple the generative dynamics from fixed discrete time steps, we propose Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM). Rather than relying on sequential one-step Markov diffusion chains, BFM defines a unified continuous global Bernoulli probability flow path between data distributions and pure noise, from which we derive analytical closed-form posterior transitions over arbitrary time intervals. Consequently, reducing the inference NFE is no longer an approximation based on skipping discrete steps; it only requires re-evaluating the analytical posterior over a new time grid. This eliminates the structural training-inference mismatch inherent to discrete chains and yields self-consistent low-NFE sampling. Experiments show that BFM is highly robust to aggressive NFE reduction. On LSUN Churches 256x256, a BFM trained with 256 steps achieves an FID of 9.22 using only 16 sampling steps, whereas the state-of-the-art discrete baseline degrades to 204.10. BFM also remains competitive with continuous and discrete generative baselines under standard full-step inference. These results establish BFM as a theoretically rigorous, self-consistent, and practically effective framework for fast binary data generation.

AI.tldr: 提出Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM)，用连续全局伯努利概率流替代离散一步扩散链，实现任意时间区间解析后验转移，低NFE下仍能保持高质量采样。
AI.motivation: 二元扩散模型在高采样质量下需要大量函数评估(NFE)，推理代价高。现有二元扩散模型定义离散一步前向路径再推导逆向后验，在低NFE跨步采样时用单步似然近似真实多步似然，严重降低样本质量，且存在训练-推理结构不匹配。
AI.method: BFM不依赖顺序一步马尔可夫扩散链，而是定义数据分布与纯噪声之间统一的连续全局伯努利概率流路径，并由此推导任意时间区间上的解析闭式后验转移。降低NFE只需在新时间网格上重新评估该解析后验，而非跳过离散步的近似。
AI.result: BFM对激进NFE缩减高度鲁棒：在LSUN Churches 256x256上，用256步训练的BFM仅16步采样即达FID 9.22，而最先进的离散基线退化到204.10；在标准全步推理下也与连续和离散生成基线具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: BFM是一个理论严谨、自洽且实用的快速二元数据生成框架，消除了离散链固有的训练-推理不匹配，实现自洽的低NFE采样。

title: PAM-ToD: Plug-and-Play Appearance Modeling for Cross-Time-of-Day 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Adapting a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) road scene to a new time of day requires learning appearance changes from a few anchor images while preserving consistent, real-time rendering. We propose PAM-ToD, a lightweight plug-in that learns color corrections while keeping the pre-trained 3DGS parameters fixed. PAM-ToD scales each Gaussian's existing color to model illumination changes and uses an additive term for additional brightness, such as when street lamps turn on at night. Under a simplified image formation model, unchanged surface albedo can be eliminated from the relation between source and target appearances, allowing us to learn these corrections without separately estimating albedo and illumination. The model corrects colors across the scene while allowing the corrections to vary by location and by Gaussian. To guide learning from a few anchor images, it discourages abrupt spatial changes in these corrections. We also introduce CARLA-ToD, a benchmark with matching geometry, camera poses, and moving-object trajectories across three times of day. A few target-time anchor images are used to train each plug-in, while separate views are used for evaluation. Across the static and dynamic settings, PAM-ToD achieves higher PSNR and lower LPIPS than the baselines, even when the anchor images come from a single synchronized capture across multiple cameras.

AI.tldr: PAM-ToD是一个轻量级插件，通过学习颜色校正将预训练3DGS道路场景适配到新的时段，同时保持实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 将预训练3DGS道路场景适配到不同时段需从少量锚点图像学习外观变化，并保持一致的实时渲染。
AI.method: 固定预训练3DGS参数，缩放每个高斯已有颜色以建模光照变化，并加入加性项处理额外亮度（如夜间路灯）。基于简化成像模型消除反照率，无需分别估计反照率与光照；校正可按位置和高斯变化，并约束空间平滑性以从少量锚点学习。
AI.result: 在静态和动态场景中，PAM-ToD的PSNR高于基线、LPIPS低于基线，即使锚点图像来自单次多相机同步采集。还提出CARLA-ToD基准，含跨三个时段匹配的几何、相机位姿和运动物体轨迹。
AI.conclusion: PAM-ToD为3DGS道路场景时段适配提供高效且实时的解决方案，并配套CARLA-ToD基准验证有效性。

title: MetaOPD: Meta-Learned Token Weighting for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using token-level teacher supervision. However, uniform weighting overlooks differences in token learning value, while existing weighting methods rely on predefined mappings from prediction signals to token weights. These mappings are not learned from the effectiveness of the resulting student updates, limiting their ability to adapt to evolving learning needs. In this paper, we propose MetaOPD, a bilevel optimization framework that jointly learns the student model and a lightweight token-weighting network. The inner objective updates the student through weighted OPD, while the outer objective optimizes the weighting network using validation loss on reference solutions after a virtual student update. Differentiating through this update connects weighting decisions to their effects on post-update performance, allowing the mapping from prediction signals to token weights to evolve alongside the student. Experiments on six mathematical reasoning and three out-of-domain datasets, covering two student scales and seven baselines, demonstrate the effectiveness of MetaOPD, with Avg@8/Pass@8 gains over OPD of 1.99/5.97 percentage points for the 0.6B student and 2.25/6.41 points for the 1.7B student.

AI.tldr: MetaOPD 提出双层优化框架，联合学习学生模型与轻量级 token 加权网络，使权重映射从学生更新效果中学习，在数学推理任务上超越 OPD。
AI.motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation 对所有 token 均匀加权，忽略 token 学习价值差异；已有加权方法依赖预定义的预测信号到 token 权重的映射，未从学生更新效果中学习，难以适应动态学习需求。
AI.method: 采用双层优化：内层用加权 OPD 更新学生模型；外层在虚拟学生更新后，用参考解答上的验证损失优化 token 加权网络。通过对该更新过程求导，将加权决策与其对更新后性能的影响关联，使预测信号到 token 权重的映射随学生共同演化。
AI.result: 在 6 个数学推理和 3 个域外数据集、2 种学生规模、7 个基线上验证有效性；相比 OPD，0.6B 学生 Avg@8/Pass@8 提升 1.99/5.97 个百分点，1.7B 学生提升 2.25/6.41 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MetaOPD 通过学习式 token 加权提升 on-policy distillation 效果，验证了从更新效果中学习权重映射的有效性。

title: SpatialOPSD: Self-Distilling Spatial Intelligence from Verified Coding Agent Traces
summary: Spatial coding agents significantly improve spatial reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by using external tools to generate verified execution traces. However, this paradigm inherently suffers from prohibitive inference-time overhead and external dependencies. In this paper, we explore whether an MLLM can internalize this agentic capability to operate entirely tool-free. We begin with a simple observation: prompting an MLLM with summarized execution traces of a spatial coding agent naturally unlocks the model's internal spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Motivated by this, we introduce SpatialOPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that internalizes spatial reasoning into a standalone MLLM by formulating verified agent traces as privileged information. To mitigate privileged-information leakage during distillation, we introduce Repetition-Aware Distillation, which combines repetition masking with unlikelihood regularization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that self-distilling SpatialOPSD achieves higher average accuracy than SFT and GRPO on both spatial and OOD datasets, exhibiting superior performance and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出SpatialOPSD，一个on-policy自蒸馏框架，将空间编码agent的能力内化到独立MLLM中，实现无需工具的推理，并优于SFT和GRPO。
AI.motivation: 空间编码agent虽能提升MLLM空间推理，但推理开销大且依赖外部工具。作者希望MLLM能内化该能力，实现完全无需工具的推理。
AI.method: 观察到用摘要化的agent执行轨迹提示MLLM可激活其内部空间CoT。据此提出SpatialOPSD，将验证过的agent轨迹作为特权信息进行on-policy自蒸馏；并引入Repetition-Aware Distillation（重复掩码+unlikelihood正则）缓解特权信息泄露。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，SpatialOPSD的平均准确率高于SFT与GRPO，在空间与OOD数据集上均表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏SpatialOPSD可有效内化agentic空间推理能力，性能与泛化性均优于现有方法。

title: SV-TAD: Native Sparse Convs for Efficient Temporal Action Detection
summary: To adapt billion-parameter Vision Transformers for long-video understanding, recent methods freeze the backbone and train lightweight convolutional modules. While effective for parameter-efficient training, existing adapters do not reduce inference-time computation, leaving scalability with respect to video length largely unaddressed. Token selection can reduce attention cost by pruning redundant tokens, but it breaks the spatial grid structure required by convolutional adapters. This forces an expensive dense reconstruction, nullifying much of the potential speedup. We address this by introducing native sparse 2D convolutions, a primitive that allows these adapters, for the first time, to operate directly and efficiently on dynamically pruned token sets. We integrate this primitive into SV-TAD, an adapter framework for temporal action detection, reducing VideoMAEv2-L computation by up to 64% and achieving 2.2x faster inference, while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy on THUMOS-14 and ActivityNet-1.3. When scaled to InternVideoNext-L, our approach surpasses the previous state of the art at roughly half its computational cost. Moreover, the sparse formulation naturally supports auxiliary task tokens, which improves fine-grained assembly detection on ATTACH.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出原生稀疏2D卷积（native sparse 2D convolutions），使适配器能直接高效地作用于动态剪枝后的token集合，构建SV-TAD框架用于时序动作检测，最多减少64%计算量并实现2.2倍加速，同时保持SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 将十亿参数级ViT适配到长视频理解时，现有方法冻结骨干并训练轻量卷积模块，虽参数高效但不降低推理计算，未解决视频长度可扩展性问题。Token选择可剪枝冗余token降低注意力开销，却破坏卷积适配器所需的空间网格结构，需昂贵的稠密重建，抵消了加速效果。
AI.method: 引入原生稀疏2D卷积这一原语，使卷积适配器首次能直接且高效地作用于动态剪枝后的token集合，无需稠密重建。将其集成到SV-TAD适配器框架中用于时序动作检测。该稀疏表述还天然支持辅助任务token。
AI.result: 在VideoMAEv2-L上减少最多64%计算量，推理速度提升2.2倍，在THUMOS-14和ActivityNet-1.3上保持SOTA精度。扩展到InternVideoNext-L时，以约一半计算成本超越此前SOTA。在ATTACH上通过辅助任务token改善细粒度组装检测。
AI.conclusion: 原生稀疏2D卷积解决了token剪枝与卷积适配器间的不兼容问题，实现了长视频理解中推理计算的大幅降低与速度提升，同时维持或超越SOTA精度，并为辅助任务token提供自然支持。

title: An Interpretable Approach to PDE Solution Discovery via Structural Experience Distillation
summary: PDE solution discovery aims to identify explicit symbolic expressions for unknown physical fields from observations under known physical constraints. Existing methods, however, collapse data fidelity and physical consistency into a single terminal score used as the sole feedback signal, providing little information about which subexpressions are responsible for a candidate's final performance. This opaque terminal feedback severely limits the interpretability of the search process itself, offering no insight into why a candidate succeeds or fails. Consequently, reusable structures in otherwise suboptimal candidates are often discarded, whereas incidental syntax along successful search trajectories may be repeatedly reinforced. We propose SED-MCTS, a Monte Carlo tree search approach that distills structural experience from evaluated expressions and reuses it to guide subsequent symbolic solution search. Through counterfactual subtree interventions, SED-MCTS estimates local structural contributions, routes reliable evidence to the responsible construction edges, and preserves useful components in a refined structural archive. The approach naturally extends to coupled multiphysics systems. Across a diverse suite of PDE benchmarks, SED-MCTS achieves strong performance under a fixed evaluation budget and improves search efficiency and robustness under noisy or scarce observations.

AI.tldr: 提出SED-MCTS，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索从已评估表达式中提炼结构经验并复用，用反事实子树干预估计局部结构贡献，提升PDE符号解发现的可解释性与搜索效率。
AI.motivation: 现有PDE符号解发现方法将数据保真度与物理一致性压缩为单一终端评分作为唯一反馈，无法判断哪些子表达式导致了最终性能，导致可复用结构被丢弃、偶然语法被反复强化，搜索过程缺乏可解释性。SED-MCTS旨在从被评估的表达式中提炼可复用的结构经验，以指导后续搜索。
AI.method: SED-MCTS基于蒙特卡洛树搜索。核心机制包括：通过反事实子树干预估计局部结构贡献；将可靠证据路由到负责构建该结构的边上；在精炼的结构档案中保留有用组件。该方法可自然扩展到耦合多物理场系统。
AI.result: 在多种PDE基准上，SED-MCTS在固定评估预算下取得强性能，并在噪声或稀缺观测条件下提升搜索效率与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将终端反馈分解为局部结构贡献并复用结构经验，SED-MCTS提升了PDE符号解发现的可解释性、搜索效率与鲁棒性，并适用于耦合多物理场系统。

title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning?} Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Evolving Functional REpertoires} (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average performance 7.50 percentage points higher than GRPO. Moreover, after adaptation to the Bio task, its performance on FinQA decreases by only 1.56 percentage points, compared with 25.10 percentage points for the base prompt optimization method. We further instantiate EFRE in a minimal agent system and observe consistent improvements across different backbone models. Overall, these results demonstrate EFRE's strong performance in continual learning for large language models and highlight its substantial potential for continual learning in advanced agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EFRE方法，用"功能库"替代单一提示词，实现大语言模型的持续学习，缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型持续学习需在学习新任务同时不退化旧能力。现有方法依赖参数更新，而提示优化虽高效却未验证能否直接用于持续学习。
AI.method: 分析提示优化在顺序任务适配中存在灾难性遗忘与过拟合局部任务分布的问题，提出Evolving Functional REpertoires (EFRE)：用函数库替代单一提示，兼容更新精炼已有函数，冲突更新触发新函数生成。
AI.result: 在三任务持续学习流上，EFRE最终平均性能比GRPO高7.50个百分点；适配Bio任务后，FinQA性能仅下降1.56个百分点，而基础提示优化下降25.10个百分点。在最小智能体系统中对不同骨干模型均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: EFRE在大语言模型持续学习中表现优异，并在高级智能体系统中具有持续学习潜力。

title: S$^3$Geo: Structure-Semantic Synergistic Learning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) aims to estimate geographic locations by matching images captured from different viewpoints, such as drone and satellite views. Existing methods mainly rely on visual representations, but often fail to jointly model fine-grained structural correspondences and semantic priors, making them prone to confusion between visually similar but semantically different regions, and thus limiting robustness under large viewpoint variations. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{S$^3$Geo}, a structure-semantic synergistic learning framework for cross-view matching. Specifically, we first introduce a Decoupled Query Pooling (DQP) module to extract a compact set of region-aware features from dense tokens, enabling explicit modeling of local structural patterns. We then design a query-level contrastive learning scheme with an optimal transport (OT)-based formulation to establish soft correspondences under cross-view spatial misalignment. Furthermore, we incorporate a Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SKD) strategy from a frozen CLIP teacher to transfer semantic priors and relational structures, thereby improving discrimination on hard negatives. By operating synergistically, the semantic priors provide robust contextual filtering, which guides the structural module to establish precise spatial alignments. Experiments on the University-1652 and SUES-200 datasets demonstrate that \textbf{S$^3$Geo} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches without increasing inference complexity, validating the effectiveness of jointly modeling structural and semantic information for CVGL.

AI.tldr: 提出S³Geo框架，通过结构与语义协同学习提升跨视角地理定位的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有CVGL方法主要依赖视觉表征，难以联合建模细粒度结构对应与语义先验，导致视觉相似但语义不同的区域易混淆，在大视角变化下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 1) Decoupled Query Pooling (DQP)从密集token中提取紧凑的区域感知特征以建模局部结构；2) 查询级对比学习结合最优传输(OT)建立跨视角空间错位下的软对应；3) 语义知识蒸馏(SKD)从冻结CLIP教师迁移语义先验与关系结构，提升难负样本判别力。
AI.result: 在University-1652和SUES-200数据集上持续优于现有最优方法，且未增加推理复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模结构与语义信息对CVGL有效，语义先验提供上下文过滤并引导结构模块实现精确空间对齐。

title: Complexity of Grounded Semantics and Preferred Semantics in Finitary Argumentation Frameworks
summary: Abstract argumentation frameworks (AFs) introduced by Dung provide a formal foundation for non-monotonic reasoning in artificial intelligence. While decision problems for general infinite AFs typically reside at high levels of the analytical hierarchy ($Σ_1^1$ or $Π_1^1$), restricting the framework to be computably finitary reduces some of the complexity to the arithmetical hierarchy. In this paper, we present a complexity mapping of grounded and preferred semantics in computably finitary AFs across standard decision problems: credulous acceptance ($\Cred$), skeptical acceptance ($\Skep$), extension existence ($\Ex$), uniqueness ($\Uni$), and non-empty existence ($\NE$). For grounded semantics, credulous and skeptical acceptance are already known to be $Σ_1^0$-complete. We show that non-empty existence is also $Σ_1^0$-complete, whereas existence and uniqueness are trivial. These classifications are understood within the domain of valid computably finitary representations. For preferred semantics, using a computably finitely branching computation tree, $\Cred_{\pref}$ is shown to be in $Π_1^0$-c and $\NE_{\pref}$ is $Σ_2^0$-c. However, it is insufficient to reduce universal quantification and global uniqueness, leaving $\Skep_{\pref}$ in $Π_1^1$ and $\UniPref$ in $Σ_2^1$-c. Our results show the precise boundary where finitarity succeeds to bring reasoning down to the arithmetical hierarchy and where second-order quantification forces problems back into the analytical hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文对可计算有限分支抽象论证框架(AFs)中grounded与preferred语义的五个标准决策问题进行了复杂度刻画，明确了有限性将问题降至算术层级的边界。
AI.motivation: 一般无限AFs的决策问题通常处于解析层级($Σ_1^1$或$Π_1^1$)，而限制为可计算有限分支可部分降低复杂度。作者旨在系统绘制这一限制下各类语义与决策问题的复杂度地图，厘清有限性何时有效、何时因二阶量化而失效。
AI.method: 针对可计算有限分支AFs，分别考察grounded与preferred语义下的五个决策问题：Cred、Skep、Ex、Uni、NE。利用可计算有限分支计算树等工具进行复杂度归类与归约分析。
AI.result: Grounded语义：Cred与Skep已知为$Σ_1^0$-complete，NE亦为$Σ_1^0$-complete；Ex与Uni为平凡。Preferred语义：Cred在$Π_1^0$内($Π_1^0$-c)，NE为$Σ_2^0$-c；但Skep仍处于$Π_1^1$，UniPref为$Σ_2^1$-c。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明：可计算有限性可使部分推理问题下降到算术层级(如grounded全部、preferred的Cred与NE)，但涉及全称量化与全局唯一性问题时，二阶量化会将问题重新推回解析层级。

title: CoPoE: Multimodal Fusion via Decomposable Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts for Missing-Modality Alzheimer's Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis benefits from integrating heterogeneous clinical, imaging, genomic, and biomarker evidence, but clinical cohorts frequently suffer from irregular modality missingness. Existing fusion methods often synthesize absent inputs, risking the introduction of artificial surrogates, or pool available signals into uninterpretable latent spaces. We present CoPoE (Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts), a disease-coordinate framework that maps multimodal evidence into a structured latent space partitioned into four distinct biological and clinical axes: genetic Risk, molecular Pathology, Neurodegeneration, and clinical Stage (R/P/N/S). Each observed modality parameterizes a diagonal Gaussian expert over the full RPNS vector, and a masked Product-of-Experts architecture fuses only the available modalities. Consequently, absent modalities add no factor to the fusion path, allowing the network to preserve a robust, decomposable posterior for any non-empty modality subset without synthetic imputation in the RPNS path. Through extensive missing-modality experiments on the ADNI dataset, CoPoE achieves the best all-modality performance and the highest mean AUROC across all 15 observed-subset evaluations among standardized missing-modality fusion baselines under a shared non-PET ADNI embedding benchmark, while substantially improving raw-probability ECE, Brier score, and NLL. Furthermore, PET-supervised probing shows evidence enrichment within the pathology (P) block under full modalities, with tau-related signal retained even when direct fluid biospecimen inputs are withheld. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/CoPoE.

AI.tldr: 提出CoPoE框架，将多模态AD证据映射到RPNS四个生物/临床轴的潜空间，用掩码Product-of-Experts仅融合可用模态，无需合成缺失输入即可在任意模态子集上保持稳健后验。
AI.motivation: 多模态AD诊断需整合临床、影像、基因组和生物标志物证据，但临床队列常存在不规则模态缺失。现有融合方法要么合成缺失输入（引入人工替代），要么将可用信号汇入不可解释的潜空间。
AI.method: CoPoE将多模态证据映射到结构化为四个轴的潜空间：遗传风险(R)、分子病理(P)、神经退行(N)、临床分期(S)。每个观测模态对完整RPNS向量参数化一个对角高斯专家，掩码Product-of-Experts架构仅融合可用模态，缺失模态不添加因子，从而在无合成插补下保持可分解后验。
AI.result: 在ADNI数据集缺失模态实验中，CoPoE取得最佳全模态性能，并在15个观测子集评估中平均AUROC最高（共享非PET ADNI嵌入基准下），同时显著改善原始概率ECE、Brier分数和NLL。PET监督探测显示全模态下病理(P)块证据富集，且tau相关信号在缺少直接体液样本输入时仍被保留。
AI.conclusion: CoPoE通过疾病坐标Product-of-Experts实现无需合成插补的稳健多模态融合，兼顾性能与可解释性，并展现跨模态证据富集能力。

title: Beyond Report Imitation: Clinically Aware Multi-Image Ultrasound Report Generation from Visible Evidence
summary: Generating ultrasound reports from multiple images requires aggregating clinical evidence across views, yet archived key frames capture only part of the dynamic examination. Raw-report imitation is therefore misaligned with visual supervision: content that is clinically valid for the full examination may be unverifiable from the images available to a model. This gap creates a clinical behavior alignment problem. A model must preserve visible findings, avoid diagnostic reversals and unsupported completion, and not collapse into conservative templates. We propose CAMEO, a Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration framework for ultrasound report generation. Stage I learns ultrasound visual-language primitives; Stage II performs Cross-View Evidence Grounding by distilling trusted visible report points into multi-image QA and report-style supervision; and Stage III performs Clinically Aware Preference Alignment using clinical-error-oriented preference pairs. From USReport, we construct USReport-Distilled with 17,670 evidence-grounded paired-image training instances and USReport-Pref with 21,869 preference pairs; we additionally use 25,631 PubMedVision-US ultrasound instruction samples for domain adaptation and multi-image instruction tuning. On the primary USReport-Distilled benchmark, CAMEO improves over EchoVLM from 0.25 to 0.40 BLEU-1, 0.28 to 0.45 ROUGE-1, and 0.27 to 0.43 METEOR, while raising ClinicalScore from 55.02 to 74.20. These results underscore the value of evidence-grounded supervision, clinically aware alignment, and clinically structured evaluation for reliable ultrasound report generation.

AI.tldr: CAMEO是一个面向超声报告生成的临床感知多图像证据整合框架，通过三阶段训练（视觉语言基元学习、跨视图证据定位、临床感知偏好对齐）解决原始报告模仿与视觉监督不匹配的问题，在USReport-Distilled上显著超越EchoVLM。
AI.motivation: 超声报告需整合多视图临床证据，但存档关键帧仅捕获动态检查的一部分。原始报告模仿与视觉监督存在错位：对完整检查有效的临床内容可能无法从模型可用图像中验证，导致模型需保留可见发现、避免诊断逆转与无依据补充、又不退化为保守模板的临床行为对齐难题。
AI.method: 提出CAMEO（临床感知多图像证据驱动的编排框架），分三阶段：Stage I学习超声视觉语言基元；Stage II执行跨视图证据定位，将可信可见报告要点蒸馏为多图像QA和报告风格监督；Stage III用面向临床错误的偏好对进行临床感知偏好对齐。构建USReport-Distilled（17,670证据定位配对图像训练实例）与USReport-Pref（21,869偏好对），并用25,631条PubMedVision-US超声指令样本做领域适应与多图像指令微调。
AI.result: 在USReport-Distilled基准上，CAMEO相比EchoVLM将BLEU-1从0.25提升至0.40，ROUGE-1从0.28提升至0.45，METEOR从0.27提升至0.43，ClinicalScore从55.02提升至74.20。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了证据驱动监督、临床感知对齐及临床结构化评估对可靠超声报告生成的价值。

title: PulseBound: Future-Beat State Forecasting Under an Explicit Information Boundary
summary: Predictive representation learning from photoplethysmography (PPG) can violate causal information access even with causal attention, as normalization, nonlocal transforms, or companion views may depend on withheld samples. We introduce PulseBound, a PPG representation learner combining physiologically structured future-beat prediction with an explicit stored-window information boundary. A content-independent cutoff separates the visible prefix from the prediction target. Prefix-only normalization, suffix replacement before derived-view construction, and aligned masking ensure that encoder inputs depend only on the visible prefix and cutoff. This yields stored-suffix invariance: with fixed model state, randomness, prefix, and cutoff, changing the stored suffix cannot change the forecast context. A shared horizon-conditioned head predicts nine rhythm and morphology descriptors for up to four extractor-valid future beats, using elementwise validity masks; optional ECG-derived pulse-arrival-time supervision is restricted to training. On MIMIC and VitalDB groups held out from PulseBound backbone pretraining, PulseBound reduces nine-state transformed-space MAE relative to last-visible-beat persistence by 28.06% and 22.22%, respectively, with gains in MAE, MAE-Skill, and Spearman correlation across all 40 source-cutoff-horizon cells.
