In a separate comparison of seven models on 13 downstream tasks, PulseBound achieves the best mean on nine frozen linear-probe and seven full-fine-tuning tasks. Stored-suffix interventions cause zero recorded changes in forecast contexts or predictions, with zero suffix-input gradients at audited precision under the stored-window interface. These findings separate three testable aspects of predictive physiological representation learning: information access, supervised future structure, and transfer.

AI.tldr: PulseBound 是一种 PPG 表征学习方法，通过显式的存储窗口信息边界和生理结构化的未来心搏预测，避免因果信息泄露，并在 MIMIC/VitalDB 上显著优于基线且提升下游迁移。
AI.motivation: 基于 PPG 的预测式表征学习即使使用因果注意力，仍可能因归一化、非局部变换或伴随视图依赖被屏蔽样本而违反因果信息访问约束。
AI.method: 引入内容无关的截断点分离可见前缀与预测目标；仅用前缀归一化、构造衍生视图前替换后缀、对齐掩码，保证编码器输入只依赖可见前缀与截断点，实现"存储后缀不变性"；用共享的、以时间跨度（horizon）为条件的预测头为最多四个有效未来心搏预测九种节律与形态描述符；可选 ECG 衍生的脉搏到达时间监督仅限训练阶段。
AI.result: 在 backbone 预训练留出的 MIMIC 与 VitalDB 分组上，相比"最后可见心搏持久化"基线，九状态变换空间 MAE 分别降低 28.06% 和 22.22%，在全部 40 个源-截断-时间跨度单元中 MAE、MAE-Skill 和 Spearman 相关均提升；在 13 个下游任务、7 个模型的比较中，PulseBound 在 9 个冻结线性探测任务和 7 个全微调任务上取得最佳均值；存储后缀干预未产生任何预测上下文或预测的显著变化，审计精度下后缀输入梯度为零。
AI.conclusion: 该工作分离出预测式生理表征学习的三个可检验方面：信息访问、监督式未来结构与迁移能力。

title: Learning from Hetero Density for Cryo-EM Protein Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing protein structures from cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) maps is essential for understanding macromolecular assemblies. Although learning-based methods have improved protein reconstruction, information from hetero components remains underused. Our analysis finds both false predictions and reference protein sites near hetero components; filtering nearby candidates can improve or impair chain construction. We introduce CryoCue, a framework that uses hetero information to guide protein reconstruction. An anchor-supervised detector learns hetero representations across five component classes. Multiscale hetero features guide backbone localization, while predicted hetero candidates condition structure refinement through their class, confidence, and frame-relative geometry. Experiments show that CryoCue improves backbone localization near hetero components and achieves more accurate protein structure reconstruction.

AI.tldr: CryoCue是一个利用hetero组件信息引导冷冻电镜蛋白质结构重建的框架，通过锚点监督检测器和多尺度特征提升骨干定位与结构精修精度。
AI.motivation: 从cryo-EM密度图重建蛋白质结构对理解大分子组装至关重要。现有学习方法虽改善了重建，但hetero组件信息利用不足。分析发现hetero组件附近既有错误预测也有真实蛋白质位点，简单过滤邻近候选会改善或损害链构建，因此需有效利用该信息。
AI.method: 提出CryoCue框架：1）锚点监督检测器学习五类hetero组件的表征；2）多尺度hetero特征引导骨干定位；3）预测的hetero候选通过其类别、置信度和帧相对几何信息条件化结构精修。
AI.result: 实验表明CryoCue改善了hetero组件附近的骨干定位，并实现了更准确的蛋白质结构重建。
AI.conclusion: 有效利用hetero组件信息可提升cryo-EM蛋白质结构重建的准确性，CryoCue为此提供了可行方案。

title: PointVGGT: Zero-Shot Multiview RGB-D Point Cloud Registration with Visual Geometry Foundation Priors
summary: This paper addresses multiview RGB-D point cloud registration, aiming to estimate global rigid poses for unordered RGB-D scans and align them in a metrically consistent coordinate frame. The conventional pairwise-then-global paradigm suffers from locally optimized pairwise registration, severe error propagation and high computational burden. In particular, existing methods typically treat RGB data as a mere auxiliary matching cue and overlook the holistic geometric priors (e.g., camera poses and 3D models) encoded across image sequences. This paper introduces PointVGGT, a zero-shot framework built upon a novel \emph{foundation-then-refinement} paradigm that systematically leverages visual geometry foundation models (e.g., VGGT) as the computational backbone for robust, training-free multiview RGB-D registration. In the foundation stage, we directly recover metrically consistent global poses (without any pairwise estimation) by grounding the scale-ambiguous pose predictions of the foundation model against metric depth observations. In the refinement stage, we introduce an efficient voxelized spatial hashing mechanism that exploits the globally coherent 3D reconstruction (induced by the foundation model) as a shared spatial anchor, enabling dense multiview correspondences in near-linear time. On top of this, an IRLS-based robust motion-only bundle adjustment is performed using a conjugate gradient solver to jointly minimize the correspondence and reprojection residuals for multiview pose refinement. Extensive experiments on indoor/object-centric/outdoor datasets verify the outstanding zero-shot registration accuracy and computational efficiency of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PointVGGT，一种基于"先基础后精化"范式的零样本多视图RGB-D点云配准框架，利用视觉几何基础模型实现免训练的全局刚性位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 传统"先成对后全局"范式存在局部最优、误差传播和计算开销大的问题；现有方法将RGB数据仅作为辅助匹配线索，忽略了跨图像序列的整体几何先验（如相机位姿和3D模型）。
AI.method: 分两阶段：基础阶段直接恢复度量一致的全局位姿（无需成对估计），通过将基础模型尺度模糊的位姿预测与度量深度观测对齐；精化阶段引入高效体素化空间哈希机制，利用全局一致的3D重建作为共享空间锚点，实现近线性时间的稠密多视图对应，并进行基于IRLS的鲁棒运动-only光束法平差，用共轭梯度求解器联合最小化对应与重投影残差。
AI.result: 在室内、物体中心及室外数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法出色的零样本配准精度和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: PointVGGT通过系统性地利用视觉几何基础模型作为计算骨干，实现了鲁棒、免训练的多视图RGB-D配准，在精度与效率上均优于现有方法。

title: InterviewPlayground: A Simulation Environment for Evaluating AI Interviewers
summary: Increasingly, AI interviewers are being developed to elicit open-ended responses in applications like market research, public polling, preference elicitation, and social science research. However, evaluating AI interviewers is challenging because they function in extended, multi-turn interactions where they must adapt to participant behaviors. To address this need, we develop InterviewPlayground, a simulation environment for evaluating AI interviewers using simulated study participants whose behaviors are grounded in social theory. Simulated studies in InterviewPlayground produce an InterviewReportCard, which assesses the performance of AI interviewers using a suite of validated measures. To test whether our simulation-based evaluations predict performance with human participants, we conduct 15 real qualitative studies with five AI interviewers, three interview topics, and 450 human participants and compare them to simulated studies in InterviewPlayground. We find that AI interviewer performance in InterviewPlayground predicts performance in human studies with an average Pearson correlation of 0.86 across 12 measures, and the simulated interactions from InterviewPlayground reproduce key findings from behavioral analysis of AI interviewers in the human studies. Together, these findings support the validity of InterviewPlayground in assessing AI interviewer performance and examining potential failure modes. Our work contributes a simulation environment for AI interviewers supported with empirical validation, and more broadly, a roadmap for future work to develop validated, simulation-based evaluations of conversational AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InterviewPlayground——一个基于社会理论的模拟环境，用于评估 AI 访谈者，并通过 15 项真人研究验证其模拟评估与人类研究结果高度相关（平均 Pearson 相关 0.86）。
AI.motivation: AI 访谈者越来越多被用于市场调研、民调、偏好 elicitation 和社会科学研究，但评估难，因为其运行于长时间多轮交互中、需适应参与者行为。现有评估缺乏可扩展且有效的方法。
AI.method: 构建 InterviewPlayground 模拟环境，使用社会理论驱动的模拟参与者行为；模拟研究生成 InterviewReportCard，用一组经过验证的指标评估 AI 访谈者。随后开展 15 项真人定性研究（5 个 AI 访谈者、3 个访谈主题、450 名真人参与者），与模拟研究对比验证。
AI.result: AI 访谈者在 InterviewPlayground 中的表现在 12 项指标上与真人研究平均 Pearson 相关 0.86；模拟交互还能复现真人研究中行为分析的关键发现，支持其有效性及失败模式考察能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献了一个经实证验证的 AI 访谈者模拟评估环境，并为未来开发可验证、基于模拟的对话式 AI 系统评估提供了路线图。

title: MC-TRCM: Observation-Aware Recursive Fusion for Incomplete Mobile and Wearable Mental-Health Feature Views
comment: Accepted to ICONIP 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/MC-TRCM
summary: Public mobile and wearable mental-health datasets often provide summarized feature tables rather than synchronized raw sensor streams. In these releases, each anchor corresponds to a survey or label time and may combine phone or wearable summaries, prior symptom scores, demographics, clinical variables, and source-availability indicators. We propose the Modality-Conditioned Temporal Recursive Context Model (MC-TRCM), which preserves each feature source as a separate token and incorporates missingness as part of the input context. Observed sources are encoded with values and missingness summaries, absent sources use learned absence tokens, dataset and task embeddings condition fusion, and a recursive prediction head refines each output over validation-selected steps. We evaluated MC-TRCM on six predefined endpoints from DepreST-CAT and Prediction of Severity Change-Depression (PSYCHE-D) using participant-level splits and validation-only model selection. MC-TRCM achieved the lowest mean absolute error on DepreST-CAT Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) and Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) severity, improving over the best tabular reference by 0.181 and 0.217 scale points. Classification endpoints showed task-dependent behavior: MC-TRCM matched the best rounded GAD-7 category balanced accuracy, was numerically highest by 0.002 balanced-accuracy points on PSYCHE-D multiclass prediction, and remained close to the strongest references on PHQ-9 category and PSYCHE-D binary prediction. Ablations support Feature-wise Linear Modulation, absence tokens, missingness projections, and recursive refinement, while calibration and feature-source controls characterize endpoint behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/MC-TRCM.

AI.tldr: 提出MC-TRCM模型，将每个特征来源作为独立token并显式建模缺失性，在精神健康数据集上实现更优的严重程度预测。
AI.motivation: 公开移动/可穿戴精神健康数据集多为汇总特征表而非同步原始传感器流，且各来源常存在缺失，需要一种能处理多源异构特征与缺失性的建模方法。
AI.method: MC-TRCM将每个特征来源保留为独立token，把缺失性纳入输入上下文：观测源用值和缺失性摘要编码，缺失源用学习的缺失token；用数据集与任务嵌入调节融合，递归预测头通过验证集选择步数逐步精炼输出。
AI.result: 在DepreST-CAT和PSYCHE-D的六个端点上用参与者级划分与仅验证集选择评估。DepreST-CAT的PHQ-9与GAD-7严重程度MAE最低，较最佳表格基线分别改善0.181和0.217分。分类端点表现任务相关：GAD-7类别平衡准确率与最佳持平，PSYCHE-D多分类数值上高0.002，其余接近最强基线。消融支持FiLM、缺失token、缺失性投影与递归精炼的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模多源特征与缺失性并结合递归精炼可提升精神健康预测性能，但分类端点增益有限且依赖任务。

title: TAM: Task-Aware Memory Distillation for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction
summary: Knowledge distillation enables efficient spatiotemporal prediction by transferring knowledge from an accurate teacher to a compact student. However, matching outputs or features independently for each sample leaves cross-sample predictive structure underused. Exploiting this structure requires representations and historical references that reflect the dynamics of each task. We propose TAM, a Task-Aware Memory Distillation framework that organizes a frozen teacher's knowledge into a bounded, retrievable history. Memory entries encode latent features, forecast changes, or flow residuals, while task-specific selection rules identify relevant historical references. The student either matches the teacher's similarity distribution over shared references or regresses observation-conditioned residual prototypes. These objectives complement supervised prediction and conventional distillation. The teacher, memory, and auxiliary adapters are used only during training, leaving student inference unchanged. We evaluate TAM on video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction across multiple teacher-student configurations. Averaged over four paired runs, adding TAM improves SSIM on all six video datasets and reduces MSE on five relative to the corresponding KD baselines. Mean paired MSE reductions reach 1.86% on KittiCaltech, 1.93% on WeatherBench with a gSTA teacher, and 1.01% on TaxiBJ. These results demonstrate the utility of historical teacher supervision across distinct forecasting tasks without additional student inference cost.

AI.tldr: TAM：一种任务感知记忆蒸馏框架，将冻结教师的知识组织为可检索历史，用于时空预测，学生推理无额外开销。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏逐样本独立匹配输出或特征，未利用跨样本的预测结构；利用这种结构需要反映各任务动态的表征与历史参考。
AI.method: 构建有界可检索的教师知识记忆：记忆条目编码潜在特征、预测变化或流残差；任务特定选择规则挑选相关历史参考。学生要么匹配教师对共享参考的相似度分布，要么回归观测条件下的残差原型，与监督预测和常规蒸馏互补；教师、记忆和辅助适配器仅训练时使用。
AI.result: 在视频预测、天气预报和交通流预测、多种师生配置下评估。四次配对运行平均，TAM 在全部六个视频数据集上提升 SSIM，在五个上降低 MSE。平均配对 MSE 降幅：KittiCaltech 1.86%，WeatherBench（gSTA 教师）1.93%，TaxiBJ 1.01%。
AI.conclusion: 历史教师监督在多种预测任务中有效，且不增加学生推理成本，验证了跨任务利用历史监督的实用价值。

title: Structure Tax: How Structured Output affects LLMs Performance
summary: Deploying large language models in production often requires constraining outputs to structured formats such as JSON or XML, and prior work treats the resulting accuracy loss as an inherent `structure tax'. We re-examine this claim by evaluating a battery of models, datasets and schemas, measuring task accuracy, confidence calibration, and hidden-state geometry. The tax turns out to depend on schema design rather than on structure per se: reasoning-first field ordering matches or exceeds free-form accuracy, while answer-first ordering causes steep drops, particularly in smaller models. Format sensitivity scales inversely with a task's own structural constraints, and schemas that preserve reasoning order also improve calibration with CKA showing greater separability between correct and incorrect representations in middle transformer layers. Our findings indicate that properly designed structured formats can match or exceed free-form performance, reframing the critical question from `whether to structure' to `how to structure' for optimal reasoning preservation.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视结构化输出（JSON/XML）导致的"结构税"假设，发现精度损失实际上取决于schema设计而非结构本身：推理优先的字段排序能匹配甚至超越自由格式精度，而答案优先排序会导致明显下降。结构格式设计得当可保持甚至提升推理性能与校准。
AI.motivation: 生产中部署大语言模型常需将输出约束为JSON或XML等结构化格式，而既有工作将由此产生的精度损失视为固有的"结构税"，作者认为这一说法需要重新检验。
AI.method: 评估一系列模型、数据集和schema，测量任务精度、置信度校准以及隐藏状态几何（用CKA分析transformer中间层正确与错误表示的可分性）。
AI.result: 结构税取决于schema设计而非结构本身：推理优先的字段排序可匹配或超越自由格式精度，答案优先排序导致急剧下降（尤其小模型）；格式敏感度与任务本身的结构约束成反比；保持推理顺序的schema还能改善校准，CKA显示中间层正确与错误表示可分性更强。
AI.conclusion: 设计良好的结构化格式可匹配或超越自由格式性能，将关键问题从"是否结构化"重新定义为"如何结构化"以最优保持推理。

title: Policy Alignment: New Signals for Membership Auditing in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model by aligning its policy with a teacher model on trajectories generated by the student model itself. Through this process, the student policy moves toward the teacher on the prompts used for distillation. However, these prompts are often private and costly, creating a need for prompt-level membership auditing. Existing methods mainly rely on likelihood-based confidence signals or student policy drift between checkpoints, but they do not capture the teacher-induced direction of the student update. In this paper, we propose Policy Alignment Membership Auditing (PAMA), a new auditing framework tailored for OPD. Our key observation is that a member prompt directly contributes to the teacher-guided policy update, while a non-member prompt only experiences indirect effects through cross-prompt generalization. Based on this directional trace, PAMA measures whether the student update moves toward reducing the teacher loss on a candidate prompt. Specifically, we introduce Teacher Alignment Gain (TAG) to estimate the teacher-aligned update direction from model outputs, and further combine it with student drift and uncertainty alignment signals for reliable membership auditing. We evaluate PAMA on six datasets and three teacher-student model families. On MATH, the primary evaluation benchmark, PAMA achieves AUC values of 0.791--0.941, improving AUC by 14.6--20.6% over state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出PAMA框架，利用教师引导的策略更新方向进行on-policy distillation的提示级成员审计，显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: OPD的提示常为私有且昂贵，需要提示级成员审计；现有方法依赖似然置信度或检查点间策略漂移，未捕捉教师引发的学生更新方向。
AI.method: 基于成员提示直接贡献教师引导更新、非成员仅通过跨提示泛化受间接影响的观察，提出PAMA：引入Teacher Alignment Gain (TAG)从模型输出估计教师对齐的更新方向，并结合学生漂移和不确定性对齐信号。
AI.result: 在六个数据集和三个师生模型家族上评估；MATH上AUC达0.791–0.941，比SOTA基线提升14.6–20.6%。
AI.conclusion: PAMA通过捕捉教师引导的策略更新方向，为OPD提供了有效的提示级成员审计方法。

title: Revisiting Handcrafted Minutiae Detection: A Simple and Effective Open Source Baseline for Modern Fingerprint Workflows
summary: Handcrafted minutiae detection algorithms remain fundamental to biometric science and forensic practice due to their full auditability, adherence to international standards, and operational independence from training datasets or GPU hardware. However, current open-source traditional baselines are severely outdated, relying almost exclusively on legacy C/C++ codebases that lack seamless integration with modern scientific software ecosystems. To bridge this gap, the present work introduces SBMEX (Skeleton-Based Minutiae EXtraction), a fast and deterministic minutiae detection method integrated into the open source \texttt{pyfing} package. SBMEX achieves high computational throughput by employing a dual Look-Up Table architecture that replaces runtime neighborhood scanning during Crossing Number computation and skeleton tracking. Additionally, it incorporates a continuous quality scoring framework driven by tracking path length, dual ridge-valley skeleton fusion, and spatial density decay. Rigorous evaluation on NIST SD302 datasets demonstrates that SBMEX delivers feature extraction accuracy comparable to or outperforming traditional open-source baselines without fine-tuning, while achieving a drastic reduction in minutiae detection latency relative to classical Crossing Number Python implementations.

AI.tldr: 提出SBMEX，一种快速确定性的细节点检测方法，集成于pyfing包，采用双LUT架构提升速度，在NIST SD302上精度媲美或超越传统基线且延迟大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 传统手工细节点检测算法仍具有可审计性、符合国际标准、不依赖训练数据与GPU等优势，但现有开源传统基线严重过时，多为遗留C/C++代码，难以与现代科学软件生态集成。
AI.method: SBMEX采用双查找表(LUT)架构，替代Crossing Number计算与骨架跟踪中的运行时邻域扫描；并引入由跟踪路径长度、双脊-谷骨架融合及空间密度衰减驱动的连续质量评分框架。
AI.result: 在NIST SD302数据集上，SBMEX无需微调即可达到与传统开源基线相当或更优的特征提取精度，同时相较经典Crossing Number的Python实现显著降低细节点检测延迟。
AI.conclusion: SBMEX为现代科学软件生态提供了快速、确定性的传统细节点检测方案，兼顾精度与效率，弥补了开源传统基线过时的问题。

title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RACE训练方法，让LLM智能体自适应决定何时推理、何时直接行动，通过检测可移除的冗余推理降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通常在每一步动作前都进行推理，但早期推理可能已能支撑后续动作，并非每轮都需重新推理。核心挑战在于如何低成本地判断已有推理是否充分、是否需要新的推理步骤，而不依赖昂贵的生成式验证。
AI.method: 作者发现：移除额外推理后，后续参考动作似然度的下降能有效反映这些动作是否仍可由早期推理支撑。基于此提出RACE，包含似然引导的渐进式推理覆盖检测（LoGiC）过程，逐步识别移除后对当前及后续参考动作影响有限的推理轮次，并将这些移除信号融入监督微调和智能体强化学习。
AI.result: 在四个代表性智能体基准上，RACE在保持或提升任务性能的同时，大幅降低了推理成本。
AI.conclusion: RACE使策略学会何时推理、何时直接行动，实现了成本与性能的良好平衡，为自适应智能体推理提供了有效方案。

title: MotiveMob: Motivation as Semantic Action for Closed-Loop Human Mobility Generation
summary: Human mobility generation, an important task in urban research, synthesizes trajectory data for urban planning and transportation management. Human mobility can be characterized as a "why-where-when" decision process: people form an intention to move and then determine where and when the corresponding activity will take place. Trajectory generation under user-level and temporal distribution shifts may benefit from explicitly modeling this decision structure. However, many existing human mobility generation methods either represent behavioral intent at a coarse granularity, such as a daily plan or a trajectory-level description, or directly predict future locations without explicitly reasoning about a possible motivation for each movement step. We introduce MotiveMob, a motivation-driven autoregressive framework for human mobility generation that first forms a hypothesis about why the next movement may occur and then jointly generates where and when it may occur. At each step, a motivation predictor conditions on the current mobility state, a long-term behavioral report, and the mobility history to infer a plausible motivation or determine whether the trajectory should terminate. Given the hypothesized motivation, a state predictor grounds it in a candidate next location and arrival time. The candidate then undergoes speed-feasibility and repetition checks before being fed back for the next decision. We evaluate MotiveMob under distribution shifts involving unseen users and unseen temporal periods, including seasonal changes and the substantial behavioral disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Experiments show that MotiveMob consistently achieves better distributional fidelity than competitive pretraining-based and prompting-based methods under user-level and temporal distribution shifts, demonstrating robust generalization to out-of-distribution mobility patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出MotiveMob，一个动机驱动的自回归人类移动性生成框架，先推断"为何移动"再联合生成"何地与何时"，在用户与时间分布偏移下均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 人类移动可视为"为何-何地-何时"决策过程，显式建模该结构有助于应对用户级与时间分布偏移。但现有方法要么以粗粒度（如日计划、轨迹级描述）表示行为意图，要么直接预测未来位置而不推理每步动机。
AI.method: MotiveMob为自回归框架：每步中，动机预测器基于当前移动状态、长期行为报告与移动历史，推断合理动机或判断轨迹是否终止；状态预测器将该动机落地为候选下一位置与到达时间；候选经速度可行性与重复性检查后再反馈进入下一决策。
AI.result: 在涉及未见用户与未见时间段的分布偏移下（含季节变化及COVID-19带来的行为剧变），MotiveMob在分布保真度上持续优于基于预训练与基于提示的竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模动机驱动决策结构能提升人类移动性生成在分布外情境下的泛化能力与鲁棒性。

title: DisFace3DNet: Explainable Facial Attractiveness Prediction via 3D Component Disentanglement
summary: Facial attractiveness prediction usually assigns one overall rating, leaving the roles of shape, appearance, and viewing conditions implicit. We propose DisFace3DNet, which uses 3D component disentanglement to learn seven component reference scores from overall ratings with auxiliary weak semantic supervision, without human-labeled component targets. Designated 3D representations and image cues feed jointly learned routes for identity, skin, hair, light, background, expression, and pose. A constrained fit then combines five static and two signed dynamic scores into the overall rating, exposing each component's numerical contribution and supporting component-specific comparisons across images. On SCUT-FBP5500, DisFace3DNet achieves a Pearson correlation of $0.8904\pm0.0063$ (mean $\pm$ standard deviation across five folds) with average human ratings; its component terms reconstruct every held-out prediction to numerical precision. Skin, hair, and facial shape account for the largest component-wise prediction variation. Human evaluation supports the score directions for facial shape, skin, and hair; expression agreement is weaker. DisFace3DNet thus connects overall prediction to quantitative analysis of the facial and contextual cues entering each estimate.

AI.tldr: 提出DisFace3DNet，通过3D组件解耦将整体人脸吸引力评分分解为七个组件分数，无需人工标注组件目标即可量化各组件贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸吸引力预测通常只给出单一整体评分，无法显式区分形状、外观和拍摄条件等各组件的作用。
AI.method: 利用3D组件解耦，借助辅助弱语义监督从整体评分中学习七个组件参考分；设计特定的3D表征与图像线索，联合学习身份、皮肤、头发、光照、背景、表情、姿态等路径；再通过约束拟合将五个静态分与两个带符号动态分合成为整体评分。
AI.result: 在SCUT-FBP5500上五折平均Pearson相关系数为0.8904±0.0063；组件项可数值精确重建留出预测；皮肤、头发和脸型对预测变化贡献最大，人工评估支持脸型、皮肤和头发分数方向，表情一致性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将整体吸引力预测与面部及上下文线索的定量分析联系起来，可暴露各组件贡献并支持跨图像的组件级比较。

title: Is Memorization Context-Sensitive? Prefix-Based Extraction Beyond Isolated Prefixes
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can expose memorized training sequences under prefix-based extraction: given a prefix from a training example, the model may assign high probability to the original continuation. In deployed systems, however, prefixes are rarely evaluated in isolation. They often appear together with instructions, retrieved documents, or other task-specific context, as in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This motivates examining whether contextual conditioning mitigates memorization or merely changes the set of memorized samples that become extractable. We investigate this issue through paired item-level measurements of probabilistic suffix extraction. For each prefix-suffix pair, we score the target suffix under an empty prompt and under retrieved contexts of varying relevance, across three open-weight instruction-tuned models. We find that context does not simply erase memorization. Instead, extractable memorization consists of a context-robust core and a context-sensitive boundary. Many samples that are extractable without context remain extractable under the retrieved context, especially as the prefix length increases. At the same time, context mainly affects marginal samples near the extraction threshold: it suppresses some exposures, but also enables new ones that are missed by prefix-only evaluation. These findings qualify the view that RAG reduces memorization risk. Context can lower aggregate extraction by suppressing boundary cases, yet robustly extractable samples persist, and context-enabled extractability remains security-relevant.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索增强生成（RAG）中的上下文条件是否抑制LLM的记忆泄漏。通过对三个开源指令微调模型进行配对的项目级概率后缀抽取测量，发现可抽取记忆由"上下文鲁棒核心"和"上下文敏感边界"构成：上下文主要影响接近阈值边缘的样本，既能抑制部分暴露，也能触发前缀单独评估时无法发现的新暴露，因此不能简单认为RAG降低记忆风险。
AI.motivation: LLM在基于前缀的抽取下可能暴露训练序列。但实际部署中前缀很少孤立出现，而常与指令、检索文档等任务上下文共现（如RAG）。这引出核心问题：上下文条件究竟减轻了记忆，还是仅改变了可被抽取的记忆样本集合？现有观点认为RAG能降低记忆风险，需要实证检验。
AI.method: 采用配对的项目级（item-level）概率后缀抽取测量。对每个前缀-后缀对，分别在空提示和不同相关度的检索上下文下对目标后缀打分，覆盖三个开源指令微调模型。通过对比同一项目在有无上下文条件下的抽取情况，区分稳定可抽取与边缘可抽取样本。
AI.result: 上下文并非简单抹除记忆。可抽取记忆呈现两部分：一是上下文鲁棒核心（无上下文可抽取的样本在检索上下文下仍可抽取，随前缀长度增加尤为明显）；二是上下文敏感边界（上下文主要影响接近抽取阈值的边缘样本，抑制部分暴露，同时也使前缀单独评估漏掉的新样本变得可抽取）。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现修正了"RAG降低记忆风险"的看法。上下文可因抑制边界案例而降低总体抽取，但鲁棒可抽取的样本依然存在，且由上下文触发的可抽取性具有安全相关性。评估记忆时须考虑上下文条件。

title: Zatom-2: Multitask Pretraining on Atomistic Data for Generative Modeling across Domains
summary: Unified atomistic modeling has the potential to accelerate discovery in chemistry, materials science, and biology by bridging data-rich chemical domains and data-scarce biological contexts. However, existing generative approaches to atomistic modeling remain highly specialized to scientific disciplines (chemistry vs. biology) or do not leverage both high-volume organic (molecule) and inorganic (material) data for general-purpose pretraining. To this end, we introduce Zatom-2, an atomistic generative model pretrained on approximately five million structures from the OMol25 and OMat24 electronic structure datasets. Zatom-2 features a multiscale Transformer architecture coupled with conditional flow matching that supports force conditioning and foundational pretraining tasks such as generation, structure prediction, and prediction of molecular and material energies and forces. Empirically, Zatom-2 achieves better molecular distribution fidelity than Zatom-1 and achieves strong performance on existing molecule and material generation benchmarks. Zatom-2 demonstrates the ability to control sample generation across low- and high-force regimes, and enhances protein generation in a low-data setting through joint generative-predictive pretraining and transfer learning, increasing protein backbone designability in a length extrapolation setting from 67.8% without pretraining to 74.8% after finetuning on 2,000 protein domains.

AI.tldr: Zatom-2是一个基于约500万结构预训练的原子级生成模型，采用多尺度Transformer与条件流匹配，统一支持分子和材料的生成、结构预测及能量/力预测。
AI.motivation: 现有原子级生成模型多局限于单一学科（化学或生物），或未能同时利用大量有机（分子）和无机（材料）数据进行通用预训练。作者希望构建统一模型，弥合数据丰富的化学领域与数据稀缺的生物领域。
AI.method: Zatom-2在OMol25和OMat24电子结构数据集约500万结构上预训练，采用多尺度Transformer架构结合条件流匹配，支持力条件化，并涵盖生成、结构预测及分子/材料能量与力预测等预训练任务。
AI.result: Zatom-2在分子分布保真度上优于Zatom-1，在分子与材料生成基准上表现强劲；能控制低力与高力区域的样本生成；通过联合生成-预测预训练与迁移学习，在2000个蛋白质结构域微调后，将长度外推场景下的蛋白质骨架可设计性从67.8%（无预训练）提升至74.8%。
AI.conclusion: Zatom-2展示了统一原子级生成模型在跨化学与生物领域通用预训练的潜力，可提升生成质量与低数据场景下蛋白质设计能力。

title: Perceptually Grounded and Semantics-Aware Evaluation for Holistic Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Holistic and semantics-aware co-speech gesture generation has advanced rapidly, yet evaluation remains behind: objective metrics do not consistently reflect human perception, and semantic appropriateness remains difficult to quantify. We present a perceptually grounded and semantics-aware benchmark that combines standardized model comparison, human-centered metric validation, and fine-grained semantic evaluation. We first curate a list of 13 objective metrics covering different aspects, including distributional similarity, geometric fidelity, kinematic quality, cross-modal synchrony, and semantic appropriateness. For the semantic-appropriateness category, we propose a new metric, Semantic Gesture Preservation (SGP), which measures how far semantic gestures in the ground truth are preserved in the generated gestures. For this, we augment the BEAT2 dataset's annotations using a multi-modal LLM. We then conduct a perceptual study where 101 participants score generated gestures among five dimensions, including human-likeness, motion diversity, absence of animation errors, speech timing and content match. We systematically analyze objective metric--subjective score correlations. Unlike Semantic Score (SC), which shows no significant association with the evaluated perceptual dimensions, SGP is selectively aligned with speech-aware human judgments. We construct five target-specific composite metrics aligned with the subjective dimensions. These composites improve perceptual alignment across all five dimensions, with the largest gains for absence of animation errors and content match, indicating that complementary objective signals can better approximate human judgments than individual metrics alone. Overall, our results show that objective metrics require validation against subjective evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个感知与语义感知的共语手势生成评测基准，结合13个客观指标、人类感知验证和新语义指标SGP，发现SGP与语音相关人类判断对齐，并通过复合指标提升与人类感知的一致性。
AI.motivation: 共语手势生成快速发展，但评测滞后：客观指标与人类感知不一致，语义适当性难以量化。
AI.method: 构建包含13个客观指标（分布相似性、几何保真、运动质量、跨模态同步、语义适当性）的基准；提出语义手势保持度（SGP），用多模态LLM增强BEAT2标注；开展101人感知研究，从五个维度评分（拟人性、多样性、无动画错误、语音时序、内容匹配）；分析客观-主观相关性并构建五个目标特定复合指标。
AI.result: SC与感知维度无显著关联，而SGP与语音感知判断选择性对齐；复合指标在所有五个维度上提升感知对齐，尤其在无动画错误和内容匹配上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 客观指标需针对主观评测进行验证；结合互补信号能更好逼近人类判断。

title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution
summary: LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from search experience to revise its strategy for allocating computational resources across candidates. EvoAlloc periodically consolidates prior search and allocation outcomes into reusable experience, which informs subsequent strategy revisions. It further uses a counterfactual exploration mechanism to occasionally evaluate candidates denied resources by the allocator, revealing their outcomes to enrich its experience for future strategy updates. Across coding and agent-harness optimization benchmarks, EvoAlloc requires 59-82% fewer full evaluations and 61-89% fewer total LLM tokens to reach baseline-level performance. Moreover, under the same full-evaluation budget, EvoAlloc achieves 8.7-12.0% higher final performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoAlloc，一种自进化资源分配智能体，通过学习历史搜索与分配经验，动态调整 LLM 程序进化中候选程序的评估资源分配，显著降低评估成本并提升性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 程序进化依赖评估反馈指导迭代搜索，但评估计算代价高昂，需将有限资源分配给最能推进搜索的候选程序。现有方法通常采用固定分配策略，可能浪费资源于低价值候选，同时忽略有潜力的候选。
AI.method: EvoAlloc 周期性地将先前的搜索与分配结果整合为可复用经验，用于指导后续分配策略修订；并引入反事实探索机制，偶尔评估被分配器拒绝资源的候选，揭示其结果以丰富经验，促进未来策略更新。
AI.result: 在编码和智能体框架优化基准上，EvoAlloc 达到基线性能所需的全量评估次数减少 59-82%，总 LLM token 使用减少 61-89%；在相同全量评估预算下，最终性能提升 8.7-12.0%。
AI.conclusion: EvoAlloc 通过自进化、经验驱动的资源分配策略，可显著提升 LLM 程序进化的计算效率与最终性能。

title: Generative Adversarial Loops
summary: AI research progress can be viewed as the interaction between two processes: benchmark creation and method discovery. Historically, both were driven by human intelligence. However, recent advances in AI have accelerated automated method discovery, while automated benchmark creation has received comparatively less attention. To enable self-advancing systems, we propose Generative Adversarial Loop (GAL), a generator-discriminator framework alternating between two agentic searches: (1) a discriminator that generates adversarial data to expose weaknesses in current systems, and (2) a generator that discovers algorithms to overcome them. We apply this framework to approximation algorithms for efficient inference. Unlike existing auto research systems, which primarily focus on algorithm discovery, GAL introduces a discriminator agent that automates goalpost setting by continually searching for weaknesses in the current algorithm. We demonstrate adversarial data generation across four tasks: KV compression, sparse video generation, sparse attention, and context extension, where the discriminator identifies weaknesses in state of the art techniques. We further show that GAL enables autonomous improvement, with newly discovered algorithms improving not only on adversarially generated data, but also on established benchmarks. Specifically, GAL improves CompactorPress on KV compression with Qwen3-4B at 4x, raising performance on the discriminator dataset from 0.35 to 0.97, while also outperforming RULER-HARD (+0.77 pts). For context extension, GAL boosts Dual Chunk Attention from 0.20 to 0.90 on the discriminator dataset, while yielding gains on standard benchmarks(ScienceFiction (+6 pts) and PG19 32K (-0.33 PPL)). GAL thus provides a path toward autonomous goalpost setting and algorithmic improvement, where AI systems continually discover their own weaknesses and develop methods to overcome them.

AI.tldr: 提出生成对抗循环GAL框架，用判别器自动设目标、生成器发现算法，实现自推进的算法改进。
AI.motivation: AI研究由基准创建和方法发现驱动，自动方法发现进展快，但自动基准创建（目标设定）被忽视，阻碍自推进系统。
AI.method: GAL是生成器-判别器框架，交替进行两种智能体搜索：判别器生成对抗数据暴露当前系统弱点，生成器发现算法克服之，应用于高效推理的近似算法。
AI.result: 在KV压缩、稀疏视频生成、稀疏注意力、上下文扩展四任务生成对抗数据；提升CompactorPress（KV压缩，Qwen3-4B 4x）判别器数据0.35→0.97并超RULER-HARD +0.77；Dual Chunk Attention上下文扩展0.20→0.90，ScienceFiction +6、PG19 32K -0.33 PPL。
AI.conclusion: GAL提供自主目标设定与算法改进路径，系统能持续发现自身弱点并发展克服方法。

title: VESSI - VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations
comment: 12-page main manuscript, 3 main figures; supplementary material included
summary: Automated video surveillance analysis has become a critical component of intelligence infrastructures and Law Enforcement agencies. Traditional systems lack the semantic module for comprehensive situational awareness and forensic tasks, limiting their ability to interpret events meaningfully or support post-incident investigations. This slows operational insight and increases the burden on human analysts. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer promising pathways to bridge this gap. To address this, we propose VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations (VESSI), a VLM-based framework designed to enhance automated video surveillance analysis through prompt-driven interrogation of video sequences where salient visual features are converted into textual descriptions. We test our framework with four state-of-the-art models. Since most datasets for this task are unlabeled, we also propose the Composite Model Utility Score (CMUS) to assess VLM performance. Experimental results show that our solution substantially improves the analysis capabilities of human operators and enhances the flexibility of automated surveillance systems. In our evaluation, the most reliable model flagged potentially relevant activity in more than 66% of the videos while reducing review time by more than 85%, offering a practical balance between selectivity and efficiency. The model ordering produced by the reference-free CMUS evaluation was reproduced by the normal-video CMUS evaluation and matched the false-positive-rate ordering obtained from 5,909 manually referenced frames. This agreement supports the operational use of the score within the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: VESSI 是一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的视频监控分析框架，通过提示驱动将显著视觉特征转为文本描述，用无参考的 CMUS 评分评估 VLM 表现，在实验中可标记 66% 以上可疑活动并将审查时间减少 85% 以上。
AI.motivation: 传统视频监控系统缺乏语义模块，难以进行情境感知与取证分析，导致理解困难、事后调查支持不足，加重人工分析师负担。近期 VLM 的进步为解决这一问题提供了新途径。
AI.method: 提出 VESSI 框架，基于 VLM 对视频序列进行提示驱动的询问，将显著视觉特征转换为文本描述；测试四种先进模型；针对多数数据集无标注的问题，提出复合模型效用评分（CMUS）来评估 VLM 性能。
AI.result: 最可靠的模型标记了 66% 以上视频中可能相关的活动，同时将审查时间减少 85% 以上，兼顾选择性与效率；CMUS 评估的模型排序与普通视频 CMUS 评估一致，并与基于 5,909 帧人工标注得到的假阳性率排序吻合。
AI.conclusion: VESSI 显著提升了人工操作员的分析能力并增强了自动化监控系统的灵活性；CMUS 在该评测场景下的一致性与人工标注假阳性率排序的吻合，支持其在实际操作中使用。

title: Recompose and Refine Latent Reasoning Flows for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Latent reasoning enables vision-language-action (VLA) models to transform multimodal observations into task-relevant internal states before generating continuous robot actions. While existing methods learn to generate or refine such states for each policy query, they discard successful reasoning after execution and therefore reconstruct similar computation from scratch. We present Reasoning and Flow Memory (FLOWMEM), a unified VLA model that turns successful latent computation into reusable reasoning experience. Rather than appending a fixed retrieved context, FLOWMEM dynamically retrieves and recomposes compatible latent fragments as the embodied context evolves, forming a reasoning route that follows the temporal structure and progress of successful computation. The route is then refined using current visual and proprioceptive evidence before it conditions action generation. Experiments on RoboMME and LIBERO-Plus show that FLOWMEM attains 48.0% and 77.3% success, outperforming memory-free policies by 1.7 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the value of reusing successful latent computation for closed-loop VLA control.

AI.tldr: FLOWMEM通过将成功的潜在推理转化为可复用的记忆,动态检索并重组潜在片段,提升VLA模型的控制性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA方法为每次策略查询生成或精炼潜在状态,但执行后丢弃成功推理,导致重复计算,无法复用经验。
AI.method: 提出FLOWMEM统一VLA模型:动态检索并重组兼容的潜在片段,形成随时间演化的推理路径,再用当前视觉与本体感知证据精炼,条件化动作生成。
AI.result: 在RoboMME和LIBERO-Plus上分别达到48.0%和77.3%成功率,较无记忆策略提升1.7和4.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 复用成功的潜在计算对闭环VLA控制具有重要价值。

title: Rare Gate Disagreements Can Limit Plasticity: When Gradient Flow Mispredicts Finite-Batch SGD
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. Tong Che leads the project
summary: Population gradient flow is a common tool for reasoning about how neural networks adapt, including after pretraining. We show that it can mispredict finite-batch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) qualitatively, and we trace the discrepancy to a specific mechanism. In a two-unit ReLU regression, a source task drives the two neurons toward positive proportionality and a target task rewards separating them. After source training for time $T$, gradient flow recovers on the target in time linear in $T$. Online SGD with batch size $b$ and step size $η$ in both phases instead fails with high probability throughout a horizon of order $e^{c/η}$ once $T \gtrsim \log(b/η)$, uniformly on an explicit set of initializations with Gaussian probability above one percent. For each fixed $T$, small-step SGD still recovers, so the failure requires the joint limit of small steps and long pretraining. At the target clone, the population instability is carried entirely by inputs on which the two ReLU gates disagree. For units at angle $δ$ these inputs form a wedge of probability $δ/π$, and weight decay shrinks the angle exponentially during pretraining. On every other input both units receive the same random linear update, which contracts their separation in conditional expectation. Bounding the cumulative probability of sampling the wedge along the exact online recursion, without a diffusion approximation, shows that recovery with fixed probability from an identical source-gradient-flow checkpoint, within $e^{c/η}$ updates, requires $Nb \gtrsim e^{λT}$ target samples and batch size $b \gtrsim ηe^{λT}$, where $N$ counts updates and $λ$ is the weight decay. In simulations, recovery is approximately a function of the disagreement budget $bδ/η$ and saturates in the horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文指出种群梯度流会定性错误预测有限批SGD的行为：在两单元ReLU回归中，源任务使两神经元趋于正比例，目标任务奖励分离；经过长时间预训练后，小步长在线SGD以高概率无法恢复，而梯度流却能在与T线性时间内恢复。
AI.motivation: 种群梯度流常用于分析神经网络（尤其是预训练后）的适应过程，但其是否准确刻画有限批SGD存在疑问。作者希望揭示两者在定性行为上的偏差及其具体机制。
AI.method: 在两单元ReLU回归模型上，先由源任务训练使两神经元趋于正比例，再在目标任务上比较种群梯度流与批大小b、步长η的在线SGD。通过分析两ReLU门不一致输入构成的楔形区域（概率δ/π），结合权重衰减使角度指数收缩，并在不依赖扩散近似的情况下沿精确在线递归界采样概率，推导恢复所需的样本量与批大小条件。
AI.result: 当T≳log(b/η)时，在线SGD在约e^{c/η}的时间范围内以高概率失败，且在一个高斯概率超过1%的显式初始化集上一致成立；对固定T，小步长SGD仍能恢复，因此失败需要小步长与长预训练的联合极限。高概率恢复所需条件为Nb≳e^{λT}且b≳ηe^{λT}。模拟中恢复近似由“不一致预算”bδ/η决定，并在时间尺度上饱和。
AI.conclusion: 种群梯度流与有限批SGD在预训练适应中可能出现定性分歧；该分歧由两ReLU门不一致输入楔形区域的采样与权重衰减导致的角度收缩共同驱动，需同时满足小步长与长预训练才显现。

title: HI3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D): Object-specific 3D Asset Generation with High Resolution
summary: Image-to-3D generation has become increasingly capable of producing objects that closely resemble the input image, and an outstanding challenge is to reproduce the depicted object itself, including the specific geometry that defines it. Inscriptions, brand marks, and repeated structures are frequently distorted or lost, despite being critical to object identity. We present Hi3D 3.0, an image-to-3D generation system targeting object-specific fidelity, with Twinkle3D as its geometry model for generating watertight triangle meshes at $2048^{3}$ resolution. Twinkle3D advances high-fidelity geometry generation along four dimensions. First, while O-Voxel/FaithC offers high representational precision, it often suffers from poor surface quality and non-watertight geometry. We address both issues while retaining its $2048^{3}$-level precision. Second, we scale diffusion generation to sequences of up to 300K geometric tokens through a redesigned DiT architecture and large-scale distributed training optimizations, reducing training time per step from approximately ten minutes to ten seconds. Third, subsequent refinement cannot fully compensate for errors introduced during initial generation; we therefore strengthen both global shape and local detail in the initial generation stage, and the resulting single-stage model surpasses prior two-stage pipelines with $512^{3}$ refinement. Finally, we introduce a fine-grained image-3D cross-modal interaction mechanism that strengthens correspondence between visual evidence and geometric tokens, improving the recovery of object-specific structures. We evaluate geometric fidelity using alignment metrics derived from silhouettes and normal fields. Hi3D 3.0 outperforms four commercial systems across all reported metrics, recovering 82.1% of inscribed characters at 98.2% precision, compared with 21.7% recall for the strongest competitor.

AI.tldr: Hi3D 3.0是一个图像到3D生成系统，以Twinkle3D为几何模型，在2048^3分辨率下生成水密三角网格，显著提升物体专属细节保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到3D生成虽能生成与输入图像相似的物体，但常丢失或扭曲物体的专属细节（如铭文、品牌标记、重复结构），而这些对物体身份至关重要。
AI.method: Twinkle3D从四方面改进：(1)解决O-Voxel/FaithC表面质量差、非水密问题，同时保留2048^3精度；(2)通过重设DiT架构和分布式训练优化，将扩散生成扩展至30万几何token，每步训练从约10分钟降至10秒；(3)强化初始生成的全局形状与局部细节，使单阶段模型超越此前512^3精修的两阶段流程；(4)引入细粒度图像-3D跨模态交互机制，增强视觉证据与几何token的对应。
AI.result: 采用基于轮廓和法线场的对齐指标评估，Hi3D 3.0在所有指标上超越四款商用系统，铭文字符恢复召回率达82.1%、精度98.2%，而最强竞品召回率仅21.7%。
AI.conclusion: Hi3D 3.0在物体专属几何保真度上大幅领先现有商用系统，尤其擅长恢复关键细节结构。

title: Universal Textual Teaching for LLMs
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret or reuse across models and limits KD for API-only or costly-to-train models. This paper studies knowledge transfer for large language models (LLMs). We introduce Universal Textual Teaching (UTT), a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into a textual, interpretable, and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer. Specifically, UTT first identifies representative gap cases through paired evaluations, and iteratively updates the Primer via multi-role interactions: the Student attempts each task, the Prompter turns evaluation feedback into a teaching instruction, the Teacher provides a targeted demonstration, and the Synthesizer consolidates validated lessons. Empirically, on the challenging math (Omni-MATH-2) and code generation (KernelBench) tasks, extensive results confirm the effectiveness of the method: UTT remarkably raises the Student's accuracy from 9.4% to 48.6% and Fast1 accuracy from 9% to 35% on KernelBench, while increasing mathematical reasoning accuracy from 27.6% to 51.7%. UTT also performs better than representative prompt engineering and parameter-based KD methods. Of note, UTT is shown to be generalizable across different Teachers and Students: a Primer synthesized for one Teacher-Student pair can generalize to other Students that do not participate in the synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出UTT，一种无需更新参数的知识蒸馏框架，将师生知识差距蒸馏为可解释、可复用的自然语言产物Primer。
AI.motivation: 传统KD需训练学生参数，知识绑定于特定架构和检查点，难以解释和跨模型复用，且不适用于仅API或训练成本高的模型。
AI.method: UTT通过配对评估识别代表性差距案例，利用多角色交互迭代更新Primer：学生尝试任务、Prompter将反馈转为教学指令、Teacher提供示范、Synthesizer整合有效经验。
AI.result: 在Omni-MATH-2和KernelBench上，学生准确率从9.4%升至48.6%，Fast1从9%升至35%，数学推理从27.6%升至51.7%，优于Prompt工程和参数化KD方法，且Primer可跨师生泛化。
AI.conclusion: UTT实现了免参数更新、可解释、可复用的知识蒸馏，效果显著且具跨模型泛化能力。

title: Towards Unified Evaluation of Prompt Enhancers for Video Generation
summary: Modern video generators can realize increasingly complex visual narratives, positioning the prompt enhancer (PE) as a critical bridge from concise user instructions and multimodal references to structured cinematic plans. However, existing PE evaluation relies on rendered videos, imposing substantial computational and human costs, slowing PE training and iteration, and conflating PE quality with downstream generator behavior. To address this gap, we introduce PEBench, the first unified benchmark for direct PE evaluation across text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video prompt enhancement. It comprises 1,100 expert-verified cases and 1,005 visual assets, spanning 35 fine-grained tasks with diverse temporal, cinematic, audiovisual, and multi-reference requirements. In addition, we develop PEBench evaluation, an evidence-grounded framework that combines modality-aware fact extraction with rubric-based assessment across 24 criteria. Our systematic evaluation of representative open- and closed-source PE methods reveals an emerging shift from fine-grained descriptive expansion toward intent-preserving cinematic planning, while the caption-reconstruction and forward-refinement methods show complementary strengths in cinematic coverage and semantic fidelity or internal coherence, respectively. Human validation shows that PEBench scores align closely with expert judgments of enhanced prompts and downstream videos from Wan3.0 and MiniMax-H3, indicating that prompt-level evaluation reliably reflects downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 提出PEBench，首个直接评估提示增强器（PE）的统一基准，覆盖T2V、I2V、R2V三类任务，避免依赖渲染视频的高成本评估。
AI.motivation: 现有PE评估依赖渲染视频，计算与人工成本高，拖慢PE训练迭代，并将PE质量与下游生成器行为混淆，缺乏直接评估手段。
AI.method: 构建PEBench基准，含1,100个专家验证案例、1,005个视觉素材，覆盖35个细粒度任务（时序、电影化、视听、多参考等）；并开发PEBench evaluation，结合模态感知事实提取与基于24项标准的评分量表评估框架。
AI.result: 系统评估代表性开源与闭源PE方法，发现从细粒度描述扩展向意图保持的电影化规划的转变趋势；caption-reconstruction与forward-refinement方法在电影化覆盖、语义保真或内部一致性上各有互补优势。
AI.conclusion: 人类验证表明PEBench分数与专家对增强提示及Wan3.0、MiniMax-H3下游视频的评判高度一致，证明提示级评估可可靠反映下游效用。

title: Use and Disuse: Intent-Structured Experience Consolidation for Memory and Learning in LLM Agents
summary: The evolution of Large Language Model agents from single-task execution to long-term autonomous operation highlights the critical challenge of transforming continuous experiences into reusable knowledge. To address this, we propose Hippocam, a hierarchical memory and continual learning architecture. Hippocam draws inspiration from two characteristics of human memory: cognitive processes selectively maintain information relevant to current goals, while long-term memories form gradually through repeated consolidation. Accordingly, Hippocam structures an agent's ongoing work as nested intents. The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.

AI.tldr: Hippocam是一种受人类记忆启发的大语言模型智能体分层记忆与持续学习架构，通过嵌套意图、递归前缀整合实现经验的抽象化与复用。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体从单任务执行走向长期自主运行，核心挑战在于如何将连续经验转化为可复用知识。
AI.method: 借鉴人类记忆两大特性（目标相关性选择、重复巩固形成长期记忆），将工作组织为嵌套意图；活动上下文聚焦当前意图，已完成意图被整合为后续所需的结果与状态；采用递归前缀整合使久未使用的经验逐渐抽象，同时保留原始交互以按需恢复细节；经验被召回时随风新经验再次巩固。
AI.result: 通过"使用与废弃"的记忆动态，将工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累与技能学习统一于一个持续演进的经验过程中。
AI.conclusion: 使智能体无需参数更新即可通过自身经验学习并演进能力。

title: When to Intervene? State-Aware Sparse Manipulation in Federated Reinforcement Learning
summary: Federated reinforcement learning (FRL) enables distributed agents to collaboratively train decision-making policies, but its decentralized training process also exposes global policy learning to Byzantine manipulation. Existing poisoning attacks primarily focus on how to construct malicious updates, while trajectory-level intervention timing remains largely implicit. In sequential decision making, however, where an intervention is applied can alter subsequent trajectories and learning signals. Through controlled experiments, we find that changing the selected trajectory states materially alters attack efficacy even when the malicious-update construction is fixed. We therefore identify when as a distinct attack dimension and introduce the Viability-constrained Behavioral Steering Attack (V-BSA), which uses local policy uncertainty to select sparse intervention states and applies envelope-constrained behavioral steering. Across discrete-action benchmarks, V-BSA achieves substantial degradation against robust aggregators and ensemble defenses with only a fraction of the interventions used by dense poisoning, while revealing task- and aggregation-dependent boundaries. Overall, our results highlight intervention timing as a distinct dimension of sequential robustness in FRL. The code is available at https://github.com/Yodeesy/V-BSA

AI.tldr: 本文提出V-BSA攻击,通过利用局策略不确定性选择稀疏干预状态,在联邦强化学习中实现高效拜占庭投毒。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦强化学习投毒攻击主要关注如何构造恶意更新,而忽略了轨迹级干预时机这一独立维度。在序列决策中,干预位置会影响后续轨迹与学习信号。
AI.method: 通过控制实验验证选定轨迹状态对攻击效果的影响,提出Viability约束行为操控攻击(V-BSA),利用本地策略不确定性选择稀疏干预状态,并施加包络约束的行为操控。
AI.result: 在离散动作基准上,V-BSA仅用少量干预即可对鲁棒聚合器与集成防御造成显著性能退化,并揭示了任务与聚合方式相关的边界。
AI.conclusion: 研究将干预时机确立为联邦强化学习序列鲁棒性的一个独立维度。

title: Streaming-Aware Diffusion for Real-Time Video Super-Resolution via Cross-Step Attention
summary: Real-time video super-resolution requires high spatio-temporal fidelity under strict latency constraints, challenging diffusion models due to their iterative sampling cost and limited temporal coordination. We propose a streaming-aware framework that adapts pretrained single-image latent diffusion models for efficient video super-resolution (VSR) by exploiting the sequential structure of video streams. Our Cross-Step Attention mechanism reuses intermediate denoising features across adjacent frames and diffusion steps, enabling temporal information exchange without explicit temporal modeling. We further introduce Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling, which aligns adjacent diffusion states and provides cleaner intermediate representations for cross-step conditioning, improving temporal coherence. These components are integrated into a streaming inference pipeline that incrementally propagates latent states across frames, reducing the effective computational complexity from $O(N \cdot S)$ to $O(N + S)$ for $N$ frames and $S$ diffusion steps. Experiments on REDS4 and YouHQ40-Test demonstrate improved perceptual quality and temporal realism while maintaining frame-wise stability. Our method achieves over 40 FPS at $512 \times 512$ resolution after cold start, enabling real-time VSR without explicit temporal modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出流式感知框架，将预训练单图像潜在扩散模型适配到实时视频超分，通过跨步注意力和轨迹耦合扩散调度，将复杂度从O(N·S)降到O(N+S)，实现40+ FPS。
AI.motivation: 实时视频超分需在严格延迟约束下保证时空保真度，而扩散模型因迭代采样成本高、时序协调有限难以满足需求。
AI.method: 利用视频流的序列结构，提出Cross-Step Attention在相邻帧和扩散步间复用中间去噪特征，实现隐式时序信息交换；引入Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling对齐相邻扩散状态，为跨步条件提供更干净表示；整合为流式推理管线增量传播潜状态。
AI.result: 在REDS4和YouHQ40-Test上提升了感知质量和时序真实性，保持帧间稳定性；冷启动后512×512分辨率下超40 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 无需显式时序建模即可实现实时视频超分，验证了流式扩散框架的有效性。

title: An Investigation of Model Coherence: Narrow Finetunes Contradict Themselves Under Resampling
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/themachinefan/twominds
summary: A large body of research measures model coherence based on output variance without adequately considering competing causes. We identify two such causes, ambiguity and indifference, and we introduce a set of 175 questions where contradicting answers cannot easily be explained by either. We then measure incoherence in terms of contradictions when resampling answers to the same question. In contrast to other methods our metric has high specificity, and only ranks models as incoherent when the issues are glaring. Even so, we find narrow finetunes score poorly. Inspecting inconsistencies flagged by our method, we find that model organisms from the literature display severe issues such as identity conflation, introspection failures and rationalizations. These findings suggest that the pathologies induced by narrow finetuning may limit what these models can tell us about coherent misaligned behaviour.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种高特异性的模型不一致性度量方法，通过在175个精心设计的问题上重采样答案来检测矛盾，并发现窄域微调模型存在严重不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常基于输出方差衡量模型一致性，但未充分考虑导致方差的竞争性原因，如歧义和无关紧要（indifference）。这些混淆因素会使模型看似不一致，实则并非如此，从而影响对模型不一致性的准确判断。
AI.method: 作者识别出歧义和无关紧要两种竞争性原因，设计了一个包含175个问题的数据集，使得矛盾答案难以用这两种原因解释。然后通过对同一问题重采样答案，以矛盾程度衡量不一致性（incoherence）。
AI.result: 该方法具有高特异性，只有当问题明显时才将模型列为不一致；即便如此，窄域微调模型得分仍很差。检查被标记的不一致时，发现文献中的模型有机体表现出身份混淆、内省失败和合理化等严重问题。
AI.conclusion: 窄域微调引发的病理可能限制这些模型在揭示一致性失调行为方面所能提供的信息，说明用此类模型研究连贯的错位行为存在局限。

title: Conditional Transfer from Controlled Pretraining Mixtures to Code
summary:
Synthetic tasks are increasingly used both as probes of language-model capability and as pretraining data. Both uses are often justified by loss reduction: falling loss is treated as informative, and faster loss reduction with more sampling as evidence that a task is worth sampling. We separate three signals. A task is diagnostic when its loss tracks global pretraining progress; it is teachable when its loss responds to its own token budget; and a data source transfers when including it improves a downstream target. We study controlled pretraining in which 70% of the corpus is fixed general Python and the remaining 30% is a simplex over three source families: OpenCodeInstruct, a curated suite of 12 code-adjacent synthetic tasks, and 15 literature-derived probe tasks. Across a task-budget sweep we detect teachability for 14 of 27 tasks, with a sharp asymmetry between the two synthetic families (10/12 curated versus 4/15 literature-derived).
  Teachability and downstream transfer give different rankings. On the mixture-simplex edge between the curated suite and OpenCodeInstruct, HumanEval pass@20 after a fixed fine-tuning stage rises from 15.9 at pure curated data to its highest observed value, 22.6, at a mixture that is 75% OpenCodeInstruct, then falls to 19.5 at pure OpenCodeInstruct. Curated synthetic data therefore has conditional value: it contributes as a limited share of a mixture that a target-aligned source still dominates. Finally, a loss-based adaptive scheduler exposes the mismatch between residual loss reducibility and downstream transfer. Across three 60k-step free-ratio runs, Ado drives the OpenCodeInstruct share below 5% within the first 5k steps and to 1.2--1.4% by the end of training, and underperforms its matched fixed-mixture controls by 2.4--11.0 percentage points. Optimizing near-term task-loss reduction moves the mixture away from the region that transfers.

AI.tldr: 论文区分合成任务的三个信号（诊断性、可教性、迁移性），发现可教性与下游迁移给出不同排序；精选合成数据仅在混合中占少量时有条件价值，基于loss的自适应调度会偏离有效迁移区域。
AI.motivation: 合成任务既被用作能力探针又被用作预训练数据，二者常以loss下降为依据（loss越低越有信息、采样越多loss降得越快越值得采样）。作者认为这种"loss减少即价值"的假设过于笼统，需要把不同含义的信号拆开，厘清什么任务真正有用。
AI.method: 控制变量预训练：语料70%为固定通用Python，剩余30%是三类来源（OpenCodeInstruct、12个精选代码相关合成任务、15个文献衍生的探针任务）的单纯形混合。进行任务预算扫描以检测可教性，并在混合单纯形边上评估下游迁移（固定微调后HumanEval pass@20），同时比较基于loss的自适应调度器与固定混合对照。
AI.result: 任务预算扫描中27个任务有14个可教，两类合成族差异明显（精选10/12 vs 文献衍生4/15）。迁移排序不同于可教性：精选与OpenCodeInstruct混合边上，HumanEval pass@20从纯精选15.9升至75% OpenCodeInstruct混合时的最高22.6，再降至纯OpenCodeInstruct的19.5。三个60k步自适应调度运行中，Ado在前5k步将OpenCodeInstruct份额压到5%以下、结束时1.2--1.4%，比匹配的固定混合对照低2.4--11.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 可教性与下游迁移是不同信号，不能用loss减少互相替代。精选合成数据具有条件性价值，只在被目标对齐数据主导的混合中占有限份额时才有益；按近端任务loss下降优化会把混合推离能真正迁移的区域。

title: Dino Forcing Flow Models: Do not denoise what you can predict
summary: Co-denoising pretrained representations such as DINO can substantially improve the training speed and quality of flow matching models, but it introduces a second denoising trajectory and requires carefully designed schedules. We propose a simpler alternative: predict the pretrained representation directly, then condition the model on its own prediction. This removes the need for a second ODE and any representation-specific denoising schedules, while retaining the benefits of representation guidance. Our approach converges substantially faster and achieves better generation quality as measured by FID score. On ImageNet, it outperforms the state of the art in latent space at 2x fewer epochs than prior methods; in pixel space, it improves FID over comparable prior methods by more than 20%. These results support a simple principle: do not denoise what you can predict. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出直接预测预训练表示（而非对其去噪）来引导流匹配模型，简化训练并提升生成质量与速度。
AI.motivation: 现有 co-denoising 方法（如 DINO）虽能加速并提升流匹配生成质量，但引入第二条去噪轨迹，需要精心设计的调度器，增加复杂度。
AI.method: 直接预测预训练表示，并将模型条件建立在其自身预测之上；无需第二条 ODE，也无需表示特定的去噪调度。
AI.result: 收敛更快、FID 更优：ImageNet 上潜空间以 2 倍更少 epoch 超越 SOTA；像素空间 FID 较同类方法提升超 20%。
AI.conclusion: 支持一个简单原则：能预测的就不要去噪。代码已开源。

title: OA-MAP: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Multimodal Framework for Interpretable Knee Osteoarthritis Progression
summary: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) progression prediction can support patient monitoring, requiring the integration of multimodal data and multidomain expertise. Moreover, isolated risk estimates provide limited insight underlying a prediction. To automate the progression assessment workflow and reduce manual effort while providing interpretable findings and supporting evidence, we present OA-MAP, an autonomous multi-agent framework for evidence-grounded assessment of structural and pain progression in KOA. The system incorporates modality-specific agents including MRI, X-ray, and clinical agents, together with a coordinator agent. This framework can autonomously recruit specialist agents, select tools for prediction and analysis, and retrieve literature as external evidence based on user request and available patient information. An uncertainty-informed human-in-the-loop mechanism enables clinicians to review and correct intermediate findings, triggering recomputation of affected results. We evaluate the prediction models using 600 participants from the FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium cohort. On the test set of 100 participants, the fusion models achieve AUROCs of 0.80 for structural progression and 0.68 for pain progression. A case study illustrates how OA-MAP combines risk estimates with intermediate findings, cross-modal conflicts, literature support, and uncertainty indicators to support interactive review.

AI.tldr: 提出OA-MAP，一个自主多智能体框架，用于KOA结构与疼痛进展的可解释、证据支撑评估。
AI.motivation: KOA进展预测需整合多模态数据与多领域专业知识，且孤立的风险估计缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 含MRI、X-ray、临床等模态专属智能体及协调者智能体，可自主招募专家、选择分析与预测工具、检索文献；引入不确定性驱动的human-in-the-loop机制供临床医生审核纠正。
AI.result: 在FNIH队列600人中评估，100人测试集上融合模型AUROC为结构进展0.80、疼痛进展0.68。
AI.conclusion: OA-MAP能结合风险估计、中间发现、跨模态冲突、文献支持与不确定性指标，支持交互式审查。

title: $C_4$-Equivariant Flow Matching on Anisotropic Power-Diagram Graphs for Microstructure Generation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshops on Representations for the Physical Sciences and Geometric Distributional Deep Learning. 12 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
summary: Acquiring realistic microstructure data through Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) is costly and time consuming, often relying on specialised equipment. As microstructures strongly influence material properties, generating realistic samples is essential for modelling the behaviour of polycrystalline materials. We introduce a generative model for synthesising realistic polycrystalline microstructures using flow matching and graph neural networks. By representing microstructures as anisotropic power diagrams, our model learns a compact geometric parametrisation and can render generated samples at arbitrary pixel resolution. A $C_4$-equivariant architecture incorporates rotational symmetry directly into the model, ensuring that rotations of the input noise produce corresponding rotations of the generated microstructure. We also demonstrate how training-free guidance can be used to generate complex microstructures, based on user defined objective function. In particular, we generate microstructures resembling a copper weld, cast metal slab, 3D-printed stainless steel and heterogeneous lamella titanium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于flow matching与图神经网络的生成模型，用各向异性power diagram表示多晶微结构，实现低成本、任意分辨率、具备旋转等变性的真实微结构合成。
AI.motivation: EBSD获取真实微结构数据成本高、耗时长且依赖专业设备，而微结构强烈影响材料性能，因此需要生成真实样本来建模多晶材料行为。
AI.method: 将微结构表示为各向异性power diagram以获得紧凑几何参数化；采用flow matching与图神经网络构建生成模型，可任意像素分辨率渲染；设计C4等变架构将旋转对称性嵌入模型，保证输入噪声旋转对应生成微结构的旋转；并引入无需训练的引导机制。
AI.result: 模型可基于用户定义的目标函数进行无训练引导，生成复杂微结构，成功复现铜焊缝、铸造金属板、3D打印不锈钢及异质层片钛等微结构。
AI.conclusion: 该生成框架能低成本合成真实多晶微结构，具备分辨率灵活性与旋转等变性，并通过无训练引导支持用户自定义的复杂微结构生成。

title: Memory Forcing: Attendable Mid-Horizon History for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache. Once an event leaves this window, later frames can no longer attend to it, a failure we term mid-horizon forgetting. We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size. Its Archive \& Working Banks partition the cache into sink, archive, and working regions, retaining diverse intermediate events alongside recent motion under fixed memory. Because absolute temporal indices drift outside the training range, Bank-aware RoPE reassigns indices at attention time so each bank remains distinguishable. At 1.3B, Memory Forcing leads on longer clips, shows the smallest drop from 5s to 60s among methods reporting all four lengths, and preserves subjects and scenes through leave-and-return. The same design scales to Wan2.2 5B, producing more physically plausible, realistic, and dynamic videos and, to our knowledge, the first public 5B model on this forcing line.

AI.tldr: 提出 Memory Forcing，一种少步流式自回归视频扩散方法，在不增加 KV 缓存大小的前提下保留被固定窗口丢弃的中程历史，缓解"中程遗忘"问题，并扩展到 5B 模型。
AI.motivation: 现有少步流式系统仅保留开头与最近帧的固定大小 KV 缓存，事件离开窗口后后续帧无法再关注它，导致 mid-horizon forgetting（中程遗忘）。
AI.method: 将缓存划分为 sink、archive、working 三个区域的 Archive & Working Banks；在固定内存下同时保留多样化的中间事件与近期运动；用 Bank-aware RoPE 在注意力阶段重分配时间索引，避免绝对索引超出训练范围并保持各 bank 可区分。
AI.result: 在 1.3B 规模下，长视频表现领先；在同时报告 5s–60s 四种长度的方法中从 5s 到 60s 的性能下降最小；在离开-返回场景中保持主体与场景一致。扩展到 Wan2.2 5B 后生成更符合物理、更真实且更动态的视频，为该 forcing 路线下首个公开的 5B 模型。
AI.conclusion: 固定缓存的记忆分区加索引重分配可有效扩展流式视频扩散的时间一致性，且该设计具备良好可扩展性。

title: Q-Shaped Options for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Learning to tackle long-horizon, goal-conditioned tasks requires an agent to reason over extended timescales and act across a broad range of states. In principle, Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) addresses both challenges through the interaction between action (temporal) and state (spatial) abstraction. First, using an action abstraction to represent temporally extended behaviour as options reduces the effective decision horizon. Second, enabling different state abstractions at each level of the decision process permits greater data aggregation for learning. However, realising these two benefits of a hierarchical policy depends on learning an appropriate action abstraction. Current HRL algorithms fail in one of two ways. Some discard distinctions between options needed for optimal control, undermining hierarchy altogether. Others retain unnecessary distinctions, preserving horizon reduction, but forfeiting coarser state abstraction. In this work, we characterise three desiderata for an action abstraction. We introduce Q-Shaped Options (QSO) to address all three. QSO builds on an architecture with distinct state-value functions, Q functions and policies at each level of the hierarchy. It learns the action abstraction between consecutive levels as a shared encoder shaped by their respective Q functions. The low-level Q function uses the option as a goal, encouraging the abstraction to retain distinctions necessary for optimal control. The high-level Q function uses it as an action, encouraging unnecessary distinctions to be discarded. Across offline goal-conditioned locomotion and manipulation environments, QSO learns semantically meaningful option spaces and outperforms baselines, achieving non-zero performance in tasks where all other evaluated algorithms fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Q-Shaped Options (QSO)，通过由高低层Q函数共同塑造的共享编码器学习动作抽象，同时满足保留最优控制所需区分与丢弃冗余区分，从而在离线目标条件下超越基线。
AI.motivation: 长时序目标条件任务需要跨时间与状态推理。HRL本应通过动作(时间)与状态(空间)抽象解决，但现有HRL算法要么丢失对最优控制必要的选项区分(削弱层次)，要么保留冗余区分(保留时间缩减却牺牲粗粒度状态抽象)。因此需要一种能恰当学习动作抽象的方法。
AI.method: 作者刻画了动作抽象的三项期望标准，并提出QSO。QSO在层级各层使用独立的状态价值函数、Q函数与策略，并将相邻层之间的动作抽象学习为共享编码器，由两层各自的Q函数塑造。低层Q函数将选项作为目标，促使抽象保留最优控制所需的区分；高层Q函数将选项作为动作，促使丢弃不必要的区分。
AI.result: 在离线目标条件运动与操作环境中，QSO学到语义上有意义的选项空间，性能超越基线，并在其他所有被评估算法均失败的任务上取得非零性能。
AI.conclusion: 共享编码器结合高低层Q函数塑造的动作抽象能同时实现时间与状态抽象的两大优势，是解决现有HRL缺陷的有效方向。

title: New Lower Bound and Upper Bounds on the Regret for Online Sparse Linear Regression
comment: This work was accepted by IJTCS-FAW 2026
summary: We study online sparse linear regression (OSLR) where any algorithm is restricted to accessing only $b$ out of $d$ attributes per instance for prediction and $b_0\geq 0$ additional attributes after prediction, which was proved to be NP-hard. Previous work focused on designing computationally efficient algorithms under regularity assumptions, but did not characterize its information theoretic complexity. In this work, we give the first lower bound on the minimax regret of OSLR and design algorithms with better upper bounds without regularity assumptions. We characterize how minimax regret scales with problem-dependent parameters, capturing the information theoretic complexity of OSLR.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在线稀疏线性回归（OSLR）的信息论复杂度，首次给出最小最大遗憾的下界，并在无正则假设下设计了更优上界的算法。
AI.motivation: OSLR中算法每次只能访问d个属性中的b个进行预测、预测后最多再访问b0个属性，已被证明是NP难的。已有工作主要依赖正则假设设计高效算法，但未刻画其信息论复杂度。
AI.method: 作者给出OSLR最小最大遗憾的第一个下界，并设计在无正则假设下具有更优上界的算法，刻画遗憾如何随问题相关参数变化。
AI.result: 获得了OSLR最小最大遗憾的首个下界，并实现了比已有工作更好的上界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作刻画了OSLR的信息论复杂度，揭示了最小最大遗憾随问题相关参数的缩放规律。

title: From Video Clips to Creation Trajectory: Sora100K for AI-Native Video Creation
summary: AI-Native video creation is shifting from isolated video clips toward iterative video creation workflows. However, existing datasets remain largely video clips, representing video generation and editing as separate tasks rather than connected stages of a video creation workflow. In this paper, we introduce Sora100K, a dataset that represents the AI-Native video creation workflow as a structured video creation trajectory. Specifically, we first identify video creation trajectories and decompose them into three subsets according to their structural roles: text-to-video generation records as roots, single-turn video editing records as editing edges, and multi-turn video editing records as complete trajectories. Then, we use a VLM to assign semantic annotations for generation roots and editing-operation annotations for editing edges. A strict construction pipeline further reconstructs source-to-edit lineage, editing order, and intermediate video states while ensuring data quality. Finally, we perform lightweight adaptation on LTX-2 models to assess the supervision value of Sora100K. The results show improvements in visual quality, multi-shot generation, and cross-shot consistency, while successive-turn evaluation reveals that following multi-turn editing instructions remains challenging. Sora100K establishes a new data foundation for AI-Native video creation beyond isolated video clips and toward structured video creation trajectory. The dataset and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K.

AI.tldr: Sora100K将AI原生视频创作建模为结构化创作轨迹数据集，包含生成、单轮和多轮编辑记录，基于LTX-2验证其监督价值并揭示多轮编辑仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集多为孤立视频片段，将视频生成与编辑割裂为独立任务，无法反映迭代式视频创作工作流的连通性。
AI.method: 将创作轨迹按结构角色分解为三类子集（文生视频为根、单轮编辑为边、多轮编辑为完整轨迹）；用VLM标注生成语义与编辑操作；通过严格流程重建源到编辑的血缘、编辑顺序及中间视频状态。
AI.result: 对LTX-2轻量适配后，视觉质量、多镜头生成与跨镜头一致性均有提升；连续轮次评估显示遵循多轮编辑指令仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: Sora100K为超越孤立片段、走向结构化视频创作轨迹的AI原生视频创作提供了新的数据基础。

title: Instruction-Conditioned Electromagnetic Spectrum Understanding via Budget-Adaptive Signal Tokenization
summary: Electromagnetic spectrum monitoring increasingly requires flexible analysis beyond task-specific recognition and detection. Multimodal large language models offer a unified interface, but extending vision-language models (VLMs) to raw I/Q signals requires tokenization that balances fidelity against a strict budget. For signals, dense encoding causes token costs to grow with observation length, whereas fixed-resolution compression may discard short-duration or localized signal evidence. Thus, we propose \textbf{BATok}, a budget-adaptive signal tokenizer that adjusts token capacity to the input length while allocating that capacity according to the signal content. BATok constructs candidate representations from signal-derived features using lightweight multi-resolution branches, then combines a local energy prior with learnable queries to resample these representations into compact signal tokens. The number of tokens adapts to the input length while remaining strictly bounded. The resulting tokens are projected into the language embedding space of VLMs. We further introduce \textbf{EMSpec-Instruct}, a multimodal instruction dataset aligning raw I/Q signals, waterfall images, and language supervision for modulation recognition, structured detection, and language-conditioned signal grounding. Experiments show that BATok learns effective signal representations and achieves competitive performance across all tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出预算自适应信号分词器BATok及多模态指令数据集EMSpec-Instruct，将原始I/Q信号接入视觉语言模型，在多项电磁频谱任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 电磁频谱监测需要超越特定任务的灵活分析能力，多模态大语言模型提供了统一接口。但将视觉语言模型扩展到原始I/Q信号时，分词需在保真度与严格预算间权衡：稠密编码导致token开销随观测长度增长，而固定分辨率压缩可能丢失短时或局部信号证据。
AI.method: 提出BATok，一种预算自适应信号分词器：用轻量多分辨率分支从信号特征构建候选表示，结合局部能量先验与可学习查询将这些表示重采样为紧凑信号token；token数量随输入长度自适应且严格有界，并投影到VLM语言嵌入空间。同时构建EMSpec-Instruct多模态指令数据集，对齐原始I/Q信号、瀑布图与语言监督，覆盖调制识别、结构化检测和语言条件信号定位。
AI.result: 实验表明BATok能学习有效的信号表示，并在所有任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: BATok通过预算自适应分词有效解决I/Q信号接入VLM的token效率与保真度矛盾，配合EMSpec-Instruct数据集，验证了该框架在电磁频谱多任务分析中的有效性。

title: Best of Both Worlds in Federated LSA: Speedup When Possible, Personalization Always
summary: We study personalized federated linear stochastic approximation (LSA), a framework which notably encompass personalized temporal difference learning. In this setting, heterogeneous agents collaborate to solve distinct linear fixed-point equations, each corresponding to an agent-specific learning problem. A central open question in personalized learning is whether a single method can adapt to an unknown level of heterogeneity by converging to each agent's personalized solution in all regimes while achieving a linear speedup in the number of agents when their learning problems are sufficiently similar. We answer this question affirmatively by introducing PF-LSA, a minimalist algorithm that mixes each agent's local stochastic update with the average update across agents, at no additional computational cost relative to standard federated methods. We prove that PF-LSA, achieves best-of-both-worlds guarantees without any prior knowledge on the level of heterogeneity. Our analysis is based on a sharp decomposition of the error into consensus and disagreement components. The consensus error decays rapidly, whereas the disagreement error decays more slowly but becomes negligible in low-heterogeneity regimes.

AI.tldr: 论文研究个性化联邦线性随机逼近(LSA)，提出PF-LSA算法，能在未知异质性水平下自适应，实现"两全其美"的收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 个性化学习中一个核心开放问题：是否存在单一方法能在未知异质性水平下，既收敛到每个智能体的个性化解，又在学习问题足够相似时获得随智能体数量的线性加速。
AI.method: 提出PF-LSA，一种极简算法：将每个智能体的局部随机更新与所有智能体的平均更新相混合，计算开销与标准联邦方法相比无额外增加。
AI.result: 证明PF-LSA无需任何关于异质性水平的先验知识，即可实现"两全其美"的保证。分析基于误差的精细分解：共识误差与分歧误差。共识误差快速衰减，分歧误差衰减较慢但在低异质性情形下可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作肯定地回答了个性化学习的核心开放问题，PF-LSA在各类异质性情形下均能自适应收敛并取得线性加速。

title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
summary: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill-V——可验证的自演化技能库,用版本化、可证伪的契约表示技能,通过环境结果驱动技能增加与修订,在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上分别达 95.3% 和 85.9% 成功率,且库更紧凑。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化技能库主要通过积累新知识来改进,失败会促使新技能,而已存技能很少被重新审视。但仅增长不保证可靠性:检索到的技能在当前任务条件下可能不适用,已有技能也可能编码了错误的操作边界。可靠演化需要测试和修订已有知识。
AI.method: 将技能表示为版本化、可证伪的契约,连接语义意图与可观测行为标准。用环境结果驱动演化:任务失败→增加技能;契约评估与任务结果的不一致→修订技能边界。修订需保留受保护语义约束,并在历史回放证据上满足不退化标准。最后用适用性感知过滤器排除判定为不适用的候选。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上成功率分别达 95.3% 和 85.9%,技能库比增长导向基线更紧凑。适用性过滤减少错误调用,结果驱动的修订纠正错误技能边界且不损害历史证据上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的技能演化不止于积累经验:技能库必须学会保留哪些知识、何时修订、何时应用。

title: Learning to Plan by Looking Back: Hindsight Hierarchies for Training Reasoning Models
summary: We introduce a self-improvement loop for reasoning models based on the following observation: Even when the difficulty of a problem exceeds the model's current solving abilities, an additionally supplied solution might enable the model to extract useful solution ideas in hindsight. We operationalize this by jointly training the same model to exhibit the following three capabilities: predicting solution ideas from problems alone, reverse-engineering ideas from problems and known solutions, and solving problems using provided ideas. The loop alternates between reverse engineering such ideas from problems with supplied solutions and using these ideas as additional supervision for joint training of all three capabilities. We give a formal specification of our method and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation remains future work.

AI.tldr: 提出一种推理模型的自改进闭环：通过联合训练"从问题预测思路、从问题+解反推思路、用思路解题"三种能力，在反推与联合训练间交替进行。
AI.motivation: 即使问题难度超出模型当前解题能力，额外提供的解答仍可能让模型事后提取有用的解题思路，从而利用这些思路进行自我提升。
AI.method: 将同一模型联合训练三种能力：(1)仅由问题预测解题思路；(2)由问题与已知解反推思路；(3)利用给定思路解题。闭环在"借助给定解反推思路"与"用这些思路作为额外监督联合训练三能力"之间交替。文中给出方法的形式化描述，并在Lean定理证明器中给出具体实例化。
AI.result: 本文仅提供方法的形式化规范及在Lean中的具体实例化，实验评估留待未来工作。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于"事后思路提取"的推理模型自改进框架及其在交互式定理证明中的具体形式，实证验证尚未进行。

title: Sera: Semantic Representation Aggregation for Reliable and Interpretable Battery Health Forecasting
summary: Battery state of health (SoH) forecasting is important for battery management, but remains challenging due to nonlinear degradation and heterogeneity across batteries. Existing data-driven approaches primarily use temporal models to learn from numerical battery time series, and higher-level degradation characteristics are often not explicitly represented. These characteristics, however, can provide degradation guidance to support reliable forecasting and make the influence of degradation more interpretable. In this paper, we propose \textsc{Sera}, a \underline{se}mantic \underline{r}epresentation \underline{a}ggregation framework that complements temporal modelling with degradation semantics. Guided by battery domain expertise, \textsc{Sera} extracts degradation semantics from time series and constructs two complementary representations using rule-based knowledge and LLM-based interpretation. The representations are independently encoded and integrated with the representation learned by temporal models through gated aggregations.
