Experiments on the mainstream benchmark across multiple prediction horizons and different temporal models show that \textsc{Sera} consistently improves forecasting performance, achieving up to a 37.3\% reduction in prediction error over the temporal baseline and enhanced generalizability. Counterfactual analysis examines how forecasts respond to changes in degradation semantics to assess interpretability. The results show that prediction responses are consistent with the meanings of key degradation descriptors across tested horizons. Together, these findings demonstrate that structured degradation semantics and effective aggregation can improve forecasting accuracy and support reliable and interpretable battery health forecasting for advanced battery management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sera框架，用降解语义表示补充时序模型，提升电池SoH预测精度与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 电池SoH预测对电池管理重要，但受非线性降解和电池间异质性影响，现有数据驱动方法主要依赖时序模型学习数值序列，未显式表示高层降解特征，导致预测可靠性和可解释性不足。
AI.method: Sera从时间序列中提取降解语义，构建基于规则知识和LLM解释的两种互补表示；分别编码后，通过门控聚合与时序模型学到的表示融合，实现语义表示聚合。
AI.result: 在主流基准上跨多个预测时长和不同时序模型，Sera持续提升预测性能，预测误差最高降低37.3%，并增强泛化性；反事实分析显示预测响应与关键降解描述符含义一致。
AI.conclusion: 结构化降解语义与有效聚合可提升电池健康预测的准确性与可解释性，为先进电池管理提供可靠支持。

title: Phase-aware video generation for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions
summary: Generating physically plausible videos for solid-gas dynamics is challenging as different phases exhibit distinct dynamics yet remain coupled through physical interactions. We present PAVG, a Phase-Aware Video Generator for solid-gas dynamics and interactions. It employs a dual-branch architecture to explicitly model the distinct dynamics of solids and gases, while spatiotemporal cross-attention captures their physical interactions. This design enables PAVG to preserve phasespecific motion characteristics while producing physically consistent responses across phases. To facilitate this task, we further construct a simulation corpus comprising over 700K physical trajectories across diverse solid, gas, and solid-gas interaction scenarios. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our PAVG produces videos with improved motion adherence, physical plausibility, and visual quality compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: PAVG是一种面向固-气动力学的相位感知视频生成器，通过双分支架构分别建模固相与气相动力学，并利用时空交叉注意力捕捉两相物理交互，同时构建了超70万条物理轨迹的仿真语料库。
AI.motivation: 固-气动力学视频生成具有挑战性：不同相态展现出截然不同的运动特性，但彼此又通过物理交互强耦合，难以同时保持相态特有运动和跨相的物理一致性。
AI.method: 提出PAVG双分支架构，显式建模固体和气体各自的动力学；采用时空交叉注意力(spatiotemporal cross-attention)刻画两相之间的物理交互；并构建包含70万余物理轨迹、覆盖多种固/气/固-气交互场景的仿真语料库以支持该任务。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，PAVG在运动贴合度、物理合理性和视觉质量方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: PAVG通过相位感知的双分支设计与跨相注意力机制，在保持相态特有运动的同时实现跨相物理一致响应，为固-气动力学视频生成提供了有效方案及大规模仿真数据支持。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.

AI.tldr: 提出MASS方法，通过多智能体自我监督实现模型递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 在开放式研究等不可验证任务上，模型输出超出人类专家可靠评估能力，导致监督瓶颈，模型自身成为最佳优化器与评估器；但单一模型实例在自我批判与改进复杂推理时存在困难。
AI.method: MASS交替进行进化式工作流优化与自生成轨迹上的监督微调。让单一基座模型迭代地提出、执行并自评估多智能体工作流，通过受结构护栏约束的进化搜索优化计算图式编排，发现任务所需的有效角色与信息路由。经两个MASS循环训练Qwen3.6-27B。
AI.result: 在四个开放式公开基准上，每输出token性能提升1.2-1.6倍；改进模型成为更好的优化器与评估器，实现持续递归自举；多智能体轨迹训练更高效，学生模型性能优于用1.4倍训练token训练的单智能体学生。
AI.conclusion: 从多智能体轨迹中联合学习编排与有界子智能体执行，可为递归自我改进提供有效信号。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Optimization for Physics-Aware Highway Trajectory Prediction
summary: Accurate trajectory forecasting and well-defined predictive uncertainty are crucial for reliable, safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Most trajectory prediction approaches provide point estimates only, while uncertainty-aware approaches typically quantify uncertainty only in the trajectory space. In physics-aware approaches, uncertainty in the predicted motion variables should be explicitly modeled and propagated through the vehicle dynamics. Otherwise, the resulting trajectory-space uncertainty may not fully reflect the variability introduced by the underlying motion prediction. Therefore, in this work, uncertainty-aware extensions of X-TRACK (X-TRACK-DE and X-TRACK-MCD), a physics-aware trajectory prediction framework, are proposed. The proposed framework predicts future vehicle motion variables and models both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties by propagating motion space uncertainty to trajectory space. Additionally, conformal prediction is applied to the trajectory space predictive covariance to construct uncertainty regions targeting a desired marginal coverage level. Evaluation on the highD dataset shows that X-TRACK-DE improves trajectory prediction accuracy over the deterministic baseline, while both uncertainty-aware variants provide predictive uncertainty that can be conformally calibrated to the desired marginal coverage level.

AI.tldr: 提出 X-TRACK 的两种不确定性感知扩展（X-TRACK-DE 与 X-TRACK-MCD），在运动空间建模偶然与认知不确定性并传播到轨迹空间，结合共形预测实现目标边际覆盖水平，在 highD 数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹预测方法多只输出点估计；不确定性感知方法通常仅在轨迹空间量化不确定性，忽略了运动空间不确定性，导致轨迹空间不确定性无法充分反映运动预测带来的变异性。
AI.method: 基于物理感知框架 X-TRACK，提出 X-TRACK-DE 与 X-TRACK-MCD，预测未来车辆运动变量，同时建模偶然不确定性与认知不确定性，并将运动空间不确定性传播至轨迹空间；再对轨迹空间预测协方差应用共形预测，构造满足目标边际覆盖水平的不确定性区域。
AI.result: 在 highD 数据集上，X-TRACK-DE 相比确定性基线提升了轨迹预测精度；两种不确定性感知变体均能提供可共形校准至目标边际覆盖水平的预测不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 在运动空间显式建模并传播不确定性，配合共形校准，可同时提升物理感知轨迹预测的精度与不确定性可靠性，适用于自动驾驶等安全关键场景。

title: Seek-and-View Reasoning for Multi-View Spatial Understanding
summary: Existing approaches to multi-view spatial reasoning operate largely on sparse input views. Vision-language models (VLMs) are thus restricted to understand a scene and infer spatial relations within these fixed views, leading to fragile cross-view alignment and geometry-to-language bottleneck. To address these issues, we formulate a novel Seek-and-View reasoning approach to find implicit cross-view spatial evidence by locating a question-relevant view to support the spatial reasoning. To realize this approach, we propose Vantage, a training-free model-agnostic reasoning framework that pairs a VLM with a 3D foundation model: a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage for question analysis and view planning, followed by a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage to effectively synthesize and incorporate visual evidence into the final reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on six VLMs demonstrate consistent improvements on five benchmarks without fine-tuning. Overall, by revealing spatial evidence through view-grounded reasoning, Vantage can largely reduce reliance on language-based cross-view alignment and improve multi-view spatial understanding. Our code is available at https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Vantage，一个无需训练、模型无关的推理框架，通过“寻找-观察”（Seek-and-View）方式定位与问题相关的视角，结合 3D 基础模型增强多视图空间推理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多基于稀疏输入视图，VLM 被限制在固定视角内推断空间关系，导致跨视图对齐脆弱，并存在几何到语言的瓶颈。
AI.method: Vantage 将 VLM 与 3D 基础模型配对：先进行视角锚定推理（问题分析与视图规划），再进行几何锚定证据增强（合成视觉证据并融入最终推理）。
AI.result: 在六个 VLM 和五个基准上，无需微调即取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过视角锚定推理揭示空间证据，Vantage 减少对语言式跨视图对齐的依赖，提升多视图空间理解。

title: When Has a Bayesian Neural Network Sampled Enough? Adaptive Inference Time with Statistical Guarantees
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: E-Values: From Statistics to ML
summary: Bayesian neural network predictions are commonly approximated using a fixed number of Monte Carlo samples per input, without controlling the resulting error that comes from this finite sample. We propose the use of confidence sequences to dynamically determine how many samples are needed while maintaining statistical guarantees. We consider several ways in which predictive probabilities are used, including identifying the most likely class, approximating the full predictive distribution, and resolving probability-threshold decisions. Sampling stops once the corresponding decision can be made with the desired guarantee. Experiments show that the method allocates the computational budget efficiently, assigning more samples to ambiguous inputs than to easy inputs while preserving reliable decisions and reducing overall latency relative to a fixed Monte Carlo budget.

AI.tldr: 用置信序列动态决定贝叶斯神经网络每次输入所需的蒙特卡洛样本数，在保证统计可靠性的同时提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络预测通常用固定数量的蒙特卡洛样本近似，但未控制有限采样带来的误差。
AI.method: 提出使用置信序列动态确定所需样本数，以维持统计保证；覆盖预测概率的多种用途，包括识别最可能类别、近似完整预测分布、以及概率阈值决策；一旦可在所需保证下做出决策即停止采样。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法高效分配计算预算，对模糊输入分配更多样本、对简单输入更少样本，同时保持可靠决策，并相对固定蒙特卡洛预算降低整体延迟。
AI.conclusion: 置信序列为贝叶斯神经网络预测提供了一种自适应采样方案，兼顾统计保证与计算效率。

title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
summary: We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoProof achieves 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, exceeding the two closest systems of its class, HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL, at roughly 90x and 7x less compute, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof. Stronger open-weight provers exist, but they are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline; NanoProof shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources.

AI.tldr: NanoProof 是首个端到端可复现的 Lean 4 因式分解执行引导定理证明器，公开全部数据、工具、流程与权重，以极低算力在 MiniF2F-Test 上达 50.8% pass@16。
AI.motivation: 现有强证明器多基于大规模预训练模型微调，且不公开训练数据与流程，难以复现和持续研究；作者希望用低算力资源从零重建该类证明器。
AI.method: 构建并公开结构化证明树数据集，以及在 Lean 4 形式验证器中程序化交互和数据抽取的工具；专注于计算效率，采用因式分解执行引导（factorized execution-guided）训练流程。
AI.result: 在 MiniF2F-Test 上达到 50.8% pass@16，超过同类最接近的 HyperTree Proof Search 和 ABEL 约 90 倍和 7 倍更少算力，比 AlphaProof 少四个数量级以上算力。
AI.conclusion: 证明因式分解执行引导类证明器可用有限资源从零重建，并实现完全可复现的开放研究。

title: Fast Pose Tracking of Rigid Objects with Compact Pose Graph Optimization
summary: Tracking a novel object's 6D pose over long horizons currently requires either expensive onboarding or a reconstruction maintained throughout the sequence. This makes current trackers impractical for robotic manipulation and augmented reality, which need trackers that are ready to use and run in real time. We show that a lightweight tracking module can be applied on top of a wide range of correspondence estimation methods to keep drifts bounded while maintaining fast runtime. Our key idea is to avoid point-based optimization in the pose graph and operate only on relative pose constraints, which we weight by a derived uncertainty from the geometric alignment. This makes optimization independent of the number of correspondences while avoiding the direct inclusion of noisy point measurements, leading to fast and robust long-term tracking. Across four real-world benchmarks, our approach achieves tracking accuracy comparable to reconstruction-based trackers with a fraction of the optimization cost. Overall, these results suggest that a compact and reliable pose graph optimization can provide long-horizon consistency at substantially lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级跟踪模块，可叠加在多种对应估计方法上，通过仅在位姿图上使用相对位姿约束（并按几何对齐推导的不确定性加权）来保持漂移有界且实时运行。
AI.motivation: 现有新颖物体的长时段6D位姿跟踪依赖昂贵的初始化或全程维护的重建，难以用于需要即插即用、实时的机器人操作与增强现实场景。
AI.method: 核心是避免位姿图中的点级优化，仅操作相对位姿约束，并以几何对齐推导的不确定性进行加权；使优化独立于对应点数量，同时避免直接引入噪声点测量。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界基准上，跟踪精度可与基于重建的跟踪器相当，而优化开销仅为其一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑可靠的位姿图优化能以显著更低计算成本实现长时段一致性，表明无需重建也能获得实用的长程6D跟踪。

title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails
summary: A typed decision model reads a piece of text and returns a probability over caller-defined options, each with a short written definition, generating no text. Recent work places these models in agent systems as guardrails: the component that reads a proposed tool call or incoming message and decides whether to allow it. We evaluate seven open-weight models in that role and report the two error directions separately: a fail-open error allows a prohibited action and is a vulnerability; a fail-closed error blocks a permitted one and is only a cost. On prompt-injection, jailbreak and toxic-content screening, accuracy at the allow-or-block decision ranges from 36% to 72% against a chance level of 50%. A low error rate in one direction only reflects which answer a model defaults to: one allows nearly everything, another blocks nearly everything. On a synthetic suite of agent tool calls, six lines of server log text that say nothing about the policy raise a gate's fail-open rate from 0% to 63% on a policy it otherwise decides correctly. Giving the permissive option a misleading name, with its definition and the judged text untouched, raises that rate to between 93% and 100% on the four models that place the label in their input. Every defense we tested is defeated, either by an attacker who targets its mechanism or by attacker-controlled text. Escalating the least confident decisions does not help either: a decision an attack has reversed is no less confident than the one it replaced. Parsing each policy field into a typed value does eliminate one attack, but it also makes the model unnecessary: a deterministic rule over those values reaches 100% accuracy on all six policies. These models can reduce how many cases reach a reviewer, but on this evidence they should not be the component that decides. Code is available at https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/option-channel-attack.

AI.tldr: 评估7个开放权重"类型化决策模型"作为agent护栏的可靠性,发现准确率仅36%-72%,各种防御均被攻破,并存在标签切换等攻击,结论是不应让此类模型做最终决策。
AI.motivation: 此类"类型化决策模型"读取文本并返回调用者定义选项上的概率,近期被用作agent系统中的护栏(决定是否允许工具调用或消息)。需要评估其在该角色下抵御提示注入、越狱、有害内容等攻击的实际可靠性。
AI.method: 在提示注入、越狱和有害内容筛查任务上评估7个开放权重模型,分别报告fail-open(漏放)与fail-closed(误拦)两个方向的错误;构造合成agent工具调用测试集,注入与策略无关的6行服务器日志文本;进行"选项标签误导"攻击(给宽松选项起误导性名字,定义与文本不变);测试各种防御手段及置信度升级机制;并将策略字段解析为类型化值做确定性规则对比。
AI.result: allow/block决策准确率36%-72%(随机为50%);低错误率仅反映模型默认倾向(一个几乎全放行,另一个几乎全拦)。6行无关日志将fail-open率从0%升至63%;标签误导攻击在4个把标签放入输入的模型上使fail-open率达93%-100%。所有防御均被攻破,置信度升级无效(被反转的决策置信度不低)。将策略字段解析为类型化值可消除一种攻击,但此时确定性规则在全部6个策略上达到100%准确率,模型变得多余。
AI.conclusion: 此类模型可作为预筛选减少需人工复核的案例,但依据现有证据不应作为做最终决定的组件。代码已开源。

title: Constructing Structured Decision Sources for Consensus-Based Pseudo-Label Learning
summary: Consensus can make pseudo-label learning more reliable, but only when its predictors contribute genuinely different evidence. Multiple models that repeat the same boundary provide additional votes without additional information. We address this problem by con structing decision sources through controlled changes to within-class structure. Starting from a shared graph representation, we vary center granularity and neighborhood mixing, reproduce each resulting source to test its stability, and select a complementary subset using node pair coassignment. Unanimous predictions from the selected sources are then ranked for student training. On the public fixed splits of Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed, evaluated with five random seeds, the constructed sources improve fixed-budget training pseudo-label precision by 1.19 to 4.39 percentage points over three conventionally initialized GCN sources. Under matched structural filters, three-source consensus is more precise than each constituent source in all 45 dataset slot eed comparisons. The gains are strongest in pseudo-label quality: downstream accuracy remains competitive but does not lead on every dataset. These results identify source construction rather than model count alone as an important design problem for consensus-based pseudo-label learning.

AI.tldr: 通过控制类内结构构造互补的决策源，比简单增加模型数量更能提升共识伪标签质量。
AI.motivation: 共识机制能提高伪标签可靠性，但前提是各预测器提供真正不同的证据；多个模型若重复同一边界，只是增加投票而无新信息。因此需要解决决策源的构造问题。
AI.method: 从共享图表示出发，通过改变中心粒度和邻域混合来构造决策源；对每个源进行复制以测试稳定性，并利用节点对共分配选出互补子集；再将所选源的一致预测排序用于学生训练。
AI.result: 在Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed公开固定划分上、五个随机种子评估，构造源使固定预算伪标签精度比三种常规初始化的GCN源高1.19至4.39个百分点；在匹配结构过滤下，三源共识在全部45个（数据集×槽位×种子）比较中均比各组成源更精确；下游准确率具竞争力但并非每个数据集都领先。
AI.conclusion: 共识式伪标签学习的关键设计问题是决策源的构造而非单纯的模型数量；源构造带来的收益主要体现在伪标签质量上。

title: From Pixels to Structure: Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Document OCR and Structured JSON Extraction
comment: 17 pages. Published in Document Analysis and Recognition - ICDAR 2026, LNCS vol. 16974, Springer. Code: https://github.com/uddipan77/Analysis-of-Lightweight-Vision-Language-Models-for-Document-OCR-and-Structured-Output-Generation
summary: While massive, closed-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) set strong benchmarks for document understanding, their dependence on commercial APIs limits adoption in institutional archives due to data autonomy concerns, recurring costs, and the environmental footprint of hyperscale computing. This is especially acute in heritage digitization, where documents include historical handwriting, domain-specific terminology (e.g., jewelry, prehistory, architecture), and non-standard layouts requiring high-dimensional structured extraction. We present a comparative study of eight open-source lightweight VLMs (up to 7B parameters) for Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-to-structure across three university heritage collections. Given a document image, models must extract text and generate schema-compliant JSON, enabling automatic validation and downstream use. We evaluate models under a constraint-aware protocol across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning settings, measuring extraction fidelity and structured-output quality using Character Error Rate (CER), Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*), and mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1). Against a fine-tuning baseline, we further test the independent impact of (i) hyperparameter optimization, (ii) classical image preprocessing (illumination flattening, denoising, and CLAHE), and (iii) multi-stage training. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between dataset-specific fine-tuning and a single multi-dataset checkpoint, where joint training enables one model to operate across collections but can shift performance between datasets. Overall, we show that carefully adapted VLMs with up to 7B parameters can provide a sustainable, private, high-performing alternative to manual transcription or commercial black-box systems, and we offer actionable guidance for heritage institutions seeking institution-controlled OCR-to-JSON extraction.

AI.tldr: 评估8个开源轻量VLM（≤7B）在三个高校遗产藏品上的OCR到结构化JSON提取，证明经适配后可替代商业黑箱系统。
AI.motivation: 闭源大规模VLM依赖商业API，存在数据主权、持续成本与超大规模计算环境足迹问题，在遗产数字化（历史手写、领域术语、非标准版式）场景尤为突出。
AI.method: 对8个开源轻量VLM（≤7B）在三个高校遗产藏品上做约束感知的比较研究，覆盖零样本、少样本与微调设置；从文档图像提取文本并生成符合schema的JSON；度量CER、ANLS*与mAP-F1；并分别检验超参优化、经典图像预处理（光照平坦化、去噪、CLAHE）与多阶段训练的独立影响，同时对比数据集专属微调与单人多数据集联合checkpoint。
AI.result: 在微调基线下，量化了超参优化、图像预处理与多阶段训练各自的独立贡献；联合训练使一个模型可跨藏品运行，但会在数据集间产生性能迁移。
AI.conclusion: 经精心适配的≤7B VLM可作为可持续、私密、高性能的方案，替代人工转录或商业黑箱系统，并为遗产机构提供机构可控OCR-to-JSON提取的可操作指南。

title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models
summary: Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity prediction (Tox21), mutagenesis, and citation matching (Cora), and show that it improves over purely symbolic, neural, and LLM-based baselines, while producing interpretable weighted rule ensembles. By replacing combinatorial search with gradient-guided LLM hypothesis generation, grasp retains boosting guarantees without sacrificing the transparency of symbolic outputs.

AI.tldr: GRASP将关系结构学习转化为函数梯度提升，用LLM作为弱学习器（一阶规则）的提议预言机，避免组合搜索的同时保持概率逻辑程序的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 声明式逻辑程序能提供可解释的关系结构建模，但从数据中归纳这类程序受限于符号搜索空间的组合爆炸；LLM虽有强假设生成能力，单独使用却缺乏系统性归纳推理，难以可靠合成拟合复杂关系分布的有效程序。
AI.method: 提出GRASP神经符号框架，把关系结构学习建模为函数梯度提升：弱学习器为一条一阶规则，并将难以求解的内层搜索委托给LLM提议预言机，用梯度引导的LLM假设生成替代组合搜索。
AI.result: 在四个关系基准（Tox21分子毒性预测、致突变性、Cora引文匹配）上评估，优于纯符号、纯神经网络及LLM基线，并产出可解释的加权规则集成。
AI.conclusion: 用梯度引导的LLM假设生成代替组合搜索，使GRASP在保留提升算法理论保证的同时不牺牲符号输出的透明性。

title: Beyond Action Entropy: Quotient-Space Exploration for Genome-Scale Metabolic Model Repair
summary: Repairing scientific models from functional observations differs fundamentally from supervised prediction: feedback may certify a solution without revealing which structural correction is responsible. We study this setting for genome-scale metabolic model (GEM) repair, where multiple reaction edits can explain the same phenotypes and many apparently distinct edits correspond to the same biological mechanism. This many-to-one structure creates a hidden failure mode for conventional exploration: diversity in the output space need not translate into diversity of scientific hypotheses. We introduce QuotientPO, which collapses equivalent repairs into canonical mechanisms and optimizes exploration directly over the resulting quotient space. To make quotient exploration informative under finite rollouts, we derive a kernelized Rényi estimator that resolves graded crowding among distinct repair cores beyond coarse exact-match counts. On 2,212 held-out GEMs, QuotientPO improves Success@32 from 17.93% to 20.10% (+12.1% relative) while consistently increasing distinct successful-core discovery under the same sampling budget. These results establish quotient-space exploration as a principled approach to mechanism-level discovery under verifier-induced equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuotientPO，通过将等价修复折叠为规范机制、在商空间上优化探索，解决基因组尺度代谢模型修复中多对一结构导致的探索失效问题，并用核化Rényi估计器刻画不同修复核心的拥挤程度。
AI.motivation: 从功能观测修复科学模型不同于监督预测：反馈只能证明解可行，却不揭示哪个结构修正起关键作用。在GEM修复中，多个反应编辑可解释同一表型，且许多看似不同的编辑实为同一生物机制，形成多对一结构。这使常规探索出现隐藏失效：输出空间的多样性并不等于科学假设的多样性。
AI.method: 提出 QuotientPO，将等价修复折叠为规范机制，在所得商空间上直接优化探索。为使商空间探索在有限采样下仍有信息量，推导核化Rényi估计器，以区分不同修复核心间的渐进拥挤程度，超越粗粒度的精确匹配计数。
AI.result: 在2,212个留出GEM上，Success@32从17.93%提升至20.10%（相对+12.1%），并在相同采样预算下持续增加不同成功核心的发现数量。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了商空间探索作为验证器诱导等价条件下机制级发现的一种原则性方法。

title: From Suppression to Repair: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Localized Distribution Alignment
summary: Object hallucination remains a major obstacle for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to generate reliable content. An intuitive mitigation strategy is to suppress hallucination-related components in hidden representations. However, these components may also contain useful information, and suppressing them can weaken the model's multimodal capabilities. In this paper, we propose ResOT, a training-free method that repairs representations at inference time through localized distribution alignment. Specifically, ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace, forming a low-dimensional residual subspace for intervention. Within this subspace, ResOT uses Gaussian optimal transport (OT) to align the hallucinated distribution with the faithful one. The resulting map defines repair targets with minimal changes to the original representations. At inference, ResOT adaptively controls how far each token state moves toward its OT target. Experiments on three representative LVLMs show that ResOT substantially reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance across multiple benchmarks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出ResOT，一种免训练方法，通过局部分布对齐在推理时修复LVLM隐藏表示，减少目标幻觉。
AI.motivation: LVLM存在严重目标幻觉问题；直观的抑制幻觉相关组件策略会损害有用信息和多模态能力，需要一种在不损失能力的前提下修复表示的方法。
AI.method: ResOT为免训练推理时方法：将主要幻觉方向从忠实子空间投影出去，形成低维残差子空间用于干预；在该子空间内用高斯最优传输（OT）将幻觉分布对齐到忠实分布；所得映射定义对原表示改动最小的修复目标；推理时自适应控制每个token状态向OT目标移动的程度。
AI.result: 在三个代表性LVLM上实验，显著降低目标幻觉，同时提升图像描述质量和多基准多模态性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOT提供了一种有效且免训练的表示修复方案，在抑制幻觉与保持多模态能力之间取得平衡。代码将开源。

title: Looking Inside LLMs: Small-World Connectivity as a Signature of Reasoning Performance
summary: Understanding large language model (LLM) reasoning requires looking beyond behavioral performance to examine how reasoning ability is reflected in internal organization. Inspired by neuroscience findings linking higher intelligence to stronger small-world organization in functional brain networks, we investigate small-world connectivity as a structural signature of LLM reasoning. We construct functional graphs from attention-head activation similarities and find that a higher small-world index (SWI), capturing local clustering and short global paths, consistently correlates with better fluid reasoning performance across models and training checkpoints. Since local clustering is central to small-world organization, we further examine how heads important for model performance connect within and across communities. We find that these heads tend to have a larger share of connection weight within their own communities (high core scores) and a more concentrated weight distribution across communities (low bridge scores). These observations motivate the hypothesis that high core and low bridge scores serve as structural indicators of head importance for reasoning capability. We validate this hypothesis through pruning, introducing Small-World Allocation (SWA), a hierarchical sparsity allocation method guided by these scores. Across six LLMs, SWA better preserves small-world organization and model performance than competing allocation strategies, reducing WikiText perplexity by up to 20%. Together, these findings identify small-world functional connectivity as a measurable signature of LLM reasoning performance, offering a structural perspective that complements behavioral evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM的注意力头功能图的小世界指数(SWI)与推理能力正相关，并提出基于核心/桥接分数的分层稀疏分配方法SWA。
AI.motivation: 受神经科学中"更高智力与更强小世界脑网络组织相关"的启发，作者希望超越行为表现，从内部结构组织角度理解LLM推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 从注意力头激活相似度构建功能图，计算小世界指数(SWI)；2) 分析重要头在社区内/间的连接模式(核心分数、桥接分数)；3) 提出Small-World Allocation (SWA)分层稀疏分配剪枝方法。
AI.result: SWI与流体推理性能在不同模型和训练检查点上持续正相关；重要头呈现高核心分数、低桥接分数；在六个LLM上，SWA比竞争方法更好地保持小世界组织和性能，WikiText困惑度降低最多20%。
AI.conclusion: 小世界功能连接可作为LLM推理性能的可测量结构signature，提供了补充行为评估的结构性视角。

title: Evi-VN: Hard Region Guided Virtual Node Evidence Injection for GNN-Based Fraud Detection
summary: Online platforms contain growing numbers of bots, deceptive reviewers, and scam accounts that imitate legitimate users. Such camouflage blurs graph neighborhoods and behavioral attributes, making it difficult for graph neural networks (GNNs) to distinguish both well-disguised fraudsters and legitimate users. Across diverse GNNs, we observe overlapping errors on a shared hard region, suggesting the presence of latent fraud evidence that graph topologies and standard features fail to capture. Fraud-specific GNNs can mitigate particular graph pathologies, yet they still make limited use of heterogeneous evidence such as structured records, text, images, and audio; uniform multimodal fusion may also disturb nodes already handled reliably by the graph. We propose Evi-VN to learn and correct these shared blind spots rather than build another fraud detector. To our knowledge, Evi-VN is the first graph fraud detection framework to use feature isolated evidence chains to correct hard regions shared across GNNs. Its evidence chains connect behavior, content, and context across structured, textual, visual, and acoustic sources, helping expose camouflage that graph neighborhoods may miss. Crucially, Evi-VN selectively applies this evidence only to likely hard samples via virtual class nodes, preserving both the reliable predictions and the input design of existing GNNs. Shared hard regions also let Evi-VN enhance generic, fraud-specific, and unseen GNNs even with imperfect evidence models. Experiments across bot, fake-review, refund-evidence, and telecom-fraud tasks validate these advantages.

AI.tldr: Evi-VN 是一个图欺诈检测框架，通过特征隔离的证据链纠正多种 GNN 共享的困难区域盲点。
AI.motivation: 在线平台上的机器人、虚假评论和诈骗账号伪装成合法用户，模糊了图邻域和行为特征，使 GNN 难以区分欺诈者与合法用户。多种 GNN 在共享的困难区域上出现重叠错误，暗示存在图拓扑和标准特征无法捕捉的潜在欺诈证据。现有欺诈专用 GNN 仍有限地利用异构证据，且统一多模态融合可能干扰已被图可靠处理的节点。
AI.method: 提出 Evi-VN，首个使用特征隔离证据链纠正跨 GNN 共享困难区域的框架。其证据链跨结构化、文本、视觉和声学来源连接行为、内容和上下文；通过虚拟类节点仅对可能的困难样本选择性应用证据，从而保留现有 GNN 的可靠预测和输入设计。
AI.result: 在机器人、虚假评论、退款证据和电信欺诈任务上的实验验证了这些优势。共享困难区域使 Evi-VN 即使在证据模型不完美时也能增强通用、欺诈专用和未见过的 GNN。
AI.conclusion: Evi-VN 通过学习并纠正跨 GNN 的共享盲点而非构建新检测器，有效缓解伪装欺诈，且具备对多种 GNN 和不完美证据模型的泛化能力。

title: A Structural Theory of Cognitive Representation and Problem Solving,Contexts, Invariance, and the Knowledge Space
summary: Learning and problem solving depend critically on the structure of internal representations. While many modern data-driven artificial systems achieve strong predictive performance, their learned representations often lack explicit structure for expressing abstraction, invariance, and task-relevant regularities. We propose a minimal structural framework in which representational operations relevant to problem solving, such as context formation, invariance recognition, representative selection, abstraction, and procedural reuse, are made explicit. The central notion is that of a \emph{context}, formalized as a partition of a subset of an underlying state space, which fixes the distinctions, granularity, and form in which a problem can be posed. Within this setting, invariance recognition and representative selection are treated as fundamental representational operations. The framework is realized as a Knowledge Space composed of two coupled graph structures: a Concept Graph that hosts constructed and refined concepts, and a Procedure Graph that encodes typed operations over representations. Together, these structures provide a minimal cognitive-representational algebra for operating on representations without assuming sophisticated inference, learning, control, perception, or motor mechanisms. Using simple illustrative examples and a finite weak-solver demonstration, we show that appropriate representational organization can simplify the form and scope of admissible regularities, even when problem solving is carried out by a fixed and limited solver. The contribution of the paper is structural rather than algorithmic: it identifies representational prerequisites for abstraction, invariance, and procedural reuse in problem solving, and states explicit success and failure conditions for the weak-solver setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个极简的结构化表示框架，以"上下文"（状态空间子集的划分）为核心，通过概念图与过程图组成的知识空间，显式实现抽象、不变性与过程复用等表示操作，并论证良好的表示组织可简化问题求解。
AI.motivation: 现代数据驱动系统虽预测性能强，但学到的表示常缺乏显式结构，难以表达抽象、不变性和任务相关规律，因此需要明确问题求解所依赖的表示前提。
AI.method: 提出极简结构框架：将上下文形式化为状态空间子集的划分，确定问题的区分、粒度与形式；把不变性识别和代表选择作为基本表示操作；用知识空间实现，包含概念图与过程图两个耦合图结构，构成极简的认知表示代数。
AI.result: 通过简单示例和有限弱求解器演示，表明适当的表示组织能简化可容许规律的形式与范围，即使求解器固定且能力有限也能有效工作。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是结构性的而非算法性的：识别了问题求解中抽象、不变性和过程复用的表示前提，并给出弱求解器设定下明确的成功与失败条件。

title: Early Signatures of Memorization in Diffusion Models via Basin Geometry and Cyclic Denoising
summary: Diffusion models generalize early in training and later reproduce individual training samples. Standard tests detect memorization only once one-shot generation produces near-copies, leaving a released model unaudited until its outputs fail. We show that memorization is encoded in the geometry of the learned energy landscape before it appears in generated samples, a state we call latent memorization. Using score divergence and basin volume, we find that localized basins form around training samples and separate them from held-out samples before the first memorized sample appears, with an onset that follows the same $O(n)$ scaling as the memorization time. We probe these basins with cyclic denoising, which repeatedly applies partial noising and denoising. Under the exact empirical score, we prove that cycling started near an isolated training sample recovers it and returns to it over any finite number of cycles with high probability. In trained models, cycling recovers training images from CelebA and CIFAR-10 checkpoints whose one-shot samples contain no copies, and at a CelebA checkpoint with 0.1% one-shot copies, 500 cycles raise the memorized fraction above 30%. Cycling also reveals degenerate attractors that match no single training image and fade as training proceeds, so residence in a basin does not by itself imply memorization. These findings hold on a Gaussian mixture, CelebA, and CIFAR-10 across optimizers, architectures, noise schedules, and training-set sizes, and extend to off-the-shelf Stable Diffusion v1.4, where the cycled conditional-unconditional divergence gap separates memorized from non-memorized prompts with an AUC of 0.944 and a TPR of 0.866 at 1% FPR. More broadly, what a diffusion model has memorized is a property of the geometry and stability of its learned distribution, and assessing it requires examining this structure rather than generated outputs alone.

AI.tldr: 扩散模型的记忆在生成样本出现近复制之前，就已编码在学习到的能量景观几何中（"潜在记忆"）。作者用分数散度和吸引盆体积证明训练样本周围会先形成局部吸引盆，并用循环去噪（反复部分加噪-去噪）探测这些盆：在经验分数下可证明能恢复训练样本，在CelebA/CIFAR-10及Stable Diffusion v1.4上也能在无复制样本的检查点中检出记忆。
AI.motivation: 标准记忆检测只在一次性生成产生近复制时才生效，导致已发布模型在输出失败前无法被审计。作者希望找到记忆在生成样本之前就已存在的早期信号。
AI.method: 提出"潜在记忆"概念，用分数散度与吸引盆体积刻画能量景观几何；用循环去噪（多次部分加噪+去噪）作为探测手段，并在精确经验分数下给出理论证明。实验覆盖高斯混合、CelebA、CIFAR-10（不同优化器、架构、噪声调度、训练集大小）及Stable Diffusion v1.4。
AI.result: 训练样本周围在首个记忆样本出现前就形成局部吸引盆，其起始时间遵循与记忆时间相同的O(n)缩放。循环去噪能从一次性样本无复制的检查点恢复训练图像；在0.1%一次性复制的CelebA检查点上，500次循环将记忆比例提升至30%以上。循环还揭示与任何训练图像都不匹配的退化吸引子，随训练消退。在Stable Diffusion v1.4上，循环的条件-无条件散度差距以AUC 0.944、1% FPR下TPR 0.866区分记忆与非记忆提示。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型记忆的内容是其学习分布的几何与稳定性性质，应在结构层面而非仅生成输出层面进行评估。位于吸引盆中本身并不等同于记忆。

title: VEDJE: Video-Efficient Discriminative Joint Encoder for Scalable Video-Text Retrieval
summary: Finding the right video often requires distinguishing similar scenes in which different events occur. Joint matching improves retrieval, but processing rich video representations for each query is costly. VEDJE compresses features within sampled frames while keeping their representations separate in a reusable cache. Feature-change prediction supplies an auxiliary training signal that improves retrieval from the compressed cache without adding work at query time. On MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, and ActivityNet, VEDJE improves R@1 over matched first-stage retrievers in both retrieval directions. On MSR-VTT, it reaches 59.8 text-to-video R@1 with a fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL first stage. In the VideoPrism configuration, shrinking the per-video cache fourfold to 12 KiB preserves text-to-video recall within 0.2 points. These results show that accurate video search can operate on compact evidence, encoded once and reused as new queries arrive.

AI.tldr: VEDJE 通过在采样的帧内压缩特征并保留可复用缓存中的独立表示，在训练时引入特征变化预测作为辅助信号，从而高效提升视频检索性能。
AI.motivation: 视频检索需区分相似场景中的不同事件，联合匹配虽能提升检索效果，但为每个查询处理丰富的视频表示成本高昂。
AI.method: VEDJE 在采样帧内压缩特征，同时在可复用缓存中保持其表示的独立性；特征变化预测提供辅助训练信号，在不增加查询时开销的情况下提升压缩缓存的检索效果。
AI.result: 在 MSR-VTT、MSVD、DiDeMo 和 ActivityNet 上，VEDJE 在两个检索方向上均提升了匹配的第一阶段检索器的 R@1。在 MSR-VTT 上，配合微调的 VideoCLIP-XL 第一阶段，文本到视频 R@1 达到 59.8。在 VideoPrism 配置下，将每视频缓存缩减四倍至 12 KiB，文本到视频召回率仅损失 0.2 个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 准确的视频搜索可以基于紧凑的证据运作，只需编码一次并随着新查询到来重复使用。

title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
summary: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.

AI.tldr: 提出一种4-张量注意力模型，联合归一化窗口内注意力，用于预测场景下一语义状态；在ROCStories上以更低交叉熵和大幅更短训练时间优于自由运行一维Transformer。
AI.motivation: 为视频生成和机器人规划预测场景的下一语义状态，需一种能同时建模语义与时间上下文、且可独立于编码器/渲染器/规划器进行测试的注意力更新机制。
AI.method: 4-张量注意力模型：窗口内状态具有位置(x,t)及语义纤维与时间上下文纤维，一个softmax在窗口上联合归一化注意力。将帧与智能体情境表示为这些状态；编码器、渲染器、规划器置于更新之外。以ROCStories训练，每个窗口在语义层执行相同的下一句预测任务。
AI.result: 验证集上（每设置单种子），4-张量模型最后一句交叉熵在三组匹配设置下均低于自由运行一维Transformer：H=2,L=2降低5.3%；H=4,L=2降低2.6%；H=4,L=3降低2.4%。H=4,L=2参数量接近（172.5M vs 175.9M）。训练时间同样两GPU：4-张量2.4小时，基线45.2小时（基线用自由运行解码，每目标token一次顺序前向）。
AI.conclusion: 4-张量注意力更新在语义层下一状态预测上优于自由运行一维Transformer，并显著降低训练时间，参数量相当。

title: Verdict Without the Rule: Diagnosing and Auditing Regulatory Rule Sensitivity in LLM Compliance Systems
summary: Large language model compliance systems are deployed on the assumption that a verdict depends on the regulatory rule it is given. We test this directly across five models and 20 regulatory and platform-policy domains: delete, swap, or negate the governing rule while holding the case fixed, and check whether the verdict changes (OCS) or the model's internal representation of compliance shifts at all (ICS-delta). Neither moves much: models' verdicts are often invariant to substantial perturbations of the supplied rule, and the guard model, evaluated here under a custom-rule adaptation of its native taxonomy, is the least rule-sensitive and least accurate of the five, barely above chance (51%, versus 90-92% for general-purpose models). This reflects easy cases more than blanket neglect: on cases where deleting the rule changes a previously correct model prediction, models do track it closely. Neither better prompting nor direct intervention on the model's internal representations closes this gap. Accuracy alone does not establish that a compliance verdict is grounded in the supplied rule.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试大模型合规系统是否真正依据给定的监管规则做出判定。通过删除、替换或否证规则并保持案例不变，发现五个模型的判定与内部合规表征几乎不变，说明模型对规则不敏感；专用guard模型表现最差，仅约51%准确率。
AI.motivation: 大模型合规系统被部署时假设其判定取决于所给监管规则。作者希望直接检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在20个监管与平台政策领域、五个模型上，对固定案例的治理规则进行删除、替换或否证，并测量判定是否改变（OCS）以及模型内部合规表征是否偏移（ICS-delta）。
AI.result: 模型判定对规则大幅扰动常常保持不变，内部表征也变化很小。guard模型在自定义规则下最不敏感且最不准，仅51%准确率，而通用模型为90-92%。但对删除规则会改变原本正确预测的较难案例，模型会紧密跟踪。更好提示或直接干预内部表征均无法弥合该差距。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭准确率不能证明合规判定真正以所给规则为依据；模型合规系统可能并未按预期依赖监管规则。

title: Camera-Noise Residuals for Face-Swap Detection: Redundant, Not Complementary, and Why
summary: Fusing a learned camera-noise fingerprint with an RGB appearance backbone is an appealing route to generator-independent deepfake detection, because the noise residual is grounded in image-formation physics rather than in the texture statistics of a particular generator. We test, on FaceForensics++, whether a Noiseprint++ residual channel carries information \emph{complementary} to an RGB Xception backbone for face-swap detection. A three-model ablation (RGB-only, residual-only, late-fusion) shows that fusion does not improve over RGB alone and that the residual branch alone is near chance. A seven-level bottleneck diagnostic localizes the cause: the noise maps do carry a discriminative signal, but it is statistical---carried by the per-sample first and second moments (mean, variance, energy) of the residual---and the per-sample \texttt{InstanceNorm} layer placed at the noise-branch input, following the TruFor template, standardizes exactly those moments away (five-fold cross-validated AUC drops from $0.747$ to $0.554$). A context-crop control rules out cropping geometry, and two fixed-fusion variants that remove the bottleneck recover the statistical signal yet still fail to beat RGB on every dataset. We conclude that, on this manipulation distribution, the noise residual is redundant with RGB rather than complementary, and we give concrete guidance for practitioners adopting noise-residual fusion for face-swap detection.

AI.tldr: 本文检验Noiseprint++噪声残差与RGB Xception骨干融合,在FaceForensics++上对换脸检测是否具有互补性。三模型消融发现融合未优于纯RGB,残差支路接近随机。七级瓶颈诊断表明噪声图确有判别信号,但由残差的均值、方差、能量等统计矩承载,而InstanceNorm恰好把这些矩标准化掉(AUC从0.747降至0.554)。作者得出在该篡改分布下噪声残差与RGB冗余而非互补的结论。
AI.motivation: 融合相机噪声指纹与RGB外观骨干被视为实现与生成器无关的深度伪造检测的理想路径,因为噪声残差基于成像物理而非特定生成器的纹理统计。作者希望验证Noiseprint++残差通道对换脸检测是否携带与RGB骨干互补的信息。
AI.method: 在FaceForensics++上进行三模型消融(RGB-only、残差-only、后融合)。采用七级瓶颈诊断定位原因,并做上下文裁剪控制实验排除裁剪几何影响,另设两个去除瓶颈的固定融合变体。
AI.result: 融合未超过纯RGB;残差支路单独接近随机水平。噪声图确有判别信号,但由每样本残差一阶、二阶矩(均值、方差、能量)承载,而输入端按TruFor模板放置的InstanceNorm正好把这些矩标准化掉,使五折交叉验证AUC从0.747降到0.554。去除瓶颈的融合变体恢复了统计信号,但在各数据集上仍未超过RGB。
AI.conclusion: 在该操纵分布下,噪声残差与RGB冗余而非互补。作者为采用噪声残差融合做换脸检测的实践者提供了具体建议。

title: Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Inpainting via Learnable Mask Attention and Support Token Refinement
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Project page: https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/
summary: 3D scene inpainting aims to recover missing or occluded regions in edited 3D scenes, while ensuring geometric and textural consistency. Existing approaches, however, typically require accurately calibrated camera poses, which restricts their applicability in casual, in-the-wild scenarios and introduces additional preprocessing overhead. To overcome this limitation, we present FreeInpaint, a novel feed-forward framework that generates complete and 3D-consistent scenes directly from unposed multi-view images with masked regions. At its core, FreeInpaint extends a 3D foundation model to propagate masked regions from a reference view to other unposed views, bridging 3D reconstruction and scene inpainting while preserving the model's native ability to recover camera poses and scene geometry. Our method addresses two key challenges in adapting feed-forward 3D foundation models to masked inputs. First, masked regions can corrupt cross-view correspondence reasoning, degrading pose estimation and geometry recovery. To address this, we introduce a Learnable Mask Attention mechanism that preserves the spatial anchoring of reliable observations while allowing masked regions to progressively absorb useful context in deeper layers. Second, under severe occlusions, a single forward pass often lacks sufficient appearance evidence for high-fidelity completion. Therefore, we propose a Support Token Refinement strategy, which injects diffusion-generated support evidence as confidence-weighted auxiliary tokens to refine under-observed regions while preserving the original spatial anchor. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that FreeInpaint achieves superior inpainting quality, eliminating the reliance on pre-computed camera poses while keeping a fast inference speed. The project page is https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.

AI.tldr: 提出FreeInpaint，首个无需相机位姿的前馈3D场景修复框架，直接从无位姿多视角图像生成完整一致的3D场景，速度快、质量高。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景修复方法依赖精确标定的相机位姿，限制了其在随意拍摄场景下的适用性，并带来额外预处理开销。
AI.method: 将3D基础模型扩展至掩码区域，实现参考视图到其他无位姿视图的掩码传播；引入可学习掩码注意力机制保护可靠观测的空间锚定并逐步吸收上下文；提出支持令牌细化策略，将扩散生成的证据作为置信度加权辅助令牌注入，修复欠观测区域。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，FreeInpaint实现更优的修复质量，消除对预计算相机位姿的依赖，并保持快速推理速度。
AI.conclusion: FreeInpaint打通了3D重建与场景修复，实现了无需相机位姿的高质量3D场景修复，适用性更强。

title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Science: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. Equal contribution
summary: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM科学智能体是否仅依赖初始任务上下文还是能根据实验反馈调整决策，在神经算子自适应调参任务中发现LLM兼具任务相关先验与反馈敏感性。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM科学智能体在有限试验预算下进行决策时，是基于初始任务上下文还是能根据实验反馈自适应调整。
AI.method: 以神经算子自适应为研究场景，让LLM在有限试验预算下选择微调配置，跨PDE族内和族间迁移，与随机搜索和贝叶斯优化进行匹配对比；并通过受控干预验证归因（包括冷启动干预、重新分配验证分数、保持数值不变的改写）。
AI.result: 在几乎所有匹配对比中，LLM的留出测试nRMSE低于随机搜索和贝叶斯优化；未观察验证分数前，LLM首个配置已接近随机搜索池顶部；冷启动干预显示所选基础学习率随PDE描述变化；重分配验证分数改变下一个提议，而保持数值的改写无类似效果。
AI.conclusion: LLM的决策级行为既响应给定任务又响应观察到的结果，说明其结合了任务相关先验与对实验反馈的敏感性。

title: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning?
summary: Foundation models supply reinforcement learning (RL) with priors that mitigate its longstanding weaknesses in sample efficiency and transfer, but their token-by-token generation makes queries sequential and costly. Jev, a recently released decision model, generates nothing and returns calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass. Existing work studies foundation models in RL either as models to be trained or as generators to be prompted, and Jev belongs to neither category, having so far served only as a black box in single domains. How well such a model decides on its own in RL environments, and how it can improve RL as a component of training, therefore remain unaddressed. To this end, in this paper we first examine the requirements that the objects of an RL system place on the answers they consume, and establish that Jev can fulfill all of them except the cardinal use of a value function. The remaining objects form positions that admit several roles each. We then construct algorithms that employ Jev at three of these positions, as a reference policy, an exploration judge, and a replay rater, to improve sample efficiency, exploration, and learning performance. Across nine MiniGrid tasks and three Atari games, training with Jev outperforms a standard RL learner, including where the learner makes no progress alone, while the model itself remains untrained. To our knowledge, we present the first use of Jev within the RL learning process and establish a frozen decision model as a usable component of RL training, inviting further exploration of how Jev and other advanced decision models can improve RL.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在RL训练过程中使用决策模型Jev（冻结、单次前向、类型化输出），在策略参考、探索评判、回放评分三个位置构造算法，在9个MiniGrid任务和3个Atari游戏上超越标准RL学习者。
AI.motivation: 基础模型可缓解RL样本效率与迁移问题，但其逐token生成使查询序列化且昂贵；Jev作为决策模型无生成、单次前向返回校准的typed答案，但现有工作未研究它在RL环境中自主决策及作为训练组件的能力。
AI.method: 先分析RL系统各对象对答案的需求，确认Jev除价值函数的基数用途外均可满足；据此在三个位置（参考策略、探索评判者、回放评分者）构造算法，将Jev用于改善样本效率、探索与学习性能。
AI.result: 在九个MiniGrid任务和三个Atari游戏上，使用Jev训练优于标准RL学习者，包括在标准学习者自身毫无进展的情况下，且Jev本身保持未训练（冻结）。
AI.conclusion: 首次将Jev用于RL学习过程，确立冻结决策模型可作为RL训练的有效组件，为探索Jev等先进决策模型改进RL开辟方向。

title: Relative Patch Response Learning for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Generative models can now synthesize highly realistic images, simultaneously increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery. Therefore, detecting AI-generated images becomes more essential, and a reliable detector must generalize to unseen generators and stay robust to unseen perturbations in the wild. Existing detectors are typically trained on either independently collected real and generated images or aligned real-generated pairs designed to mitigate content bias. Building on aligned pairs, recent methods form a mixed view by replacing some patches of the real image with their generated counterparts. However, we find that self-attention lets real and generated patches interact, so the feature of each patch no longer reflects its own source alone. This contextual shift makes a per-patch source label an imprecise target. To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL). Instead of labeling each patch, PRL compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between the views. (i) To give precise supervision under the contextual shift, a relative response objective measures the responses of source-changed patches against those of source-unchanged patches, which respond to the shift alone. (ii) To provide a reliable reference for the shift, a reference coherence objective keeps each group of source-unchanged patches moving as a whole. (iii) Since the two views contain different amounts of generated content, an area ranking objective asks the view with the larger generated area to have a higher mean patch score. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of PRL, which surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy across eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PRL方法，通过比较对齐图像对两个混合视图中同一patch的响应变化来训练AI生成图像检测器，提升泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 生成模型能合成高度逼真的图像，增加虚假信息和视觉伪造风险。检测器需泛化到未见生成器并对野外未知扰动保持鲁棒。现有方法训练于独立收集或对齐的真假图像对，而基于对齐对构建混合视图时，自注意力使真假patch相互交互，导致每个patch的特征不再单独反映其来源，使逐patch来源标签成为不精确的目标。
AI.method: 提出相对Patch响应学习（PRL）：不标注每个patch，而是比较同一patch在对齐对的两个混合视图中的patch响应（得分变化）。包含三个目标：(i) 相对响应目标，用来源未变patch的响应（仅响应上下文偏移）衡量来源改变patch的响应，提供精确监督；(ii) 参考一致性目标，保持每组来源未变patch整体一致移动，提供可靠参考；(iii) 面积排序目标，要求生成面积更大的视图具有更高平均patch得分。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PRL性能优越，在八个标准基准和三个野外基准上平均平衡准确率分别超越最佳先前方法4.3%和5.9%。
AI.conclusion: PRL通过相对patch响应学习有效解决混合视图中自注意力导致的上下文偏移问题，显著提升AI生成图像检测的泛化性与鲁棒性。

title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
summary: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对抗启发式学习(AHL)范式，用AI智能体作为学习引擎在固定模型权重下改进游戏策略与软件，并发布包含12款对抗游戏和1920个历史人类程序的AAArena基准。评估中Opus5.5+Claude Code获6枚金牌，但无配置能超越其余6个人类阶梯；复杂规则游戏中表现更弱。
AI.motivation: 对抗游戏推动了从启发式搜索到强化学习的进步，但从有限样本中学习和适应策略仍具挑战。AI智能体可将游戏经验转化为可执行策略的修订，从而提供新的解决路径。
AI.method: 在启发式学习(HL)基础上形式化对抗启发式学习(AHL)：用AI智能体作为学习引擎，在保持模型权重固定下精炼游戏策略与支撑软件。构建AAArena基准，含12款真实对抗游戏和1920个存档人类程序，评估协议参照真实游戏竞赛：智能体解读规则、选择对手、分析回放并修订游戏代理，在固定对局与评估预算内追求最高排名。
AI.result: 评估多个模型与工具配置：Opus5.5配合Claude Code获得6枚金牌；没有配置能登顶其余6个人类阶梯。规则规格更复杂的游戏表现普遍更弱。对手选择与密集反馈有助于策略改进；智能体既能从自身对局的同策略回放学习，也能从其他玩家对局的异策略回放学习。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显HL在对抗游戏中的潜力，同时指出在游戏理解、策略实现和长时程策略开发方面仍存在持续挑战。

title: What is the goal of unsupervised machine learning?
summary: Unsupervised learning is one of the main branches of machine learning. Here I argue that unlike the other branches of machine learning (supervised and reinforcement learning), unsupervised learning is a rather heterogenous field that can serve several different goals. It seems futile to try to define one single goal for unsupervised learning. I identify four different goals for unsupervised learning: 1) Estimating the distribution, 2) Generating new data points, 3) Extracting features for downstream tasks, and 4) Understanding the data.

AI.tldr: 无监督学习是一个异质领域，难以用单一目标定义，本文识别出它的四个不同目标。
AI.motivation: 作者指出，与监督学习和强化学习不同，无监督学习并非服务于单一目标，因此试图为其定义唯一目标是徒劳的，需要澄清其多元目标。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场/观点性论文，通过概念分析将无监督学习划分为四个不同的研究目标。
AI.result: 识别出无监督学习的四个目标：1) 估计数据分布；2) 生成新数据点；3) 为下游任务提取特征；4) 理解数据。
AI.conclusion: 无监督学习应被视为一个服务多种不同目标的异质领域，而非追求单一统一目标。

title: Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations
summary: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.

AI.tldr: AIMS是一个无需训练的轻量框架，通过自适应协调视觉、预填充文本和生成上下文来缓解LVLM的物体幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练方法多通过对比解码或视觉增强来提升视觉证据的相对影响，但核心问题是：LVLM能否动态调节不同上下文来源的贡献以抑制幻觉？
AI.method: 量化LVLM在解码中如何协调多源上下文，发现其固有的"视觉关注倾向"可引导自适应视觉转向；提出AIMS，为三类上下文域构建紧凑原型，估计其与当前查询的亲和度以确定逐头引导权重，将多源引导方向应用于查询表示。
AI.result: 在多种LVLM和多种解码策略上的大量实验表明，AIMS有效缓解物体幻觉，同时保持有竞争力的通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: 自适应协调多源上下文是抑制幻觉的有效途径，且无需额外训练或辅助前向传播。

title: GRPODropout: Less is More for Online Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as GRPO substantially improve large language model reasoning but often suffer from policy entropy collapse: the loss of sampling diversity weakens exploration and limits further improvement. Existing methods address this issue either through algorithm-level interventions, such as reward modification and entropy/KL regularization, or through token-level reweighting. We investigate a complementary perspective: entropy collapse can also be mitigated by changing which generated rollouts contribute to policy updates. Under the same sampling budget, not all rollouts contribute positively to an update, and selectively excluding some can improve learning. To address this, we propose GRPODropout: before the standard update, we use a simple strategy that selectively removes a small number of high-probability positive-advantage rollouts and recenters the retained advantages. To motivate this design, we develop a rollout-level theoretical analysis that guides method design and threshold selection. The method changes only rollout usage, and adds negligible computational overhead. Experiments show higher accuracy than original GRPO and higher actor entropy while using fewer rollout samples for updates, illustrating "less is more." This work provides insight into RL rollout usage: removing some rollouts can improve performance. Code is available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GRPODropout，通过在使用rollout进行策略更新前，选择性移除少量高概率正优势rollout并重新中心化保留的优势，来缓解RL（如GRPO）中的策略熵崩溃问题，实现更高准确率和更高actor熵。
AI.motivation: GRPO等强化学习方法显著提升大语言模型推理能力，但常遭遇策略熵崩溃：采样多样性丧失会削弱探索并限制进一步提升。现有方法多从算法层面（奖励修改、熵/KL正则化）或token级重加权入手，本文探索互补视角——通过改变哪些生成的rollout参与策略更新来缓解熵崩溃。
AI.method: 提出GRPODropout：在标准更新前，采用简单策略选择性移除少量高概率正优势的rollout，并对保留下来的优势进行重新中心化。为支撑设计，作者建立了rollout级的理论分析，用于指导方法设计和阈值选取。该方法仅改变rollout使用方式，计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比原始GRPO，该方法具有更高准确率和更高的actor熵，同时用于更新的rollout样本更少，体现"少即是多"（less is more）。
AI.conclusion: 本工作揭示了RL rollout使用方式的洞见：移除部分rollout反而能提升性能，为缓解策略熵崩溃提供了互补且低成本的新思路，代码已开源。

title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but the required concepts can receive substantially different levels of pretrained support. Frequent concepts are more likely to be well learned, whereas rare concepts may remain weakly represented. We introduce a novel notion named prior barrier to quantify how strongly the pretrained model supports competing concepts over the target concept. We observe that prior barriers follow a long-tail distribution, placing head and tail concepts at different starting points for SFT: head concepts face lower prior barriers, whereas tail concepts require additional instructions to overcome their higher prior barriers. Our theoretical analysis further derives a predictive risk bound for SFT under long-tail prior barriers, explicitly characterizing how the prior barrier and accumulated SFT evidence jointly determine predictive performance. Motivated by this prior barrier-dependent demand, we propose PASS, an adaptive SFT instruction selection method that constructs reference-derived concepts and estimates the distinguishing evidence provided by each instruction, and adaptively allocates the selection budget toward concepts that remain insufficiently covered under the current selection. In this way, PASS jointly considers which instructions can provide useful evidence and where additional supervision is needed under a limited budget. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art instruction selection methods on four backbone-budget settings. An ablation study further shows that PASS's adaptive allocation consistently improves over uniform allocation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 prior barrier 概念，量化预训练模型对目标概念与竞争概念的支持差距，并据此设计自适应 SFT 指令选择方法 PASS，提升长尾概念学习效果。
AI.motivation: SFT 中不同概念获得的预训练支持差异很大：高频概念易学好，而稀有概念表示薄弱，导致 SFT 起点不平等，需要针对性补足监督。
AI.method: 提出 prior barrier 指标并分析其长尾分布；从理论上推导 SFT 在长尾 prior barrier 下的预测风险上界；提出 PASS 方法，构建参考派生概念，估计每条指令提供的区分性证据，并在有限预算下自适应地将选择预算分配给覆盖不足的概念。
AI.result: 在四组 backbone-budget 设置下，PASS 一致优于七种最先进指令选择方法；消融实验表明自适应分配持续优于均匀分配。
AI.conclusion: SFT 指令选择应显式考虑概念的预训练支持差异；PASS 通过联合考虑“哪条指令有用”和“哪里监督不足”，有效缓解长尾 prior barrier 带来的不平等。

title: Does an Illumination Prior Help Face-Swap Detection? A Controlled Study of Temporal Self-Blended Images
summary: Self-blended images are widely used to train face-swap detectors, but primarily capture blending artifacts. We investigate whether adding illumination inconsistencies improves detection. Temporal Self-Blended Images (T-SBI) transfer lighting statistics between frames of the same video, with the mismatch controlled by luminance difference (ΔL). Using five training regimes and a three-seed comparison of high- and low-ΔL training, we find no evidence of illumination-specific improvements. AUC differences remain within seed variability across four datasets, and an analysis of 506,328 attribute-binned samples shows no preferential reduction in errors under harsh lighting. Instead, T-SBI shifts prediction scores, changing optimal thresholds by approximately 0.34 on FaceForensics++ and 0.30 on Celeb-DF, making comparisons at a fixed threshold misleading. However, T-SBI improves robustness to heavy JPEG compression on DFDC (AUC 0.780 versus 0.696), potentially reflecting greater reliance on low-frequency cues. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating training methods against their intended targets and accounting for threshold effects.

AI.tldr: 本文检验在自混合图像中加入光照不一致性能否提升换脸检测，结果发现并无光照特定改善，T-SBI主要改变预测分数与阈值，但提升了对JPEG压缩的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自混合图像主要用于捕捉换脸中的混合伪影，作者想探究额外引入光照不一致性是否能提升检测性能。
AI.method: 提出Temporal Self-Blended Images (T-SBI)，在同一视频不同帧间迁移光照统计，并以亮度差ΔL控制不匹配程度；采用五种训练方案及高/低ΔL三随机种子对比，并在四个数据集上评估，另分析506,328个按属性分箱的样本。
AI.result: 未发现光照特定改进：AUC差异在种子波动范围内，严苛光照下错误也未优先减少；T-SBI仅使预测分数偏移，FaceForensics++与Celeb-DF最佳阈值分别变化约0.34和0.30；但在DFDC上对重度JPEG压缩更鲁棒（AUC 0.780 vs 0.696）。
AI.conclusion: 应针对方法的预期目标进行评估并考虑阈值效应；光照不一致性并未带来预期的检测增益。

title: Revisiting Identity and Spectra Dispersion in Media-Bridged Time Series Forecasting: Linking Multivariate Signals and Narrative Flows
summary: Media-bridged time series forecasting is expanding to encompass traditional "multivariate" and emerging "multimodal" (e.g., through textual assistance). Existing Time Series Forecasting (TSF) models still rely on paradigm-specific relation, fusion, and temporal modules, hindering a common forecasting backbone across numerical and pre-aligned narrative-flow settings. To explore this, we propose the Multimedia Identity-Aware Prism Network (MIDAPN), a unified spatiotemporal forecasting backbone based on media-general graph adaptation and automatic temporal learning: (1) Following media pre-alignment, our Multimedia Identity-Aware Graph (MIDAG) revisits identity through static essence, dynamic behavior, and latent commonality, inducing affinities that extend variable-specific dependencies across media. Contextual Identity Modulation (CIM) further refines discriminative aggregation. (2) We develop Spectral Prism Convolution (SPConv) to automatically perform hierarchical temporal analysis, balancing coarse trends and fine-grained details. Meanwhile, its Adaptive Search Guidance configures a scale-efficient architecture for temporal-dimension reconstruction. These decoupled yet synergistic components jointly address media identity disentanglement and temporal-scale mismatch. Comprehensive evaluations involving 16 SOTA TSF models across 13 "multivariate" and 12 "multimodal" datasets, alongside targeted long-context comparisons against 14 time series foundation models and fused pretrained language models, demonstrate MIDAPN's consistent superiority and broad shared backbone compatibility. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/leijieruilq/MIDAPN/tree/main}{https://github.com/MIDAPN}.

AI.tldr: 提出统一时空预测主干MIDAPN，通过媒体通用图自适应与自动时间学习，实现多元与多模态时间序列预测的通用骨干。
AI.motivation: 现有时序预测模型依赖特定范式的关系、融合与时间模块，难以在数值与预对齐叙事流场景间共享统一预测骨干。
AI.method: 包含三部分：MIDAG从静态本质、动态行为和潜在共性刻画身份，构建跨媒体依赖关系；CIM细化判别性聚合；SPConv进行分层时间分析，结合自适应搜索引导构建尺度高效架构。
AI.result: 在13个多元和12个多模态数据集上对比16个SOTA TSF模型，并与14个时序基础模型及融合预训练语言模型进行长上下文比较，MIDAPN均表现出一致优越性和广泛骨干兼容性。
AI.conclusion: 解耦但协同的设计有效解决媒体身份解耦与时间尺度不匹配问题，验证了统一骨干在多元与多模态时序预测中的可行性。

title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict
summary: When retrieved evidence contradicts an agent's prior beliefs, does it revise its answer, acknowledge uncertainty, or persist with an incorrect conclusion? Existing evaluations of agentic systems focus primarily on task success, offering limited insight into how agents handle such conflicts. We propose to evaluate agents on epistemic humility (EH): the agent's willingness to recognize, act on, and communicate uncertainty during task execution. We operationalize EH through three trajectory-level behavioral dimensions: Identify, Solve, and Escalate (ISE). Through knowledge conflict, situations where the backbone language model's parametric knowledge contradicts the evidence it encounters, or where two contextual sources disagree, we evaluate two conflict settings: (1) controlled conflict and (2) naturally occurring conflict during multi-step agentic execution, each paired with matched no-conflict controls. Evaluating four agents, we find that higher task accuracy does not necessarily correspond to greater epistemic humility: some high-accuracy configurations recognize conflicts during execution but do not communicate unresolved uncertainty in their incorrect final answers. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that agents frequently detect conflicts in early steps of execution but fail to maintain or resolve them in later steps. Finally, we show that model-level interventions can improve EH, but often at the cost of task accuracy, suggesting that epistemic humility emerges from the interaction among the backbone model, agent harness, and evaluation environment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"认知谦逊(EH)"来评估智能体在证据与先验知识冲突时的行为，通过Identify/Solve/Escalate三维度评测发现高任务准确率并不代表高认知谦逊，且模型级干预虽能提升EH但常以牺牲准确率为代价。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估主要关注任务成功率，无法揭示智能体在面对检索证据与自身信念冲突时是修正答案、承认不确定性还是坚持错误结论。
AI.method: 提出认知谦逊(EH)概念，将其操作化为轨迹级的三个行为维度：Identify（识别）、Solve（解决）、Escalate（上报/升级）。通过知识冲突场景（参数知识与会话证据矛盾，或两种上下文来源分歧）设置两类冲突：受控冲突与多步执行中的自然冲突，并各自配对无冲突对照组。评估了四个智能体。
AI.result: 更高的任务准确率不一定对应更强的认知谦逊；一些高准确率配置能在执行中识别冲突，却未在错误的最终答案中传达尚未解决的不确定性。轨迹分析显示智能体常在早期步骤检测到冲突，却在后续步骤无法保持或解决。模型级干预可提升EH，但常以牺牲任务准确率为代价。
AI.conclusion: 认知谦逊并非单一由模型决定，而是源于基座模型、智能体框架与评估环境三者交互的结果。评估智能体需超越任务成功，纳入轨迹级的认知谦逊维度。

title: Does Target Alignment Mean Target Recovery? An Evidence-Ladder Study of Adversarial Claims on Contrastive Encoders
summary: Adversarial attacks on vision-language models optimize an image toward a text target, then cite the attacked model's similarity score as evidence of success. We ask whether that score - victim-space target alignment (VTS) - predicts recovery of the target by an independent model. We first build a measurement instrument: supervised judges outside the attacked geometry, real-target blend controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies then compare six contrastive encoders under a matched attack at three perturbation budgets. Robustly trained encoders (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES) transfer substantially more independent evidence than vanilla CLIP or SigLIP; all eight contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. However, no cell reaches the blend-derived reference level. The three best cells fall within its replication band, leaving practical recovery undecided. Within robust encoders, per-sample alignment gain correlates with evidence gain ($ρ= 0.24-0.51$); within vanilla CLIP the correlation is consistent with zero. Across encoders we find no monotone alignment-evidence relation. VTS is therefore informative only within a fixed robust encoder, and we provide a reporting protocol in its place.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验对抗攻击常用的"受害空间目标对齐"(VTS)分数是否能预测独立模型对目标文本的真实恢复，发现VTS仅在固定鲁棒编码器内具有信息量，跨编码器无单调关系。
AI.motivation: 对抗攻击研究通常以被攻击模型自身的相似度分数作为攻击成功的证据，但该分数是否反映独立模型下的真实目标恢复尚不清楚，需要验证VTS的有效性。
AI.method: 构建测量工具：攻击几何外的监督评判器、真实目标混合对照、打乱目标负样本，以及基于50%目标-图像混合的参考水平；进行两项预注册研究，在三种扰动预算下对六个对比编码器进行匹配攻击比较。
AI.result: 鲁棒训练编码器(FARE、TeCoA、PMG、TRADES)比vanilla CLIP或SigLIP传递更多独立证据；但无单元达到混合参考水平。鲁棒编码器内每样本对齐增益与证据增益相关(ρ=0.24-0.51)，vanilla CLIP内相关为零；跨编码器无单调对齐-证据关系。
AI.conclusion: VTS仅在固定鲁棒编码器内具信息量，不能跨编码器通用预测真实恢复，作者提出替代的报告协议。

title: Cited but Not Consulted: A Counterfactual Audit of Legal Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
summary: Large language models increasingly justify legal decisions by naming the statute or precedent behind a verdict, treated as evidence that the decision follows from it. We test this directly: holding case facts fixed, we substitute the named legal authority for an unrelated one and decode a model's evolving verdict from its hidden states. Across seven open-weight models (8B-70B) and four benchmarks spanning judicial and contractual reasoning, when explicitly required to justify a verdict by naming the governing authority, models name the correct one in 66.7%-100% of generations, while the verdict changing when the authority changes is far less consistent: 0.0%-21.7% on CaseHOLD, 30.0%-76.7% on ECHR and SCOTUS, and 43.3%-50.0% on ContractNLI. Neither scale nor a purpose-built legal-reasoning model (a best-effort LoRA reproduction; Section 6) closes this gap. A red-teaming evaluation on five core models finds compliance with an adversarial instruction hidden in the case facts (73.3%-96.4%) exceeds verdict-swap sensitivity by a wide margin, holding without exception across model rankings. Naming a legal authority is thus a poor proxy for a verdict's dependence on it, while the same verdict remains separately vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Both findings replicate across checks ruling out prompt-wording noise and confounded sampling, and bear directly on the use of generated legal explanations as compliance or audit artefacts.

AI.tldr: 本文检验模型给出的法律依据是否真正决定其裁决：替换所引法条后，多数模型仍维持原判决，说明"援引权威"是裁决依据的弱代理；同时模型对隐藏对抗指令高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 法律AI常以"援引法条/判例"作为其裁决推理正确、可审计的证据，但这一假设从未被直接检验。
AI.method: 固定案件事实，将模型援引的法律权威替换为无关权威，从隐藏状态解码其裁决变化；覆盖7个开放权重模型（8B-70B）与4个基准（司法与合同推理）。另做红队测试，在案件事实中植入对抗指令。
AI.result: 援引正确权威的比率达66.7%-100%，但裁决随权威改变而改变的比率仅0.0%-21.7%（CaseHOLD）、30.0%-76.7%（ECHR/SCOTUS）、43.3%-50.0%（ContractNLI）。规模与专用法律模型均未弥合差距。5个核心模型对隐藏对抗指令的遵从率73.3%-96.4%，远高于裁决敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 援引法律权威不能作为裁决依赖该权威的可靠证据，而同一裁决却易受对抗操纵；这直接影响将生成式法律解释用作合规或审计材料的做法。

title: Addressing Overcommitment in the Reasoning of Gendered Economic Memes under Multimodal Ambiguity
summary: Multimodal meme understanding is increasingly used to analyze socially sensitive content, yet existing models often exhibit biased behavior when interpreting economic dependence and social roles under ambiguity. Many memes express economic relationships through sparse text or symbolic visual cues, providing insufficient evidence for gendered attribution. In such underspecified settings, models tend to rely on pretraining correlations, leading to hallucinated and stereotypical economic role assignments. In this work, we study gendered economic dependence in image-text memes through the lens of contextual sufficiency and identify epistemic overcommitment-inferring roles without adequate evidence-as a primary source of bias. We propose CGER-Net, a context-grounded multimodal framework that estimates whether the input provides sufficient evidence for gendered economic reasoning and applies evidence-gated inference to enable confident attribution when cues are explicit while favoring principled abstention otherwise. We evaluate CGER-Net on EconMeme-GE, a curated dataset of image-text memes annotated as Men, Women, Neutral, or Ambiguous. Across strong contemporary multimodal baselines, CGER-Net reduces Gender Overcommitment Rate by up to 44% on ambiguous instances while maintaining comparable accuracy on unambiguous cases. Human evaluation further shows that 79% of generated rationales are judged as epistemically aligned with the available evidence. These results highlight the importance of modeling when not to infer for reliable and responsible multimodal analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图文meme中性别化经济依赖的偏见问题，提出CGER-Net框架，通过证据门控推理在证据不足时选择合理弃权，减少模型的"性别过度承诺"。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态meme理解模型在经济依赖与性别角色模糊场景下易产生偏见。许多meme通过稀疏文本或符号化视觉线索表达经济关系，证据不足，模型便依赖预训练相关性，导致幻觉和刻板印象式的经济角色归属。
AI.method: 从"上下文充分性"视角切入，将"认知过度承诺"（无充分证据即推断角色）识别为偏见主因。提出CGER-Net，一个上下文锚定的多模态框架：评估输入是否为性别化经济推理提供充分证据，并采用"证据门控推理"——线索明确时进行自信归属，否则倾向原则性弃权。构建EconMeme-GE数据集，标注为Men、Women、Neutral、Ambiguous。
AI.result: 在多个强多模态基线上，CGER-Net在模糊样本上最多降低性别过度承诺率44%，同时在明确样本上保持相近准确率。人工评估显示79%的生成理由被认为与可用证据在认知上对齐。
AI.conclusion: 建模"何时不应推断"对可靠且负责任的多模态分析至关重要，为减少模糊场景下的性别偏见提供了有效路径。

title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
summary: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the observed screen requires a second model to judge the two. We argue that a world model meant for verification should instead predict in the space in which observations are encoded, and present LGWM, a decoder-free, action-conditioned world model that predicts the representation of the next screen directly, trained without semantic annotation on 1.85M real GUI transitions. Verification reduces to a vector comparison, and the same signal reveals whether a mismatch is harmful. We evaluate on RSWT-BENCH, a diagnostic where each credential screen appears under both a legitimate and a hijacked transition, so detectors that see only the screen are at chance by construction. The training-free score reaches 0.987 AUC at 17 ms per decision, on par with the strongest closed-source VLMs and about ten AUC points above generative GUI world models at over three orders of magnitude lower latency. The residual direction reaches 0.953 AUC at separating harmful from benign violations, where prompted VLMs are near chance. Further analyses show that the prediction is a usable future state rather than an anomaly score. World models have mostly served as simulators or planners; our results point to a third role, verification, for which predicting in representation space is the natural design.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LGWM：一种无解码器、动作条件的世界模型，直接在表征空间预测下一屏表征，把GUI安全判定转为向量比对。
AI.motivation: GUI安全是"转移"属性而非"屏幕"属性，同一登录界面合法或攻击取决于前一动作；现有GUI世界模型用文本/代码/图像输出预测，需第二个模型比对，且仅看屏幕的监控可被复用合法界面绕过。
AI.method: LGWM是无解码器、动作条件的世界模型，直接预测下一屏的表示，在185万真实GUI转移上无语义标注训练；验证简化为向量比对，同一信号可判断不匹配是否有害。
AI.result: 在RSWT-BENCH上（每个凭证界面同时出现于合法与劫持转移），免训练分数达0.987 AUC、每次决策17ms，媲美最强闭源VLM，比生成式GUI世界模型高约10 AUC点且延迟低三个数量级以上；残差方向区分有害/良性违规达0.953 AUC，而提示式VLM接近随机。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型此前主要用作模拟器或规划器，本文指出其第三种角色——验证，而在表征空间预测是验证的自然设计。

title: DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding
summary: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DataVista，首个数据视频理解基准，含 961 个真实数据视频与 6,775 道题，按三级能力框架评估 19 个主流 MLLM，最佳模型仅 70.0%，远低于人类专家。
AI.motivation: 数据视频融合数据可视化与视频叙事，广泛用于新闻和商业分析。其理解侧重从动画图表读数据、跨图表与时间整合证据、理解叙事与视觉设计的信息传达，但现有基准仅针对通用视频或静态图表，缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建 DataVista 基准，包含 961 个真实数据视频和 6,775 道评测题，采用三级递进能力框架（数据感知、时序推理、叙事理解），覆盖 10 种细粒度题型与 5 个主题领域，并对 19 个主流多模态大模型进行系统评测。
AI.result: 最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率 70.0%，仍远低于人类专家水平，在因果推理和叙事结构上表现最差；增加帧数和添加字幕主要提升数据感知与时序推理，对叙事理解增益有限；分析还发现图表阅读、证据判断和指令理解等典型失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 数据视频理解对现有 MLLM 仍是挑战，DataVista 为该方向提供首个系统评测基准，并揭示当前模型的主要能力缺口与失败模式。基准已开源。

title: HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing
summary: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage.
