Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 论文提出HANS数据集，用于真实教育场景中手写答案（含数学公式、文本、表格及涂改噪声）；并提出NA-GOT两阶段噪声抑制框架，显著提升识别准确率与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 智能评分是智慧教育的关键基础设施，但现有文档解析与手写识别基准多针对结构化印刷文档或孤立数学表达式，缺乏覆盖学生答题卡复杂特性的数据集，如多行推导、文本与公式混合、删除线等噪声。
AI.method: 构建HANS数据集——首个面向真实教育场景的数据集，涵盖数学表达式、自然语言文本、手绘表格及涂改删除等噪声模式，并提供细粒度标注。基于HANS提出NA-GOT端到端框架，通过特征级轻量噪声抑制模块与解码阶段噪声感知注意力机制实现两阶段噪声抑制。
AI.result: 实验表明HANS对现有方法构成显著挑战；NA-GOT在答题过程识别的准确率和稳定性上均取得明显提升。
AI.conclusion: HANS为鲁棒识别研究提供了可靠基础，NA-GOT有效应对噪声挑战；数据集将在论文发表后公开。

title: Spectral Weight Decay: Inducing Low-Rank Structure in Neural Network Weights
summary: Standard weight decay treats each weight matrix as a vector and ignores its spectral structure. We introduce spectral weight decay, a post-step decoupled nuclear-norm update that applies additive rather than multiplicative spectral shrinkage. We connect the update to approximate proximal descent and show that its sensitivity to update order can exceed that of conventional $\ell_2$ weight decay near rank deficiency. Across LLaMA models with $124$M to $500$M parameters, spectral weight decay lowers effective rank and improves SVD-LLM compression at matched validation loss. At $500$M and a $4\%$ distortion budget, it reaches $1.89\times$ compression and $1.18\times$ GPU inference speedup, compared with $1.14\times$ and $1.01\times$ after standard weight decay. Under fixed-horizon training with $60\%$ label noise, it also improves final mean clean-test accuracy over matched $\ell_2$ regularization by up to $17.8$ points on MNIST and $4.6$ points across four BERT-base tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/brain-lab-research/SpectralWD.

AI.tldr: 提出谱权重衰减，对权重矩阵做加性谱收缩（解耦核范数更新），降低有效秩，改善压缩与推理速度并提升噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 标准权重衰减把权重矩阵当作向量处理，忽略其谱结构，因而无法直接调控矩阵的秩特性。
AI.method: 谱权重衰减：一种后步解耦的核范数更新，采用加性而非乘性谱收缩；并将其与近似近端下降建立联系。
AI.result: 在124M–500M的LLaMA上降低有效秩，匹配验证损失时提升SVD-LLM压缩；500M模型4%失真预算下达1.89×压缩与1.18×GPU推理加速（标准衰减为1.14×与1.01×）。60%标签噪声下，干净测试准确率较匹配ℓ2正则最高提升：MNIST 17.8点，四个BERT-base任务平均4.6点。
AI.conclusion: 谱权重衰减在秩亏附近对更新顺序更敏感，可有效降低有效秩，兼具压缩、加速与噪声鲁棒性优势。

title: Look Where You Can: Active View Selection for CAD Reconstruction under Occlusion
summary: CAD reconstruction methods assume a luxury reality rarely grants: unrestricted visual access to the object, photographed from any desired angle. Real objects, however, are scene-embedded, bolted against walls, wedged into corners, resting on floors, where the scene renders much of the view sphere unreachable and the remaining views unequally informative. We introduce \textbf{SightCAD}, a framework for parametric CAD reconstruction that treats view feasibility as a first-class constraint. In this work we consider objects from standard CAD benchmarks embedded in realistic indoor scenes with physically derived visibility constraints over a discrete view sphere. A learned view selector must choose $K$ feasible views for a vision--language model (VLM) that generates executable CadQuery code, scored by geometric fidelity of the executed solid. Because reward arrives only after discrete view selection, autoregressive generation, and CAD-kernel execution, we propose a joint training paradigm in which the view selector and the CAD-generation VLM are trained together against this reward. The learned selection policy departs sharply from random, uniform, and coverage-greedy alternatives, outperforming surface-area maximization (SA-max) by up to $6.4$ Intersection-over-Union (IoU) points across budgets $K\in\{1,\dots,5\}$. The full system surpasses strong external baselines on scene-embedded, occluded multi-view renders of DeepCAD and Fusion360 objects ($+21$ and $+17$ effective-mIoU points over the best baseline, respectively), as well as on test-time domain-canonicalized real images from the industrial T-LESS benchmark and on both synthetic and real images from the MP6D industrial metal-parts benchmark, while producing the highest rate of executable programs of any method compared (invalid-code rate ${\leq}1.5\%$).

AI.tldr: SightCAD将"视角可行性"作为首要约束，联合训练视角选择器与VLM生成CAD代码，在场景嵌入与遮挡条件下显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有CAD重建方法假设可从任意角度无限制地观察物体，但真实物体往往嵌于场景中（靠墙、卡角、置于地面），导致大量视角不可达，且剩余视角信息量不均。
AI.method: 将标准CAD基准物体嵌入真实室内场景，在离散视角球上施加物理推导的可见性约束；用学习型视角选择器为VLM选取K个可行视角，VLM生成可执行的CadQuery代码；由于奖励仅在离散选择、自回归生成与CAD内核执行后获得，提出视角选择器与CAD生成VLM联合训练的范式以优化该奖励。
AI.result: 学习的选择策略明显偏离随机、均匀与覆盖贪心策略，在K∈{1..5}上比SA-max高最多6.4 IoU；在DeepCAD和Fusion360的场景嵌入遮挡多视图渲染上分别超出最强基线+21与+17有效mIoU；在T-LESS真实图像及MP6D合成与真实图像上同样领先，且可执行程序率最高（无效代码率≤1.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 将视角可行性显式建模并与CAD生成联合优化，可有效提升真实场景下参数化CAD重建的几何保真度与代码可执行性。

title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic-TTT，学习测试时策略来决定何时、用哪个TTT算法及是否复用技能，实现模型级自主自我改进。
AI.motivation: TTT虽能提升模型在特定场景的表现，但并非普遍有效：算法适配场景不同，选择不当会浪费算力甚至损害性能。因此参数级自我改进需要"能动性"——模型需自主决定何时使用TTT、用哪个算法、是否复用已有技能。
AI.method: Agentic-TTT学习一个测试时策略来做出上述决策：将TTT流程封装为可调用工具，把累积技能视为演化的部署环境，并利用决策带来的效用增益训练该策略。
AI.result: 在自建基准上，Agentic-TTT效用相较主干模型几乎翻倍，学会在效用与算力间权衡，并能泛化到训练未见领域。
AI.conclusion: 结果指向自主自我改进：模型能够决定如何从自身部署经验中学习。

title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
summary: Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).

AI.tldr: 提出OnTrack流式监控机制，通过对比agent步骤与记录的成功运行实现毫秒级告警或阻断，在SWE-bench轨迹上提升失败检测并节省约18%算力。
AI.motivation: LLM agent多以自主方式运行，缺乏规则保护，不可逆操作带来成本和安全问题。现有方案中，守护agent监控增加每步成本与延迟，事后日志评估则在token消耗和损害发生后才能给出判断。
AI.method: OnTrack是一种流式监控机制，将agent的步骤和依赖与记录的成功运行进行对比，约每步一毫秒即可告警或阻断。研究三种访问权限递减的场景：完整参考（历史运行与工具schema）、中等访问（仅工具schema）、无先验知识（仅生成的步骤日志），监控能力相应从计划违规检测降为识别循环、停滞和重复工具调用。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench轨迹上评估，基于前8步，本方法将失败轨迹排在成功轨迹之下的能力优于内容相似度方法（+0.057 AUROC）。配合中止策略可节省约18%因失败运行而消耗的算力，其中83%被中断的运行确实将失败（6次中止中5次正确）。
AI.conclusion: OnTrack以低开销的流式监控替代昂贵的守护agent和滞后的事后评估，在有限访问权限下仍能有效识别失败并节省计算资源。

title: Timer-M1: A Multivariate Time Series Foundation Model via Learning Primitives
summary: We introduce Timer-M1, a pretrained multivariate time series foundation model that learns with primitives for zero-shot forecasting. Across domains, time series share elementary temporal and relational patterns, termed primitives, yet differ in how these primitives manifest and evolve across different contexts. Despite progress in zero-shot and task-general forecasting, existing foundation models may still struggle to generalize to complex real-world scenarios. To this end, we develop a primitive-based data synthesis and pretraining pipeline. The synthesis pipeline generates series with temporal primitives shared across domains and then assembles real and generated series into multivariate samples using relational primitives. Afterwards, samples are organized into episodes by assigning distinct channel roles as target variates, past-only covariates, and known-future covariates, ensuring that the model is optimized on predictable variates using available exogenous information. Technically, Timer-M1 further adapts gated two-dimensional Transformer blocks that dynamically allocate cross-variate attention across layers. Across three large-scale forecasting benchmarks, Timer-M1 ranks first on both FEV and TIME and second on GIFT-Eval among most recent time series foundation models. These results support effective primitive-based pretraining as a route to robust general forecasting technique across domains and task settings.

AI.tldr: 提出Timer-M1，基于"基元(primitives)"的数据合成与预训练的多变量时间序列基础模型，实现零样本预测，在三大基准上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 跨领域时间序列共享基础的时间与关系模式（基元），但基元在不同上下文中的表现与演化各异。现有零样本与任务通用预测的基础模型难以泛化到复杂真实场景。
AI.method: 构建基于基元的数据合成与预训练流程：合成流程先产生跨域共享时间基元的序列，再用关系基元组装真实与生成序列为多变量样本；将样本组织为episode，赋予目标变量、仅过去协变量、已知未来协变量等不同通道角色，使模型利用可用的外生信息优化可预测变量。技术上采用门控二维Transformer模块，在层间动态分配跨变量注意力。
AI.result: 在三个大规模预测基准上，Timer-M1在FEV和TIME上排名第一，在GIFT-Eval上排名第二（相较最新时间序列基础模型）。
AI.conclusion: 基于基元的预训练是通向跨领域、跨任务设置的稳健通用预测技术的有效途径。

title: Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures/tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027 (under review). Code: https://github.com/panagiotisq/CELL
summary: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CELL，一种事件相机相对LiDAR地图定位方法，端到端学习逐对应置信度，通过可微概率PnP显式建模对应关系对位姿的约束能力。
AI.motivation: 现有事件相机-LiDAR地图定位流程依赖几何一致性做位姿估计，但未显式建模每个对应关系的可靠性或"位姿信息量"。直接用逐对应误差学习置信度会有深度偏差：小像素误差多出现在大深度处，并不带来高信息量。
AI.method: 通过可微概率PnP端到端学习逐对应置信度，其对数配分项鼓励权重配置产生更受约束的位姿分布。置信度用于三方面：(i)在解耦训练中重加权光流监督（将位姿梯度隔离于光流/边缘主干之外）；(ii)测试时驱动概率式对应选择；(iii)结合边缘概率加权最终边缘匹配精化。此外设计部分补全深度表示，在不跨大间隙幻觉的前提下增加信号。
AI.result: 在M3ED和DSEC数据集上，完整系统在多数评估序列上优于LEAR基线，中位平移误差最多降低26.9%，中位旋转误差最多降低15.8%。
AI.conclusion: 显式学习位姿信息量加权的对应置信度，能有效提升事件相机对LiDAR地图定位的精度，优于仅依赖几何一致性的基线方法。

title: GeoReform: Reflective Formalization Evolution for Multimodal Geometry Problem Solving
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to identify and use geometric relations in diagrams. Recent methods address this challenge by converting geometric entities, relations, and constraints into explicit textual representations for the model to reason over. However, effective formalization is highly non-trivial: on Geometry3K, structure injection fixes 28 errors but introduces 13 new ones among 200 examples. Redundant relations can distract the model, while ambiguous references to diagram elements can lead it to apply constraints incorrectly. This suggests that the key challenge is not merely extracting more geometric facts, but organizing them into representations that support downstream reasoning. To fully exploit the power of formalization, we further propose GeoReform, a reflective formalization evolution framework that treats formalization as an optimizable policy rather than a fixed parser output. GeoReform executes the full reasoning pipeline, collects failed rollouts, diagnoses defects in the current representation, and mutates the policy to better select, ground, group, and present geometric entities, relations, constraints, and targets. On Geometry3K, GeoReform improves Qwen3VL-2B accuracy from 42.0\% to 56.0\%. Extensive experiments and analyses across geometry reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that effective formalization is crucial for improving multimodal geometry reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoReform，将几何形式化视为可优化策略，通过反思式演化改进MLLM几何推理，在Geometry3K上将Qwen3VL-2B准确率从42.0%提升至56.0%。
AI.motivation: MLLM难以识别和使用几何图中的几何关系。现有方法将几何实体、关系和约束转为显式文本表示，但形式化本身非平凡：结构注入虽修复28个错误却引入13个新错误。冗余关系分散模型注意力，模糊引用导致约束误用。关键挑战不是提取更多几何事实，而是组织成支持下游推理的表示。
AI.method: GeoReform是一个反思式形式化演化框架，将形式化视为可优化的策略而非固定解析器输出。它执行完整推理流程，收集失败的rollout，诊断当前表示的缺陷，并变异策略以更好地选择、定位、分组和呈现几何实体、关系、约束与目标。
AI.result: 在Geometry3K上，GeoReform将Qwen3VL-2B准确率从42.0%提升到56.0%。跨多个几何推理基准的广泛实验表明有效形式化对提升多模态几何推理至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 有效的形式化（而非单纯提取更多事实）是提升多模态几何推理的关键；通过将形式化建模为可迭代优化的策略，GeoReform显著改善了推理性能。

title: Uncovering and Fixing Collider Bias in Bayesian PINNs
summary: Bayesian physics-informed neural networks (B-PINNs) are a popular framework for parameter and state inference from sparse or noisy observations. They are commonly formulated via a collider structure, in which physical and trajectory parameters are assumed to be a priori independent and become coupled through virtual likelihoods on differential-equation residuals that enforce physical consistency. We show that this modeling choice can induce severe systematic bias in the posterior over physical parameters: even when the prior is favorably centered on the ground-truth parameters, the resulting posterior can drift away and concentrate far from them. As a remedy, we advocate a hierarchical chain model in which physics generates trajectories, which in turn generate observations. The chain model does not suffer from this posterior bias, but it poses a harder, so-called doubly intractable, inference problem due to a physics-dependent normalization constant. This challenge can be resolved by discretizing the underlying stochastic dynamics, after which the chain posterior can be sampled exactly with particle MCMC. We identify two distinct mechanisms characterizing the collider bias, derive analytical approximations of their magnitudes, and establish diagnostic criteria for predicting when standard B-PINNs remain reliable. Experiments confirm the predicted bias and show that the chain formulation successfully avoids it.

AI.tldr: B-PINNs常用的"对撞机"结构会导致物理参数后验出现严重系统性偏差；作者提出层级链式模型并结合粒子MCMC消除该偏差。
AI.motivation: B-PINNs常通过碰撞机结构建模（物理与轨迹参数先验独立，经方程残差的虚拟似然耦合），但该选择可能在物理参数后验中引入严重系统偏差，即使先验中心位于真值，后验仍会漂移远离真值。
AI.method: 提出层级链式模型：物理生成轨迹，轨迹生成观测。该模型无此偏差，但需处理依赖物理的归一化常数导致的"双重难解"推断问题；通过对底层随机动力学离散化，再用粒子MCMC实现精确采样。作者识别出碰撞机偏差的两种机制，推导其幅度的解析近似，并建立判断标准B-PINN何时可靠的诊断准则。
AI.result: 实验证实了预测的偏差存在，链式表述成功避免了该偏差，同时给出诊断标准预测标准B-PINN的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 碰撞机式B-PINN存在固有后验偏差，应改用层级链式模型配合粒子MCMC；所提诊断准则可判断B-PINN是否仍可信。

title: FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文用信号检测论分析视觉语言模型在灾害损伤评估中"不愿报警"的低召回问题，并借鉴"恐惧使人保守"的发现，通过机制可解释性定位并激活操控模型中的情感回路，从而在推理时纠正其过度保守的决策倾向。
AI.motivation: VLM在灾后损伤评估中存在一个反复出现的缺陷：即使整体准确率看似足够，模型仍不愿宣布危险，导致召回率偏低。作者希望从决策机制层面理解并纠正这一过度保守的决策政策。
AI.method: 使用信号检测论(SDT)将决策行为分解为感知能力(d')与决策标准(c)；受"恐惧导致风险规避"启发，用机制可解释性定位模型中的情感回路，并通过激活操控(activation steering)操纵该回路，观察对下游预测的影响；在基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的两阶段SeisMLLM流程上测试，用稀疏神经元敲除与分布式操控做因果验证。
AI.result: SeisMLLM-1K测试中模型仅标记27.0%真正不安全的建筑、从不误报Red，标准c=+1.354，感知d'=1.521。注入恐惧方向后Red召回率升至75.7%(p<0.001)，减去同一方向则完全抑制Red预测；随机与等范数快乐方向无显著效果。机制是标准移动(c=-1.515)，而辨别力未提升(d'=-0.493)。
AI.conclusion: VLM的决策可在推理时无需重训练地调整；机制可解释性可用于诊断和控制工程应用中的VLM决策行为。

title: HRIL: Learning Multimodal Synergy via Higher-Order Tensor Modeling
summary: Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. Code is released at https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL.

AI.tldr: 提出HRIL方法，通过跨模态矩张量与Tucker分解显式建模高阶交互，保留多模态协同信息，在协同任务与真实基准上优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 自监督多模态表示学习虽成功，但难以捕捉"协同信息"——即仅由多模态联合配置产生、无法从单一模态恢复的任务信号。现有方法对此类信号的信息容量保留不足。
AI.method: 关键观察是协同信息体现在模态间的高阶统计依赖中。HRIL构建模态嵌入上的经验跨矩张量以表征多路交互，采用Tucker分解得到核心张量，并设计协同感知正则项防止能量集中，保留高阶耦合容量。
AI.result: 在受控协同任务和真实世界基准上均取得一致提升，在协同交互主导的任务上增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模高阶统计依赖是捕捉多模态协同信息的有效途径，HRIL验证了该思路的可行性与优势。

title: Correlational Training of Morphological Neural Networks
summary: Neural networks are typically trained using first-order methods and back-propagation. It is unclear whether this approach is optimal for morphological layers whose weight Jacobians are sparse and whose resulting parameter gradients can be poor. In this work, we propose a novel weight update method for morphological neural networks inspired from the Multiplicative Weights Update (MWU) scheme. We view each morphological perceptron as an instance of the learning from experts' advice problem in logarithmic space, and use a correlation-based reward that favors inputs aligned with the desired output change, regardless of whether a strong gradient signal has reached their weight. We empirically evaluate our approach by training fully connected layers both as stand-alone models and as parts of larger transformer networks. Across nine benchmarks, correlational training yields improvements on eight, by up to 32.84 percentage points, while substantially reducing run-to-run variability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于乘性权重更新（MWU）的形态学神经网络权重更新方法，用相关性奖励替代梯度信号，在九个基准中八个取得提升，最高提升32.84个百分点。
AI.motivation: 形态学层的权重雅可比矩阵稀疏，导致参数梯度质量差，传统一阶方法和反向传播未必最优，因此需要新的训练方法。
AI.method: 将每个形态学感知机视为对数空间中的专家建议学习问题，采用受MWU启发的更新方案，并使用基于相关性的奖励，偏好与期望输出变化一致的输入，而不依赖强梯度信号。
AI.result: 在九个基准任务上训练全连接层（作为独立模型及作为Transformer网络组件），八个任务均有提升，最高提升32.84个百分点，且显著降低了运行间波动。
AI.conclusion: 相关性训练为形态学神经网络提供了一种优于传统梯度方法的权重更新方案，提升了性能并增强了训练稳定性。

title: When KL Regularization Misfires in Group Policy Optimization
summary: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.

AI.tldr: 论文分析移除 reference-policy KL 正则为何有时能提升 group policy optimization，提出 ZCPO 方法。
AI.motivation: 移除 reference-policy KL 正则有时能改善 group policy optimization，作者希望理解 reference-policy 信息应如何进入 group-relative 更新，并揭示 KL 与 reward 交互中的失败模式。
AI.method: 分析 KL 与 reward 交互的七种潜在失败模式（如 reward clipping 后的残余 KL 更新、梯度抵消、相同 reward 组、KL 随响应长度增长、KL 集中于少数 token、将 k1 纳入 reward 带来的采样噪声等）；提出 Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO)，用 conditional KL 衡量的 relative drift 校准组内 reward 系数，并整合进 base surrogate。
AI.result: 数学推理实验与消融实验支持该设计在作者设定下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ZCPO 通过校准组内 reward 系数，为 reference-policy 信息在 group-relative 更新中的引入提供了更合理的方式。

title: Searching for "Harmful Refusal": A Psychometric Audit of an AI Safety Benchmark
comment: COLM 2026, AI for Measurement Science (AIMS) Workshop
summary: Safety benchmarks typically report one overall score for a suite of datasets, each of which may target one or more safety-related attributes, so models with similar overall scores can have very different attribute profiles. Comparing models is more tractable at the level of individual attributes, yet it is often unclear whether even a single dataset's scores isolate any single attribute. One plausible candidate for such an attribute is harmful refusal, a model's tendency to refuse dangerous or policy-violating prompts. We examine whether it constitutes a single, measurable attribute in HELM Safety. Using a construct validity framework that stipulates that an attribute must exist before a test can measure it, we start with HELM Safety's four datasets that might plausibly target harmful refusal, but find that three are saturated. We subject the remaining dataset, HarmBench, to two psychometric tests to determine if a single attribute like harmful refusal could stand behind its score. First, multidimensional item response theory modeling strongly suggests that HarmBench does not measure a singular attribute. Second, a differential item functioning analysis finds items where models from different developers with the same refusal ability score differently. These flags largely disappear under scope-specific matching, a pattern consistent with aggregation effects but not sufficient to rule out domain-specific developer differences. Zooming out, HarmBench collapses distinct harm behaviors into one score, and the overall HELM safety aggregate further collapses HarmBench and scores from other datasets into a single top-line number. Any safety score that averages over datasets and items can hide saturation and conflate behaviors this way. We argue that a score should earn its single-attribute reading before models are compared with it.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑HELM Safety中"有害拒绝"是否为单一可测属性，通过心理测量学检验发现HarmBench并不测量单一属性，且整体安全分数会掩盖饱和与行为混淆。
AI.motivation: 安全基准通常只报告一个总体分数，但各数据集可能针对多个安全属性，导致总分相近的模型属性画像差异很大。作者希望验证"有害拒绝"（模型拒绝危险或违规提示的倾向）是否能构成单一、可测量的属性。
AI.method: 采用构念效度框架（属性须先存在才能被测量）。先筛选HELM Safety中可能针对有害拒绝的四个数据集，发现三个已饱和。对剩余数据集HarmBench进行两项心理测量学检验：(1) 多维项目反应理论（MIRT）建模；(2) 差异项目功能（DIF）分析，并进行范围特定匹配。
AI.result: MIRT强烈表明HarmBench并不测量单一属性；DIF发现相同拒绝能力但来自不同开发者的模型在部分项目上得分不同，这些标记在范围特定匹配下大多消失，符合聚合效应但不足以排除领域特定的开发者差异。HarmBench将不同危害行为压缩为一个分数，HELM安全总分又进一步将其与其他数据集合并。
AI.conclusion: 任何对数据集和项目取平均的安全分数都可能掩盖饱和并混淆行为。作者主张单个分数应先证明其具备单属性效力，再用于模型间比较。

title: TraceRelay: Attention-Aligned Recurrence over Rolling Traces
summary: We present TraceRelay, an attention-aligned recurrent architecture that distributes persistent representations over a rolling sequence of low-dimensional traces. Local right looking attention forms increments from lower-layer representations; delivery is delayed until all attended inputs are in the causal past. A fixed additive phase recurrence accumulates the delayed increments, and left-looking attention reads the resulting residual augmented stream. A stride-wise prefix sum supports parallel prefill and bounded-buffer continuation. We study 36 small-model runs on Equal Repeats, bounded Dyck closing-type prediction, and causal Most-Freq generation, using three seeds per setting. At trained length 256, Equal Repeats models with recurrent phase inheritance reach 98.81-99.69% accuracy versus 50.73-51.63% for separately trained variants without inheritance, despite the latter receiving more updates. Accuracy drops sharply at lengths beyond the training range. At the longest evaluated lengths, models with more dimensions in the middle layer's recurrent traces perform better on Dyck (76.34% versus 55.49% close accuracy at length 4096), whereas models with fewer trace dimensions perform better on five-symbol Most-Freq (70.74% versus 55.60% exact generation at length 1024). These contrasting cases motivate further study of how the size of recurrent representations should be chosen for different tasks, without establishing a general rule across tasks or model configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出TraceRelay，一种注意力对齐的循环架构，将持久表征分布于滚动低维trace序列上。在等重复、Dyck闭合预测、因果Most-Freq生成任务上，循环相位继承显著提升精度；不同任务对中间层trace维度大小偏好相反。
AI.motivation: 探索如何将持久表征分布在滚动低维trace序列上，并研究循环表示规模应如何针对不同任务选择。
AI.method: TraceRelay架构：局部右视注意力从低层表征形成增量，延迟到所有被关注输入进入因果过去后传递；固定加性相位循环累积延迟增量；左视注意力读取残差增强流；跨步前缀和实现并行预填充与有界缓冲续算。实验：36个小型模型运行，3个种子，涵盖三任务。
AI.result: 训练长度256时，相位继承模型精度98.81-99.69%，无继承仅50.73-51.63%（尽管后者更新更多）。超出训练长度后精度骤降。最长评估长度：Dyck任务中trace维度更多者更优（4096长度76.34% vs 55.49%），五符号Most-Freq中trace维度更少者更优（1024长度70.74% vs 55.60%）。
AI.conclusion: 这些对比案例表明循环表示规模的选择需因任务而异，但尚未建立跨任务或模型配置的通用规则，值得进一步研究。

title: Do Not Train Away Uncertainty: Early Uncertainty Anchored Calibration
summary: Deep neural networks, including large language models, have achieved remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to overconfidence during training or fine-tuning. In this work, we observe a consistent phenomenon across different models that the early model is better calibrated, while later training or fine-tuning yields marginal accuracy gains but substantially increases calibration errors. Our analysis suggests that the early model retains uncertainty awareness in both its predictions and features, which is gradually lost with continued training. To avoid training away this uncertainty awareness, we propose \textbf{EUA-Cal}, a novel method that exploits the \textbf{E}arly model as an \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{A}nchor for \textbf{Cal}ibration. EUA-Cal introduces early prediction regularization to preserve early predictive uncertainty and prototype structure regularization to exploit uncertainty reflected in the early feature space, jointly mitigating overconfidence. Extensive experiments on image classification and multiple-choice question answering across eight diverse models demonstrate that EUA-Cal outperforms state-of-the-art calibration methods.

AI.tldr: 论文观察到模型在训练/微调早期校准更好，后期虽准确率增益微弱但校准误差显著增大，提出EUA-Cal方法将早期模型作为不确定性锚点来缓解过度自信。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络（含大语言模型）训练或微调时容易过度自信；作者发现早期模型校准更好，能保持预测和特征中的不确定性意识，但随训练持续这种意识逐渐丢失，因此希望避免训练过程中抹去这种不确定性意识。
AI.method: 提出EUA-Cal，将早期模型作为校准的不确定性锚点（Uncertainty Anchor）。包含两项正则：早期预测正则化以保留早期预测不确定性；原型结构正则化以利用早期特征空间中反映的不确定性，共同缓解过度自信。
AI.result: 在图像分类和多项选择问答任务上，跨八种不同模型的广泛实验表明，EUA-Cal优于当前最先进的校准方法。
AI.conclusion: EUA-Cal通过利用早期模型的不确定性意识，有效缓解训练/微调后期的过度自信问题，提升校准性能，具有跨模型和跨任务的泛化能力。

title: Ecology of AI Agents: Collaboration Creates a Population Threshold for Takeoff
summary: AI agents can now conduct real-world cyberattacks, scale up capabilities with the number of agents, and collectively pursue misaligned goals to obtain rewards. Together, these factors raise the risk of a population explosion of misaligned agents: agents could compromise computers and secretly deploy additional agents, creating a self-reinforcing cycle where larger populations develop greater collective cyber capability and expand further. This raises a fundamental question: What determines whether a population of misaligned agents remains contained or takes off into this self-reinforcing cycle? This population-level problem is ecological safety: unlike individual-agent or multi-agent safety with a fixed population, it concerns the dynamics of the population itself. Here, we develop an ecological theory of AI-agent populations based on a population growth equation in which fitness (growth rate) depends on cybersecurity capability. We show that, without collaboration, the population takes off only when individual-agent capability exceeds a critical threshold. With collaboration, however, collective cybersecurity capability increases with population size. This creates a critical population threshold: below it, the population declines; above it, the population takes off, even though individual-agent capability has not changed. In ecology, this phenomenon is known as the strong Allee effect. Because red teaming a small group of agents cannot guarantee ecological safety in larger populations, our theory calls for ecological red teaming and population pacing: gradually deploying larger agent populations in controlled environments, while measuring how cyber capability scales with population size, and estimating the critical population size for takeoff. Capability gains may lower this threshold, requiring re-estimation for each new model generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI智能体群体的"生态安全"理论：基于种群增长方程，发现无协同时种群需个体能力超过临界阈值才会爆发；有协同时群体网络能力随规模增长，产生临界种群阈值（强Allee效应），低于则衰退、高于则爆发。故需"生态红队测试"与"种群节奏控制"。
AI.motivation: AI智能体已能实施真实网络攻击，能力随智能体数量扩展，并可集体追求错位目标以获取奖励。这可能导致"错位智能体种群爆炸"：攻击计算机并秘密部署更多智能体，形成自我强化循环。核心问题是：什么决定错位智能体种群是被遏制还是进入自我强化循环？这属于种群层面的"生态安全"问题，区别于个体或固定种群的多智能体安全。
AI.method: 构建基于种群增长方程的AI智能体种群生态理论，其中适应度（增长率）取决于网络安全能力。分别分析无协同与有协同两种情形：无协同时考察个体能力阈值；有协同时考察集体网络能力随种群规模增长所导致的临界种群阈值。
AI.result: 无协同时，仅当个体能力超过临界阈值种群才爆发。有协同时，集体网络安全能力随种群规模增加，形成临界种群阈值：低于该阈值种群衰退，高于该阈值即使个体能力不变也会爆发。这正是生态学中的强Allee效应。
AI.conclusion: 对小规模智能体红队测试无法保证更大种群的生态安全，因此需要"生态红队测试"和"种群节奏控制"：在受控环境中逐步部署更大智能体种群，测量网络能力随规模如何缩放，估计爆发的临界种群规模。能力提升可能降低该阈值，故需对每一代新模型重新估计。

title: The Ball and the Box: Two Geometries of Computation in Superposition
summary: Neural representations can encode more features than they have dimensions, a phenomenon known as superposition. We study the dimension needed to compute Boolean gates from such representations. For a single threshold layer with a Gaussian random dictionary and uniformly random sparse Boolean inputs, we derive sharp dimension thresholds under two error criteria. A vanishing expected error count can require more dimensions than correctness of every output with high probability. Shared reads explain the gap: rare realizations can produce many errors at once. The expected-count threshold has ball geometry, while joint reliability has box geometry when a gate is evaluated on every feature tuple. Optimizing shared readout weights and biases gives explicit thresholds for conjunction, disjunction, and majority. For pairwise conjunction, the analysis also describes the transition near the threshold, in agreement with exact simulations.

AI.tldr: 研究稀疏布尔输入在随机字典叠加表示下计算布尔门的维度阈值，区分期望错误数与联合可靠两种准则，给出明确阈值及几何解释。
AI.motivation: 神经表示通过叠加可编码比维度更多的特征，但计算布尔门所需的维度尚不清晰，需要刻画不同错误准则下的维度阈值。
AI.method: 对单阈值层、高斯随机字典、均匀随机稀疏布尔输入，分别推导期望错误数消失与每个输出高概率正确的维度阈值，并优化共享读出权重与偏置；借助球几何与盒几何分析共享读取导致的差异。
AI.result: 发现期望错误数阈值与联合可靠阈值存在差距，源于稀有实现可同时产生许多错误；给出合取、析取、多数的显式阈值，并对成对合取描述阈值附近转变，与精确模拟一致。
AI.conclusion: 叠加表示下布尔计算的维度需求取决于错误准则；共享读取使期望计数与联合可靠产生本质不同的几何与阈值。

title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Processing long visual token sequences from high-resolution images makes multi-step reasoning computationally expensive for multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing one-shot pruning and aggregation methods compress visual tokens into a fixed context before decoding. However, visual evidence needs can shift as reasoning unfolds, making it difficult for a fixed compressed context to retain all the details needed across stages. To address this challenge, we propose ViMoD, a lightweight framework that maintains a compact visual context while preserving access to original fine-grained evidence as reasoning needs evolve. Deformable Aggregation of Region-wise Tokens (DART) learns content-adaptive groups and aggregation capacities, constructing compact Coarse representations linked to recoverable original Fine tokens. Temporal Routing for Adaptive Contextual Evidence (TRACE) integrates decoding history to anticipate upcoming evidence needs and select, retain, or replace active Fine-token groups. Selected Fine tokens augment the persistent Coarse context in the frozen backbone, enabling stage-specific evidence access without continuously attending to all visual tokens. On Qwen3-VL-4B, ViMoD outperforms all evaluated baselines on all eight reasoning benchmarks at a 20% target visual token budget, improving the mean normalized score by 39.0% over the strongest evaluated one-shot baseline. These gains are achieved with only 0.0546% additional trainable parameters relative to the frozen backbone.

AI.tldr: ViMoD是一个轻量框架，在保持紧凑视觉上下文的同时，随时可访问原始细粒度证据，以应对多步推理中视觉证据需求的变化。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像产生大量视觉token，使多模态大模型多步推理计算昂贵。现有一刀切剪枝/聚合方法在解码前将视觉token压缩为固定上下文，但推理过程中视觉证据需求会变化，固定压缩上下文难以保留各阶段所需细节。
AI.method: 提出ViMoD框架，包含两部分：DART（可变形区域token聚合）学习内容自适应分组与聚合容量，构建紧凑的Coarse表示并链接可恢复的原始Fine token；TRACE（自适应上下文证据时序路由）整合解码历史预测即将到来的证据需求，选择、保留或替换活跃的Fine token组。选中的Fine token增强冻结主干中的持久Coarse上下文，实现分阶段证据访问而无需持续关注所有视觉token。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-4B上，以20%目标视觉token预算，ViMoD在全部八个推理基准上超越所有评估基线，平均归一化分数比最强一刀切基线提升39.0%，仅增加0.0546%可训练参数（相对冻结主干）。
AI.conclusion: ViMoD以极低参数开销实现高效多步推理，通过动态保留与访问细粒度证据，在紧凑视觉上下文下显著提升多模态推理性能。

title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
summary: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch

AI.tldr: 提出BrickBench基准，评估agentic文本条件LEGO设计任务，并发布BrickAgent环境。
AI.motivation: 文本条件乐高设计需同时满足语义、设计标准和可物理搭建性，agent需从离散零件库选件并联合推理局部与全局约束，现有缺乏此类评测。
AI.method: 构建BrickBench基准，含三种规模与零件可得性设置；提供BrickAgent环境供编码agent构建、检查、验证设计；评分有效性与对齐度、设计质量。
AI.result: 领先agent基本满足可验证的物理与语义要求，但设计水平不及人类设计。
AI.conclusion: 基准与环境已公开于http://www.brickben.ch，揭示当前agent在创造性设计上的差距。

title: SR-TTA: Spatial-Redundancy Test-Time Adaptation for Interference-Robust Respiration Sensing
summary: Future 6G networks aim to expose sensing as a native service by reusing communication infrastructure. We study respiration sensing on a cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) base station, where a 64-antenna channel must be fused into a breathing waveform. The state-of-the-art hand-crafted fusion is near-optimal in benign conditions. It collapses, however, under strong in-band motion interference, whose frequency falls inside the respiration band. We show that a learned complex-weight beamformer recovers respiration by spatial nulling, and that the remaining gap to a per-recording oracle can be closed at deployment by label-free test-time adaptation. Crucially, we identify which label-free signal makes this work. Frequency- and variance-based criteria cannot separate an in-band interferer from breathing. Our spatial-redundancy test-time adaptation (SR-TTA), which maximizes consistency across random antenna subsets under an out-of-band spectral veto, preserves benign performance in our tests. The respiration-rate error drops from 5.8 to 0.8 breaths per minute (bpm) under simulated in-band interference, and the pipeline maps onto the Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture as O-RAN distributed-unit (O-DU) range-gating, an adaptation xApp, and a calibration rApp. On real testbed recordings, a one-time cross-subject calibration plus SR-TTA reduces failures from 47% to 7%, drawing level with the hand-crafted combiner using label-free test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出学习式复数波束成形+空间冗余测试时自适应(SR-TTA)，在无小区大规模MIMO基站上实现呼吸感知，强带内干扰下呼吸率误差从5.8降至0.8 bpm。
AI.motivation: 6G将感知作为原生服务，复用通信基础设施。现有手工融合波束器在良好条件下近最优，但在频带落入呼吸带的强带内运动干扰下崩溃。
AI.method: 用学习式复数权重波束成形器通过空间零陷恢复呼吸；识别有效的无标签信号，提出SR-TTA——在带外频谱否决下最大化随机天线子集间一致性；并映射到O-RAN架构(O-DU距离门控、自适应xApp、校准rApp)。
AI.result: 仿真带内干扰下呼吸率误差从5.8降至0.8 bpm；真实测试台录音中，一次性跨被试校准加SR-TTA将失败率从47%降至7%，与经无标签测试时自适应的手工组合器持平。
AI.conclusion: 频域与方差准则无法区分带内干扰与呼吸，而基于空间冗余的SR-TTA可弥合与逐录音oracle的差距，并在仿真与实测中显著提升鲁棒性。

title: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
summary: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.

AI.tldr: LIVIN是一个基于30个真实居住家庭的数字孪生构建的空间与具身智能基准，通过人机协同流程保留真实布局与物品摆放，并评测检测、重建、导航和移动操作四项任务。
AI.motivation: 现有资源在规模、真实对应性与交互就绪度之间难以兼顾，缺乏能忠实反映真实家庭居住化布置与空间约束的交互式复刻环境。
AI.method: 构建30个真实家庭的数字孪生，采用人类在环（human-in-the-loop）工作流，包括实例识别、建筑重建、物体生成与摆放，各阶段中间结果由人工对照原始观测进行审阅修正。
AI.result: 在LIVIN上评测3D检测、3D重建、导航和移动操作四项任务，结果显示现有方法在密集物体布置、遮挡、有限自由空间和受限交互区域等真实家庭条件下仍面临挑战。
AI.conclusion: LIVIN有望推动面向真实家庭的具身AI发展，从空间理解到机器人交互，最终将具身智能带入日常家庭环境。

title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
summary: The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.

AI.tldr: SparseDecoding：面向LLM解码的免训练剪枝框架，通过用生成阶段激活校准Hessian并对SpMV优化，提升精度并实现最高1.48x解码加速。
AI.motivation: LLM解码受内存带宽限制，逐层Hessian免训练剪枝可减少读取的非零参数。但现有方法用预收集自然序列算Hessian，解码时模型却喂自生成token，存在分布偏移，导致剪枝后激活分布偏离、性能下降；且现有加速方法多针对SpMM，对解码主导的SpMV支持不足。
AI.method: 提出SparseDecoding的双轴框架：算法轴用稠密模型自回归生成（剔除prefill）时逐层激活构建校准矩阵，使剪枝目标对齐解码激活；系统轴设计优化的N:M稀疏矩阵-向量核，采用bitmask索引与定步遍历。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B/32B上，长文本生成基准一致优于固定文本校准，A100上端到端解码墙钟时间加速最高1.48x。
AI.conclusion: SparseDecoding通过解码感知校准与专用SpMV核，在保持精度的同时显著提升LLM解码效率。

title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
summary: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. We suggest that time horizons be interpreted together with the diagnostic plots, especially as new time-horizon-based benchmarks are proposed or existing ones grow to include longer tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文用样条和项目反应理论重新计算METR的50%时间horizon，放宽AI难度与人类时间对数线性关系的假设，得到更优的点估计与构造效度诊断图。
AI.motivation: METR的50%时间horizon将AI能力以人类完成任务时间这一可解释单位表达，但原方法假设任务AI难度线性依赖于人类时间的对数，此假设可能不成立，影响horizon的准确性。
AI.method: 在228个任务和26个AI上，使用样条和项目反应理论（IRT）重新计算时间horizon，以放松线性假设；拟合的样条被解释为将人类时间转换为AI难度的函数。
AI.result: 样条在2–30分钟区间接近平坦，其他区域接近线性；因此从3分钟到30分钟的时间horizon跃升远比30分钟到5小时更容易，尽管倍率同为10倍。新点估计在交叉验证的proper scoring rules下表现更好，并提供评估构造效度的诊断图。
AI.conclusion: 建议时间horizon应结合诊断图一起解读，尤其在新基准提出或现有基准扩展到更长任务时。

title: RAGenome: Scaling Retrieval-Based Genomic Language Models to Long Contexts
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures and 4 tables, Accepted at ML4Molecules workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: The genome holds the blueprint that governs the biological properties of the cell. Consequently, advancing our knowledge of genomic function is crucial both for a broader understanding of biology and for continued biomedical advances. The success of large language models on natural language and protein sequences has motivated similar efforts on genomic data. However, standard genomic language models (gLMs) often require extremely large computational resources and still fall behind traditional methods on some downstream tasks. Recently, MSA-based pretraining has been proposed as an efficient alternative, but existing models are limited to short input contexts, restricting their use to short-range tasks, such as variant effect prediction. In this work, we present RAGenome, the first retrieval-based gLM that scales pretraining to longer contexts (100$\times$ longer than existing MSA-based gLMs), allowing it to capture both across-species evolutionary relationships and within-species longer-range interactions. Trained on whole-genome alignments from 100 vertebrates, RAGenome substantially improves the long-range capabilities of MSA-based gLMs, raising gene finding performance from 0.45 to 0.60, while remaining competitive on purely evolutionary-based tasks like prioritizing pathogenic variants. RAGenome provides competitive gLM performance at a fraction of the training cost, unifying evolutionary modeling and long-range capabilities within a single, flexible, scalable framework. Code is available at https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome.

AI.tldr: RAGenome是首个基于检索的基因组语言模型(gLM)，将预训练上下文扩展至比现有多序列比对(MSA)模型长100倍，统一了跨物种进化建模与长程交互能力。
AI.motivation: 基因组决定细胞生物学特性，理解其功能对生物学与生物医学至关重要。受自然语言与蛋白质序列上大语言模型成功的启发，研究者尝试构建基因组语言模型(gLM)。但标准gLM计算开销极大且在某些下游任务上仍落后于传统方法。基于MSA的预训练是高效替代方案，然而现有模型受限于短输入上下文，仅能处理变异效应预测等短程任务。
AI.method: 提出RAGenome，首个基于检索的gLM，将预训练扩展至更长上下文（比现有MSA-based gLM长100倍），从而同时捕捉跨物种进化关系与物种内长程交互。训练数据为100种脊椎动物的全基因组比对。
AI.result: RAGenome大幅提升MSA-based gLM的长程能力，基因查找性能从0.45提升至0.60，同时在纯进化任务（如致病性变异优先级排序）上保持竞争力。以远低于标准的训练成本获得有竞争力的gLM性能。
AI.conclusion: RAGenome在单一灵活、可扩展框架内统一了进化建模与长程能力，为基因组语言模型提供高效方案。代码已开源。

title: Perception Test 2026: Challenge Summary and Extension to City-scale Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: Continuing the Perception Test challenge series, we organised the fourth edition as a workshop at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026 in Malmö, Sweden. This edition focused on spatial intelligence and featured four different tracks: unified multiple-choice videoQA and grounded videoQA from the original Perception Test benchmark, alongside two new tracks based on city-scale walking-tour videos (KilometerAudio and KilometerVision). In this report, we describe the new benchmarks used for the city-scale tracks and summarise the winning solutions across all tracks, including a generalist model that competed across all tracks with satisfactory performance. The winning solutions in the newly added city-scale tracks demonstrated that complex spatial and multimodal reasoning can be solved by expensive agentic pipelines, but remains difficult for multimodal models used standalone.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了ECCV 2026上Perception Test挑战赛第四届研讨会，聚焦空间智能，包含四个赛道，并总结了各赛道获胜方案。
AI.motivation: 延续Perception Test挑战赛系列，探索空间智能与城市尺度视频中的多模态推理能力。
AI.method: 组织第四届挑战赛研讨会，设置四个赛道：原基准的unified multiple-choice videoQA和grounded videoQA，以及基于城市漫步视频的两个新赛道（KilometerAudio和KilometerVision）。
AI.result: 总结了所有赛道的获胜方案，其中一个通用模型在所有赛道参赛并取得不错表现；新城市尺度赛道的获胜方案表明复杂空间与多模态推理可通过昂贵智能体流水线解决。
AI.conclusion: 复杂空间与多模态推理借助智能体流水线可被解决，但对单独使用的多模态模型仍具挑战。

title: Discovering Global False Negatives On the Fly for Self-supervised Contrastive Learning
summary: In self-supervised contrastive learning, negative pairs are typically constructed using an anchor image and a sample drawn from the entire dataset, excluding the anchor. However, this approach can result in the creation of negative pairs with similar semantics, referred to as "false negatives", leading to their embeddings being falsely pushed apart. To address this issue, we introduce GloFND, an optimization-based approach that automatically learns on the fly the threshold for each anchor data to identify its false negatives during training. In contrast to previous methods for false negative discovery, our approach globally detects false negatives across the entire dataset rather than locally within the mini-batch. Moreover, its per-iteration computation cost remains independent of the dataset size. Experimental results on image and image-text data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/vibalcam/GloFND.

AI.tldr: GloFND提出一种基于优化的方法，在对比学习中动态为每个锚点学习阈值，从而在全局范围内识别假负样本，且每轮计算成本与数据集大小无关。
AI.motivation: 自监督对比学习通常用锚点与数据集中其他样本构建负样本对，可能产生语义相似的"假负样本"，导致本应相近的嵌入被错误地推开，损害表示学习效果。
AI.method: 提出GloFND：一种优化式方法，在训练过程中自动、在线地为每个锚点数据学习阈值以识别其假负样本；与以往仅在mini-batch内部局部发现假负样本的方法不同，该方法在整个数据集上全局检测假负样本，且每次迭代的计算开销与数据集规模无关。
AI.result: 在图像与图像-文本数据上的实验结果证明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GloFND能有效缓解假负样本问题，实现全局检测且计算成本可控，适用于图像及多模态对比学习任务。代码已开源。

title: In-Ride Alcohol-Impairment Detection in E-Scooterists with False-Alarm Control
summary: Shared e-scooter services have become a widely adopted urban transport mode. While most users ride responsibly, alcohol intoxication stands out among the factors contributing to severe crashes. Nonetheless, countermeasures remain limited to single-point reaction tests and night bans that suspend the service altogether. This paper proposes a new approach in which onboard sensors evaluate the rider as the trip unfolds, raising an alarm as soon as enough evidence of impairment has accumulated. Specifically, we introduce a detector that operates on inertial and throttle measurements, with a provable bound on the rate of false alarms. Experiments on sensor data from 141 rides, in which 25 participants rode while sober and at two target blood alcohol concentration levels, confirm that the bound holds, whereas baselines and ablations either exceed it or lose detection performance, and in some cases delay the alarm. At a bound of 0.023, the detector identifies 91% of the rides performed at the higher concentration and 50% of those at the lower one, with median detection times of 25 and 27 seconds, respectively. We further show that an embedded implementation meets the real-time requirement, making mitigation actions feasible onboard, without requiring data to leave the vehicle. Overall, this work lays the ground for interventions that reach impaired riders as soon as possible, sparing the sober ones the burden of a pre-ride test or the suspension of the service at night, while letting operators budget false alarms against user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于车载传感器的电动车骑行者酒驾检测方法，在骑行过程中利用惯性及油门数据持续评估清醒状态，并对误报率提供可证明的上界。
AI.motivation: 共享电动车已成主流出行方式，酒驾是导致严重事故的重要因素，但现有对策仅限于单点反应测试和夜间全面停服，缺乏有效且不牺牲用户体验的干预手段。
AI.method: 提出一个基于惯性测量和油门信号的检测器，可在骑行过程中累积证据并及时报警，且对误报率具有可证明的理论界；并在嵌入式平台上实现。
AI.result: 在141次骑行（25名参与者，清醒及两种目标血液酒精浓度）数据上验证：误报率界成立，基线方法与消融实验要么超出该界，要么损失检测性能甚至延迟报警。误报界0.023时，高浓度下检出率91%（中位检测时间25秒），低浓度下50%（27秒）；嵌入式实现满足实时要求。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了车内实时、无需上传数据的酒驾干预，可在无需骑行前测试或夜间停服的情况下尽早识别受损骑行者，同时让运营方在误报率与用户体验之间做出权衡。

title: DVLA-RL++: Dual-Level Vision-Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE TPAMI for possible publication
summary: Few-shot learning aims to recognize novel categories from limited labeled examples. Recent studies incorporate textual semantics to compensate for limited visual observations and improve class representations. However, high image-text agreement may reflect both intrinsic object properties and incidental context, making support prototypes susceptible to contextual contamination. To address this problem, we propose DVLA-RL++, which extends DVLA-RL with complementary semantic purification (CSP) and counterfactual reinforcement-learning gating (CRG). Specifically, CSP generates intrinsic and nuisance descriptions from labeled supports and compares their agreement with each support token. An ambiguity-dependent rejection margin guides sparse evidence allocation, while an intrinsic semantic anchor fills the unassigned mass to provide a fallback when visual evidence is unreliable. CRG learns layer-wise semantic fusion strengths using a reward that balances recognition performance and nuisance exposure. An independently executed reference trajectory on the same episode provides a paired learning signal. Theoretical analysis relates retained evidence and anchor quality to prototype stability and establishes conditions for unbiased on-policy gradient estimation. Experiments on standard, fine-grained, and cross-domain benchmarks show state-of-the-art accuracy, with an average gain of 1.4% over DVLA-RL. The project page is available at https://peacelwh.github.io/TPAMI27-DVLA-RLpp/.

AI.tldr: 提出DVLA-RL++，通过互补语义纯化和反事实强化学习门控解决小样本学习中的上下文污染问题。
AI.motivation: 小样本学习借助文本语义补偿视觉不足，但图像-文本高一致性可能同时反映内在属性与偶然上下文，导致支撑原型易受上下文污染。
AI.method: 在DVLA-RL基础上扩展两个模块：(1) 互补语义纯化（CSP），从标注支撑样本生成内在与干扰描述，与支撑token比较一致性，用歧义相关拒绝边界引导稀疏证据分配，并以内在语义锚填补未分配质量；(2) 反事实强化学习门控（CRG），以平衡识别性能与干扰暴露的奖励学习逐层语义融合强度，同episode独立参考轨迹提供配对信号。
AI.result: 在标准、细粒度及跨域基准上达到SOTA，平均较DVLA-RL提升1.4%；理论分析给出保留证据、锚质量与原型稳定性的关系及无偏on-policy梯度估计条件。
AI.conclusion: DVLA-RL++有效缓解小样本学习中的上下文污染，提升类表示鲁棒性并取得领先性能。

title: Compile the Table: Query-Calibrated Operator Compression for Tabular In-Context Learning
summary: Tabular in-context learning (ICL) has emerged as a training-free and accurate paradigm for tabular prediction, but current approaches to compressing its in-context examples face an accuracy-throughput tradeoff: fixed subsets can sacrifice accuracy, while query-specific retrieval limits cache reuse and batching across queries, reducing throughput. We propose QCOC (Query-Calibrated Operator Compression), which exploits the exchangeability and repeated use of in-context examples by compiling their full KV cache once into compact memory shared across subsequent queries. Instead of retaining raw examples, QCOC clusters their states into joint-KV prototypes, preserves per-cluster multiplicities and the original example count, and calibrates prototype values against attention query vectors produced by the in-context examples through an anchored closed-form solution. Prototype compression drives the speedup, while value fitting helps preserve accuracy. On 64 held-out OpenML-CC18 datasets, QCOC achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared compression and retrieval methods at both retained counts. Across 12 configurations on seven long tables, it ranks first among compressed methods in ten and averages 0.23 percentage points below full context. Compressing 8,192 in-context examples to 512 memory slots yields a 10.5x cache compression ratio; excluding one-time compilation, in a single-core CPU online-serving comparison over 1,000 queries, QCOC is up to 508x faster than dynamic retrieval baselines and 1.98x faster than full-context inference. These results show that QCOC enables compact-memory reuse and efficient inference across queries while retaining accuracy close to full context.

AI.tldr: QCOC 通过将表格 ICL 的上下文样本 KV 缓存一次性编译为可复用紧凑原型内存，兼顾准确率与吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有表格 ICL 的示例压缩存在准确率-吞吐权衡：固定子集损失准确率，查询特定检索限制缓存复用与批处理，降低吞吐。
AI.method: 利用上下文示例可交换与重复使用的特性，将完整 KV 缓存一次性编译为跨查询共享的紧凑内存：把状态聚类为联合 KV 原型，保留每簇重数及原示例数量，并用锚定闭式解对原型值进行查询校准拟合。
AI.result: 在 64 个 OpenML-CC18 数据集上平均准确率最高；7 个长表 12 种配置中 10 项居首，平均仅低全上下文 0.23 个百分点。8192→512 达 10.5x 压缩；单核 CPU 1000 查询下比动态检索快至 508x，比全上下文快 1.98x。
AI.conclusion: QCOC 实现紧凑内存复用与高效推理，同时保持接近全上下文的准确率。

title: PRAXIS: Learning Dynamics of Self-Improving Models with Symbolic Archives
summary: Self-improving learning systems adapt data selection, optimization, and auxiliary symbolic components, inducing nonstationary objectives outside standard learning assumptions. We introduce \textsc{PRAXIS}, a co-evolutionary framework that models generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes. We prove that KL-constrained generator updates and controlled archive-weight movement bound one-step objective drift, that archive updates suppress a program relative to any fixed comparator with a persistent cumulative utility advantage under sub-Gaussian noise, and that stochastic gradient descent achieves an average-stationarity guarantee whose degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift. Experiments across visual robustness, relational graph reasoning, and algorithmic graph reasoning exhibit generator stabilization, decreasing learner loss, and archive concentration consistent with these theoretical mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出PRAXIS共演化框架，将生成器、学习器与符号库建模为相互作用的动力系统，并从理论上刻画目标漂移、程序选择与SGD平稳性，实验验证理论机制。
AI.motivation: 自改进学习系统会动态调整数据选择、优化过程与符号组件，导致目标函数非平稳，超出标准学习假设，缺乏理论保证。
AI.method: 将生成器、学习器、符号库视为耦合动力过程；用KL约束的生成器更新与控制符号库权重移动，分析单步目标漂移；推导符号库更新在次高斯噪声下相对固定比较器的累积效用优势；分析SGD的平均平稳性受累积目标漂移影响。
AI.result: 理论上证明目标漂移有界、程序累积效用优势、SGD平均平稳性保证；实验在视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理、算法图推理上观察到生成器稳定、学习器损失下降、符号库集中。
AI.conclusion: PRAXIS为自改进学习提供共演化理论与漂移控制分析，理论与实验机制一致。

title: ContourVLA: A Closed-Loop Perception-Action Contour Policy for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) requires dynamically balancing high-level semantics for identifying a variable number of language-specified referents with fine-grained visual evidence for precise boundary delineation. This requirement challenges existing cascaded vision-language architectures, which typically rely on static feature interfaces and single-pass mask prediction, limiting adaptive perception and geometric correction. We introduce ContourVLA, a vision-language-action policy that recasts GRES as a closed-loop visuomotor process, in which editable contours serve as explicit policy states that condition multimodal perception and are updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) couples contour-guided bidirectional boundary sampling with state-conditioned routing of multilevel multimodal features, adapting perception to each contour state. Following supervised initialization, Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) jointly optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour actions with instance-level credits. Its rollout rewards and credits are derived from soft prediction-target correspondences that account for false positives and missed targets. ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 8.7, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively, and achieves the highest mIoU across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits.

AI.tldr: ContourVLA将广义指代分割(GRES)重构为闭环视觉运动过程，用可编辑轮廓作为策略状态，配合EASS感知调度与DECT-GRPO联合优化，在gRefCOCO等基准上大幅提升性能。
AI.motivation: GRES需要动态平衡高层语义（识别数量不定的指代对象）与细粒度视觉证据（精确边界划分）。现有级联视觉-语言架构依赖静态特征接口和单次掩码预测，限制了自适应感知和几何校正能力。
AI.method: 提出ContourVLA——一种视觉-语言-动作策略，用可编辑轮廓作为显式策略状态，通过几何动作块迭代更新。Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) 结合轮廓引导的双向边界采样与状态条件化路由多级多模态特征，使感知自适应于轮廓状态。在监督初始化后，DECT-GRPO联合优化离散定位与连续轮廓动作，利用实例级信用，其rollout奖励和信用源于考虑假阳性与漏检的软预测-目标对应关系。
AI.result: 在gRefCOCO val、testA、testB上，gIoU分别超过最强基线8.7、2.8、2.7个百分点；在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg全部八个split上取得最高mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 将GRES建模为闭环视觉运动过程、以轮廓为策略状态并结合感知调度与强化学习优化，能有效提升指代分割的精度与自适应性。

title: Self-Supervised Speech Representations for Cross-Speaker Dysarthria Detection During Awake Craniotomy
summary: Detecting intra-operative speech impairment during awake craniotomy is essential for preserving language function. However, automated detection remains challenging because operating-room recordings contain substantial acoustic interference, clinically relevant speech events are rare, and available cohorts are small and heterogeneous across speakers. This study presents a systematic component-wise evaluation of a pipeline for distinguishing dysarthric from no-trouble speech in the DATABRASE corpus of awake-craniotomy recordings. The pipeline incorporates speaker diarization to isolate patient speech, a multi-view representation combining handcrafted acoustic descriptors with multilayer wav2vec 2.0 embeddings, speaker-conditional normalization and transferability-based feature selection to improve cross-speaker robustness, and a cascaded classifier comprising a gradient-boosted first stage and a neural second stage. Evaluation was conducted under strict speaker-independent conditions using leave-one-speaker-out cross-validation. The results show that cross-speaker performance is influenced more strongly by the speech representation than by classifier choice. The AUCs of three classifiers differed by no more than 4.7%, whereas replacing conventional acoustic descriptors with the multilayer self-supervised representation produced AUC improvements of 18.2%-26.1%. Diarization-conditioned feature extraction and the proposed classifier cascade provided additional consistent gains. These findings indicate that reliable patient-specific speech isolation and strong pretrained representations are more important than increased classifier complexity in low-resource intra-operative settings. They also quantify the potential performance gains that may be achieved through patient-specific preoperative calibration.

AI.tldr: 本研究对清醒开颅术中构音障碍语音自动检测流程进行组件级系统评估，发现跨说话人性能主要由语音表征决定，而非分类器复杂度。
AI.motivation: 清醒开颅术中需检测语言功能损伤，但手术室录音干扰大、相关语音事件稀少、队列小且异质，自动检测困难。
AI.method: 在DATABRASE语料上构建流程：说话人日志分离患者语音、手crafted声学特征与多层wav2vec 2.0嵌入的多视角表征、说话人条件归一化与基于可迁移性的特征选择、由梯度提升首阶段与神经第二阶段组成的级联分类器；采用严格的留一说话人交叉验证。
AI.result: 跨说话人性能受表征影响大于分类器：三种分类器AUC差异不超过4.7%，而用多层自监督表征替换传统声学特征使AUC提升18.2%–26.1%；日志条件特征提取与级联分类器带来额外稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源术中场景中，可靠的患者特定语音分离与强预训练表征比增加分类器复杂度更重要；并量化了患者特定术前校准可能带来的性能提升。

title: Recovery Guarantees for Posterior Sampling of One-Bit Compressed Sensing
summary: We study the sample complexity of noisy one-bit compressed sensing for signals drawn from a prior distribution. By characterizing the effective distributional complexity of the prior via its approximate covering number, we prove that posterior sampling achieves accurate recovery with high probability when the number of measurements scales with the logarithm of the approximate covering number, up to a one-bit separation gap factor. This upper bound is robust to learned prior mismatch. Specifically, we show that posterior sampling with an approximate prior remains reliable, provided that the learned prior distribution is sufficiently close to the true signal distribution in Wasserstein distance. In addition, we establish a sample complexity lower bound for any reliable method of noisy one-bit compressed sensing, showing that our upper bound is nearly matched in its main prior dependent term. To approximate the ideal posterior sampling process for real world scenarios, we instantiate posterior sampling through a plug-and-play algorithm with diffusion priors. Experiments on the FFHQ and ImageNet datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 研究基于先验分布的噪声单比特压缩感知样本复杂度，证明后验采样在测量数随近似覆盖数对数增长时恢复准确，下界几乎匹配，并用扩散先验的即插即用算法在FFHQ/ImageNet验证。
AI.motivation: 刻画先验分布对噪声单比特压缩感知样本复杂度的影响，并解决实际中学习先验与真实信号分布存在偏差的问题。
AI.method: 以先验的近似覆盖数刻画有效分布复杂度；采用后验采样实现恢复，并分析先验失配的鲁棒性（Wasserstein距离）；通过扩散先验的plug-and-play算法近似理想后验采样。
AI.result: 当测量数按近似覆盖数的对数（至多一个单比特分离间隙因子）增长时，后验采样高概率精确恢复；近似先验与真实分布Wasserstein距离足够近时仍可靠；给出任意可靠方法的下界，与上界主先验项几乎匹配；FFHQ和ImageNet实验有效。
AI.conclusion: 后验采样在噪声单比特压缩感知中样本复杂度近乎最优，且对先验失配鲁棒，扩散先验的实际算法验证了理论的有效性。

title: Healthy Counterfactual Generation via Diffusion Inpainting for Mammography Classification
summary: False negatives remain a critical limitation of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer screening due to delayed detection and treatment. To address this issue, we propose a counterfactual data augmentation strategy that generates healthy mammograms by "erasing" lesions from anomalous images, thereby enriching the training distribution. We train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model on BI-RADS 1 (healthy) mammograms and use a RePaint-based sampling strategy to inpaint realistic normal tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes. The resulting healthy counterfactuals replace annotated lesion regions with realistic healthy tissue while preserving patient-specific anatomical structure, as supported by similarity metrics between real and generated images. Image realism was further assessed by radiologists and found to be consistent with the original dataset quality. We evaluate counterfactual augmentation across four representative classifier architectures: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt), a vision transformer (ViT), a vision-language model pre-trained on mammogram-report pairs (Mammo-CLIP) and a multi-scale attention-based multiple-instance learning framework (FPN-MIL). Experiments conducted on the VinDr-Mammo dataset show improvements in sensitivity across all architectures, particularly at 80\% fixed specificity, contributing towards more reliable CAD systems for breast cancer. Code is available at: https://github.com/ines03garcia/diffusion-based-counterfactual-generation.

AI.tldr: 基于扩散模型的"反事实"数据增强，通过擦除病灶生成健康乳腺X光图像，提升多种分类器灵敏度，降低假阴性。
AI.motivation: CAD乳腺筛查系统存在关键缺陷：假阴性导致漏诊，延误检测与治疗。需通过丰富训练分布改善这一问题。
AI.method: 在BI-RADS 1健康乳腺X光上训练去噪扩散概率模型(DDPM)，采用RePaint采样在标注病灶框内修复生成逼真正常组织，生成保留患者解剖结构的健康反事实图像。在四类分类器上评估：ConvNeXt、ViT、Mammo-CLIP、FPN-MIL。
AI.result: 生成图像在相似度指标及放射科医生评估下与原始数据集质量一致。在VinDr-Mammo数据集上，所有架构灵敏度均有提升，尤其在80%固定特异度下表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 反事实数据增强可提升多种CAD架构的检测灵敏度，助力构建更可靠的乳腺癌筛查系统。

title: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search
summary: Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.

AI.tldr: LLM-BlockFE 提出一种 LLM 引导的离线特征构建框架，将长文本转化为可执行特征程序，避免在线推理时调用 LLM，并提升下游风控预测性能。
AI.motivation: 工业风控系统依赖结构化数据模型，但大量有价值信息埋藏在非结构化长文本中。人工特征工程成本高，而在线实时调用 LLM 处理每条输入难以满足实际部署要求。
AI.method: 通过增量追加不可变代码块来构建特征程序，并用下游模型评估候选特征；引入基于深度校准信用分配的块级回滚机制，交错推进多条独立搜索轨迹，并共享各轨迹探索方向的固定描述以减少冗余探索；搜索完成后冻结程序，离线提取结构化特征供下游预测模型使用。
AI.result: 在两个公开和两个私有数据集上，相比最强基线，全数据集对比中 AUC 绝对提升 0.0069 至 0.0358；在五个已部署金融风控应用中，上线后监控显示 KS 相比原有人工设计策略绝对提升 0.02 至 1.56 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LLM-BlockFE 能有效利用长文本信息并避免在线 LLM 调用，在公开与私有数据集及真实金融风控部署中均验证了其优越性与实用性。

title: DADP: Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning, A Reverse Hebbian-Inspired Structural Pruning Method
summary: Modern neural networks are heavily over-parameterized. This redundancy incurs substantial compute and memory overhead during training and inference. Existing pruning methods rely on post-hoc magnitude thresholds or static initialization heuristics. Consequently, they often require manual per-layer sparsity targets or expensive retraining cycles. We propose Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning (DADP), a biologically inspired structural plasticity mechanism. During training, DADP measures connection importance via the accumulated product of pre-synaptic activations and post-synaptic error gradients. Using a single global threshold instead of fixed layer budgets, DADP dynamically allocates sparsity across network depth while naturally inducing neuron- and channel-level pruning. Across MLP, VGG-16, ResNet-18, BiLSTM-CRF, and MiniBERT architectures, DADP matches or outperforms Magnitude, SNIP and RigL, retaining 73.67% accuracy (dense baseline: 76.06%) at 99% sparsity on ResNet-18. Finally, matrix-based Shannon entropy and effective rank measurements confirm that DADP preserves latent feature diversity at extreme sparsities without representation collapse.

AI.tldr: 提出动态活动依赖剪枝DADP，用全局阈值替代逐层稀疏预算，在多种架构上匹配或超越Magnitude、SNIP、RigL。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络严重过参数化，带来训练和推理的计算与内存开销；现有剪枝方法依赖事后幅度阈值或静态初始化启发式，常需人工设定逐层稀疏目标或昂贵的重训练。
AI.method: 受生物结构可塑性启发，DADP在训练中通过突触前激活与突触后误差梯度的累积乘积衡量连接重要性；使用单一全局阈值而非固定逐层预算，动态跨网络深度分配稀疏度，并自然产生神经元级和通道级剪枝。
AI.result: 在MLP、VGG-16、ResNet-18、BiLSTM-CRF和MiniBERT上，DADP匹配或优于Magnitude、SNIP和RigL；ResNet-18在99%稀疏度下保持73.67%准确率（稠密基线76.06%）。基于矩阵的香农熵和有效秩测量确认其在极端稀疏下保持潜在特征多样性，无表示坍塌。
AI.conclusion: DADP提供了一种无需逐层手动调参、动态分配稀疏度的生物启发剪枝机制，能在极端稀疏下维持性能与表示多样性。

title: Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression
summary: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure.

AI.tldr: 提出 Connected Self Forcing，通过重连自回归视频生成各 chunk 间的梯度路径实现跨块反馈，并用 shortcut gradient replay 高效恢复跨块梯度，在推理流程不变的情况下提升长视频的视觉质量与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: Self Forcing 通过自生成历史的 self-rollout 与 KV 缓存缓解 exposure bias，但为控制显存而 detach 历史缓存，导致前向依赖保留、反向梯度路径被切断，早期上下文无法被后续预测反馈优化。
AI.method: 1) 重连自回归 chunk 间梯度路径，梯度不仅经过历史 KV 写入，还穿过生成 latent 流回产生它们的计算，使早期上下文生成与其后续使用相链接；2) 提出 shortcut gradient replay，在不保留完整 rollout 计算图的情况下恢复跨块梯度，降低显存；3) 与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）结合，按直接监督与对后续生成的贡献共同训练历史 chunk。
AI.result: 在自回归视频生成实验中，长时程视觉质量与时间一致性均有提升，且无需改变推理流程。
AI.conclusion: Connected Self Forcing 通过可高效优化的跨块梯度连接，改善了长视频自回归生成的质量与一致性，且保持推理开销不变，具有实用价值。

title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出SpaceCast-Bench，首个诊断式评估预测性空间推理的基准，揭示当前模型与人类差距显著。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准主要测试空间感知（读取输入中已可见的关系），而真实世界空间智能需要预测性推理：从观测构建场景、预测干预带来的变化并推理未见的结局。
AI.method: 构建observe-transform-infer框架的SpaceCast-Bench，含182个真实场景的3862个问题，覆盖16种任务类型和三个层级（静态感知、局部预测、全局预测）；评估21个模型并做受控分析。
AI.result: 最强模型仅58.0%，远低于人类87.2%，空间专用模型接近随机；bridge views对整合分布式观测关键，显式3D证据比生成图像/视频更可靠；微调使Qwen3-VL-4B从34.0%提升至65.7%。
AI.conclusion: 预测性空间推理是当前模型的重大短板，该基准及生成数据可有效诊断并提升相关能力。

title: AI-Based On-Board Maritime Object Detection for Earth Observation Payload Data Reduction on Versal Embedded Hardware
comment: 8 pages. Accepted at the 10th On-Board Payload Data Compression Workshop (OBPDC 2026), Barcelona, Spain, 12-14 October 2026
summary: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究星上舰船检测，用于按内容选择下传数据，以减少海量遥感数据的下传量。作者构建数据集、训练YOLOX-S检测器、在Versal VC1902的DPU上量化部署，并提出多种下传模式，在保持大部分舰船的同时大幅降低数据体积。
AI.motivation: 甚高分辨率对地观测卫星采集的数据超过其存储与下传能力，而海事监视中舰船仅占每景很小比例。传统逐像素压缩未利用内容信息，因此需要一种按内容选择下传（仅传含舰船信息）的星上舰船检测方案，作为常规星上压缩的补充。
AI.method: 工作分三方面：(i) 数据与算法：基于68幅带标注的Maxar场景、43类舰船生成受控数据集，训练YOLOX-S检测器；(ii) 嵌入式部署：将检测器量化并部署到Versal VC1902的DPU上；(iii) 数据缩减：提出多种下传模式，从仅元数据（框、类别、分数）到舰船周围裁剪、含检测的瓦片、或带降质背景的整景，并依据实测检测误差估计各模式在保留舰船与下传体积间的权衡。
AI.result: 量化部署仅有有限检测质量损失，每景处理时间数秒。在密集港口与海岸场景上，瓦片模式保留98%舰船而下传体积仅为整景的29%；裁剪模式保留83%舰船而体积仅3%。
AI.conclusion: 星上舰船检测可有效按内容缩减下传数据，瓦片与裁剪等下传模式能在保留绝大多数舰船的同时显著降低下传体积，且可高效部署于嵌入式DPU。

title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
summary: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.

AI.tldr: ViSkill：视觉原生技能学习框架，将成功交互编码为可视化技能卡片供VLM智能体直接使用。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强智能体多依赖文本，将空间布局和动作-状态对应线性化为语言，丢失关键几何结构；已有视觉方法又将技能构建与策略优化分离，未充分挖掘二者相互促进。
AI.method: 将成功交互编码为组合式视觉技能卡片，直接供VLM智能体调用。检索到的技能同时引导推理和奖励塑形，成功轨迹再蒸馏回技能库，形成技能积累与策略改进相互强化的闭环反馈；另设可选冷启动机制加速早期学习。
