AI.conclusion: 该算法改进了现有界限，实现了对d和ρ的最优遗憾依赖。

title: Scalable Hierarchical Graph Generation via Soft Community Structure
summary: Generating large attributed graphs requires reproducing the topology, generating attributes jointly with the structure, and remaining scalable. Many real-world graphs exist as a single large graph, so a generative model has to generalize from the one graph it is fit on, without independent samples. We present Schema, which recursively decomposes a reference graph into a hierarchy of soft communities, assigning each node a membership distribution. Generation is then split into three stages, each trained independently: (1) synthesizing node attributes conditioned on soft memberships, (2) generating intra-community edges from local structural context, and (3) modeling inter-community connections over bridge nodes whose membership mass is distributed across several communities. No stage forms the full adjacency matrix, and each stage operates on a subgraph bounded by the community size. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that covers structural fidelity, memorization, downstream utility, and scalability. On four real-world attributed graphs, Schema recovers the balance between local and long-range structure more closely than any other model that generates attributes, while reproducing only a small fraction of the reference edges. It retains the downstream accuracy of the reference graph without raising it artificially above that level. Baselines that match its structural fidelity memorize the reference, while those with higher downstream accuracy either exceed the reference accuracy or fail to complete on the larger graphs. We measure scalability on six additional graphs with up to 10 million nodes.

AI.tldr: Schema 通过递归分解参考图得到软社区层次结构，分三阶段独立生成节点属性、社区内边和社区间边，实现可扩展的属性图生成，在多个真实图上兼具结构保真与低记忆化。
AI.motivation: 真实世界属性图常以单一大型图存在，生成模型需从单一图泛化而无独立样本；同时要兼顾拓扑、属性联合生成与可扩展性，现有方法难以平衡结构保真、记忆化与下游效用。
AI.method: 递归将参考图分解为软社区层次，为每个节点分配隶属度分布；生成分三阶段独立训练：(1) 以软隶属度为条件合成节点属性，(2) 基于局部结构上下文生成社区内边，(3) 在隶属度分散于多社区的桥节点上建模社区间连接。各阶段不构建完整邻接矩阵，仅作用于受社区规模限制的子图。
AI.result: 在四个真实属性图上，Schema 比任何生成属性的模型更接近局部与远程结构的平衡，同时仅复现少量参考边；保留下游精度且不人为抬高于参考图水平。结构保真相当的基线会记忆参考图，下游精度更高的基线要么超过参考精度要么在大图上无法完成。另在六个最多 1000 万节点的图上测量可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: Schema 在结构保真、抗记忆化、下游效用与可扩展性之间取得良好平衡，适用于大规模单图属性图生成，并提供涵盖四方面的评估协议。

title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
summary: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment. Most existing approaches coordinate multiple players through joint multi-view generation, whose cost grows with each additional player. We present WorldCast, a distributed multiplayer world model in which each player runs a local client comprising a video generator and a state model. Using recorded player positions and map geometry during training, the state model estimates the player's position from generated video and control inputs. Clients exchange player states and project them into camera-aligned player state fields that guide where and how other players are rendered. Shared scene state enables clients to reuse one another's generated observations to maintain consistent scene appearance across views. Experiments on Counter-Strike 2 demonstrate WorldCast's consistency, real-time performance, and distributed scalability. The camera-aligned player state field improves player rendering rates by over an order of magnitude over joint-generation methods, while shared scene state improves visual consistency over whole rounds. Each client runs in real time and exchanges only player and scene states, enabling scalable multiplayer generation without a centralized computational bottleneck. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.

AI.tldr: WorldCast 是一个分布式多人世界模型,每个玩家运行本地客户端,通过交换玩家状态与场景状态实现一致、实时的多视角视频生成,避免集中式瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有多人世界模型多采用联合多视角生成来协调玩家,计算代价随玩家数量增加而增长,难以扩展。作者希望实现可扩展、分布式且保持多视角一致性的多人世界模型。
AI.method: 每个玩家运行一个本地客户端,包含视频生成器和状态模型。训练时利用记录的玩家位置与地图几何,状态模型从生成视频和控制输入中估计玩家位置。客户端之间交换玩家状态,并将其投影为相机对齐的玩家状态场,用于指导其他玩家的渲染位置与方式。共享场景状态使客户端能复用彼此生成的观测,以保持跨视角的场景外观一致性。
AI.result: 在 Counter-Strike 2 上验证了 WorldCast 的一致性、实时性和分布式可扩展性。相机对齐的玩家状态场将玩家渲染率比联合生成方法提升一个数量级以上;共享场景状态在整个回合中提升视觉一致性。每个客户端实时运行,仅交换玩家与场景状态。图像质量在长达一小时的 rollout 中保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: WorldCast 通过分布式客户端协作与状态交换,实现了无集中式计算瓶颈的可扩展多人世界生成,在一致性和实时性上均表现良好,并支持长时间稳定生成。

title: Is Real-World Training Data Necessary for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection?
summary: Generalist graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to build a foundation model that detects anomalies on arbitrary unseen graphs without retraining or fine-tuning. Sufficient data are essential for foundation model training, yet generalist GAD still faces a data shortage, as real-world anomalous graphs are scarce and costly to collect and annotate. To fill this gap, we propose AG-FORGE, an Anomalous Graph generation Forge for automatic synthesis of anomalous graphs, exploring the feasibility of synthetic data-driven training for generalist GAD. Empirically, we find that synthetic data can achieve performance comparable to real-world training, but fail to push the performance boundary further due to the limited capacity of existing methods. To further unlock model capacity as training data scale up, we develop TS-GGAD, a Topology-Semantic coordinated Generalist GAD that captures complementary topological and semantic anomaly evidence, together with a curriculum learning strategy tailored to large-scale synthetic training. Extensive experiments on 14 real-world datasets demonstrate that TS-GGAD, trained on data generated by AG-FORGE, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AG-FORGE自动合成异常图以解决通用图异常检测(GAD)训练数据稀缺问题，并设计TS-GGAD(拓扑-语义协同通用GAD)配合课程学习策略，在14个真实数据集上显著超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 通用GAD需训练基础模型在任意未见图上检测异常，但真实异常图稀缺且采集标注成本高，导致训练数据不足，因此需要合成数据来填补缺口。
AI.method: 提出AG-FORGE自动合成异常图生成框架；发现合成数据可达真实数据性能但受限于现有方法容量，进而提出TS-GGAD，协同捕捉互补的拓扑与语义异常证据，并采用面向大规模合成训练的课程学习策略。
AI.result: 在14个真实数据集上，基于AG-FORGE生成数据训练的TS-GGAD显著优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据驱动训练对通用图异常检测可行有效，结合能充分利用大规模数据容量的模型与训练策略可进一步提升性能。

title: MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances
summary: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. This factorization allows scene understanding and interaction dynamics to be learned from complementary sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that MAMHOI reduces object--scene penetration while better preserving human--object interaction quality, yielding more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions. Project page: https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/

AI.tldr: MAMHOI提出一种以affordance为中介的因子分解框架，用于复杂3D场景中的人-物交互（HOI）生成，无需配对的人-物-场景数据。
AI.motivation: 真实感HOI生成需同时具备环境交互可行性推理与人-物动作合成能力，但二者难以在规模化数据上联合监督：人-场景数据集提供环境感知动作，人-物数据集提供交互动态，配对的“人-物-场景”数据稀缺。
AI.method: MAMHOI通过显式的motion-affordance接口将场景理解与动作合成分解：先用场景条件模型预测交互可行执行的位置与方式，再由affordance条件的HOI模型生成相应的人-物动作。该分解使场景理解与交互动态可分别从互补监督源学习。
AI.result: 在复杂室内环境中，MAMHOI减少了物体-场景穿透，同时更好地保持人-物交互质量，生成更真实、物理可行的场景感知交互。
AI.conclusion: MAMHOI证明通过affordance中介的因子分解，可在缺乏配对数据的情况下实现高质量场景感知HOI生成。

title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
summary: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

AI.tldr: JWS：一种单阶段端到端扩散模型，直接在雷达空间进行概率降水临近预报，结合掩码异步扩散与时步采样，实现少步生成，在SEVIR/MeteoNet达SOTA且推理快17倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式扩散方法多依赖分离的压缩或确定性预报组件，且迭代去噪导致推理开销大；同时有损压缩带来额外不确定性。
AI.method: 提出Just Weather Scoring (JWS)：单阶段端到端扩散，直接在雷达空间建模；采用Masked Asynchronous Diffusion时步采样方案，保留干净上下文并适配高维时空数据；结合简单scoring-rule目标，对齐概率预报训练并支持少步生成。
AI.result: 在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上达到概率预报SOTA，训练与推理成本更低；最小模型以更少参数仍具竞争力，推理速度提升17倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 直接在雷达空间建模并采用少步扩散，可简化训练推理、消除压缩不确定性，同时兼顾性能与效率，为概率临近预报提供高效方案。

title: OneSearch-VL: Unified Multimodal Deep Research Agent for Image and Video
summary: Single-image, multi-image, and video deep research require different visual operations but share a workflow of visual grounding, external retrieval, and fact composition. A key challenge is to preserve the dependencies linking localized visual anchors, entity relations, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations. We introduce OneSearch-VL, a unified agent centered on the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG), which encodes these dependencies as a shared task-level reference for data construction, process supervision, and operation-level evaluation. Our VGEG-based data engine constructs and verifies multi-image and video questions and filters expert trajectories. Using these data, we assemble OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL, respectively. We further derive the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) from VGEG annotations to supervise evidence traceability and visual grounding during RL. For fine-grained evaluation, we construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, organizing questions by the research operations encoded in their VGEGs. Experiments show that OneSearch-VL-8B improves over Qwen3-VL-8B with tool access by 20.2 and 17.6 percentage points on the two new benchmarks, respectively, while also achieving substantial gains across 7 image benchmarks and VideoDR. Project repository: https://github.com/appletea233/OneSearch-VL

AI.tldr: OneSearch-VL 提出以视觉定位证据图（VGEG）为核心的统一智能体，覆盖图像/多图/视频深度研究，通过 VGEG 数据引擎构建 SFT 与 RL 数据，并在多基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 单图、多图、视频深度研究需要不同视觉操作但共享"视觉定位—外部检索—事实组合"流程，关键挑战在于保留视觉锚点、实体关系、来源支持事实与答案生成操作之间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 引入以 Visually Grounded Evidence Graph（VGEG）为核心的任务级统一表示，编码上述依赖；基于 VGEG 构建数据引擎以生成并验证多图/视频问题、过滤专家轨迹；构建 OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K 和 RL-10K 数据集；从 VGEG 标注导出证据感知视觉定位评分奖励（EVGR）用于 RL；并构建细粒度评测基准 OneSearch-MI-Bench 和 OneSearch-Video-Bench。
AI.result: OneSearch-VL-8B 相比可访问工具的 Qwen3-VL-8B，在两个新基准上分别提升 20.2 和 17.6 个百分点，同时在 7 个图像基准和 VideoDR 上也有大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 以 VGEG 为中心的统一定位、数据构建、过程监督与操作级评测框架有效提升多模态深度研究的证据可追溯性与视觉定位能力。

title: DataSense-Bench: The First Step Toward an AI Scientist
summary: As claims about recursive self-improvement (RSI) and artificial general intelligence (AGI) proliferate, we ask a simple question: do frontier AI models have a sense of data, i.e., can they reliably select the right data for training? We introduce DataSense-Bench to study this capability through the fundamental problem of data selection and performance forecasting in machine learning. We ask AI agents to select and rank candidate training subsets that can be used to fine-tune a small LLM model. Agents are allowed to inspect the data, write and execute analysis code, and run model forward passes, but can not train the model or access the actual evaluation tasks. We then fine-tune the base model on each selected subset and evaluate its post-training performance under a standardized protocol. We instantiate the benchmark in terminal problem solving and tool use, selecting trajectories from OpenThoughts-Agent and EnvScaler and evaluating on TBLite and BFCL, respectively. We then evaluate the agents along two complementary dimensions: the post-training performance of the top-ranked subset, reflecting the ability to identify high-value training data, and ranking accuracy, reflecting the ability to predict the relative performance of the selected subsets. In our experiments, selection gains over random selection are limited; agents do not reliably rank their selected groups, and ranking ability does not hold consistently across tasks: Astra identifies the best group in all three tool-use runs but in only one of three terminal runs. Analysis of execution traces on both tasks shows that agents often use similar data signals while interpreting their training value differently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DataSense-Bench，评估前沿AI模型是否具备"数据感"——能否可靠地为训练选择正确数据。通过数据选择与性能预测任务，让AI智能体从候选训练子集中挑选并排序，经微调与标准化评测发现选择增益有限、排序不可靠。
AI.motivation: 随着递归自我改进（RSI）和通用人工智能（AGI）相关主张增多，需要验证前沿AI模型是否具备可靠选择训练数据的能力。作者以一个基础问题切入：AI模型是否有"数据感"。
AI.method: 构建 DataSense-Bench 基准。让AI智能体从候选训练子集中选择并排序可用于微调小LLM的子集；智能体可检查数据、编写并执行分析代码、运行前向传播，但不能训练模型或访问真实评测任务。随后在选中的子集上微调基座模型，并按标准化协议评估。任务实例涵盖终端问题求解与工具使用，数据来自 OpenThoughts-Agent 与 EnvScaler，分别在 TBLite 和 BFCL 上评测。从两个维度评估：top-ranked子集的微调后性能（识别高价值数据的能力）与排序准确率（预测相对性能的能力）。
AI.result: 相比随机选择，选择增益有限；智能体无法可靠地对所选子集进行排序，排序能力在不同任务间不一致：Astra 在三次工具使用运行中均找到最佳子集，但在三次终端运行中仅一次找到。执行轨迹分析显示，智能体在两项任务中常使用相似的数据信号，但对其训练价值的解读不同。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型缺乏可靠的"数据感"，难以稳定选择与排序高价值训练数据。该基准揭示了当前AI在数据选择这一关键能力上的不足，对RSI与AGI的乐观主张构成制约。

title: Beyond Spatio-Temporal Priors: A Generalizable Approach for Dense Correspondence Matching
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 7 figures, including appendices
summary: Dense correspondence matching has historically been bounded by simplifying spatio-temporal priors, such as smooth motion and rigid geometry. While effective for classical tasks, these assumptions break down in image editing and reference-guided generation (IEG), where transformations can preserve visual identity while breaking physical continuity. To establish identity-preserving correspondence across such transformations, we introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework combining generative and semantic foundation representations with heterogeneous supervision from classical datasets, tracked videos, and synthetic scenes. Teacher-guided iterative refinement further improves correspondence in IEG without dense correspondence annotations. Experimentally, a single FreeMatching model substantially improves correspondence quality on challenging IEG image pairs while retaining competitive performance on classical benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate its utility as a quantitative metric for evaluating identity preservation, with scores that correlate with human judgment. The code is available at https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching.

AI.tldr: FreeMatching是一个通用密集对应匹配框架，利用生成与语义基础表征及异构监督，在图像编辑与参考引导生成(IEG)任务中实现保身份对应，同时保持经典基准性能，并可作身份保持的量化指标。
AI.motivation: 传统密集对应匹配依赖平滑运动、刚性几何等时空先验，这些假设在图像编辑与参考引导生成(IEG)中失效——因为变换可能保持视觉身份却打破物理连续性，因此需要建立跨此类变换的身份保持对应。
AI.method: 提出FreeMatching框架：融合生成式与语义基础表征；采用来自经典数据集、跟踪视频和合成场景的异构监督；并使用教师引导的迭代精炼，在无密集对应标注的情况下提升IEG上的对应效果。
AI.result: 单一FreeMatching模型显著提升挑战性IEG图像对上的对应质量，同时在经典基准上保持有竞争力的性能；作为身份保持的量化指标，其分数与人类判断相关。
AI.conclusion: FreeMatching突破了传统时空先验限制，为IEG中的身份保持对应提供了通用解决方案，并可作为评估身份保持的量化指标，代码已开源。

title: Verification with Transfer: Exact Information Frontiers and Their Price in Calls
comment: 46 pages, of which 8 pages main text. The Lean 4 formalization is in the ancillary files
summary: A verifier that accepts or rejects whole answers reveals little: under a flat prior over $k$-bit answers, zero error needs $2^k-1$ verifications. The usual remedy is to solve related source tasks, either all first, as a curriculum does, or interleaved with verification. We price this remedy in information and in calls. With an exact verifier, the least causal information that any interleaving of source calls and $n$ verifications needs to succeed with probability $s$ is a list rate-distortion function, attained by one observation before any verification. It lower-bounds the expected number of binary source calls, which designed sources meet within $1+\log_25$ calls for unique answers and within a logarithmic term in general, where no additive constant suffices. With an exact verifier and fixed sources, moving every call before the first verification preserves all hard caps on calls, although interleaving can save unboundedly many expected calls; under a noisy verifier, source-first protocols can lose unbounded factors in information and in error. For linear banks over $\mathbb{F}_2$, optimal accuracy has a closed form, and after a polynomial-time reduction the budget profile is computable in time $2^{O(h^2)}\operatorname{poly}(J,k+h)$ for $J$ sources and nuisance dimension $h$. In these banks, for zero error under a hard cap, the calls beyond the rounded-up information price are exactly those spent on nuisance. Every numbered result apart from two clauses about the planner is machine-checked in Lean 4, assuming two published results. Used as a ruler, the frontier shows a small transformer using all delivered bits at latent dimension $5$ and none at $11$ within fixed training budgets; in a test with predictions recorded before training, low XOR degree of the target bits did not suffice for their use.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究验证（verifier）在信息与调用次数上的代价，提出一个列表率失真函数作为因果信息下界，分析源任务调用与验证的交错/前置策略，并对F2线性库给出闭式最优精度与可计算预算剖面；结论经Lean 4机器验证，并用作衡量transformer利用比特能力的标尺。
AI.motivation: 整答案验证信息量少：平坦先验下零错误需2^k−1次验证，故常借助相关源任务。作者希望定量刻画这种补救在信息与调用上的代价，并厘清交错验证与源调用顺序的影响。
AI.method: 以信息论/率失真视角建模：定义列表率失真函数作为最小因果信息下界；比较"源优先"与"交错"协议；分析精确与噪声验证器；对F2线性库推导闭式最优精度与多项式归约下的预算剖面算法。
AI.result: 最小因果信息为列表率失真函数，由验证前一次观测达成；给出期望二进制源调用下界，设计源在唯一答案时逼近至1+log_25次内；源优先保留硬上限但交错可省无界期望调用；噪声验证下源优先可损失无界信息/误差因子；F2线性库有闭式精度，预算剖面可在2^{O(h^2)}poly(J,k+h)内计算，零错误的超出调用恰用于nuisance。
AI.conclusion: 除两条关于planner的陈述外，全部编号结果在Lean 4中机器验证（依赖两个已发表结果）。该前沿可用作标尺：小transformer在潜在维度5时用尽全部比特、维度11时完全不用；低XOR度不足以保证目标比特被利用。

title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
summary: We present Pumpire, a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors. In contrast to previous approaches that normally evaluate depth and camera intrinsics separately or evaluate point-clouds with geometric similarity metrics, which cannot directly reflect models' point-to-point distance estimation capability, Pumpire directly assesses point-to-point distances from the reconstructed geometry. To this end, we collect a large-scale and diverse dataset (pumpire-6k) comprising 100 real-world scenes, each annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and containing 64 frames, for a total of 6,400 frames. Building on this dataset, we establish a holistic evaluation protocol that covers both image- and video-level 3D foundation models and enables direct assessment of point-pair distance errors and cross-setting comparison. We conduct extensive experiments across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and provide a comprehensive analysis of the results. By offering this benchmark, we target the more fundamental ability to perceive and estimate physical scale in the reconstructed 3D space, which prior evaluation protocols have largely overlooked. The project page can be found at https://pumpire.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Pumpire，一个统一的基准与数据集（pumpire-6k），用于直接评估图像级和视频级3D基础模型在点对点距离估计上的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常分别评估深度和相机内参，或用几何相似度指标评估点云，无法直接反映模型的点对点距离估计能力；且忽略了重建3D空间中物理尺度感知这一更基础的能力。
AI.method: 构建大规模多样数据集pumpire-6k，包含100个真实场景、每个场景64帧（共6,400帧），并带有物理测量的点对距离标注；建立覆盖图像级和视频级3D基础模型的统一评测协议，直接评估点对距离误差并支持跨设置比较。
AI.result: 在29个代表性3D基础模型基线配置上进行了大量实验，并提供了全面的结果分析。
AI.conclusion: Pumpire填补了现有评测在物理尺度感知方面的空白，为3D基础模型的点对距离估计能力提供了直接、可比较的评估基准。

title: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
comment: 34 pages, 9 figures. Code and cached results: https://github.com/Xodios/TRAINING-ON-THE-FUTURE-A-DELAY-AWARE-AUDIT-OF-TEST-TIME-ADAPTATION-FOR-TIME-SERIES-FORECASTING
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods for time-series forecasting update a deployed model, or a small adapter around it, from incoming ground truth. But the label of an $H$-step forecast exists only $H$ steps later, and real data pipelines add further delay. We build a leakage-free harness in which the label of forecast origin $s$ is released for updates only at step $s+d$ with $d \ge H$, and enforce this rule inside the released code of four recent TTA methods (TAFAS, COSA, PETSA and DynaTTA), run on their own backbones and checkpoints across five benchmarks (ETTm1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity and Traffic). As references we add two closed-form correctors: a bank of recursive least squares (RLS) filters combined by a per-coordinate median, with no tunable hyperparameters and 56 microseconds per step on the 7-channel streams, and an ELF-style linear corrector. Under causal delayed labels the picture is asymmetric. On ETTm1 every audited method genuinely adapts, yet the RLS bank still beats three of the four at a fraction of their cost; only DynaTTA beats the bank, only at the minimum causal delay, and at roughly 2,500 times the per-update cost; the ELF-style corrector beats all four. On the other four datasets, the largest statistically significant improvement any published method achieves over its own frozen checkpoint is half a percent, on all four at least one published method is significantly worse than the frozen model at the minimum causal delay, and on drift-heavy ETTh2 longer label delays make every adapter that separates from the frozen model, ours included, significantly harmful. Leaky next-step updates inflate the apparent gains of simple adapters by up to 110%, and the backbone training recipe moves frozen online error by up to a factor of 25, more than any adaptation effect we measure. We release the harness, integration patches and all cached runs.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建无泄漏的测试时自适应(TTA)评测框架，在标签延迟d≥H的真实条件下审计四种近期时序TTA方法，发现其收益极有限，甚至常常不如简单闭式校正器或冻结模型。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测的TTA方法利用"incoming ground truth"更新模型，但H步预测的标签实际要到H步后才存在，加上数据管线延迟，会导致信息泄漏。作者希望建立无泄漏的评测标准，检验这些方法在真实因果延迟下的真实收益。
AI.method: 构建无泄漏harness：预测起点s的标签仅在s+d(d≥H)时才可用于更新，并强制此规则嵌入四种方法(TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA)的发布代码中，在各自backbone与checkpoint上跨五个基准(ETTm1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic)评测。另加入两个闭式校正器作参照：递归最小二乘(RLS)滤波器组按坐标取中位数(无超参，7通道每步56微秒)以及ELF风格线性校正器。
AI.result: 因果延迟标签下结果不对称：ETTm1上每种方法确实自适应，但RLS组以极低成本击败四者中的三个；仅DynaTTA在最小因果延迟下胜过RLS组，代价约为其2500倍；ELF风格校正器击败全部四种。其余四个数据集上，已发表方法相对自身冻结checkpoint的最大显著提升仅0.5%，且在最小因果延迟下至少有一种方法显著劣于冻结模型。ETTh2漂移严重时，更长标签延迟使所有脱离冻结模型的适配器(含作者方法)显著有害。泄漏的下一步更新会将简单适配器的表面增益夸大最多110%，而backbone训练配方对冻结在线误差的影响可达25倍，超过任何测得的自适应效应。
AI.conclusion: 在无泄漏、因果延迟标签的真实设定下，现有TTA方法的收益远低于此前报告，且常不及简单闭式校正器或冻结模型；训练配方的影响甚至超过自适应本身。作者开源了评测框架、集成补丁与全部缓存运行结果，呼吁更严格的TTA评测标准。

title: AdaCast: Conditional Parameter Generation for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved strong forecasting performance across domains. However, most adaptation methods remain static. Existing all-in-one methods learn a single set of dataset-level parameter updates and apply the same adapted model to every input. As a result, they cannot adapt the model parameters to the temporal patterns, seasonality and dynamics of each input time series. This limits their ability to produce forecasts that are tailored to heterogeneous inputs. To address this limitation, we propose AdaCast, a conditional parameter generation framework for time-series forecasting. AdaCast uses a generator to produce input-specific low-rank parameter updates for a frozen pretrained TSFM. These updates adapt the model to each input during both training and inference. Across six public benchmarks, AdaCast consistently outperforms static adaptation baseline in in-domain forecasting and improves zero-shot generalization to held-out datasets across domains. These results demonstrate that conditional parameter generation provides an effective approach for adaptive forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdaCast，一种条件参数生成框架，为冻结的时序基础模型生成输入特定的低秩参数更新，实现动态自适应预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时序基础模型适配方法多为静态：学习一套数据集级参数更新并应用于所有输入，无法适应每条序列的时序模式、季节性与动态，限制了对异质输入的定制化预测能力。
AI.method: AdaCast 使用一个生成器，为冻结的预训练时序基础模型产生输入特定的低秩参数更新；这些更新在训练和推理阶段都针对每个输入调整模型。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准上，AdaCast 在同域预测中持续优于静态适配基线，并提升了跨领域留出数据集的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 条件参数生成是时序自适应预测的一种有效途径。

title: LEGO: A Lifting-Free Approach for Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Generating an egocentric video from a single exocentric recording is a challenging case of novel view synthesis, as the two cameras share little overlap and much of the target view is unobserved. Current state-of-the-art methods reconstruct the scene explicitly by estimating depth, lifting the video into a point cloud, and re-rendering it from the egocentric camera to condition a video diffusion model. This deterministic mapping assigns each pixel to a single reprojected location, which preserves texture but translates depth errors into misplaced content. We ask what a video diffusion model should receive as its condition and propose a lifting-free answer: a learned view synthesizer, an LVSM-style transformer fine-tuned to render the egocentric view directly without depth, point clouds, or reprojection, resolving cross-view correspondence internally. In contrast, its probabilistic mapping averages each region over candidate source locations according to a learned correspondence distribution, preserving structure while fine texture is averaged away. We argue that this trade-off suits a diffusion generator, whose denoising training excels at restoring detail, so an effective condition should prioritize structural alignment over sharpness. This distribution's concentration also yields a per-region confidence, used both to mask low-confidence regions and to guide the generator toward high-confidence areas during early layout-forming denoising steps. Our approach consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art explicit pipeline and generalizes to other datasets without retraining. The synthesizer thus supplies view structure, and the diffusion model its detail.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需深度、点云与重投影的"lifting-free"视角合成器，直接用LVSM式Transformer为扩散模型提供条件，结构对齐优于清晰度，性能超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 从外视角视频生成自我中心视频是新视角合成的难例，两相机重叠小、目标视角多为未观测区域。现有SOTA显式重建场景（估深度、升为点云、重投影）作为扩散模型条件，其确定性映射将深度误差转化为内容错位，条件质量受限。
AI.method: 提出无lifting方案：微调LVSM式Transformer作为学习到的视角合成器，直接渲染自我中心视角，无需深度/点云/重投影，内部解决跨视角对应。其概率映射按学习到的对应分布对区域做加权平均，保结构但纹理被平滑；同时该分布的集中度给出区域置信度，用于遮蔽低置信区域，并在去噪早期布局阶段引导生成器关注高置信区域。
AI.result: 方法持续优于SOTA显式流程，且无需重训练即可泛化到其他数据集。
AI.conclusion: 视角合成器提供视图结构，扩散模型补充细节；条件应优先结构对齐而非清晰度。该设计对扩散生成器更为适配。

title: RIFT: Relative Isolation From Trees For Anomaly Detection
summary: Isolation Forest (IF) is a widely used baseline for unsupervised anomaly detection. Recent studies provide a closed-form expression for the infinite-forest limit for one-dimensional data. Inspired by the geometric interpretation of this formula, we introduce RIFT (Relative Isolation From Trees), a deterministic anomaly detection method that generates the minimum spanning tree and scores each point by the sum of the apparent sizes of tree edges as viewed from that point. For one-dimensional data, the RIFT score recovers the closed-form IF limit exactly. In higher dimensions, it provides a parameter-free generalization that is deterministic, robust to varying density and clustered anomalies and avoids the axis-parallel artifacts of IF. We further propose an ensemble variant for large datasets. Experiments on synthetic data and the ADBench benchmark demonstrate that the accuracy is comparable to IF, while the ensemble variant exhibits significantly lower variance across random seeds.

AI.tldr: RIFT是基于最小生成树几何解释的确定性异常检测方法，一维下精确复现IF无穷森林极限，高维下参数无关且更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: Isolation Forest应用广泛但存在轴平行伪影，对密度变化和簇状异常不够鲁棒；已有工作仅给出一维数据无穷森林极限的闭式表达，缺乏高维推广。
AI.method: 受该闭式公式几何解释启发，构造最小生成树，以从各点观察到的树边表观大小之和作为异常分数；另提出面向大数据的集成变体。
AI.result: 一维下RIFT分数精确等于IF闭式极限；高维下为参数无关的确定性推广，对密度变化和簇状异常更鲁棒、无轴平行伪影。合成数据与ADBench实验显示精度与IF相当，集成变体跨随机种子方差显著更低。
AI.conclusion: RIFT提供了IF的确定性、参数无关替代方案，保持可比精度的同时降低随机性带来的方差。

title: One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts
summary: In this work, we show that a single Transformer block, applied recurrently, can match the accuracy of a full-depth vision encoder at comparable inference FLOPs without intermediate feature distillation. reViT restores depth-specific transformations by representing the FFN at each recurrent depth as a convex combination of a small shared expert bank. A continuous normalized-depth coordinate programs this mixture, defining a resampleable trajectory through FFN parameter space. We evaluate this design in two regimes: supervised ImageNet-1k training and distillation from a DINOv2 teacher. Across both regimes, controlled adaptations identify weight-space merging as the strongest tested MoE family at a matching one-FFN budget, ahead of the token-dispatch and output-mixture alternatives. Trained from scratch, reViT-B/16 attains DeiT III accuracy with about 70\% fewer stored parameters. An 8-experts model distilled using only the teacher's output features retains nearly all of its DINOv2 teacher's linear-probe accuracy and transfers across classification, segmentation, and depth prediction. Elastic-depth training allows one checkpoint (trained model) to operate at multiple tested depths by resampling the same normalized coordinate interval. For fixed-depth deployment, the recurrent block can be materialized as a conventional dense graph, removing online routing and merging without changing the one-FFN-per-depth compute but expanding deployment storage.

AI.tldr: reViT用单个循环Transformer块，通过FFN参数空间的凸组合(专家银行)模拟深度差异，在相近推理FLOPs下达到全深度视觉编码器的精度。
AI.motivation: 减少视觉编码器的存储参数，同时保持全深度模型的精度与推理效率，无需中间特征蒸馏即可用循环块替代全深度。
AI.method: 将每个循环深度的FFN表示为小型共享专家银行的凸组合，并用连续归一化深度坐标进行程序化混合，形成FFN参数空间中的可重采样轨迹；支持弹性深度训练与固定深度稠密化部署。
AI.result: 监督ImageNet-1k和DINOv2蒸馏两种设置下，权重空间合并(weight-space merging)是最强的MoE方案；reViT-B/16从零训练以约70%更少参数达到DeiT III精度；8专家蒸馏模型保留近乎全部DINOv2线性探测精度并迁移到分类、分割、深度预测。
AI.conclusion: 循环单块+FFN专家银行混合是一种高效替代全深度编码器的方案，可弹性支持多深度部署，且可按需稠密化去除在线路由开销。

title: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
summary: Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.

AI.tldr: Cluster-TNN是一个域无关框架，通过局部提升和动态聚类采样构建拓扑小批量，解决拓扑深度学习在大规模稠密图上的全图物化瓶颈，平均减少83.2%峰值GPU内存并首次实现在Reddit等大数据集上训练高阶拓扑神经网络。
AI.motivation: 拓扑深度学习将图学习扩展到超图、胞腔复形和单纯复形等高阶域，这些域通常由输入图的模式通过图提升构建。全图训练需在执行模型前构建并存储完整的提升表示，在Reddit（233k节点、57.3M边）等大规模稠密数据集上，这种全局物化成为严重计算瓶颈，常导致训练不可行。
AI.method: 提出Cluster-TNN，一个域无关框架：在预处理阶段对输入图进行划分；运行时动态采样节点簇组，重建其诱导子图形成小批量，并在每个小批量内应用所选图提升。保留采样节点间所有边以维持跨簇构造高阶结构所需的连通性，从而生成现有拓扑神经网络可直接处理的拓扑小批量。
AI.result: 与全图执行进行21组匹配对比，Cluster-TNN在所有配置下都降低了峰值GPU内存，平均降低83.2%，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能。该内存降低使得首次能在Reddit和OGBN Products等大数据集上训练多种不同的高阶拓扑神经网络。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果确立了Cluster-TNN作为一种通用策略，可将拓扑深度学习扩展到超越全局域构建限制的规模。

title: VersaCamVLA: Camera-Configurable VLA Policies for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful foundations for robotic manipulation, but their reliance on fixed camera configurations during training makes them brittle to changes in camera count or pose during deployment. To overcome these limitations, we propose VersaCamVLA, a camera-configurable framework that decouples camera-set representation from action learning. VersaCamVLA learns a unified scene-token interface that maps an arbitrary, variable set of posed RGB views into fixed-size latent scene tokens. This is achieved via multi-signal target-view prediction and Wrist-Augmented Pose Sampling (WAPS), which leverages natural wrist-camera motion for free pose diversity. At deployment, a lightweight spatial encoder injects these compact scene tokens into a pretrained base VLA as a supplementary visual condition, requiring no explicit 3D sensing or novel-view rendering. Experiments on RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real-robot platform demonstrate that VersaCamVLA consistently outperforms prior VLA methods and direct multi-view baselines, maintaining robust performance across varying camera counts and unseen camera poses.

AI.tldr: VersaCamVLA是一个可配置相机的VLA框架，通过解耦相机集合表示与动作学习，使机器人操作策略能适应变化的相机数量与位姿。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖训练时固定的相机配置，部署时相机数量或位姿变化会导致性能脆弱。
AI.method: 学习统一的场景token接口，将任意可变数量带位姿RGB视图映射为固定大小的潜在场景token；采用多信号目标视图预测和Wrist-Augmented Pose Sampling（WAPS）利用腕部相机运动获得位姿多样性；部署时用轻量空间编码器将场景token注入预训练VLA，无需3D传感或新视图渲染。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin、LIBERO及真实机器人平台上，VersaCamVLA持续优于先前VLA方法和直接多视角基线，在不同相机数量和未见相机位姿下保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦相机配置与动作学习，VersaCamVLA实现了对可变相机配置的鲁棒泛化。

title: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
summary: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvement at 20\% cost ($2.7\times$ efficiency, $p=0.002$ over 10 seeds). On the more volatile Container Trace, it achieves 96\% at 20\% cost ($4.8\times$ efficiency, $+75\%$ MAE reduction over Static). Unlike classical drift detectors (ADWIN, DDM, Page-Hinkley) which fail to trigger on regression-scale error streams, AdaptLSTM fires 42 times over 301 steps and outperforms matched-budget baselines. Wall-clock profiling shows $1.33\times$ throughput gain and 45\% update-time reduction. The framework is model-agnostic: identical Pareto patterns hold for LSTM, GRU, and Transformer backbones.

AI.tldr: AdaptLSTM：通过验证校准阈值检测漂移并选择性更新，实现高效在线负载预测，在低成本下大幅恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 云服务弹性扩缩容需准确负载预测，但病毒内容、产品发布等导致分布漂移，使离线模型快速退化。朴素在线学习虽恢复精度但每步计算成本过高。
AI.method: 提出AdaptLSTM自适应在线框架：用验证校准阈值检测漂移，仅在漂移时进行选择性、针对性更新（模型无关，适配LSTM/GRU/Transformer）。
AI.result: Alibaba Machine Trace上以20%成本恢复朴素在线54%的改善（效率2.7×，p=0.002）；Container Trace上达96%（效率4.8×，MAE较Static降75%）。经典漂移检测器失效时，AdaptLSTM在301步内触发42次并优于等预算基线；吞吐提升1.33×，更新时间减少45%。
AI.conclusion: AdaptLSTM以低成本高效应对漂移，性能稳定且模型无关，优于经典漂移检测器与等预算基线。

title: OmniCapBench: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code and benchmark can be found at https://01yzzyu.github.io/OmniCapBench/
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits. Audio--visual captioning is an ideal diagnostic task, yet current benchmarks face a coupled trade-off: whole-caption scores provide coverage without localization, local probes provide localization without coverage, and unconstrained LLM judges introduce instability. We introduce OmniCapBench (Omni-Video Caption Benchmark), a benchmark that reframes audio--visual caption evaluation as a deep-structured diagnostic framework. OmniCapBench shifts the prediction target from free-form text to sets of atomic, verifiable evaluation units across three tracks: entity references, visual shots, and audio events, enabling reliable scoring with deterministic constraint checks and localized LLM-based semantic comparisons. With 786 densely annotated videos, OmniCapBench effectively distinguishes MLLM perception errors, including temporal grounding failures, identity drift, cross-modal misalignment, and hallucinated descriptions. Evaluating frontier MLLMs reveals strong local perception but weak long-horizon audio--visual reasoning, particularly in identity drift and cross-modal misalignment, providing a fine-grained roadmap for omnimodal development.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniCapBench，将音视频字幕评测重构为深度结构化诊断框架，用原子化可验证单元取代自由文本评分。
AI.motivation: MLLM正走向连续音视频推理，亟需暴露能力上限的评测。现有音视频字幕基准存在权衡困境：整体字幕评分有覆盖无定位，局部探针有定位无覆盖，而无约束LLM评判引入不稳定性。
AI.method: 将预测目标从自由文本转为原子化、可验证的评测单元集合，覆盖三条轨道：实体指代、视觉镜头、音频事件。结合确定性约束检查与局部化LLM语义比较进行评分，构建786个密集标注视频。
AI.result: 能有效区分MLLM感知错误，包括时序定位失败、身份漂移、跨模态错位和幻觉描述。对前沿MLLM评测显示：局部感知强，但长时程音视频推理弱，尤其在身份漂移与跨模态错位方面。
AI.conclusion: OmniCapBench为全模态发展提供细粒度路线图，揭示了当前MLLM在长时程音视频推理上的关键短板。

title: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
summary: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WorldGuide，将过程性视频生成形式化为视觉世界空间中的闭环任务执行，使模型从生成状态决定并执行下一步动作、判断完成，并构建了约 59K 步级标注视频数据集 WorldGuide Bench。方法在 WorldGuide-Bench 上任务成功率 33.33%，超过 MiniMax-H3 的 29.90%，在 VideoCraft-Bench 上达 47.69% 对 32.73%。
AI.motivation: 长时程过程性任务要求生成能根据已产生的内容自适应。开环生成无法适应执行结果，现有闭环系统多依赖预训练执行器或间接验证，导致"决定动作"与"成功实现动作"之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: WorldGuide 仅给定初始图像与任务目标，预测原子动作并生成对应视频片段，再用生成结果选择下一动作或终止。Planner 与 Executor 在同一套步级过程演示上训练：Planner 从视觉进展预测下一原子动作或任务完成，Executor 直接学习实现预测动作；并引入分层视觉记忆，在有限历史 token 成本下维持长时程状态。为弥补步级动作-视频监督的缺失，构建 WorldGuide Bench（约 59K 步级标注视频，245 个任务、27 个过程类别）。
AI.result: 在 WorldGuide-Bench 上任务成功率 33.33%，优于近期强视频模型 MiniMax-H3 的 29.90%（尽管后者接收参考动作计划）；在 VideoCraft-Bench 目标仅条件下达 47.69%，对比 MiniMax-H3 的 32.73%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将规划与学习到的执行相耦合对于目标导向的过程性视频生成至关重要。

title: Composite Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion with Optimal Oracle Complexity
summary: We consider stochastic nonsmooth nonconvex composite optimization, which includes several important problems such as constrained optimization and the regularized training of neural networks. The objective is the sum of a possibly nonsmooth nonconvex Lipschitz function and a convex regularizer, and the function is accessed through stochastic gradients or function values. The goal is to find a point that satisfies a Goldstein-type stationarity condition designed for composite objectives. To our knowledge, no oracle complexity bound for this setting is known under first-order access, and existing complexities under zeroth-order access are suboptimal. To handle this issue, we employ the framework of online-to-nonconvex conversion, which chooses update directions by an online learner and is known to achieve optimal rates for noncomposite problems. We extend the framework to our composite scenario by introducing new losses for the learner, which contain the regularizer itself rather than its linearization and for which a variant of online mirror descent achieves low regret. We show that the resulting algorithm finds such a point with $O(δ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ stochastic gradient queries or $O(dδ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ function-value queries, where $δ$ is the Goldstein radius, $\varepsilon$ is the stationarity tolerance, and $d$ is the dimension. These rates match the optimal ones for noncomposite nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, demonstrating that the additional convex regularizer does not worsen the oracle complexity. We also give rates for the smooth case and present numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机非光滑非凸复合优化，目标是找到满足Goldstein型稳定性的点；通过扩展online-to-nonconvex转换框架并设计含正则项本身的新损失，达到了与非复合问题最优复杂度相匹配的oracle复杂度。
AI.motivation: 复合优化（非光滑非凸Lipschitz函数+凸正则项）在约束优化、神经网络正则化训练中很重要，但对复合目标的Goldstein型稳定性，一阶oracle复杂度未知，零阶复杂度次优，因此需要建立最优复杂度。
AI.method: 采用online-to-nonconvex转换框架，由在线学习器选择更新方向；将其扩展到复合场景，引入包含正则项本身（而非其线性化）的新损失，并用在线镜像下降的变体实现低regret。
AI.result: 算法达到O(δ^{-1}ε^{-3})次随机梯度查询或O(dδ^{-1}ε^{-3})次函数值查询，其中δ为Goldstein半径、ε为稳定性容差、d为维度；同时给出光滑情形的速率及数值实验。
AI.conclusion: 所得速率与非复合非光滑非凸优化的最优速率一致，说明额外的凸正则项不会恶化oracle复杂度。

title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
summary: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video, which we lift and complete into multi-view videos. To learn from this imperfect supervision, we propose Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS: a Fourier-series deformation field guarantees looping by construction, while a Grounded Drift Field anchored at the reference view absorbs cross-view inconsistency. Unlike prior Eulerian methods limited to fluid-like motion, we capture general deformation, object motion, and illumination change. We introduce a ground-truth-free evaluation covering vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 39 reconstructed and generated scenes, OuroWorld outperforms all baselines and wins 70.8%-99.0% of user-study comparisons. Project page: https://ouroworld.userwei.com

AI.tldr: OuroWorld 是一个无需掩膜的框架，能将任意静态 3D 高斯泼溅场景转化为可从任意视角无缝循环的 3D 电影图像（动态场景）。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 世界模型生成的场景逼真且可探索，但静止不动、缺乏时间动态，限制了沉浸感与真实感。
AI.method: 利用视觉语言模型推断合理动态并引导视频模型合成参考视频，再提升并补全为多视角视频；提出 Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS：用傅里叶级数变形场保证循环性，用锚定于参考视角的 Grounded Drift Field 吸收跨视角不一致。
AI.result: 在 39 个重建与生成场景上，OuroWorld 超越所有基线，在用户研究中赢得 70.8%–99.0% 的对比偏好。
AI.conclusion: OuroWorld 突破了以往欧拉方法仅限流体类运动的限制，可捕捉一般变形、物体运动与光照变化，并提出无真值评估体系（生动性、自然性、循环接缝一致性、场景质量）。

title: Ambient Discrete Diffusion: Using the Wrong Data at the Right Time for Data Efficient Learning
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops (BeNTo, DiffuLM)
summary: We introduce RefineMix, a framework for training discrete diffusion models under severe data scarcity, a common constraint in scientific applications. RefineMix uses out-of-distribution data at selected diffusion times to improve generalization without biasing the sampling distribution. Although this strategy has been explored in continuous diffusion, discrete diffusion presents a distinct challenge: unlike Gaussian noise, masking preserves domain information in surviving tokens, limiting the use of related data at high noise levels. At low noise levels, however, the domains effectively disjoint supports become an advantage, allowing the model to learn from both in-domain and out-of-distribution data without biasing the sampler. We formalize these intuitions and provide a theoretical analysis for the proposed method. Experimentally, across five domain-shift settings, RefineMix matches or outperforms in-domain finetuning and data mixing. For protein sequence generation, finetuning with just 197 in-domain examples nearly doubles the fraction of generated proteins that are simultaneously novel, foldable, and in-family compared to standard finetuning.

AI.tldr: 提出RefineMix框架，在严重数据稀缺下训练离散扩散模型，通过在选定的扩散时间引入分布外数据，无偏提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 科学应用中数据稀缺，相比连续扩散，离散扩散中掩码会保留域信息，导致高噪声下难以利用相关数据，需新方法提升泛化且不偏置采样分布。
AI.method: 在选定扩散时间（尤其低噪声水平）使用分布外数据，利用域间支持集不相交的优势，同时学习域内与域外数据而不偏置采样器，并给出理论分析。
AI.result: 在五个域迁移设置中，RefineMix达到或超越域内微调与数据混合；蛋白质序列生成上，仅用197个域内样本微调，生成的兼具新颖、可折叠、同家族性质的蛋白比例相比标准微调近乎翻倍。
AI.conclusion: RefineMix有效缓解离散扩散模型在数据稀缺下的泛化问题，理论支撑充分，实验验证其在蛋白质生成等科学任务中的显著优势。

title: What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach
summary: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.

AI.tldr: 本文研究以自我为中心的人类视频扩展对世界模型的促进作用，使用3万小时、1000+场景类型、14000贡献者的数据集，直接评估智能体和物体交互保真度。
AI.motivation: 世界模型有望替代基于物理的模拟器，但距离实际部署仍很遥远。作者想探究扩展自我中心人类视频能在多大程度上推动世界模型发展，并避免依赖不透明的下游指标。
AI.method: 构建30,000小时自我中心人类视频数据集（覆盖1,000+场景类型、14,000贡献者），在具有挑战性的分布外基准上直接评估智能体与物体交互保真度；通过视觉条件设计实验分离智能体与物体保真度；提出一种监督方案，将容量从场景外观转向物体动态。
AI.result: 训练数据增加100倍时，智能体和物体保真度均有提升但不均衡：智能体建模效果良好，物体保真度仍远低且提升缓慢。精心设计的视觉条件能以少量数据使智能体保真度饱和，从而可单独测量物体保真度及其饱和点。监督方案提升了物体保真度，但仍有较大差距。结论可迁移到下游人形建模。
AI.conclusion: 扩展自我中心数据使智能体建模接近极限，但对其在世界中的影响建模仍远远落后；缩小这一差距取决于模型如何训练，而不仅是看多少数据。

title: SplitJEPA: Learning Invariant and Variant Latent Worlds without Reconstruction
summary: Understanding a dynamical world calls for more than a latent state that summarizes its observations: the state should also be organized into the factors that stay shared across related observations and the factors that vary between them. For example, a robot pushing a cube to a goal should take the same action when the camera shifts or the lights dim, since nothing in the scene has moved. Existing approaches to this decomposition commonly obtain it through reconstruction, so the latent variables must first explain the entire observational world before their organization can be trusted. Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) model the latent state directly and never reconstruct, yet no existing result recovers the invariant and variant parts of the state they learn. How to learn the invariant-variant structure of the latent world without paying for its reconstruction therefore remains open. To close this gap, we introduce SplitJEPA, a JEPA that jointly recovers the latent state and its invariant and variant organization directly in representation space, without any reconstruction. We prove that, under stationary Gaussian predictive dynamics and a full-rank variation condition, SplitJEPA identifies the invariant and variant subspaces up to independent block-wise isometries, without introducing an observation decoder. Since the guarantee needs no decoder, the result extends reconstruction-free latent recovery to invariant-variant block identification. Experiments on synthetic nonlinear systems and robotic manipulation tasks support the theoretical results and show their practical value for both robustness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: SplitJEPA 是一种无需重建的联合嵌入预测架构，直接在表示空间中将潜在状态分解为不变子空间与变异子空间，并在理论上证明了其可辨识性。
AI.motivation: 理解动态世界需要将潜在状态组织为跨相关观测共享的不变因子与随观测变化的变异因子。现有分解方法多依赖重建，须先用潜变量解释整个观测世界才能保证其组织结构可信；而 JEPA 直接建模潜在状态、不做重建，却尚无工作恢复其学到的不变与变异部分。因此，如何在不重建的前提下学习潜在世界的不变-变异结构仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 提出 SplitJEPA：一种在表示空间中联合恢复潜在状态及其不变/变异组织、且完全无重建的 JEPA。定理证明在平稳高斯预测动力学与满秩变异条件下，SplitJEPA 可在独立块级等距意义下识别不变子空间与变异子空间，且无需引入观测解码器。
AI.result: 在合成非线性系统与机器人操作任务上的实验支持了理论结果，并展示了其在鲁棒性与效率方面的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 由于该保证不需要解码器，该结果将无重建的潜在恢复扩展到不变-变异块的识别，为学习结构化世界表示提供了理论与实证基础。

title: Rubric-CEPR: Self-Evolving Image Editing via Reward-Verified Self-Distillation
summary: Instruction-guided image editors have become highly capable, yet improving them further still depends on human-edited training pairs or external reward models. Such supervision is costly to obtain and can reward plausible failures: a realistic output may leave the requested change undone or alter content that should be preserved. In this work, we strive to improve a pretrained image editor using only its own generations, without human-edited targets or an external training-time reward model. To this end, we propose a self-evolving framework, named Rubric-CEPR, that verifies the editor's own samples with its internal representations through a rubric-augmented Contrastive Edit-Preservation Reward (CEPR). A Planner proposes structured edit instructions from unlabeled images, the Editor samples multiple candidate edits, and a frozen Critic scores each candidate with decomposed rubric checks for edit realization, removal of the old state, and content preservation, using features already exposed by the editor. Non-compensatory gates reject infeasible candidates, and the best verified candidate is distilled into the editor through lightweight adapter training. On Qwen-Image-Edit, Rubric-CEPR improves ImgEdit from 4.36 to 4.60 (+5.5%), with a +24.9% gain on object isolation, and transfers to GEdit-Bench and Complex-Edit. The same procedure also improves Step1X-Edit by +7.8% on ImgEdit. We hope our approach will serve as a solid baseline for image editors that improve themselves from their own verified samples. Our code is publicly available at $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$

AI.tldr: 提出Rubric-CEPR自进化框架，仅用图像编辑器自身生成样本（无需人工编辑目标或外部奖励模型）来提升编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 指令引导的图像编辑器已很强，但进一步提升依赖人工编辑的训练对或外部奖励模型，这类监督成本高，且可能奖励"看似合理"的失败案例：如真实输出但未完成要求的修改，或改动了应保留的内容。
AI.method: 自进化框架Rubric-CEPR：用编辑器内部表示并借助"评分标准增强的对比编辑-保留奖励（CEPR）"来验证自身样本。Planner从无标签图像生成结构化编辑指令，Editor采样多个候选编辑，冻结的Critic用分解的评分项（编辑实现、旧状态移除、内容保留）对每个候选打分，利用编辑器已暴露的特征；非补偿性门控拒绝不可行候选，最佳已验证候选通过轻量适配器训练蒸馏回编辑器。
AI.result: 在Qwen-Image-Edit上，ImgEdit从4.36提升到4.60（+5.5%），物体隔离任务提升+24.9%，并迁移到GEdit-Bench和Complex-Edit；同一流程在Step1X-Edit上ImgEdit提升+7.8%。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为"从自身已验证样本中自我提升"的图像编辑器提供了坚实基线。

title: Closing the Horizon Gap in Policy Optimization for Adversarial MDPs
summary: We consider policy optimization for online episodic tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs) with adversarial losses and bandit feedback. Policy optimization updates the policy locally at each state and avoids optimization over the occupancy-measure polytope, but its existing regret bounds are larger by a factor of the horizon $H$ than those of occupancy-measure-based algorithms. We close this gap by using regularized $Q$-functions, which allow us to control the stability of the local updates jointly over all state-action pairs rather than separately at each state. The resulting algorithm attains high-probability regret bounds of $\widetilde O(\sqrt{HS(H+A)T})$ for known transitions and $\widetilde O(HS\sqrt{AT})$ for unknown transitions, where $S$ is the number of states, $A$ the number of actions, and $T$ the number of episodes. Both bounds improve the horizon dependence of existing policy optimization bounds, and the latter matches the best-known bound. We further extend the algorithm to adversarial linear-mixture MDPs and obtain the same improvement in the horizon dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文用正则化Q函数改进在线分段表格MDP的策略优化，将遗憾界中的H依赖降低，达到已知转移$\widetilde O(\sqrt{HS(H+A)T})$和未知转移$\widetilde O(HS\sqrt{AT})$。
AI.motivation: 策略优化避免占用测度多面体上的优化，但现有遗憾界比基于占用测度的算法多出horizon H因子，需要缩小这一差距。
AI.method: 使用正则化Q函数，使局部更新的稳定性在所有状态-动作对上联合控制，而非在每个状态上分别控制，并扩展到对抗性线性混合MDP。
AI.result: 已知转移达到高概率遗憾界$\widetilde O(\sqrt{HS(H+A)T})$；未知转移达到$\widetilde O(HS\sqrt{AT})$，后者匹配最优已知界；两者均改进现有策略优化界的horizon依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该方法缩小了策略优化与基于占用测度算法之间的H因子差距，并在对抗性线性混合MDP中取得相同的horizon依赖改进。

title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
summary: Koopman operator theory provides a linear framework for analyzing nonlinear dynamical systems and has become a major tool for data-driven modeling. A central challenge, however, is that finite-dimensional approximations computed by methods such as extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) require the dictionary to be specified a priori. Recent machine-learning approaches address this limitation by learning the dictionary from data, predominantly using artificial neural network (ANN) autoencoder architectures. Although kernel methods offer an alternative with greater interpretability and tractability for theoretical analysis, they have received little attention in this setting. We introduce extended dynamic mode decomposition with kernel-based dictionary learning (EDMD-kDL), a kernel-based method for learning finite-dimensional Koopman embeddings directly from data. The method combines ideas from collocation methods and bilevel optimization to simultaneously learn a kernel dictionary and the corresponding Koopman approximation. We evaluate EDMD-kDL against state-of-the-art ANN-based approaches on a range of numerical experiments, including global sea-surface-temperature forecasting and learning directly from video data. Across all tested settings, EDMD-kDL achieves performance comparable to or better than the ANN-based methods. Moreover, in contrast to standard kernel methods, the proposed approach is scalable to large datasets by design since the size of the required kernel matrices depends on the number of collocation points rather than the size of the training dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出基于核的EDMD-kDL方法，直接从数据学习Koopman嵌入，性能媲美或优于ANN方法，且可扩展。
AI.motivation: EDMD需预先指定字典，而现有机器学习方法多用ANN自编码器，虽有效但可解释性与理论分析性不足；核方法在这方面的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 结合配点法(collocation)与双层优化(bilevel optimization)，同时学习核字典及其对应的Koopman近似，实现有限维Koopman嵌入的直接数据驱动学习。
AI.result: 在全球海表温度预测、直接从视频数据学习等任务上，EDMD-kDL性能与最先进ANN方法相当或更优；核矩阵规模仅依赖配点数而非训练集大小，故可扩展至大数据集。
AI.conclusion: EDMD-kDL为Koopman字典学习提供了具可解释性、可理论分析且可扩展的核方法替代方案。

title: Marformer: A Transformer for Predicting Missing Data Distributions
comment: 45 pages, 19 figures; presented in part in a COLM 2026 keynote
summary: Real decisions are made under incomplete information. If we observe only some of the random variables we need, we can predict the others. The \textbf{conditional marginals} over the missing variables are the key ingredient for computing Bayes risk and Value of Information (VOI), the expected gain from acquiring one more observation before deciding. We present the Marformer, a Transformer trained to directly predict conditional marginals given any set of observed values. Like BERT, which is trained to predict missing words from context, the Marformer constructs a hidden-vector representation for each distribution $p(X_i)$ and iteratively refines it through attention to other distributions $p(X_j)$. Unlike generative approaches, the Marformer does not model the full joint distribution, requires no domain knowledge of the data-generating process, and makes all predictions in a single forward pass. We evaluate across three synthetic domains with missing data---Bayesian networks, discretized multivariate Gaussians, and structured annotation data. The Marformer can match or outperform classical missing-data methods, even when those methods are given the true model family and prior that generated the synthetic data. We also evaluate on a real annotation dataset, where the Marformer outperforms the evaluated baselines at the largest training size. In both cases, the Marformer is substantially faster than the evaluated generative baselines.

AI.tldr: Marformer：一种Transformer，直接预测任意观测下的条件边缘分布，用于计算贝叶斯风险与信息价值，无需建模联合分布或领域知识，单次前向推理，精度与速度均优于经典缺失数据方法。
AI.motivation: 现实决策常在信息不完整下进行。条件边缘分布是计算贝叶斯风险与信息价值(VOI)的关键，但传统方法需要完整联合分布或领域知识。
AI.method: 借鉴BERT，为每个分布p(X_i)构建隐向量表示，并通过注意力对其他p(X_j)迭代精炼。不建模完整联合分布，不需数据生成过程知识，单次前向完成全部预测。
AI.result: 在贝叶斯网络、离散多元高斯、结构化标注三类合成域上匹配或超越经典方法，即使后者已知真实模型族与先验；在真实标注数据集上最大训练规模时也优于基线；速度显著快于生成式基线。
AI.conclusion: Marformer可作为通用、快速、免领域知识的条件边缘分布预测器，服务贝叶斯决策与VOI计算。

title: Prospective Prediction of OOD Degradation from Source-Side Training Dynamics
summary: We study whether persistent out-of-distribution (OOD) degradation can be predicted before it is directly observed using only source-side training dynamics. In a controlled shortcut-learning setting, a simple logistic regression predictor develops a clear prospective signal, while training time alone does not. Temporal summaries of the source-side quantities are substantially more informative than their current values. When transferred without additional training from a CNN to an MLP, confidence and entropy dynamics retain substantial predictive information. These results provide a proof of principle that source-side training dynamics can contain an early warning signal for future OOD failure.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨能否仅用源端训练动态，在OOD退化被直接观测前进行预测。在受控捷径学习设置下，简单逻辑回归预测器产生清晰的前瞻信号，而单独训练时间不能。时间摘要比当前值更具信息量，且从CNN迁移到MLP时置信度和熵动态仍保留预测信息。
AI.motivation: 研究是否能在OOD退化实际发生前，仅凭源端训练动态预测持续性OOD退化，以实现早期预警。
AI.method: 在受控捷径学习设置中，使用简单逻辑回归预测器；对比训练时间、当前值与时间摘要的信息量；并将CNN上学到的预测迁移到MLP（无需额外训练）。
AI.result: 逻辑回归预测器产生清晰前瞻信号，训练时间单独无效；时间摘要显著比当前值更有信息量；置信度和熵动态在CNN到MLP迁移中保留大量预测信息。
AI.conclusion: 源端训练动态可包含未来OOD失败的早期预警信号，提供了原理性证明。

title: Learning Kilometer-Scale Weather Prediction with Global-Regional Alignment
summary: Kilometer-scale regional weather forecasting is essential for local weather warnings and weather-sensitive decisions. Existing data-driven approaches often rely on numerical forecasts for large-scale guidance or require additional training of global forecasting components. Pretrained global weather models offer an efficient source of large-scale forecasts, motivating their reuse to guide high-resolution regional prediction. However, this coupling requires aligning global and regional representations across different grids and integrating global guidance with local interactions to advance regional states. We propose ScaleCast, a regional forecasting framework that addresses these challenges through Global-Regional Alignment. Its Global-Regional Conversion module aligns joint global and regional representations with regional locations, while the Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics block combines aligned guidance with regional neighborhood interactions. Experiments using ERA5 global analyses on a 0.25-degree grid and CERRA regional reanalysis at 5.5 km spacing demonstrate improved regional forecasts across surface and upper-air variables, with a single trained model supporting multiple global forecast drivers (i.e., Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES) without specific retraining. Fine-tuning on HRRR at 3 km spacing further demonstrates the framework's adaptability to a different regional domain and spatial resolution. Windstorm case studies show improved cyclone positioning and core-pressure estimates, while comparisons with HadISD station observations show closer agreement with local temperature and humidity changes.

AI.tldr: 提出ScaleCast区域天气预报框架，通过Global-Regional Alignment复用预训练全球气象模型来指导高分辨率区域预测，无需额外训练全球组件即可支持多种全球预报驱动源。
AI.motivation: 公里级区域天气预报对本地预警和气象敏感决策至关重要，但现有数据驱动方法依赖数值预报提供大尺度引导或需额外训练全球预报组件，故希望高效复用预训练全球气象模型来引导高分辨率区域预测。
AI.method: 提出ScaleCast框架，核心为Global-Regional Alignment。Global-Regional Conversion模块将全球与区域联合表征对齐到区域位置；Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics block将对齐后的引导与区域邻域交互结合，推进区域状态演化。
AI.result: 基于ERA5(0.25°)与CERRA(5.5km)实验，在地面与高空变量上均改善区域预报；单一模型无需重训练即可支持Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、HRES等多种全球驱动；在HRRR 3km上微调验证了跨域跨分辨率适应性；风暴案例显示改进的气旋定位与核心气压估计，与HadISD站点观测的温度湿度变化更一致。
AI.conclusion: ScaleCast通过全局-区域对齐有效复用预训练全球模型，实现多驱动、跨域跨分辨率的区域高分辨率预报，并在实际天气事件与站点观测中显示更优表现。

title: A Unified Bellman Operator for Safety-Critical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning in safety-critical domains requires maximizing task performance while strictly adhering to safety constraints. Existing safe reinforcement learning paradigms typically force a trade-off: they either require a priori knowledge to provide strict safety guarantees (e.g., safety filters), or they enable joint learning but only satisfy safety constraints on average. In this work, we propose a novel Bellman operator that unifies performance and safety objectives into a joint value function. We show that temporal difference learning with the joint Bellman operator converges under a two-timescale stochastic approximation framework. On the fast timescale, the safety value of the learning joint policy is estimated, while the joint value is estimated on the slow timescale. Convergence is ensured by formulating the limiting dynamics as an occupation-averaged differential inclusion, and showing that it asymptotically converges to a set of limiting optimal safety-constrained task value functions. Theoretically, once converged, the resulting optimal policy maximizes task return while maintaining safety at all times. Empirical evaluations on continuous control tasks with neural approximations demonstrate stable convergence with near-zero safety violations at test time.

AI.tldr: 提出一种联合贝尔曼算子，将性能与安全统一为联合值函数，在双时间尺度随机逼近下收敛，实现最大化任务回报并始终满足安全约束。
AI.motivation: 安全关键领域需在最大化任务性能的同时严格满足安全约束。现有安全强化学习方法存在两难：要么依赖先验知识（如安全滤波器）提供严格保证，要么支持联合学习但仅在平均意义上满足约束。
AI.method: 提出新的贝尔曼算子，将性能与安全目标统一为联合值函数；使用时序差分学习，在双时间尺度随机逼近框架下求解。快时间尺度估计学习到的联合策略的安全值，慢时间尺度估计联合值；将极限动力学建模为占用平均微分包含并证明其收敛性。
AI.result: 理论上证明收敛后得到的最优策略在最大化任务回报的同时始终保持安全；在连续控制任务上结合神经网络逼近进行实验，展示稳定收敛且测试时安全违规接近零。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过统一贝尔曼算子与双时间尺度分析，为同时实现高性能与严格安全约束的安全强化学习提供了理论保证与实证支持。

title: Rounding in Preconditioner Space: Redesigning 4-bit AdamW Optimizer-State Quantization
summary: Quantizing AdamW's optimizer states reduces persistent storage, but quantization errors propagate through the moment recurrences and perturb subsequent adaptive updates. We redesign 4-bit optimizer-state quantization for AdamW from the perspective of \emph{rounding space}: the coordinate in which a quantizer chooses between adjacent reconstruction levels. For the second moment, a local analysis of the quantization cell adjacent to zero shows that small mean state error need not imply small mean preconditioner error at the next step. A one-dimensional quadratic construction further shows qualitatively different optimization dynamics under state-space and preconditioner-space rounding. These results motivate Zero-Inclusive Preconditioner-space Stochastic Rounding (\textbf{ZIP-SR}), which retains zero in the second-moment codebook and computes stochastic-rounding probabilities in preconditioner space. As a complementary route, Zero-Excluding EDEN calibration (\textbf{ZE-EDEN}) uses a zero-excluding second-moment codebook and rescales the quantized second-moment block to mitigate the preconditioner distortion caused by the positive quantization floor. Both configurations use 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) for the first moment, with targeted stochastic rounding of the LM-head first moment during the final 10\% of training. Across GPT- and Llama-style pretraining experiments ranging from \textbf{130M} to \textbf{2.7B} parameters, both methods reduce TorchAO 4-bit AdamW's mean validation-loss gap to 32-bit AdamW at every evaluated model size, with the largest reported gap reduction reaching \textbf{70\%}. In full-parameter supervised fine-tuning, both recipes achieve lower validation loss than TorchAO while remaining close to 32-bit AdamW on downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 从"舍入空间"视角重新设计AdamW的4位优化器状态量化，提出ZIP-SR与ZE-EDEN两种方案，在130M–2.7B模型上将验证损失差距最大缩小70%。
AI.motivation: 量化AdamW优化器状态可减少存储，但量化误差会沿动量递推传播并扰动自适应更新，需要新的量化设计来抑制误差影响。
AI.method: 从舍入空间角度出发：对二阶矩，分析零附近量化单元，证明小的均值状态误差未必带来小的下一步预条件器误差；用一维二次构造展示状态空间与预条件器空间舍入的动力学差异。据此提出ZIP-SR（二阶矩码本含零、在预条件器空间计算随机舍入概率）与ZE-EDEN（二阶矩码本排除零并重缩放以缓解正量化下限造成的预条件器失真）。两者一阶矩均用4位NF4，并在最后10%训练中对LM-head一阶矩做定向随机舍入。
AI.result: 在130M–2.7B参数的GPT与Llama式预训练中，两种方法在各规模均缩小TorchAO 4位AdamW与32位AdamW的验证损失差距，最大缩小70%；全参数监督微调中验证损失低于TorchAO且接近32位AdamW。
AI.conclusion: 预条件器空间舍入是设计4位优化器状态量化的有效视角，ZIP-SR与ZE-EDEN在多种规模与任务上均优于TorchAO基线。

title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
comment: 11 pages main text, 98 pages total; 18 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/AlignmentResearch/caught-in-the-act-probes
summary: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可扩展的白盒欺骗检测探针方法，构建迄今最大欺骗数据集并设计新探针架构，在SHADE-Arena达98.8% AUC，超越文本监控基线，并揭示"内省式欺骗"这一新场景。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体监控面临挑战，模型可能欺骗人类。现有白盒欺骗检测方法难以扩展到前沿监控场景，且在仅凭上下文无法判断欺骗的情况下存在检测盲区。
AI.method: 收集迄今最大的欺骗数据集FIBS用于训练探针；提出一种新型探针架构，能够跨多个层和多个token聚合信息；将白盒探针方法扩展至前沿监控设置，并针对"内省式欺骗"（introspective deception）案例进行压力测试。
AI.result: 探针在SHADE-Arena达到98.8% AUC，超越Opus 5.5文本监控基线，且随底层模型规模增大效果提升；在内省式欺骗评估中，区分含模型真实隐藏目标的对话与含其他目标的对话，AUC最高达99.7%；在开源权重模型上也能轻松检测其在政治敏感话题及受压时关于自身信念的欺骗。
AI.conclusion: 白盒探针方法可有效扩展至前沿监控场景，并能应对上下文难以判断的欺骗情形。作者公开FIBS数据集，推动探针的实际部署，并鼓励社区补充更多欺骗与破坏行为的样本。

title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
summary: Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. At a symmetry-breaking bifurcation, a single input admits multiple equally valid solutions, violating the one-to-one assumption underlying most learned physical surrogates. We introduce Bi-FORK, a generative framework for learning these one-to-many solution maps in high-dimensional systems. Bi-FORK generates complete trajectories through latent flow matching, preserving space and time coherence, and uses repulsion-guided sampling to recover distinct solution branches in a single amortized pass. We evaluate Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, spanning continuous, discrete, and field-valued bifurcations with discretizations up to 260,000 points. Bi-FORK recovers the multimodal solution structure while scaling several orders of magnitude beyond prior approaches, opening generative modeling to high-dimensional bifurcating physical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出Bi-FORK生成框架，通过潜在流匹配与排斥引导采样学习高维物理系统中的一-to-多分岔解映射，可处理高达26万点离散化，覆盖连续、离散和场值分岔。
AI.motivation: 分岔在物理系统中普遍存在，但在深度学习中探索不足。对称破缺分岔处单输入对应多个有效解，违反大多数学习型物理代理的一-to一假设，亟需能学习一-to-多解映射的方法。
AI.method: Bi-FORK通过潜在流匹配生成完整轨迹，保持空间和时间一致性；并使用排斥引导采样在单次摊销过程中恢复不同解分支。
AI.result: 在屈曲梁、机械超材料和Allen-Cahn相分离上评估，覆盖连续、离散和场值分岔，离散化高达260,000点。Bi-FORK恢复多模态解结构，且比先前方法扩展数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Bi-FORK将生成式建模拓展到高维分岔物理系统，为学习一-to-多解映射提供了可扩展方案。
